# 公司研究与跟踪模块 实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 落地规格 `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-04-company-research-design.md`（**第 6 稿**；§0 为规范性修订，与正文冲突时以 §0 为准；owner 决策 §15 A–K 全部取默认值）：公司页 `/stock/[ticker]` 升级为按市场流的事实视图（报表 / 指标 / 文件 / 概览 + 披露历史抽屉 + `asOf` 回放），事实驱动的公司事件物化与按用户跟踪收件箱，覆盖目录 `/intel/companies`，`/api/financials` 读者迁移（DCF、agent 工具、`useFinancials`、consensus mock），全部数值经统一证据门槛。

**Architecture:** 两个迁移（表 + 函数）；`src/lib/company/db.ts` 的 `CompanyDb` 契约有 Supabase / 内存 / pg 三实现；规格二已落地的 `FactsDb` 只读复用，规格二未落地的读能力由本模块适配器提供（`company_read_snapshot` 同快照读、证据索引 `company_fact_evidence` + 读函数、`metric-catalog.ts`、`/api/companies/snapshot`）；事件推导、覆盖汇总、网格构建、证据门槛、DCF 种子全是纯函数；物化 cron 只依赖注入的 `CompanyDb`、`FactsDb`、快照读取器；页面是服务端 `page.tsx` + 客户端视图，UI 按 Claude Design 画布实现。

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 15 App Router、TypeScript、Supabase（PostgreSQL 17 + PostgREST + Storage）、next-intl、vitest、`pg`（集成测试）、Playwright（e2e）、`tsx` 脚本。

**画布：** [公司研究与跟踪 Company Research](https://claude.ai/artifact/RTWzyyWQikDPCdD8VaBLsv)；12 个画板源文件已复制到 `docs/superpowers/plans/assets/2026-11-06-company-canvas/project/*.dc.html`（`Main`=报表视图、`Replay`、`Metrics`、`Filings`、`Overview`、`Drawer`、`States`、`Tracking`、`Directory`、`M-Company`、`M-Drawer`、`M-Tracking`）。UI 任务**必须**先读对应画板；画板里的数值是版式示意，不是数据；画板用的类名（`card`、`chip`、`bdg`、`seg`、`t`、`tabs`…）是画布样式，实现时一律换成 `DESIGN.md` / `globals.css` tokens 与 `src/components/ui` 组件。

实施按 owner 规则：指挥 Opus 5.5；每任务 Sonnet 5.5 实施子代理（`model: sonnet`）→ Opus 规格复审 → Opus 质量复审 → Codex CLI（gpt-6-astra，medium）`codex review` + 对抗挑战 → 修复 P1/P2；记录在 `docs/audits/2026-11-06-company-research/01-implementation-log.md`。

## 仓库约定（动手前必读）

- **工作树**：`/Volumes/AIMATE_WORK/Developer/CodeX/OsbornAlpha/.claude/worktrees/company-research-ebd56f`（分支 `claude/company-research-ebd56f`）。不要 `cd` 出去；不要裸 `git stash`（栈与其他工作树共享）。
- **只读依赖（不得修改）**：`src/lib/facts/*`、`src/lib/facts/providers/*`、`src/app/api/facts/*`、`src/app/api/filings/*`、`supabase/migrations/20261106090000_financial_facts.sql`、`src/lib/entities/*`、`src/lib/dq/*`。需要的能力缺失时在 `src/lib/company/*` 写适配器，并在本计划末尾"接口请求清单"登记。
- **迁移**：`supabase/migrations/20261112090000_company_research.sql`（表、索引、触发器、RLS、授权）与 `supabase/migrations/20261112091000_company_research_functions.sql`（全部函数与其授权）。可重放：`create table if not exists`、`create index if not exists`、`create or replace function`、`drop policy if exists` 后 `create policy`、`drop trigger if exists` 后 `create trigger`。写入 `supabase/migrations.lock.json`（追加 `{file, sha256}`，文件字节的 hex；已锁文件不可再改——所以迁移只在其任务的最后一步锁定，后续任务需要改 SQL 时，只能改**尚未锁定**的文件；Task 2 锁定两个文件之前必须让全部 SQL 定稿）。`scripts/ci/research-checks.ts::migrationInventory` 要求新迁移晚于已锁最新（当前 `20261106090000`）。并行分支占用：计划三 `20261107*`、F3 `20261108*`、F4 `20261109*`、F6 `20261110*`、行业 `20261111*`；本模块只用 `20261112*`。
- **SQL 写法**：函数 `security definer set search_path = ''`，对象全部 `public.` 限定（`pg_catalog` 函数如 `sha256`、`convert_to`、`encode`、`jsonb_*` 不需要限定）；托管实例 `postgres` 角色非超级用户，函数 owner 就是迁移角色，不要 `alter function … owner to`。每个函数后 `revoke execute on function … from public, anon, authenticated;` 再 `grant execute … to <角色>`（Supabase 默认给 anon/authenticated 新函数 EXECUTE）。新表先 `revoke all on table … from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;` 再按规格 §4.6 + §0 #64 授权。
- **本地 harness**：`test:db`（`scripts/ci/research-db.ts`）启动本地 PostgreSQL 17、按序执行全部迁移、再跑 vitest；本地只建了 `storage.buckets` 五列，迁移不得引用 `storage.objects`。本地 PostgREST `max_rows=1000`：返回多行的函数一律返回单个 `jsonb`。
- **集成测试**：读 `process.env.S4_TEST_STATE`（JSON，含 `adminUrl` 等），`describe.skipIf(!enabled)`。**任何包含字符串 `S4_TEST_STATE` 的 `.test.ts` 都必须加进 `scripts/ci/research-checks.ts::criticalSuites`**（放在 `// COMPANY` 注释块里），否则 `test:db` 报 "Database suite inventory drift"。迁移重放助手 `replayMigration` 未导出：从 `src/lib/facts/facts.integration.test.ts:26` 复制到本模块测试文件。角色切换用 `set local role anon|authenticated|service_role` + `set local request.jwt.claims = '{"sub":"<uuid>","role":"authenticated"}'`（参照 `src/lib/facts/facts.integration.test.ts` 的写法）。
- **只跑一个 DB 测试文件**：工作树 `.claude/scratch/db-one.ts`（未提交；内容见 `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-04-HANDOFF-data-foundation-2-execution.md` §5，丢了按那里重建），用法 `LC_ALL=C PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin:$PATH npx tsx .claude/scratch/db-one.ts src/lib/company/company-research.integration.test.ts`。`LC_ALL=C` 只给 `test:db`/`test:migrations`/`db-one`，**不要**导出给 `npm test`。
- **共享文件改动隔离**（并行分支要合并）：`src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts`、`scripts/ci/research-checks.ts`、`vercel.json`（JSON 无注释：只追加一个 cron 对象，不重排）、`src/i18n/request.ts::MESSAGE_DOMAINS`、`src/i18n/messages-parity.test.ts` 的改动都包在 `// COMPANY` 起止注释内。
- **Supabase 客户端**：公共读 `getAnonSupabase()`（`src/lib/supabase/anon.ts`）；服务端特权 `getAdminSupabase()`（`src/lib/supabase/admin.ts`）；会话 `await getServerSupabase()`（`src/lib/supabase/server.ts`）。管理员门禁 `requireAdminUser()`（`src/lib/admin/auth.ts`）；cron 鉴权 `authorizedCronRequest(header, process.env.CRON_SECRET)`（`src/lib/observability/cron-auth.ts`）。批次 `startBatch/finishBatch`（`src/lib/dq/batches.ts`，`INFO_CODES` 已含 `deadline_hit`），新鲜度 `recordAttempt/freshnessOf`（`src/lib/dq/freshness.ts`）。`TableClient` 见 `src/lib/db/table-client.ts`。
- **规格二读接口（只读复用）**：`FactsDb`（`src/lib/facts/types.ts`）、`supabaseFactsDb`（`src/lib/facts/db.ts`）、`publicClients()`、`resolvePublicIssuer`、`readParams/dateParam/intParam/listParam/asOfParam/flagParam`、`QueryError`、`errorResponse`、`paramErrorResponse`、`failureResponse`、`successHeaders`、`STALE_CACHE_CONTROL`、`FRESH_METRICS_CACHE_CONTROL`、`citationOf`、`publicFiling`、`publicFact`、`isPublished`、`TICKER_RE`（`src/lib/facts/public-route.ts`）；`deriveMetrics`、`FORMULA_VERSION`、`Q_SINGLE_CONCEPTS`、`DERIVE_CONCEPTS`、`metricNames`（`derive.ts`）；`FACT_CONCEPTS`、`conceptById`、`MAPPING_GEN`、`MAPPING_VERSION`（`concepts.ts`）；`parseCompanyFacts`（`providers/edgar-companyfacts.ts`）、`parseTushareStatements`（`providers/tushare-statements.ts`）、`rawHashOf`（`providers/shared.ts`）、`SNAPSHOT_BUCKET`、`snapshotPath`、`metaPath`（`snapshot-store.ts`）。解析器返回的候选在运行时带额外的 `locator` 字段（`FactCandidate & {locator:string}`）。
- **路由约定**（规格 §6 + §0）：`export const dynamic='force-dynamic'`；参数用 `readParams(url, allowed)`（重复 → 400 `invalid_parameter:<name>`）；票据一律 `resolvePublicIssuer`（§0 #69）；错误与空结果 `Cache-Control: no-store`；成功用 `successHeaders(now, asOf, empty)`；公共端点不读会话；按用户端点 `private, no-store`、未登录 401 `not_authenticated`；管理端点 `requireAdminUser()` + `private, no-store`。

- **环境变量**：`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`、`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`、`SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`、`CRON_SECRET`、`VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA`（cron 的 `code_version`；缺失 → 503，与 facts-sync cron 一致）、`NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPANY_F3_DRAWER`、`NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPANY_JUDGMENTS`（缺省关闭）。本机无 `TUSHARE_TOKEN` 时 CN 用规格二的合成夹具 `src/lib/facts/fixtures/tushare/_synthetic/`；`TUSHARE_TOKEN` 在 `~/.config/osbornalpha/secrets.env`，绝不打印。

## 共享契约（所有任务必须用这些名字；`src/lib/company/types.ts` 原样落地）

```ts
// src/lib/company/types.ts
// Shared contract of the company research module (plan 2026-11-06 §共享契约; spec §4, §5.3,
// §5.6, §6, §0). Every task uses these names verbatim. CompanyDb has three implementations:
// supabaseCompanyDb (db.ts, rpc + from), memoryCompanyDb (unit tests), pgCompanyDb (integration).
import type {Market,FactRow,FilingRow,Duration,MetricDuration} from '@/lib/facts/types';
export type {Market};

export type EventKind='filing_published'|'period_first_seen'|'fact_revised';
export const EVENT_KINDS:readonly EventKind[]=['filing_published','period_first_seen','fact_revised'];

/** What deriveIssuerEvents produces and replace_company_digest accepts (event_id/payload_hash are server-computed). */
export interface EventInput{
 kind:EventKind;natural_key:string;occurred_on:string;period_end:string|null;concept:string|null;filing_id:string|null;
 payload:Record<string,unknown>;meta:Record<string,unknown>;
}
/** A stored issuer_events row (service_role only, §0 #64). */
export interface EventRow extends EventInput{
 event_id:string;issuer_id:string;market:Market;payload_hash:string;based_on_rev:number;
 first_seen_at:string;payload_changed_at:string|null;retired_at:string|null;rebuilt_at:string;rebuild_id:string;rebuild_batch_id:string;
}
export interface CitationSummary{linked:number;pending:number;edgar:number}
export interface CoverageInput{
 filings_count:number;facts_count:number;concepts_covered:number;
 earliest_period_end:string|null;latest_period_end:string|null;latest_available_date:string|null;
 citation_summary:CitationSummary;scope_last_success_at:string|null;scope_last_status:'success'|'failed'|null;
}
export interface CoverageRow extends CoverageInput{issuer_id:string;market:Market;based_on_rev:number;rebuilt_at:string;rebuild_id:string;rebuild_batch_id:string}
export interface WatchRow{user_id:string;issuer_id:string;note:string|null;muted:boolean;created_at:string;updated_at:string}
export interface DigestStateRow{
 issuer_id:string;market:Market;digested_rev:number;attempt_seq:number;last_attempt_id:number|null;
 last_success_attempt_id:number|null;last_failed_attempt_id:number|null;last_attempt_at:string|null;
 last_status:'success'|'failed'|null;consecutive_failures:number;next_attempt_at:string;swept_at:string|null;updated_at:string;
}
export interface DueStream{issuerId:string;market:Market;stateRev:number;digestedRev:number}
export interface ReplaceResult{upserted:number;changed:number;retired:number;revived:number}

/** One verified association fact → snapshot (company_fact_evidence, §0.1 item 2). */
export interface EvidenceIndexRow{
 fact_id:string;raw_hash:string;snapshot_sha256:string;snapshot_path:string;hash_locator:string;json_pointer:string;field:string|null;
 source:'edgar'|'tushare';api:string|null;url:string|null;params:Record<string,unknown>|null;
 captured_at:string|null;http_status:number|null;page:number|null;index_version:string;
}
export const EVIDENCE_INDEX_VERSION='company-evidence/1';
/** Output of company_fact_evidence(fact_ids) per fact (joined server-side with run → batch). */
export interface EvidenceRecord extends EvidenceIndexRow{run_id:string;code_version:string|null;tool_versions:Record<string,unknown>|null;mapping_version:string}
export interface PdfLocator{page:number;table:string|null;row:string;column:string;documentUrl:string}

/** §0 #62 — the DTO every financial-value response carries in its `evidence` dictionary. */
export interface EvidenceDto{
 factId:string;rawHash:string;
 snapshot:{source:'edgar'|'tushare';sha256:string;path:string;api:string|null;url:string|null;params:Record<string,unknown>|null;capturedAt:string|null;httpStatus:number|null;page:number|null;download:string|null};
 locator:{hashLocator:string;jsonPointer:string;field:string|null;pdf:PdfLocator|null};
 run:{runId:string;codeVersion:string|null;toolVersions:Record<string,unknown>|null};
 mappingVersion:string;unitRule:string|null;
 sourceDocument:{kind:'edgar_index'|'cninfo_pdf';url:string}|null;
}
export type WithheldReason='evidence_incomplete'|'citation_pending';
export interface WithheldCell{kind:'withheld';reason:WithheldReason;factId:string}
export interface FactCell{kind:'fact';factId:string;value:string;unit:string;availableDate:string;filingId:string;disclosureSeq:number;isRevision:boolean;mappingGen:number;rawHash:string;runId:string;otherUnits:boolean}
export interface DerivedCell{kind:'derived';metric:string;value:string;unit:string;inputUnit:string;basis:string;formulaVersion:string;inputs:{factId:string;concept:string;filingId:string;availableDate:string}[];rule?:'a'|'b'}
/** Grid cell (spec §5.3). null = no visible fact in the row's primary unit for this period (periods with only other-unit facts are listed in statements-grid GridResult.otherUnitOnly → "—" + U). `otherUnits` drives the U badge on a value cell. */
export type Cell=FactCell|DerivedCell|WithheldCell|null;
export interface WithheldCounts{evidenceIncomplete:number;citationPending:number}

export type StatementKind='IS'|'BS'|'CF';
export type Basis='disclosed'|'annual'|'quarterly';
export interface PeriodCol{key:string;periodStart:string;periodEnd:string;duration:Duration|MetricDuration}
export interface GridRow{concept:string;unit:string|null;unitKind:'money'|'shares'|'per_share'|'ratio';sourceConcepts:string[];notes:string|null;cells:Record<string,Cell>}
export interface FilingSummary{filingId:string;formType:string;fiscalYear:number|null;fiscalPeriod:string|null;periodEnd:string|null;availableDate:string;sourceRef:string;source:'edgar'|'tushare';url:string|null;documentUrl:string|null;citation:'edgar'|'linked'|'pending';linkAttempts:number;factCount:number;mappingGen:number}

/** company_read_snapshot result: read_facts envelope + same-statement filings (§0.1 item 3). */
export interface ReadSnapshotResult{stateRev:number;rows:FactRow[];truncated:boolean;filings:FilingSummary[]}
export interface ReadSnapshotOptions{concepts:string[]|null;asOf:string;from?:string|null;to?:string|null;history:boolean;limit?:number}

export class CompanyDbError extends Error{constructor(public code:'stale_computation'|'stale_attempt'|'invalid_event'|'unknown_stream'|'watch_limit'|'invalid_read'|'invalid_evidence'|'internal',message?:string){super(message??code);this.name='CompanyDbError';}}

export interface InboxRow extends EventRow{read:boolean}
export interface CompanyDb{
 // digest (service_role)
 digestDue(now:Date,limit:number,market?:Market):Promise<DueStream[]>;   // market filter applies before the limit (plan audit Q6)
 sweepDue(olderThan:Date,now:Date,limit:number,market?:Market):Promise<DueStream[]>;
 beginAttempt(issuer:string,market:Market,now:Date):Promise<number>;
 replaceDigest(issuer:string,market:Market,batch:string,attemptId:number,rebuildId:string,basedOnRev:number,sweep:boolean,events:EventInput[],coverage:CoverageInput):Promise<ReplaceResult>;
 markDigestFailed(issuer:string,market:Market,attemptId:number,now:Date):Promise<boolean>;
 backlog():Promise<{failedStreams:number}>;
 digestState(issuer:string,market:Market):Promise<DigestStateRow|null>;
 replaceEvidence(issuer:string,market:Market,rows:EvidenceIndexRow[]):Promise<{upserted:number;deleted:number}>;
 // reads behind the evidence gate (service_role; routes assemble + gate server-side, §0 #64)
 eventsOfIssuer(issuer:string,market:Market,opts:{since?:string;until?:string;kinds?:EventKind[];cursor?:string|null;limit:number}):Promise<{rows:EventRow[];nextCursor:string|null}>;
 eventsOfIssuers(issuers:string[],opts:{kinds?:EventKind[];cursor?:string|null;limit:number}):Promise<{rows:EventRow[];nextCursor:string|null}>;
 evidenceOf(factIds:string[]):Promise<Map<string,EvidenceRecord>>;   // rpc company_fact_evidence, ≤100 per call (batches internally)
 // public reads (anon)
 coverageOf(issuers:string[]):Promise<CoverageRow[]>;
 listCoverage(filter:{market?:Market;issuerIds?:string[]},sort:'latest_available_date'|'latest_period_end'|'name',page:{offset:number;limit:number}):Promise<{rows:CoverageRow[];total:number}>;
 // per user (session client, RLS)
 watchesOf(userId:string):Promise<WatchRow[]>;
 upsertWatch(userId:string,issuerId:string):Promise<{row:WatchRow;created:boolean}>;   // watch_limit → CompanyDbError('watch_limit')
 patchWatch(userId:string,issuerId:string,patch:{note?:string|null;muted?:boolean}):Promise<WatchRow|null>;
 deleteWatch(userId:string,issuerId:string):Promise<boolean>;
 markRead(userId:string,issuerId:string,eventIds:string[]):Promise<{inserted:number}>;
 readEventIds(userId:string,eventIds:string[]):Promise<Set<string>>;
}
```

### SQL 函数签名（Task 2 原样实现；全部返回 jsonb 或标量）

| 函数 | 语言/安全 | 授权 | 规格 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `begin_company_digest_attempt(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_now timestamptz) → bigint` | plpgsql definer | service_role | §4.6 |
| `replace_company_digest(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_batch uuid, p_attempt_id bigint, p_rebuild_id uuid, p_based_on_rev bigint, p_sweep boolean, p_events jsonb, p_coverage jsonb) → jsonb` | plpgsql definer | service_role | §4.6 ①–⑨ |
| `mark_company_digest_failed(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_attempt_id bigint, p_now timestamptz) → boolean` | plpgsql definer | service_role | §4.6 + §0 #70 |
| `replace_company_fact_evidence(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_rows jsonb) → jsonb {upserted, deleted}` | plpgsql definer | service_role | §0.1 item 2：每行 `fact_id` 必须属于该流；整流替换（不在 p_rows 中的旧行删除） |
| `company_fact_evidence(p_fact_ids uuid[]) → jsonb` | sql/plpgsql definer stable | anon, authenticated, service_role | §0.1 item 2：≤100；只 ok + published run + 当前代；白名单字段 |
| `company_read_snapshot(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_concepts text[], p_as_of date, p_from date, p_to date, p_history boolean, p_limit int) → jsonb {facts: <read_facts 信封>, filings: [...]}` | sql **invoker** stable | anon, authenticated, service_role | §0.1 item 3 |
| `company_digest_due(p_now timestamptz, p_limit int, p_market text default null) → jsonb`、`company_sweep_due(p_older_than timestamptz, p_now timestamptz, p_limit int, p_market text default null) → jsonb`、`company_digest_backlog() → int` | sql definer stable | service_role | §4.7（`fact_sync_scope` 对 service_role 只读，left join 需一条语句）；`company_sweep_due` 只选 `state_rev > 0` |
| `company_list_coverage(p_market text, p_issuer_ids uuid[], p_sort text, p_offset int, p_limit int) → jsonb {rows, total}` | plpgsql **invoker** stable | anon, authenticated, service_role | §8；`listCoverage` 三实现都调它（`sort='name'` 需联 `issuers` 排序后分页） |
| 内部助手 `company_canonical_json(jsonb) → text`、`company_ev_keys/_text/_date/_int/_uuid/_fact/_filing/_side/_check`、`company_cov_check`、`company_evidence_check` | definer | **不授任何客户端角色** | §4.6 ⑤、事件/覆盖/证据校验 |
| 触发器函数 `company_watches_limit()`（≥200 → `watch_limit`）、`company_watches_touch()`、`company_event_reads_check()`（Task 1 表迁移） | plpgsql | 触发器 | 决策 F、§4.3 |

错误码（函数消息首词 = `CompanyDbError.code`）：`unknown_stream`、`stale_computation`、`stale_attempt`、`invalid_event`、`invalid_evidence`、`invalid_read`、`watch_limit`；`invalid_attempt`/`invalid_batch`/`invalid_now`/`immutable_watch_key` → `internal`；`markRead` 的外键失败 → `invalid_read`。函数内"今天" = `(now() at time zone 'UTC')::date`；TS 侧 digest `cutoff` 同为 UTC 日期。

`replace_company_digest` 的 canonical JSON（§4.6 ⑤）与 `src/lib/company/canonical.ts`（Task 2 建）必须逐字节一致：对象键按 Unicode 码点升序、无空白、字符串按 JSON 转义（与 `JSON.stringify` 相同）、数值一律以字符串出现（payload 中的值字段本来就是 `value_text` 字符串；整数计数如 `factCount`、`conceptCount` 以 JSON 数字出现，SQL 侧用 `jsonb` 的文本输出前先自建 canonical 序列化函数 `public.company_canonical_json(jsonb) → text`，不要依赖 `jsonb::text`（它在 `:` 与 `,` 后加空格））。Task 2 的集成测试断言 SQL 与 TS 对同一组 payload 的 `event_id`/`payload_hash` 相等。

### 事件 payload 固定 schema（Task 2 SQL 校验与 Task 5 TS 产出共用）

```
filing_published   payload {formType:string, fiscalYear:int|null, fiscalPeriod:string|null, periodEnd:date|null, availableDate:date, sourceRef:string, factCount:int}   meta {}
period_first_seen  payload {periodStart:date, periodEnd:date, duration:string, filingId:uuid, conceptCount:int, headline:{[k in revenue|revenue_operating|net_income_parent|operating_cash_flow]?:{factId:uuid,value:string,unit:string}}, ambiguousUnits:string[]}   meta {headlineAsOf:date}
fact_revised       payload {concept, statement, periodStart:date, periodEnd:date, duration, consolidation:'consolidated', unit, from:{factId,value,filingId,availableDate}, to:{factId,value,filingId,availableDate}, relChange?:string}   meta {}
```
`relChange` 为精确十进制字符串（Task 5 `decimalRelChange(from,to)`：10 位小数、四舍五入远离零，再去尾零成规范形，如 `'0.2'`；`from=0` 时省略）。SQL 只校验出现条件（当且仅当 `from` 数值 ≠ 0）与格式 `^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$`（去尾零与否都接受），不重算数值。payload 中 `value` 必须等于对应事实的 `value_text`（函数校验）。所有 kind 的顶层键恰为 `kind, natural_key, occurred_on, period_end, concept, filing_id, payload, meta`；`filing_published`：`natural_key = filing_id`、`concept = null`、payload 与 filings 行逐项相等（含 `factCount`，故 digest 以全部概念读取）；`fact_revised`：`filing_id`/`concept` 取自 `to`，INSTANT 的 `periodStart = periodEnd`，每个自然键序列按可得日期折叠（同日只留最后一条），自然键末段为 `to.availableDate`。Task 3 `db-contract.ts` 的 `filingPublishedOf`/`factRevisedOf` 与 Task 5 `deriveIssuerEvents` 逐键一致。

## Part A：迁移、函数、`CompanyDb` 契约与三实现（Tasks 1–4）

本部分对骨架的修订与补充（**已由整合编辑并入**"文件结构"与"SQL 函数签名"）：

- **`canonical.ts` 改由 Task 2 创建**（连同 `canonical.test.ts`），因为 Task 2 的集成测试要断言 SQL 与 TS 逐字节一致；Task 3 只使用它。文件结构表中 `src/lib/company/canonical.ts` 一行改为"（Task 2）"，并增加 `src/lib/company/canonical.test.ts（Task 2）`。
- **骨架之外新增的 SQL 对象**（都在 Task 2 的函数迁移里，除触发器外）：
  - 触发器函数 `company_watches_limit()`、`company_watches_touch()`、`company_event_reads_check()`（Task 1，表迁移）。
  - 公共读 `company_list_coverage(p_market text, p_issuer_ids uuid[], p_sort text, p_offset int, p_limit int) → jsonb {rows, total}`（`plpgsql stable security invoker`，授 anon/authenticated/service_role）。指挥决定：`listCoverage` 的 `sort='name'` 需要联 `issuers` 排序后分页，PostgREST 无法在父表上按被嵌入列排序后再 `range()`，所以三个实现统一调用此函数。
  - 内部助手（不授任何客户端角色）：`company_canonical_json(jsonb) → text`、`company_ev_keys`、`company_ev_text`、`company_ev_date`、`company_ev_int`、`company_ev_uuid`、`company_ev_fact`、`company_ev_filing`、`company_ev_side`、`company_ev_check`、`company_cov_check`、`company_evidence_check`。
- **错误消息与 SQLSTATE**（消息就是代码，`db.ts::toCompanyDbError` 按消息首词映射）：`unknown_stream`（P0002）、`stale_computation`（55P03，规格 §4.6 原文）、`stale_attempt`（P0001）、`invalid_event`（22023，`detail` 说明哪一项）、`invalid_evidence`（22023）、`invalid_read`（22023 函数参数；23514 回执触发器）、`watch_limit`（23514）、`invalid_attempt` / `invalid_batch` / `invalid_now`（22023，程序错误路径 → `internal`）、`immutable_watch_key`（23514 → `internal`）、`company_test_fault`（P0001，仅测试开关）。
- **"今天"**：函数内一律用 `(now() at time zone 'UTC')::date`（不是 `current_date`，与会话时区无关）。指挥决定：digest 的 TS 侧 `cutoff` 也是 UTC 日期（Part B Task 5/8 必须用 `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)`）。

### Task 1: 表迁移 + RLS/授权 + 触发器 + Row 类型 + 集成测试骨架

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/migrations/20261112090000_company_research.sql`
- Create: `src/lib/company/company-research.integration.test.ts`
- Modify: `scripts/ci/research-checks.ts`（`criticalSuites`，`// COMPANY` 块）
- Modify: `src/lib/supabase/database.types.ts`（`// COMPANY` 块：六个 Row 类型 + `Tables` 登记）

本任务**不锁定**迁移：Task 2 写函数时可能还需要调整表（列、约束、索引），所以两个迁移文件都在 Task 2 最后一步一起写入 `supabase/migrations.lock.json`。Task 1 完成后 `npm run test:migrations` 不在本任务的门禁里（未锁文件不影响 `migrationInventory`，因为 `20261112090000 > 20261106090000`）。

表的要点（实现者不读规格，以下为全部要求）：

| 表 | 内容 | 授权（§4.6 + §0 #64） |
|---|---|---|
| `issuer_events` | 事实事件时间线；`event_id` = 服务端计算的 64 位 hex；`unique (issuer_id, market, kind, natural_key)`；`payload`/`meta` 必须是 JSON 对象；墓碑 `retired_at`；`rebuild_id` 每次 replace 一个；`rebuild_batch_id → ingest_batches` | 只 `select` 给 service_role |
| `issuer_coverage` | 每 (发行人, 市场) 一行计数与日期，无财务数值 | `select` 给 anon/authenticated/service_role，RLS `using (true)` |
| `company_watches` | 按用户跟踪；`note` ≤ 2000 字符；上限 `MAX_COMPANY_WATCHES = 200` 由触发器 `company_watches_limit` 强制（`pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('company_watches:' || user_id))`；同一 `(user_id, issuer_id)` 已存在 → 放行给主键冲突处理；否则计数 ≥ 200 → `raise 'watch_limit' using errcode='23514'`）；`company_watches_touch` 维护 `updated_at`、禁止改键 | authenticated：select/insert/update/delete，RLS own-rows；service_role 同四项；anon 无 |
| `company_event_reads` | 已读回执，按 event_id；`(user_id, issuer_id) → company_watches` `on delete cascade`（取消跟踪清回执）；`event_id → issuer_events` `on delete cascade`；触发器 `company_event_reads_check` 拒绝 event 不属于 issuer 的回执（`invalid_read`，23514） | authenticated：select/insert/delete（无 update），RLS own-rows；service_role 同三项；anon 无 |
| `company_digest_state` | 物化游标与尝试归属（含 `last_failed_attempt_id`） | 只 `select` 给 service_role |
| `company_fact_evidence` | 证据索引（§0.1 item 2）；`fact_id` pk → `financial_facts` `on delete cascade` | 只 `select` 给 service_role |

所有表：`enable row level security`；先 `revoke all … from public, anon, authenticated, service_role`；**公共/物化表（events、coverage、digest_state、evidence）对任何角色都没有 insert/update/delete/truncate**，写只经 Task 2 的 `security definer` 函数。

指挥决定（Task 1）：
- `company_fact_evidence` 额外存 `issuer_id`、`market`（规格列表之外）：`replace_company_fact_evidence` 需要"整流替换"时按流删除旧行，联 `financial_facts` 求流也可，但冗余列 + 索引更直接；函数保证它与事实行一致。
- `company_event_reads_check` 与 `company_watches_limit` 是 `security definer`：前者以 authenticated 身份运行时读不到 `issuer_events`（无授权），后者计数必须看到该用户全部行。
- RLS 策略写 `(select auth.uid()) = user_id`（initplan，每语句求值一次）。
- `company_watches_touch`：`before update` 设 `updated_at = now()`；`user_id`/`issuer_id`/`created_at` 变化 → `immutable_watch_key`（23514）。键不可改，否则回执的复合外键会悬空。
- 本地 harness 的 `auth.uid()` 读 `request.jwt.claim.sub`，托管 Supabase 读 `request.jwt.claims` 的 `sub`；测试两者都设。

- [ ] **Step 1: 写集成测试骨架（真实 PostgreSQL，先失败）**

```ts
// src/lib/company/company-research.integration.test.ts
// Company research on real PostgreSQL (spec §4, §4.6, §12.2, §0 #64 #70, §0.1 items 2–3): the two
// company migrations — tables, constraints, triggers, RLS and grants under real roles (Task 1); the
// digest / evidence / snapshot / selection functions with two-connection interleavings and the
// SQL-vs-TS canonical ids (Task 2); the pgCompanyDb contract (Task 4). Rows are never cleaned up:
// test:db creates a fresh database for every run, and every test uses its own issuers and users.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {createHash,randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {Pool} from 'pg';
import type {PoolClient} from 'pg';
import {afterAll,beforeAll,describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';

const enabled=!!process.env.S4_TEST_STATE;
const TABLES_MIGRATION='supabase/migrations/20261112090000_company_research.sql';
const FUNCTIONS_MIGRATION='supabase/migrations/20261112091000_company_research_functions.sql';
const TABLES=['issuer_events','issuer_coverage','company_watches','company_event_reads','company_digest_state','company_fact_evidence'];
const SERVICE_ONLY=['issuer_events','company_digest_state','company_fact_evidence'];
const NO_DIRECT_WRITE=['issuer_events','issuer_coverage','company_digest_state','company_fact_evidence'];
type Market='US'|'CN';
type Role='anon'|'authenticated'|'service_role';

// Same replay policy as src/lib/facts/facts.integration.test.ts (not exported there): one transaction,
// short lock_timeout, retry on lock timeout (55P03) and deadlock (40P01).
const RETRYABLE=new Set(['55P03','40P01']);
async function replayMigration(pool:Pool,sql:string,attempts=10):Promise<void>{
 for(let attempt=1;;attempt++){
  const c=await pool.connect();
  try{
   await c.query(`begin; set local lock_timeout='3s';\n${sql}\n;commit;`);
   return;
  }catch(e){
   await c.query('rollback').catch(()=>{});
   const code=(e as {code?:string}).code;
   if(attempt>=attempts||!code||!RETRYABLE.has(code))throw e;
   await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250*attempt+Math.floor(Math.random()*250)));
  }finally{c.release();}
 }
}

/** One open transaction on its own connection, optionally as a client role with JWT claims (local auth.uid() reads request.jwt.claim.sub; hosted reads request.jwt.claims). */
interface Tx{c:PoolClient;pid:number;commit():Promise<void>;rollback():Promise<void>}
async function openTx(pool:Pool,o:{role?:Role;userId?:string}={}):Promise<Tx>{
 const c=await pool.connect();let done=false;
 try{
  await c.query('begin');
  if(o.userId)await c.query(`select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',$1,true), set_config('request.jwt.claims',$2,true)`,[o.userId,JSON.stringify({sub:o.userId,role:o.role??'authenticated'})]);
  if(o.role)await c.query(`set local role ${o.role}`);   // o.role is a fixed literal union
 }catch(e){c.release(e as Error);throw e;}
 const pid=Number((await c.query('select pg_backend_pid() p')).rows[0].p);
 const end=async(sql:string)=>{if(done)return;done=true;try{await c.query(sql);c.release();}catch(e){c.release(e as Error);throw e;}};
 return {c,pid,commit:()=>end('commit'),rollback:()=>end('rollback')};
}
/** Runs body in one transaction (as role/user when given); commits on success, rolls back and rethrows on failure. */
async function inTx<T>(pool:Pool,o:{role?:Role;userId?:string},body:(tx:Tx)=>Promise<T>):Promise<T>{
 const tx=await openTx(pool,o);
 try{const out=await body(tx);await tx.commit();return out;}
 catch(e){await tx.rollback().catch(()=>{});throw e;}
}
/** Deterministic "is blocked": polls (20 ms, <= 3 s) until some backend waits on `pid`, then asserts p is still pending. */
async function stillBlockedBehind(pool:Pool,pid:number,p:Promise<unknown>):Promise<void>{
 let settled=false;p.then(()=>{settled=true;},()=>{settled=true;});
 for(const deadline=Date.now()+3000;;){
  const n=Number((await pool.query(`select count(*)::int n from pg_stat_activity where $1 = any(pg_blocking_pids(pid))`,[pid])).rows[0].n);
  if(n>=1)break;
  if(settled||Date.now()>deadline)throw new Error(`no backend blocked behind pid ${pid} (settled=${settled})`);
  await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));
 }
 expect(settled).toBe(false);
}
type PgErr={message:string;code?:string;detail?:string};
/** Resolves with the rejection (message + SQLSTATE + detail) so tests can assert all three. */
const fails=(p:Promise<unknown>)=>p.then(()=>{throw new Error('expected rejection');},e=>e as PgErr);
const hex=(s:string)=>createHash('sha256').update(s,'utf8').digest('hex');

interface FactSpec{fact_id?:string;concept?:string;statement?:string;period_start?:string|null;period_end?:string;duration?:string;value?:string;unit?:string;raw_hash?:string}
interface FilingSpec{sourceRef?:string;available?:string;form?:string;fiscalYear?:number|null;fiscalPeriod?:string|null;periodEnd?:string|null;facts?:FactSpec[]}
interface Published{run:string;filingIds:string[];factIds:string[][]}
interface Stream extends Published{iss:string;market:Market;factsBatch:string}

/** Fixtures over the admin (superuser) pool: issuers, users, batches, and published fact streams built with the landed facts functions. */
function fixtures(pool:Pool){
 const q=async(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>(await pool.query(text,values)).rows as Record<string,any>[];
 const one=async(text:string,values:unknown[]=[])=>(await q(text,values))[0]?.v;
 const issuer=async(name='ZZ Company Test')=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_en) values($1,$2)`,[id,name]);return id;};
 const issuers=async(n:number)=>(await q(`insert into public.issuers(issuer_id,canonical_name_en) select gen_random_uuid(),'ZZ Company Bulk '||g from generate_series(1,$1::int) g returning issuer_id`,[n])).map(r=>String(r.issuer_id));
 const user=async()=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into auth.users(id,email) values($1,$2)`,[id,`${id}@example.test`]);return id;};
 const batch=async(producer='company-digest',dataset='company.digest')=>{const id=randomUUID();await q(`insert into public.ingest_batches(batch_id,producer,dataset,code_version,tool_versions) values($1,$2,$3,'test-sha','{"node":"test"}'::jsonb)`,[id,producer,dataset]);return id;};
 const scope=(iss:string,market:Market)=>one(`select public.reconcile_fact_sync_scope($1,$2::jsonb) v`,[market,JSON.stringify([{issuer_id:iss,reasons:['test'],priority:10,fetch_key:'0000000001'}])]);
 const filingRow=(market:Market,f:FilingSpec,sourceRef:string)=>market==='US'
  ?{filing_id:randomUUID(),source:'edgar',origin:'sec',form_type:f.form??'10-K',fiscal_year:f.fiscalYear===undefined?2023:f.fiscalYear,fiscal_period:f.fiscalPeriod===undefined?'FY':f.fiscalPeriod,period_end:f.periodEnd===undefined?'2023-12-31':f.periodEnd,available_date:f.available??'2024-02-01',source_ref:sourceRef,url:'https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1/x.htm'}
  :{filing_id:randomUUID(),source:'tushare',origin:'sse',form_type:f.form??'annual',fiscal_year:f.fiscalYear===undefined?2023:f.fiscalYear,fiscal_period:f.fiscalPeriod===undefined?'FY':f.fiscalPeriod,period_end:f.periodEnd===undefined?'2023-12-31':f.periodEnd,available_date:f.available??'2024-03-30',source_ref:sourceRef,url:null};
 /** One run on an existing scope: stage the filings (an existing sourceRef reuses its filing) and their facts, publish. state_rev + 1. */
 const publish=async(iss:string,market:Market,factsBatch:string,filings:FilingSpec[],gen=1):Promise<Published>=>{
  expect(await one(`select public.claim_fact_sync_lease($1,$2,$3,600) v`,[iss,market,factsBatch])).toBe(true);
  const run=String(await one(`select public.begin_sync_run($1,$2,$3,$4) v`,[iss,market,factsBatch,gen]));
  const filingIds:string[]=[];const factIds:string[][]=[];
  for(const f of filings){
   const sourceRef=f.sourceRef??randomUUID();const row=filingRow(market,f,sourceRef);
   const m=await one(`select public.stage_filings($1,$2::jsonb) v`,[run,JSON.stringify([row])]) as Record<string,string>;
   const fid=m[sourceRef];filingIds.push(fid);
   const facts=(f.facts??[]).map(x=>{const duration=x.duration??'12M';return {fact_id:x.fact_id??randomUUID(),filing_id:fid,concept:x.concept??'revenue',source_concept:'Revenues',
    statement:x.statement??(duration==='INSTANT'?'BS':'IS'),period_start:duration==='INSTANT'?null:(x.period_start??'2023-01-01'),period_end:x.period_end??'2023-12-31',duration,
    value:x.value??'100',unit:x.unit??(market==='US'?'USD':'CNY'),consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:row.available_date,mapping_version:`facts-map/${gen}`,raw_hash:x.raw_hash??'h'};});
   if(facts.length)expect(await one(`select public.stage_facts($1,$2::jsonb) v`,[run,JSON.stringify(facts)])).toBe(facts.length);
   factIds.push(facts.map(x=>x.fact_id));
  }
  await one(`select public.publish_sync_run($1,$2::uuid[]) v`,[run,filingIds]);
  return {run,filingIds,factIds};
 };
 /** A fresh issuer with a scope row and one published run (state_rev = 1). */
 const stream=async(filings:FilingSpec[],market:Market='US'):Promise<Stream>=>{
  const iss=await issuer();expect(await scope(iss,market)).toBe(1);
  const factsBatch=await batch('facts-sync',market==='US'?'facts.us':'facts.cn');
  return {iss,market,factsBatch,...await publish(iss,market,factsBatch,filings)};
 };
 const rev=(iss:string,market:Market)=>one(`select public.fact_state_rev($1,$2) v`,[iss,market]).then(Number);
 /** Raw issuer_events row written as the superuser (Task 1 tests only; Task 2+ write through replace_company_digest). */
 const rawEvent=async(iss:string,market:Market,b:string,o:{kind?:string;natural_key?:string;payload?:unknown;filing_id?:string|null}={})=>{
  const id=hex(randomUUID());
  await q(`insert into public.issuer_events(event_id,issuer_id,market,kind,natural_key,occurred_on,payload,payload_hash,based_on_rev,rebuild_id,rebuild_batch_id,filing_id)
   values($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,'2024-02-01',$6::jsonb,$7,1,gen_random_uuid(),$8,$9)`,[id,iss,market,o.kind??'filing_published',o.natural_key??randomUUID(),JSON.stringify(o.payload??{}),hex('p'),b,o.filing_id??null]);
  return id;
 };
 return {q,one,issuer,issuers,user,batch,scope,publish,stream,rev,rawEvent};
}

describe.skipIf(!enabled)('company research tables on real PostgreSQL',()=>{
 let admin:Pool;let fx:ReturnType<typeof fixtures>;
 beforeAll(async()=>{
  const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.env.S4_TEST_STATE!,'utf8'));
  admin=new Pool({connectionString:state.adminUrl,statement_timeout:10000});fx=fixtures(admin);
 });
 afterAll(async()=>{await admin?.end();});
 const priv=(role:string,t:string,p:string)=>fx.one(`select has_table_privilege($1,'public.'||$2,$3) v`,[role,t,p]);

 it('creates six RLS tables with the §4.6/§0 #64 grant matrix and three triggers, and replays twice',async()=>{
  const rows=await fx.q(`select c.relname,c.relrowsecurity from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relname=any($1)`,[TABLES]);
  expect(rows.map(r=>r.relname).sort()).toEqual([...TABLES].sort());for(const r of rows)expect({t:r.relname,rls:r.relrowsecurity}).toEqual({t:r.relname,rls:true});
  for(const role of ['anon','authenticated','service_role'] as const){
   for(const t of NO_DIRECT_WRITE)for(const p of ['INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE','TRUNCATE'])expect({role,t,p,ok:await priv(role,t,p)}).toEqual({role,t,p,ok:false});
   for(const t of ['company_watches','company_event_reads'])expect({role,t,ok:await priv(role,t,'TRUNCATE')}).toEqual({role,t,ok:false});
   expect({role,ok:await priv(role,'issuer_coverage','SELECT')}).toEqual({role,ok:true});
   expect({role,ok:await priv(role,'company_event_reads','UPDATE')}).toEqual({role,ok:false});
  }
  for(const t of SERVICE_ONLY){
   for(const role of ['anon','authenticated'])expect({t,role,ok:await priv(role,t,'SELECT')}).toEqual({t,role,ok:false});
   expect({t,ok:await priv('service_role',t,'SELECT')}).toEqual({t,ok:true});
  }
  for(const p of ['SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE']){
   expect({p,ok:await priv('anon','company_watches',p)}).toEqual({p,ok:false});
   expect({p,ok:await priv('authenticated','company_watches',p)}).toEqual({p,ok:true});
   expect({p,ok:await priv('service_role','company_watches',p)}).toEqual({p,ok:true});
  }
  for(const p of ['SELECT','INSERT','DELETE']){
   expect({p,ok:await priv('anon','company_event_reads',p)}).toEqual({p,ok:false});
   expect({p,ok:await priv('authenticated','company_event_reads',p)}).toEqual({p,ok:true});
   expect({p,ok:await priv('service_role','company_event_reads',p)}).toEqual({p,ok:true});
  }
  const triggers=await fx.q(`select tgname, tgrelid::regclass::text rel from pg_trigger where not tgisinternal and tgname = any($1) order by tgname`,[['company_event_reads_check','company_watches_limit','company_watches_touch']]);
  expect(triggers).toEqual([{tgname:'company_event_reads_check',rel:'company_event_reads'},{tgname:'company_watches_limit',rel:'company_watches'},{tgname:'company_watches_touch',rel:'company_watches'}]);
  const fn=(sig:string)=>fx.q(`select r.rolname, has_function_privilege(r.rolname,$1,'EXECUTE') ok from pg_roles r where r.rolname in ('anon','authenticated','service_role') order by 1`,[sig]);
  for(const sig of ['public.company_watches_limit()','public.company_watches_touch()','public.company_event_reads_check()'])
   expect({sig,rows:await fn(sig)}).toEqual({sig,rows:[{rolname:'anon',ok:false},{rolname:'authenticated',ok:false},{rolname:'service_role',ok:false}]});
  const sql=readFileSync(TABLES_MIGRATION,'utf8');
  await expect(replayMigration(admin,sql)).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  await expect(replayMigration(admin,sql)).resolves.toBeUndefined();
 });

 it('constraints and foreign keys: enums, JSON shapes, hex ids, the natural key, batches, filings, coverage, note length, evidence cascade',async()=>{
  const s=await fx.stream([{facts:[{}]}]);const b=await fx.batch();
  const ins=(o:Record<string,unknown>)=>fx.q(`insert into public.issuer_events(event_id,issuer_id,market,kind,natural_key,occurred_on,payload,meta,payload_hash,based_on_rev,rebuild_id,rebuild_batch_id,filing_id)
   values($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,'2024-02-01',$6::jsonb,$7::jsonb,$8,1,gen_random_uuid(),$9,$10)`,
   [o.event_id??hex(randomUUID()),o.issuer_id??s.iss,o.market??'US',o.kind??'filing_published',o.natural_key??'k',o.payload??'{}',o.meta??'{}',o.payload_hash??hex('p'),o.batch??b,o.filing_id??s.filingIds[0]]);
  await ins({natural_key:'k1'});
  expect((await fails(ins({natural_key:'k1'}))).code).toBe('23505');                        // unique (issuer_id, market, kind, natural_key)
  for(const bad of [{market:'HK'},{kind:'news'},{payload:'[]'},{meta:'"x"'},{event_id:'XYZ'},{payload_hash:'abc'},{natural_key:''}])
   expect({bad,code:(await fails(ins({natural_key:randomUUID(),...bad}))).code}).toEqual({bad,code:'23514'});

  expect((await fails(ins({natural_key:randomUUID(),issuer_id:randomUUID()}))).code).toBe('23503'); // issuer_id → issuers
  const cov=(o:Record<string,unknown>)=>fx.q(`insert into public.issuer_coverage(issuer_id,market,filings_count,facts_count,concepts_covered,citation_summary,scope_last_status,based_on_rev,rebuild_id,rebuild_batch_id)
   values($1,$2,$3,0,0,$4::jsonb,$5,1,gen_random_uuid(),$6)`,[o.issuer_id??s.iss,o.market??'US',o.filings_count??0,o.citation_summary??'{"linked":0,"pending":0,"edgar":0}',o.status??null,b]);
  await cov({});

  for(const bad of [{market:'CN',filings_count:-1},{market:'CN',citation_summary:'[]'},{market:'CN',status:'running'}])
   expect({bad,code:(await fails(cov(bad))).code}).toEqual({bad,code:'23514'});
  const u=await fx.user();
  expect((await fails(fx.q(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id,note) values($1,$2,repeat('x',2001))`,[u,s.iss]))).code).toBe('23514');
  expect((await fails(fx.q(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2)`,[randomUUID(),s.iss]))).code).toBe('23503');   // auth.users
  await fx.q(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id,note) values($1,$2,repeat('x',2000))`,[u,s.iss]);
  expect((await fails(fx.q(`insert into public.company_digest_state(issuer_id,market,consecutive_failures) values($1,'US',-1)`,[s.iss]))).code).toBe('23514');
  expect((await fails(fx.q(`insert into public.company_digest_state(issuer_id,market,last_status) values($1,'US','running')`,[s.iss]))).code).toBe('23514');
  await fx.q(`insert into public.company_digest_state(issuer_id,market) values($1,'US')`,[s.iss]);
  expect((await fx.q(`select digested_rev::int d, attempt_seq::int a, consecutive_failures c, next_attempt_at = 'epoch'::timestamptz epoch, swept_at, last_failed_attempt_id from public.company_digest_state where issuer_id=$1`,[s.iss]))[0])
   .toEqual({d:0,a:0,c:0,epoch:true,swept_at:null,last_failed_attempt_id:null});
  // Evidence rows cascade with their fact: a staged fact deleted by abandoning its run takes its index row along.

  const ev=(o:Record<string,unknown>)=>fx.q(`insert into public.company_fact_evidence(fact_id,issuer_id,market,raw_hash,snapshot_sha256,snapshot_path,hash_locator,json_pointer,source,index_version,http_status)
   values($1,$2,'US',$3,$4,$5,'loc',$6,$7,'company-evidence/1',$8)`,[o.fact_id??staged,s.iss,o.raw_hash??hex('x'),hex('s'),'edgar/x.json',o.pointer??'/facts/us-gaap/Revenues/units/USD/0',o.source??'edgar',o.http_status??200]);
  for(const bad of [{raw_hash:'h'},{pointer:'facts'},{source:'cninfo'},{http_status:42}])
   expect({bad,code:(await fails(ev(bad))).code}).toEqual({bad,code:'23514'});
  expect((await fails(ev({fact_id:randomUUID()}))).code).toBe('23503');
  await ev({});
  await fx.q(`select public.abandon_sync_run($1)`,[run]);
  expect(await fx.one(`select count(*)::int v from public.company_fact_evidence where fact_id=$1`,[staged])).toBe(0);
 });

   `delete from public.issuer_coverage where issuer_id='${s.iss}'`,
   `insert into public.company_digest_state(issuer_id,market) values('${s.iss}','CN')`,
   `update public.company_digest_state set digested_rev=99 where issuer_id='${s.iss}'`,
   `delete from public.company_fact_evidence where issuer_id='${s.iss}'`,
   `truncate public.company_watches`,
  ];
  for(const role of ['anon','authenticated','service_role'] as const)for(const sql of writes)
   expect({role,sql,msg:(await fails(inTx(admin,{role},tx=>tx.c.query(sql)))).message}).toEqual({role,sql,msg:expect.stringMatching(/permission denied/)});
 });

 it('watches and receipts are own-rows: user B neither sees nor writes A\'s rows; service_role sees both',async()=>{
  const iss=await fx.issuer();const a=await fx.user();const bU=await fx.user();const b=await fx.batch();
  const e1=await fx.rawEvent(iss,'US',b);
  await inTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:a},async tx=>{
   expect((await tx.c.query(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id,note) values($1,$2,'mine') returning user_id`,[a,iss])).rowCount).toBe(1);
   expect((await tx.c.query(`insert into public.company_event_reads(user_id,issuer_id,event_id) values($1,$2,$3)`,[a,iss,e1])).rowCount).toBe(1);
  });
  await inTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:bU},async tx=>{
   expect((await tx.c.query(`select count(*)::int n from public.company_watches`)).rows[0].n).toBe(0);
   expect((await tx.c.query(`select count(*)::int n from public.company_event_reads`)).rows[0].n).toBe(0);
   expect((await tx.c.query(`update public.company_watches set note='x' where user_id=$1`,[a])).rowCount).toBe(0);
   expect((await tx.c.query(`delete from public.company_watches where user_id=$1`,[a])).rowCount).toBe(0);
   expect((await tx.c.query(`delete from public.company_event_reads where user_id=$1`,[a])).rowCount).toBe(0);
  });
  const otherIssuer=await fx.issuer();
  expect((await fails(inTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:bU},tx=>tx.c.query(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2)`,[a,otherIssuer])))).message).toMatch(/row-level security/);
  expect((await fails(inTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:bU},tx=>tx.c.query(`insert into public.company_event_reads(user_id,issuer_id,event_id) values($1,$2,$3)`,[a,iss,e1])))).message).toMatch(/row-level security/);
  expect(await inTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:a},async tx=>(await tx.c.query(`select note from public.company_watches`)).rows)).toEqual([{note:'mine'}]);
  expect(await inTx(admin,{role:'service_role'},async tx=>(await tx.c.query(`select count(*)::int n from public.company_watches where user_id=$1`,[a])).rows[0].n)).toBe(1);
  // touch trigger: updated_at moves, keys are immutable
  const before=(await fx.q(`select updated_at::text u from public.company_watches where user_id=$1`,[a]))[0].u;
  await fx.q(`select pg_sleep(0.01)`);
  await inTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:a},tx=>tx.c.query(`update public.company_watches set muted=true where user_id=$1 and issuer_id=$2`,[a,iss]));
  expect((await fx.q(`select updated_at::text u from public.company_watches where user_id=$1`,[a]))[0].u).not.toBe(before);
  const moved=await fails(fx.q(`update public.company_watches set issuer_id=$2 where user_id=$1`,[a,await fx.issuer()]));
  expect(moved).toMatchObject({message:'immutable_watch_key',code:'23514'});
 });

 it('watch_limit: 200 per user, enforced under concurrent inserts; an existing key passes to the primary key',async()=>{
  const ids=await fx.issuers(202);const u=await fx.user();
  expect((await fx.q(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) select $1, unnest($2::uuid[])`,[u,ids.slice(0,199)])).length).toBe(0);
  // two sessions race for the 200th slot with different issuers: the second waits on the advisory lock, then sees 200 and is refused
  const t1=await openTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:u});const t2=await openTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:u});
  try{
   await t1.c.query(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2)`,[u,ids[199]]);
   const second=t2.c.query(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2)`,[u,ids[200]]);
   await stillBlockedBehind(admin,t1.pid,second);
   await t1.commit();
   expect(await fails(second)).toMatchObject({message:'watch_limit',code:'23514'});
  }finally{await t1.rollback().catch(()=>{});await t2.rollback().catch(()=>{});}
  expect(await fx.one(`select count(*)::int v from public.company_watches where user_id=$1`,[u])).toBe(200);
  // at the limit an existing key is not counted: on conflict do nothing → 0 rows, plain insert → 23505 (not watch_limit)
  expect(await inTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:u},async tx=>(await tx.c.query(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2) on conflict (user_id,issuer_id) do nothing`,[u,ids[0]])).rowCount)).toBe(0);
  expect((await fails(inTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:u},tx=>tx.c.query(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2)`,[u,ids[0]])))).code).toBe('23505');
  expect(await fails(fx.q(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2)`,[u,ids[201]]))).toMatchObject({message:'watch_limit',code:'23514'});
  // a multi-row insert counts the rows it already wrote
  const v=await fx.user();
  expect(await fails(fx.q(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) select $1, unnest($2::uuid[])`,[v,ids.slice(0,201)]))).toMatchObject({message:'watch_limit'});
  // the same new key from two sessions at 199: the second waits, then finds the key and lets on conflict do nothing decide
  const w=await fx.user();
  await fx.q(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) select $1, unnest($2::uuid[])`,[w,ids.slice(0,199)]);
  const s1=await openTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:w});const s2=await openTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:w});
  try{
   await s1.c.query(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2)`,[w,ids[199]]);
   const same=s2.c.query(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2) on conflict (user_id,issuer_id) do nothing`,[w,ids[199]]);
   await stillBlockedBehind(admin,s1.pid,same);
   await s1.commit();
   expect((await same).rowCount).toBe(0);
   await s2.commit();
  }finally{await s1.rollback().catch(()=>{});await s2.rollback().catch(()=>{});}
  expect(await fx.one(`select count(*)::int v from public.company_watches where user_id=$1`,[w])).toBe(200);
 });

 it('receipts: the event must belong to the issuer; the issuer must be watched; unwatching clears the receipts',async()=>{
  const i1=await fx.issuer();const i2=await fx.issuer();const i3=await fx.issuer();const u=await fx.user();const b=await fx.batch();
  const e1=await fx.rawEvent(i1,'US',b);const e1cn=await fx.rawEvent(i1,'CN',b);const e3=await fx.rawEvent(i3,'US',b);
  await fx.q(`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2),($1,$3)`,[u,i1,i2]);
  const read=(iss:string,ev:string,conflict='')=>inTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:u},async tx=>(await tx.c.query(`insert into public.company_event_reads(user_id,issuer_id,event_id) values($1,$2,$3)${conflict}`,[u,iss,ev])).rowCount);
  expect(await fails(read(i2,e1))).toMatchObject({message:'invalid_read',code:'23514'});        // cross-issuer receipt
  expect(await fails(read(i1,hex('missing')))).toMatchObject({message:'invalid_read',code:'23514'});
  expect(await read(i1,e1)).toBe(1);
  expect(await read(i1,e1cn)).toBe(1);                                                          // both markets belong to the issuer
  expect(await read(i1,e1,' on conflict (user_id,event_id) do nothing')).toBe(0);
  expect((await fails(read(i3,e3))).code).toBe('23503');                                         // not watched → composite FK
  await inTx(admin,{role:'authenticated',userId:u},tx=>tx.c.query(`delete from public.company_watches where user_id=$1 and issuer_id=$2`,[u,i1]));
  expect(await fx.one(`select count(*)::int v from public.company_event_reads where user_id=$1`,[u])).toBe(0);
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 写表迁移**

```sql
-- supabase/migrations/20261112090000_company_research.sql
-- Company research and tracking (spec 2026-11-04 company research §4, §0 #64, §0.1 item 2; plan
-- 2026-11-06 Task 1): six tables. Public/materialized tables — issuer_events (fact event timeline),
-- issuer_coverage (counts and dates per issuer+market), company_digest_state (materialisation cursor
-- and attempt ownership), company_fact_evidence (verified fact → raw snapshot index) — accept NO
-- direct insert/update/delete from any role, service_role included; every write goes through the
-- security definer functions of 20261112091000_company_research_functions.sql. issuer_events,
-- company_digest_state and company_fact_evidence are readable by service_role only (§0 #64: routes
-- assemble events and evidence server-side behind the evidence gate); issuer_coverage holds no
-- financial values and is public read. Per-user tables company_watches / company_event_reads are
-- RLS own-rows for authenticated (service_role: all, for tests and operations). The watch cap
-- (MAX_COMPANY_WATCHES = 200) and the receipt/issuer consistency are triggers.
-- Supabase grants ALL on new tables to anon/authenticated by default and RLS does not stop TRUNCATE,
-- so every table starts with revoke all. Functions keep the migration role as owner (hosted postgres
-- is not a superuser). Replayable: guarded creates, create or replace, drop-then-create policies and
-- triggers.

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4.1 issuer_events
create table if not exists public.issuer_events (
  event_id           text primary key check (event_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),   -- sha256(canonical({issuer_id, market, kind, natural_key})), server-computed
  issuer_id          uuid not null references public.issuers(issuer_id) on delete restrict,
  market             text not null check (market in ('US','CN')),
  kind               text not null check (kind in ('filing_published','period_first_seen','fact_revised')),
  natural_key        text not null check (length(natural_key) between 1 and 256),           -- never contains a fact_id
  occurred_on        date not null,                                                          -- availability date
  period_end         date,
  concept            text check (concept is null or length(concept) between 1 and 64),
  filing_id          uuid references public.filings(filing_id) on delete restrict,
  payload            jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'),                -- economic content, hashed
  meta               jsonb not null default '{}' check (jsonb_typeof(meta) = 'object'),      -- display metadata, not hashed
  payload_hash       text not null check (payload_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  based_on_rev       bigint not null check (based_on_rev >= 0),
  first_seen_at      timestamptz not null default now(),                                     -- kept across rebuilds and revivals
  payload_changed_at timestamptz,                                                            -- set only when payload_hash changes
  retired_at         timestamptz,                                                            -- tombstone
  rebuilt_at         timestamptz not null default now(),
  rebuild_id         uuid not null,                                                          -- one per replace call
  rebuild_batch_id   uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  constraint issuer_events_key_uniq unique (issuer_id, market, kind, natural_key)
);
create index if not exists issuer_events_timeline_idx on public.issuer_events(issuer_id, market, occurred_on desc, event_id) where retired_at is null;
create index if not exists issuer_events_seen_idx on public.issuer_events(first_seen_at desc, event_id) where retired_at is null;
create index if not exists issuer_events_issuer_seen_idx on public.issuer_events(issuer_id, first_seen_at desc, event_id desc) where retired_at is null;   -- inbox: issuer_id = any(watched)
create index if not exists issuer_events_filing_idx on public.issuer_events(filing_id);                                                                  -- FK checks on filings

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4.2 issuer_coverage
create table if not exists public.issuer_coverage (
  issuer_id              uuid not null references public.issuers(issuer_id) on delete restrict,
  market                 text not null check (market in ('US','CN')),
  filings_count          int not null check (filings_count >= 0),
  facts_count            int not null check (facts_count >= 0),
  concepts_covered       int not null check (concepts_covered >= 0),
  earliest_period_end    date,
  latest_period_end      date,
  latest_available_date  date,
  citation_summary       jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(citation_summary) = 'object'),   -- {linked, pending, edgar}
  scope_last_success_at  timestamptz,
  scope_last_status      text check (scope_last_status in ('success','failed')),
  based_on_rev           bigint not null check (based_on_rev >= 0),
  rebuilt_at             timestamptz not null default now(),
  rebuild_id             uuid not null,
  rebuild_batch_id       uuid not null references public.ingest_batches(batch_id) on delete restrict,
  primary key (issuer_id, market)
);
create index if not exists issuer_coverage_latest_idx on public.issuer_coverage(latest_available_date desc);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4.3 company_watches / company_event_reads
create table if not exists public.company_watches (
  user_id     uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  issuer_id   uuid not null references public.issuers(issuer_id) on delete restrict,
  note        text check (note is null or char_length(note) <= 2000),
  muted       boolean not null default false,
  created_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at  timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (user_id, issuer_id)
);
create index if not exists company_watches_user_updated_idx on public.company_watches(user_id, updated_at desc);

create table if not exists public.company_event_reads (
  user_id    uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  issuer_id  uuid not null,
  event_id   text not null references public.issuer_events(event_id) on delete cascade,
  read_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (user_id, event_id),
  constraint company_event_reads_watch_fkey foreign key (user_id, issuer_id) references public.company_watches(user_id, issuer_id) on delete cascade
);
create index if not exists company_event_reads_user_issuer_idx on public.company_event_reads(user_id, issuer_id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- 4.4 company_digest_state
create table if not exists public.company_digest_state (
  issuer_id               uuid not null references public.issuers(issuer_id) on delete cascade,
  market                  text not null check (market in ('US','CN')),
  digested_rev            bigint not null default 0 check (digested_rev >= 0),
  attempt_seq             bigint not null default 0 check (attempt_seq >= 0),
  last_attempt_id         bigint,
  last_success_attempt_id bigint,
  last_failed_attempt_id  bigint,          -- largest accepted failed attempt (monotone, §0 #70)
  last_attempt_at         timestamptz,
  last_status             text check (last_status in ('success','failed')),
  consecutive_failures    int not null default 0 check (consecutive_failures >= 0),
  next_attempt_at         timestamptz not null default 'epoch',
  swept_at                timestamptz,
  updated_at              timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (issuer_id, market)
);
create index if not exists company_digest_state_next_idx on public.company_digest_state(next_attempt_at);
create index if not exists company_digest_state_swept_idx on public.company_digest_state(swept_at nulls first);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- §0.1 item 2 company_fact_evidence
-- One verified association fact → raw snapshot. raw_hash = sha256(snapshot_sha256 || '\n' || hash_locator)
-- (it is NOT the object hash). issuer_id/market are denormalised from the fact (the writer function
-- checks them) so a stream can be replaced as a whole.
create table if not exists public.company_fact_evidence (
  fact_id          uuid primary key references public.financial_facts(fact_id) on delete cascade,
  issuer_id        uuid not null references public.issuers(issuer_id) on delete restrict,
  market           text not null check (market in ('US','CN')),
  raw_hash         text not null check (raw_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  snapshot_sha256  text not null check (snapshot_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  snapshot_path    text not null check (length(snapshot_path) between 1 and 512),
  hash_locator     text not null check (length(hash_locator) between 1 and 1024),
  json_pointer     text not null check (json_pointer ~ '^/' and length(json_pointer) <= 1024),
  field            text check (field is null or length(field) between 1 and 64),
  source           text not null check (source in ('edgar','tushare')),
  api              text check (api is null or length(api) between 1 and 64),
  url              text check (url is null or length(url) between 1 and 2048),
  params           jsonb check (params is null or jsonb_typeof(params) = 'object'),   -- never a token
  captured_at      timestamptz,                                                        -- sidecar first-write time ("snapshot first fetched")
  http_status      int check (http_status is null or http_status between 100 and 599),
  page             int check (page is null or page >= 0),
  index_version    text not null check (length(index_version) between 1 and 64),
  verified_at      timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists company_fact_evidence_stream_idx on public.company_fact_evidence(issuer_id, market);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- triggers
-- MAX_COMPANY_WATCHES = 200 (decision F). Serialised per user by a transaction-scoped advisory lock;
-- an existing (user_id, issuer_id) is let through so the primary key / on conflict decides; rows an
-- outer multi-row insert already wrote are visible to the count. security definer: the count must
-- see every row of the user whatever the caller's RLS.
create or replace function public.company_watches_limit() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
declare n int;
begin
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('company_watches:' || new.user_id::text));
  if exists (select 1 from public.company_watches w where w.user_id = new.user_id and w.issuer_id = new.issuer_id) then
    return new;
  end if;
  select count(*) into n from public.company_watches w where w.user_id = new.user_id;
  if n >= 200 then
    raise exception 'watch_limit' using errcode = '23514', detail = 'MAX_COMPANY_WATCHES = 200';
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.company_watches_limit() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
drop trigger if exists company_watches_limit on public.company_watches;
create trigger company_watches_limit before insert on public.company_watches
  for each row execute function public.company_watches_limit();

-- updated_at is server time; the key never changes (receipts hang off it).
create or replace function public.company_watches_touch() returns trigger
language plpgsql set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if (new.user_id, new.issuer_id, new.created_at) is distinct from (old.user_id, old.issuer_id, old.created_at) then
    raise exception 'immutable_watch_key' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  new.updated_at := now();
  return new;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.company_watches_touch() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
drop trigger if exists company_watches_touch on public.company_watches;
create trigger company_watches_touch before update on public.company_watches
  for each row execute function public.company_watches_touch();

-- A receipt names an event of its own issuer (either market). security definer: authenticated
-- cannot read issuer_events (§0 #64).
create or replace function public.company_event_reads_check() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.issuer_events e where e.event_id = new.event_id and e.issuer_id = new.issuer_id) then
    raise exception 'invalid_read' using errcode = '23514', detail = 'event does not belong to the issuer';
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;
revoke execute on function public.company_event_reads_check() from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
drop trigger if exists company_event_reads_check on public.company_event_reads;
create trigger company_event_reads_check before insert on public.company_event_reads
  for each row execute function public.company_event_reads_check();

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- privileges and policies (§4.6 + §0 #64)
do $$ declare t text; begin
  foreach t in array array['issuer_events','issuer_coverage','company_watches','company_event_reads','company_digest_state','company_fact_evidence'] loop
    execute format('alter table public.%I enable row level security', t);
    execute format('revoke all on public.%I from public, anon, authenticated, service_role', t);
  end loop;
  foreach t in array array['issuer_events','company_digest_state','company_fact_evidence'] loop
    execute format('grant select on public.%I to service_role', t);
    execute format('drop policy if exists "%s service read" on public.%I', t, t);
    execute format('create policy "%s service read" on public.%I for select to service_role using (true)', t, t);
  end loop;
end $$;
grant select on public.issuer_coverage to anon, authenticated, service_role;
drop policy if exists "issuer_coverage public read" on public.issuer_coverage;
create policy "issuer_coverage public read" on public.issuer_coverage for select using (true);

grant select, insert, update, delete on public.company_watches to authenticated, service_role;
drop policy if exists "company_watches own select" on public.company_watches;
create policy "company_watches own select" on public.company_watches for select to authenticated using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);
drop policy if exists "company_watches own insert" on public.company_watches;
create policy "company_watches own insert" on public.company_watches for insert to authenticated with check ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);
drop policy if exists "company_watches own update" on public.company_watches;
create policy "company_watches own update" on public.company_watches for update to authenticated using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id) with check ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);
drop policy if exists "company_watches own delete" on public.company_watches;
create policy "company_watches own delete" on public.company_watches for delete to authenticated using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);
drop policy if exists "company_watches service all" on public.company_watches;
create policy "company_watches service all" on public.company_watches for all to service_role using (true) with check (true);

grant select, insert, delete on public.company_event_reads to authenticated, service_role;
drop policy if exists "company_event_reads own select" on public.company_event_reads;
create policy "company_event_reads own select" on public.company_event_reads for select to authenticated using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);
drop policy if exists "company_event_reads own insert" on public.company_event_reads;
create policy "company_event_reads own insert" on public.company_event_reads for insert to authenticated with check ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);
drop policy if exists "company_event_reads own delete" on public.company_event_reads;
create policy "company_event_reads own delete" on public.company_event_reads for delete to authenticated using ((select auth.uid()) = user_id);
```

**函数要求（实现者不读规格，以下即全部）：**

所有函数 `set search_path = ''`，对象 `public.` 限定；owner 为迁移角色（不 `alter … owner`）。授权：每个函数先 `revoke execute … from public, anon, authenticated[, service_role]` 再 `grant`。

| 函数 | 安全 | 执行授权 |
|---|---|---|
| `begin_company_digest_attempt(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_now timestamptz) → bigint` | plpgsql definer | service_role |
| `replace_company_digest(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_batch uuid, p_attempt_id bigint, p_rebuild_id uuid, p_based_on_rev bigint, p_sweep boolean, p_events jsonb, p_coverage jsonb) → jsonb {upserted, changed, retired, revived}` | plpgsql definer | service_role |
| `mark_company_digest_failed(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_attempt_id bigint, p_now timestamptz) → boolean` | plpgsql definer | service_role |
| `replace_company_fact_evidence(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_rows jsonb) → jsonb {upserted, deleted}` | plpgsql definer | service_role |
| `company_fact_evidence(p_fact_ids uuid[]) → jsonb {<fact_id>: EvidenceRecord}` | plpgsql definer stable | anon, authenticated, service_role |
| `company_read_snapshot(p_issuer uuid, p_market text, p_concepts text[], p_as_of date, p_from date, p_to date, p_history boolean, p_limit int) → jsonb {facts, filings}` | **sql invoker** stable | anon, authenticated, service_role |
| `company_list_coverage(p_market text, p_issuer_ids uuid[], p_sort text, p_offset int, p_limit int) → jsonb {rows, total}` | plpgsql invoker stable | anon, authenticated, service_role |
| `company_digest_due(p_now timestamptz, p_limit int, p_market text default null) → jsonb`、`company_sweep_due(p_older_than timestamptz, p_now timestamptz, p_limit int, p_market text default null) → jsonb`、`company_digest_backlog() → int` | sql definer stable | service_role |
| `company_canonical_json(jsonb) → text` 与 `company_ev_*`、`company_cov_check`、`company_evidence_check` 助手 | invoker | 无（只被 definer 函数以 owner 身份调用） |

`replace_company_digest` 一个事务内的固定顺序：
1. `select state_rev … from public.fact_sync_scope where issuer_id = p_issuer and market = p_market for update`（**排他**：与规格二的发布/提升/裁决函数互斥，也让两个 digest 写者串行）；无行 → `unknown_stream`（P0002）。
2. `state_rev <> p_based_on_rev` → `stale_computation`（55P03）。锁 `company_digest_state` 行（`for update`）；行不存在或 `p_attempt_id` 不在 `[1, attempt_seq]` → `invalid_attempt`；`p_attempt_id < coalesce(last_success_attempt_id, 0)` → `stale_attempt`（P0001）。
3. `p_batch` 必须存在于 `ingest_batches` 且 `producer = 'company-digest' and status = 'running'`，否则 `invalid_batch`；`p_rebuild_id` 已被该流任一 `issuer_events`/`issuer_coverage` 行使用 → `invalid_event`（detail `rebuild_id: already used by this stream`）。
4. 逐项校验 `p_events`（数组）与 `p_coverage`（见下），任一失败 → `invalid_event`（22023，`detail` 指出路径）；`(kind, natural_key)` 重复 → `invalid_event`。
5. 服务端算 `event_id = encode(sha256(convert_to(company_canonical_json(jsonb_build_object('issuer_id', p_issuer::text, 'market', p_market, 'kind', kind, 'natural_key', natural_key)), 'UTF8')), 'hex')` 与 `payload_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(company_canonical_json(payload), 'UTF8')), 'hex')`（`meta` 不进哈希）。
6. upsert（冲突键 `(issuer_id, market, kind, natural_key)`）：更新 `occurred_on/period_end/concept/filing_id/payload/meta/payload_hash/based_on_rev/rebuilt_at/rebuild_id/rebuild_batch_id`；`payload_changed_at` 只在哈希变化时置 `now()`；`retired_at = null`；`first_seen_at` 永不更新。
7. 该流 `rebuild_id <> p_rebuild_id and retired_at is null` 的行 → `retired_at = now()`（墓碑，不删）。
8. 测试开关：`current_setting('company.fail_after_events', true) = 'on'` → `raise 'company_test_fault'`（在事件写入之后、覆盖写入之前；只有集成测试会设它，生产无人设置，设置也只会让调用失败）。
9. `issuer_coverage` upsert（全部列取 `p_coverage`，`based_on_rev = p_based_on_rev`、`rebuild_id`、`rebuild_batch_id = p_batch`、`rebuilt_at = now()`）。
10. `company_digest_state`：总是 `digested_rev = p_based_on_rev`、`last_success_attempt_id = greatest(coalesce(last_success_attempt_id,0), p_attempt_id)`；**只当 `p_attempt_id > coalesce(last_failed_attempt_id, 0)`** 时 `last_status='success', consecutive_failures=0, next_attempt_at=now(), swept_at = case when p_sweep then now() else swept_at end`；否则这些字段不变（更新的尝试已失败，旧尝试的成功不能抹掉它）。
返回计数：`upserted` = 写入的事件数；`changed` = 新插入 + `payload_hash` 变化的行；`revived` = 原先 `retired_at` 非空、本次复活的行（与 `changed` 独立计数）；`retired` = 第 7 步墓碑化的行数。

`mark_company_digest_failed`（§0 #70）：锁 `fact_sync_scope` 行（无行 → `unknown_stream`），再锁 `company_digest_state` 行（无行或 attempt 越界 → `invalid_attempt`）；只在 `p_attempt_id > greatest(coalesce(last_success_attempt_id,0), coalesce(last_failed_attempt_id,0))` 时接受：`last_failed_attempt_id = p_attempt_id`、`consecutive_failures + 1`、`next_attempt_at = p_now + least(24h, 1h × 2^min(旧 consecutive_failures, 5))`、`last_status = 'failed'`，返回 true；否则返回 false 且不改任何列（同一失败投递两次、新失败之后到达的旧失败都返回 false）。

`begin_company_digest_attempt`：`fact_sync_scope` 无行 → `unknown_stream`；`insert … on conflict (issuer_id, market) do update set attempt_seq = attempt_seq + 1, last_attempt_id = attempt_seq + 1, last_attempt_at = p_now`（新行从 1 起），返回新的 `attempt_seq`。

**事件校验（`company_ev_check`，与 Part B Task 5 的产出逐键对应；全部 kind 的顶层键恰为 `kind, natural_key, occurred_on, period_end, concept, filing_id, payload, meta` 八个）：**

| kind | 顶层列约束 | payload（键集合精确，无多余键） | meta |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filing_published` | `natural_key = filing_id::text`；`filing_id` 必填且是本流 `mapping_gen > 0`、`available_date <= 今天` 的 filing；`occurred_on = filings.available_date`；`period_end = filings.period_end`；`concept = null` | `formType = form_type`、`fiscalYear = fiscal_year`（int\|null）、`fiscalPeriod = fiscal_period`、`periodEnd = period_end`、`availableDate = available_date`、`sourceRef = source_ref`、`factCount` = 该 filing `status='ok' and mapping_gen = filing.mapping_gen` 的事实数 | `{}` |
| `period_first_seen` | `natural_key = periodStart:periodEnd:duration`；`period_end = periodEnd`；`concept = null`；`filing_id = payload.filingId`；`occurred_on = 该 filing 的 available_date` | `periodStart`/`periodEnd`（日期；`INSTANT` 时 `periodStart = periodEnd`，否则 `periodStart < periodEnd`）、`duration ∈ 3M/6M/9M/12M/INSTANT`、`filingId`（本流合格 filing）、`conceptCount`（int ≥ 1）、`headline`（键 ⊆ `revenue, revenue_operating, net_income_parent, operating_cash_flow`，每项恰为 `{factId, value, unit}`：事实可见、`concept` = 键、`value = value_text`、`unit` 相等、期间/duration 与 payload 相同、`consolidated`）、`ambiguousUnits`（字符串数组，元素 ∈ 上述四个概念、不重复、不在 `headline` 中） | `{headlineAsOf: date ≤ 今天}` |
| `fact_revised` | `natural_key = concept:periodStart:periodEnd:consolidated:unit:<to.availableDate>`；`occurred_on = to.availableDate`；`period_end = periodEnd`；`concept = payload.concept`；`filing_id = to.filingId` | `concept, statement, periodStart, periodEnd, duration, consolidation('consolidated'), unit, from, to` + 可选 `relChange`；`from`/`to` 恰为 `{factId, value, filingId, availableDate}`，都是可见事实，`value = value_text`、`filingId`/`availableDate` 与事实行相等；两者自然键与 payload 一致；`from.availableDate <= to.availableDate`、`from` ≠ `to`、数值不等；`relChange` 当且仅当 `from` 数值 ≠ 0 时出现，形如 `^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$` | `{}` |

"可见事实" = `financial_facts` 行属于 `(p_issuer, p_market)`、`status='ok'`、`mapping_gen` 等于其 filing 的 `mapping_gen`、`available_date <= 今天`。全部字符串 1..256 字符；日期必须是 `YYYY-MM-DD`；uuid 必须是小写规范形式；整数必须是 JSON 整数。所有 `occurred_on <= 今天`。

指挥决定（Task 2）：
- `fact_revised` 对 `INSTANT` 事实的 `periodStart` 记为 `periodEnd`（与 `period_first_seen` 相同规则），自然键因而是 `concept:pe:pe:consolidated:unit:date`。理由：规格只对 `period_first_seen` 写明，两种 kind 用同一规则可避免 `null` 进入自然键。
- 顶层 `filing_id`/`concept`/`period_end`/`occurred_on` 与 payload 必须一致（上表），`filing_published` 的 payload 必须与 filings 行逐项相等（含 `factCount`）：事件是公共可读事实的派生物，服务端能核对的都核对。Part B 的 `deriveIssuerEvents` 必须以 `concepts: CONCEPT_IDS`（全部概念）读取事实，否则 `factCount` 不等。
- `relChange` 只校验格式与出现条件，不在 SQL 重算其数值（舍入规则归 Task 5 的 `decimalRelChange`，其输出去尾零；正则同样接受）。
- `p_coverage` 恰为 `CoverageInput` 九键：三个计数 int ≥ 0、三个日期可空、`citation_summary` 恰为 `{linked, pending, edgar}` 非负整数、`scope_last_success_at` 时间戳字符串或 null、`scope_last_status ∈ {success, failed, null}`；按调用方给的值存储（不改写为锁内的 scope 值）。
- `company_sweep_due` 只选 `state_rev > 0` 的流（从未发布过事实的流没有可物化的内容）。
- canonical JSON 规则：对象键按 Unicode 码点升序（= UTF-8 字节序，SQL 用 `collate "C"`，TS 用 `Buffer.compare`；**不是** JS 默认的 UTF-16 排序——`'�' < '😀'`）；无空白；字符串转义与 `JSON.stringify` 相同：`"` `\\` `\b` `\f` `\n` `\r` `\t` 用短转义，其余 U+0000–U+001F 用小写 `\u00xx`，U+007F、U+2028/U+2029、`/` 与全部非 ASCII 原样输出（PostgreSQL `to_json(text)` 恰好是这个规则）；数字只允许安全整数（|n| ≤ 2^53−1），以十进制整数输出（`-0` → `0`）；其他数字 → SQL `invalid_event` / TS `CanonicalJsonError`。TS 侧另外拒绝含 U+0000 或孤立代理项的字符串（PostgreSQL 文本无法表示，两边不可能一致）；对象中值为 `undefined` 的键被省略（与 `JSON.stringify` 送到 SQL 的结果一致），数组中的 `undefined` 抛错。哈希一律对 UTF-8 字节。
- `company_fact_evidence` 中 `p_fact_ids` 超过 100 个（按数组长度计，含重复）→ `invalid_read`；`null` 视为空数组。

```ts
  expect(['😀','�'].sort(compareCodePoints)).toEqual(['�','😀']);

 });
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/canonical.ts
// Canonical JSON and the server-computed identities of issuer_events (spec §4.1, §4.6 ⑤; plan Task 2).
// Byte-identical to public.company_canonical_json(jsonb) in 20261112091000_company_research_functions.sql:
// object keys in Unicode code-point order (UTF-8 byte order; SQL collate "C"), no whitespace, strings
// escaped exactly like JSON.stringify (== PostgreSQL to_json(text)), numbers only as safe integers.
// Strings PostgreSQL cannot store (U+0000, lone surrogates) are refused so the two sides can never
// disagree. Hashes are sha256 over the UTF-8 bytes, lowercase hex. Deliberately imports nothing from
// types.ts (Task 3) — callers pass plain strings.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';

export class CanonicalJsonError extends Error{constructor(message:string){super(message);this.name='CanonicalJsonError';}}
const LONE_SURROGATE=/[\uD800-\uDBFF](?![\uDC00-\uDFFF])|(?<![\uD800-\uDBFF])[\uDC00-\uDFFF]/;
const utf8=(s:string)=>Buffer.from(s,'utf8');
/** Code-point order (= UTF-8 byte order = PostgreSQL collate "C"); NOT the default UTF-16 sort. */
export const compareCodePoints=(a:string,b:string):number=>Buffer.compare(utf8(a),utf8(b));
const str=(s:string):string=>{
 if(s.includes('\u0000'))throw new CanonicalJsonError('nul_in_string');
 if(LONE_SURROGATE.test(s))throw new CanonicalJsonError('lone_surrogate');
 return JSON.stringify(s);
};
export function canonicalJson(v:unknown):string{
 if(v===null)return 'null';
 switch(typeof v){
  case 'boolean':return v?'true':'false';
  case 'number':
   if(!Number.isSafeInteger(v))throw new CanonicalJsonError(`unsafe_number:${String(v)}`);
   return String(v);   // String(-0) === '0'
  case 'string':return str(v);
  case 'object':{
   if(Array.isArray(v))return '['+v.map(x=>{if(x===undefined)throw new CanonicalJsonError('undefined_in_array');return canonicalJson(x);}).join(',')+']';
   const proto=Object.getPrototypeOf(v);
   if(proto!==Object.prototype&&proto!==null)throw new CanonicalJsonError('not_a_plain_object');
   const o=v as Record<string,unknown>;
   const keys=Object.keys(o).filter(k=>o[k]!==undefined).sort(compareCodePoints);
   return '{'+keys.map(k=>`${str(k)}:${canonicalJson(o[k])}`).join(',')+'}';
  }
  default:throw new CanonicalJsonError(`unsupported_type:${typeof v}`);
 }
}
export const sha256Utf8=(s:string):string=>createHash('sha256').update(s,'utf8').digest('hex');
/** issuer_events.event_id = sha256(canonical({issuer_id, market, kind, natural_key})); uuid text is lowercase in PostgreSQL. */
export const eventIdOf=(issuerId:string,market:string,kind:string,naturalKey:string):string=>
 sha256Utf8(canonicalJson({issuer_id:issuerId.toLowerCase(),market,kind,natural_key:naturalKey}));
/** issuer_events.payload_hash = sha256(canonical(payload)); meta is never hashed. */
export const payloadHashOf=(payload:Record<string,unknown>):string=>sha256Utf8(canonicalJson(payload));
```
