- [ ] **Step 2: 实现 pg `CompanyDb`**

```ts
// src/lib/company/pg-company-db.ts
// TEST-ONLY CompanyDb over node-postgres (spec §4.7, §12.2): calls the same SQL functions supabaseCompanyDb
// calls through rpc, but every call runs in its own transaction under a real client role, so the
// contract exercises grants and RLS: digest / evidence / event reads as service_role, coverage reads as
// anon, per-user methods as authenticated with JWT claims and WITHOUT a user filter of their own (only
// the RLS policies keep users apart). Nothing in src/app imports this. Dates and timestamps come back as
// raw text (typeParsers), so inbox cursors keep microseconds; normalisers and cursors come from db.ts.
// pgRpcClient gives readSnapshot a Supabase-shaped rpc over a pool and a role.
import type {Pool,PoolClient} from 'pg';
import {typeParsers} from '../db/pg-table-client';
import {EVIDENCE_IDS_PER_CALL,checkEventIds,checkEventsQuery,chunkOf,coverageFromRow,coveragePageFromJson,decodeInboxCursor,decodeIssuerCursor,digestStateFromRow,dueFromJson,
 eventFromRow,evidenceFromJson,inboxPage,issuerPage,replaceResultFromJson,sortCoverage,toCompanyDbError,watchFromRow,watchPatch} from './db';
import type {PgErrorLike,RawEvent} from './db';
import type {RpcClient} from './snapshot-read';
import type {CompanyDb,CompanyDbError,EvidenceRecord} from './types';

type Role='anon'|'authenticated'|'service_role';
type Row=Record<string,unknown>;
const ROLES:readonly Role[]=['anon','authenticated','service_role'];

/** Runs body in one transaction as `role` (with JWT claims when userId is given); errors are mapped like PostgREST errors. */
async function asRole<T>(pool:Pool,role:Role,userId:string|null,body:(c:PoolClient)=>Promise<T>,fk?:CompanyDbError['code']):Promise<T>{
 if(!ROLES.includes(role))throw new Error(`invalid_role:${role}`);
 const c=await pool.connect();let broken:Error|undefined;
 try{
  await c.query('begin');
  if(userId!==null)await c.query(`select set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub',$1,true), set_config('request.jwt.claims',$2,true)`,[userId,JSON.stringify({sub:userId,role})]);
  await c.query(`set local role ${role}`);
  const out=await body(c);
  await c.query('commit');
  return out;
 }catch(e){
  await c.query('rollback').catch(x=>{broken=x as Error;});
  throw toCompanyDbError(e,fk);
 }finally{c.release(broken);}
}
const q=async(c:PoolClient,text:string,values:unknown[]=[]):Promise<Row[]>=>(await c.query({text,values,types:typeParsers})).rows as Row[];

export function pgCompanyDb(pool:Pool):CompanyDb{
 const fn=<T>(role:Role,call:string,values:unknown[]):Promise<T>=>asRole(pool,role,null,async c=>(await q(c,`select ${call} as v`,values))[0].v as T);
 const svc=<T>(body:(c:PoolClient)=>Promise<T>)=>asRole(pool,'service_role',null,body);
 const user=<T>(userId:string,body:(c:PoolClient)=>Promise<T>,fk?:CompanyDbError['code'])=>asRole(pool,'authenticated',userId,body,fk);
 return {
  async digestDue(now,limit,market){return dueFromJson(await fn('service_role','public.company_digest_due($1::timestamptz,$2,$3)',[now.toISOString(),limit,market??null]));},
  async sweepDue(olderThan,now,limit,market){return dueFromJson(await fn('service_role','public.company_sweep_due($1::timestamptz,$2::timestamptz,$3,$4)',[olderThan.toISOString(),now.toISOString(),limit,market??null]));},
  async beginAttempt(issuer,market,now){return Number(await fn('service_role','public.begin_company_digest_attempt($1,$2,$3::timestamptz)',[issuer,market,now.toISOString()]));},
  async replaceDigest(issuer,market,batch,attemptId,rebuildId,basedOnRev,sweep,events,coverage){
   return replaceResultFromJson(await fn('service_role','public.replace_company_digest($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8::jsonb,$9::jsonb)',[issuer,market,batch,attemptId,rebuildId,basedOnRev,sweep,JSON.stringify(events),JSON.stringify(coverage)]));
  },
  async markDigestFailed(issuer,market,attemptId,now){return (await fn('service_role','public.mark_company_digest_failed($1,$2,$3,$4::timestamptz)',[issuer,market,attemptId,now.toISOString()]))===true;},
  async backlog(){return {failedStreams:Number(await fn('service_role','public.company_digest_backlog()',[]))};},
  async digestState(issuer,market){const [r]=await svc(c=>q(c,`select * from public.company_digest_state where issuer_id = $1 and market = $2`,[issuer,market]));return r?digestStateFromRow(r):null;},
  async replaceEvidence(issuer,market,rows){
   const x=await fn<{upserted:unknown;deleted:unknown}>('service_role','public.replace_company_fact_evidence($1,$2,$3::jsonb)',[issuer,market,JSON.stringify(rows)]);
   return {upserted:Number(x.upserted),deleted:Number(x.deleted)};
  },
  async eventsOfIssuer(issuer,market,o){
   checkEventsQuery(o);
   const cur=o.cursor?decodeIssuerCursor(o.cursor):null;
   const values:unknown[]=[issuer,market];let where='issuer_id = $1 and market = $2 and retired_at is null';
   if(o.since!==undefined){values.push(o.since);where+=` and occurred_on >= $${values.length}::date`;}
   if(o.until!==undefined){values.push(o.until);where+=` and occurred_on <= $${values.length}::date`;}
   if(o.kinds?.length){values.push(o.kinds);where+=` and kind = any($${values.length}::text[])`;}
   if(cur){values.push(cur[0],cur[1]);where+=` and (occurred_on < $${values.length-1}::date or (occurred_on = $${values.length-1}::date and event_id collate "C" > $${values.length}))`;}
   values.push(o.limit+1);
   const rows=await svc(c=>q(c,`select * from public.issuer_events where ${where} order by occurred_on desc, event_id collate "C" limit $${values.length}`,values));
   return issuerPage(rows.map(eventFromRow),o.limit);
  },
  async eventsOfIssuers(issuers,o){
   checkEventsQuery(o);
   const cur=o.cursor?decodeInboxCursor(o.cursor):null;
   const ids=[...new Set(issuers)];
   if(!ids.length)return {rows:[],nextCursor:null};
   const values:unknown[]=[ids];let where='issuer_id = any($1::uuid[]) and retired_at is null';
   if(o.kinds?.length){values.push(o.kinds);where+=` and kind = any($${values.length}::text[])`;}
   if(cur){values.push(cur[0],cur[1]);where+=` and (first_seen_at < $${values.length-1}::timestamptz or (first_seen_at = $${values.length-1}::timestamptz and event_id collate "C" < $${values.length}))`;}
   values.push(o.limit+1);
   const rows=await svc(c=>q(c,`select * from public.issuer_events where ${where} order by first_seen_at desc, event_id collate "C" desc limit $${values.length}`,values));
   return inboxPage(rows.map((r):RawEvent=>({row:eventFromRow(r),seen:String(r.first_seen_at)})),o.limit);
  },
  async evidenceOf(factIds){
   const out=new Map<string,EvidenceRecord>();
   for(const part of chunkOf([...new Set(factIds)],EVIDENCE_IDS_PER_CALL)){
    const x=await fn<Record<string,Row>>('service_role','public.company_fact_evidence($1::uuid[])',[part]);
    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(x??{}))out.set(k,evidenceFromJson(v));
   }
   return out;
  },
  async coverageOf(issuers){
   const ids=[...new Set(issuers)];
   if(!ids.length)return [];
   return sortCoverage((await asRole(pool,'anon',null,c=>q(c,`select * from public.issuer_coverage where issuer_id = any($1::uuid[])`,[ids]))).map(coverageFromRow));
  },
  async listCoverage(filter,sort,page){
   return coveragePageFromJson(await fn('anon','public.company_list_coverage($1,$2::uuid[],$3,$4,$5)',[filter.market??null,filter.issuerIds??null,sort,page.offset,page.limit]));
  },
  async watchesOf(userId){return (await user(userId,c=>q(c,`select * from public.company_watches order by updated_at desc, issuer_id`))).map(watchFromRow);},
  async upsertWatch(userId,issuerId){
   return user(userId,async c=>{
    const [made]=await q(c,`insert into public.company_watches(user_id,issuer_id) values($1,$2) on conflict (user_id,issuer_id) do nothing returning *`,[userId,issuerId]);
    if(made)return {row:watchFromRow(made),created:true};
    const [r]=await q(c,`select * from public.company_watches where issuer_id = $1`,[issuerId]);
    if(!r)throw new Error('watch_not_visible');
    return {row:watchFromRow(r),created:false};
   });
  },
  async patchWatch(userId,issuerId,patch){
   const p=watchPatch(patch);const cols=Object.keys(p);
   const [r]=await user(userId,c=>cols.length
    ?q(c,`update public.company_watches set ${cols.map((k,i)=>`${k==='note'?'note':'muted'} = $${i+2}`).join(', ')} where issuer_id = $1 returning *`,[issuerId,...cols.map(k=>p[k])])
    :q(c,`select * from public.company_watches where issuer_id = $1`,[issuerId]));
   return r?watchFromRow(r):null;
  },
  async deleteWatch(userId,issuerId){return (await user(userId,c=>q(c,`delete from public.company_watches where issuer_id = $1 returning issuer_id`,[issuerId]))).length>0;},
  async markRead(userId,issuerId,eventIds){
   const ids=checkEventIds(eventIds);
   if(!ids.length)return {inserted:0};
   const rows=await user(userId,c=>q(c,`insert into public.company_event_reads(user_id,issuer_id,event_id) select $1, $2, unnest($3::text[]) on conflict (user_id,event_id) do nothing returning event_id`,[userId,issuerId,ids]),'invalid_read');
   return {inserted:rows.length};
  },
  async readEventIds(userId,eventIds){
   const ids=checkEventIds(eventIds);
   if(!ids.length)return new Set();
   return new Set((await user(userId,c=>q(c,`select event_id from public.company_event_reads where event_id = any($1::text[])`,[ids]))).map(r=>String(r.event_id)));
  },
 };
}

const NAME=/^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$/;
/** Supabase-shaped rpc over node-postgres as one client role: named arguments, jsonb results, PostgREST-like {data, error}. */
export function pgRpcClient(pool:Pool,role:Role):RpcClient{
 return {
  async rpc(fnName,args){
   const keys=Object.keys(args);
   if(!NAME.test(fnName)||!keys.every(k=>NAME.test(k)))return {data:null,error:{message:'invalid_rpc_name'}};
   try{
    const data=await asRole(pool,role,null,async c=>(await q(c,`select public.${fnName}(${keys.map((k,i)=>`${k} => $${i+1}`).join(', ')}) as v`,keys.map(k=>args[k])))[0].v);
    return {data,error:null};
   }catch(e){
    const x=e as {message?:string;code?:string;details?:string|null};
    return {data:null,error:{message:x.message,code:x.code,details:x.details??null} satisfies PgErrorLike};
   }
  },
 };
}
```

说明：`patchWatch` 的列名只可能是 `note`/`muted`（`watchPatch` 只产出这两个键），模板里显式映射，不拼接任意字符串。`asRole` 在 catch 中已把错误转为 `CompanyDbError`，所以 `pgRpcClient` 把它还原成 PostgREST 形状（`message` 里已含 `"<code>: <detail>"`，`readSnapshot` 再映射时首词不变）。

**要求清单（逐条有测试）：**

1. `EVENTS_VERSION='company-events/1'`。规则任何改动 +1（本任务不改）。
2. `deriveIssuerEvents({rows, filings, cutoff})` 纯函数、确定性：同一输入（含行顺序被打乱）两次输出 `JSON.stringify` 逐字节相同；输出按 `(occurred_on, kind, natural_key)` 码点升序。
3. 输入过滤：filings 只取 `mappingGen > 0 && availableDate <= cutoff`；rows 只取 `status='ok' && available_date <= cutoff` 且 `filing_id` 属于上述 filings；`cutoff` 必须 `YYYY-MM-DD`，否则 `RangeError`。
4. `filing_published`：每个合格 filing 一条。`natural_key = filingId`；`occurred_on = availableDate`；`period_end = periodEnd`；`concept = null`；`filing_id = filingId`；payload 恰为 `{formType, fiscalYear, fiscalPeriod, periodEnd, availableDate, sourceRef, factCount}`（`factCount` 取 `FilingSummary.factCount`，同一快照计数，可为 0）；`meta = {}`。
5. `period_first_seen`：只看 `consolidation='consolidated'` 的行；期间键 `<ps>:<pe>:<duration>`，`ps = period_start ?? period_end`（INSTANT 的起点记为终点）。`occurred_on` = 组内最小 `available_date`；payload `filingId` = 取得该最小日期的行中 `fact_id` 最小者的 `filing_id`；`conceptCount` = 组内不同概念数；`headline` 只含 `revenue`、`revenue_operating`、`net_income_parent`、`operating_cash_flow`：该概念在该期间键下**当前**行（每个自然键序列的最后一条）恰好一个单位 → `{factId, value: value_text, unit}`；多个单位 → 不进 headline，概念 id 进 `ambiguousUnits`（按上面四个概念的固定顺序）；`meta = {headlineAsOf: cutoff}`；`period_end` 列 = 期末，`concept = null`，`filing_id = payload.filingId`。
6. `fact_revised`：自然键 `K = (concept, period_start, period_end, consolidation, unit)`，只看 consolidated。序列排序：`disclosure_seq`（缺失视为 ∞）→ `available_date` → `created_at`（按时刻）→ `fact_id`。**按日折叠（指挥决定）**：同一 `available_date` 的多行只保留序列中最后一行作为该日的点；相邻两点值不等（`decimalEquals(value_text)`）→ 一条事件。理由：事件唯一键 `(issuer, market, kind, natural_key)` 含 `to.available_date`，同日两条边会撞键；折叠后"同日同值不产生事件"自然成立。`natural_key = <concept>:<ps>:<pe>:consolidated:<unit>:<to.available_date>`（`ps` 同第 5 条，INSTANT 记为终点——指挥决定：与 `period_first_seen` 同一约定，payload `periodStart` 因此恒为日期）；`occurred_on = to.available_date`；`period_end`、`concept` 为该键的值；`filing_id = to.filing_id`；payload `{concept, statement: to.statement, periodStart: ps, periodEnd, duration, consolidation:'consolidated', unit, from:{factId,value,filingId,availableDate}, to:{…}, relChange?}`，`value` 一律 `value_text`；`relChange = decimalRelChange(from.value, to.value)`，`from = 0` 时省略该键；`meta = {}`。
7. 迟到的中间披露 B（可得日期在 A、C 之间）：`A→C` 的键（`to` = C 的日期）不变但 payload 变为 `B→C`，并新增 `A→B`。
8. `decimalRelChange(from, to) = (to − from) ÷ |from|`，BigInt 精确运算，四舍五入远离零到 10 位小数，再 `canonicalDecimal`（去尾零；指挥决定：与 `derive.ts` 比率输出同一规范形）；`from` 为 0 返回 `null`。`decimalSub(a,b)` 精确差，规范形。
9. `summarizeCoverage({rows, filings, scope})` → `CoverageInput`：`filings_count` = `mappingGen>0` 的 filing 数；`facts_count` = `status='ok'` 的行数（history 信封里每条披露一行；指挥决定："当前可见"按信封可见行计，与 `filing_published.factCount` 之和一致）；`concepts_covered` = 不同概念数；`earliest_period_end`/`latest_period_end` = 行的最小/最大 `period_end`；`latest_available_date` = filings 最大 `availableDate`（含零事实 filing；与目录列"最近文件日"同义）；`citation_summary = {linked, pending, edgar}` 按 `FilingSummary.citation` 计数；`scope_last_success_at`/`scope_last_status` 原样复制 `scope.last_success_at/last_status`（`scope` 为 null 时两者 null）。
10. 夹具清单 `src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest.json`（整合注：Task 19 把清单迁到最终 schema，并用 `src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest.ts` 取代本任务的 `fixture-manifest.ts`；本任务的骨架与读取器在 Task 5–18 期间有效）：列出规格二夹具文件、sha256（`shasum -a 256` 算出，**文件字节**的摘要，不是实现输出）与录制时间；期望值条目全部 `status:"pending"`、`expected:null`、`transcribed_by:null`——**不得以实现输出填期望值**（§0 #72）；`fixture-manifest.ts` 给后续验收测试用 `pendingExpectation(id)` 判断跳过。

```ts
// src/lib/company/decimal.ts
// Exact decimal helpers of the company module (spec §4.1 relChange, §5.3 formatDecimalText; plan
// 事件 payload schema). Strings in, strings out: BigInt on a common scale, never JS floating point.
// Rounding is half away from zero everywhere (same rule as facts derive.ts). Task 5 creates the
// parse/sub/relChange part; Task 7 appends the display formatting helpers below the marker.
import {canonicalDecimal} from '@/lib/facts/json-numbers';

export interface Dec{n:bigint;s:number}
export const pow10=(k:number)=>10n**BigInt(k);
/** Exact value of a decimal string (exponent forms accepted); throws invalid_decimal like canonicalDecimal. */
export function parseDecimal(v:string):Dec{
 const c=canonicalDecimal(v);
 const neg=c.startsWith('-'),body=neg?c.slice(1):c,[i,f='']=body.split('.');
 const n=BigInt(i+f);return {n:neg?-n:n,s:f.length};
}
export function decToString(d:Dec):string{
 const neg=d.n<0n;let digits=(neg?-d.n:d.n).toString();
 if(d.s>0){digits=digits.padStart(d.s+1,'0');digits=`${digits.slice(0,-d.s)}.${digits.slice(-d.s)}`;}
 return canonicalDecimal((neg?'-':'')+digits);
}
function align(a:Dec,b:Dec):[bigint,bigint,number]{const s=Math.max(a.s,b.s);return [a.n*pow10(s-a.s),b.n*pow10(s-b.s),s];}
/** num/den rounded half away from zero; den > 0. */
export function roundDiv(num:bigint,den:bigint):bigint{
 if(den<=0n)throw new RangeError('roundDiv: den must be positive');
 const q=num/den,r=num%den;                     // BigInt division truncates toward zero
 const twice=(r<0n?-r:r)*2n;
 return twice>=den?q+(num<0n?-1n:1n):q;
}
export function decimalSub(a:string,b:string):string{const [x,y,s]=align(parseDecimal(a),parseDecimal(b));return decToString({n:x-y,s});}
export const REL_CHANGE_SCALE=10;
/** (to − from) / |from| to REL_CHANGE_SCALE places, half away from zero, canonical; null when from is zero. */
export function decimalRelChange(from:string,to:string):string|null{
 const [x,y]=align(parseDecimal(from),parseDecimal(to));
 if(x===0n)return null;
 const q=roundDiv((y-x)*pow10(REL_CHANGE_SCALE),x<0n?-x:x);
 return decToString({n:q,s:REL_CHANGE_SCALE});
}
// ---- display formatting (Task 7) ----
```

// src/lib/company/test-builders.ts
// Deterministic builders for company unit tests (plan Task 5). Not a test file: Tasks 6–8 and the
// route/UI tasks import it. sequenced() delegates disclosure_seq / is_current / is_revision to the
// landed facts read semantics (src/lib/facts/read.ts::sequencesOf), never a second implementation.
import {sequencesOf} from '@/lib/facts/read';
import type {FactRow,Market} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {FilingSummary} from './types';

export const ISSUER='11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
export const uuidOf=(prefix:string,n:number)=>`${prefix.padEnd(8,'0').slice(0,8)}-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12,'0')}`;
let factN=0,filingN=0;
/** Resets the id counters (call in beforeEach when a test compares ids across builds). */
export function resetBuilders(){factN=0;filingN=0;}
export function filingSummary(o:Partial<FilingSummary>={}):FilingSummary{
 const id=o.filingId??uuidOf('f1',++filingN);
 return {filingId:id,formType:'10-K',fiscalYear:2023,fiscalPeriod:'FY',periodEnd:'2023-12-31',availableDate:'2024-02-01',sourceRef:`ref-${id.slice(-6)}`,source:'edgar',url:`https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1/${id.slice(-6)}/`,documentUrl:null,citation:'edgar',linkAttempts:0,factCount:0,mappingGen:1,...o};
}
export function factRow(filing:FilingSummary,o:Partial<FactRow>={}):FactRow{
 const n=++factN;
 const v=o.value_text??o.value??'100';
 return {fact_id:uuidOf('fa',n),issuer_id:ISSUER,market:'US' as Market,filing_id:filing.filingId,run_id:uuidOf('aa',1),concept:'revenue',source_concept:'us-gaap:Revenues',statement:'IS',
  period_start:'2023-01-01',period_end:'2023-12-31',duration:'12M',unit:'USD',consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:filing.availableDate,mapping_gen:filing.mappingGen,mapping_version:'facts-map/1',status:'ok',
  raw_hash:'0'.repeat(64),created_at:`2026-01-01T00:00:00.${String(n%1000).padStart(3,'0')}Z`,...o,value:v,value_text:v};
}
/** History envelope rows as company_read_snapshot returns them (ok rows, sequence fields filled). */
export function sequenced(rows:FactRow[],filings:FilingSummary[],asOf='2099-12-31'):FactRow[]{
 return sequencesOf(rows,{asOf,filings:new Map(filings.map(f=>[f.filingId,f.mappingGen])),history:true});
}
/** Sets factCount of each filing to its number of ok rows (what company_read_snapshot computes). */
export function withCounts(filings:FilingSummary[],rows:FactRow[]):FilingSummary[]{
 return filings.map(f=>({...f,factCount:rows.filter(r=>r.filing_id===f.filingId&&r.status==='ok').length}));
}
/** Seeded PRNG (mulberry32) for property tests. */
export function rng(seed:number):()=>number{
 let a=seed>>>0;
 return ()=>{a=(a+0x6D2B79F5)>>>0;let t=a;t=Math.imul(t^(t>>>15),t|1);t^=t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),t|61);return ((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};
}

```ts
// src/lib/company/events.ts
// Company event derivation (spec §7.1, §7.2, §4.1; plan 事件 payload schema). Pure and deterministic:
// one (issuer, market) stream's history envelope (ok rows with disclosure_seq) plus its activated
// filings, cut at `cutoff` (digest: today; replay: asOf) → filing_published / period_first_seen /
// fact_revised, sorted by (occurred_on, kind, natural_key). Natural keys never contain fact ids, so a
// mapping-generation upgrade keeps event identity. fact_revised collapses each sequence by day (the
// last row of a day is that day's point; commander decision: natural keys carry the to-date, so two
// edges on one day would collide). INSTANT periods use period_end as their start in keys and payloads.
// Values are value_text verbatim; relChange is the exact decimal of decimal.ts (omitted when from = 0).
import {decimalEquals} from '@/lib/facts/json-numbers';
import type {FactRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {decimalRelChange} from './decimal';
import type {EventInput,FilingSummary} from './types';

export const EVENTS_VERSION='company-events/1';
export const HEADLINE_CONCEPTS=['revenue','revenue_operating','net_income_parent','operating_cash_flow'] as const;
export interface DeriveEventsInput{rows:FactRow[];filings:FilingSummary[];cutoff:string}

const DAY=/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const cmpInstant=(a:string,b:string)=>{const x=Date.parse(a),y=Date.parse(b);return Number.isNaN(x)||Number.isNaN(y)?cmp(a,b):x<y?-1:x>y?1:0;};
const seqOrder=(a:FactRow,b:FactRow)=>(a.disclosure_seq??Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)-(b.disclosure_seq??Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)||cmp(a.available_date,b.available_date)||cmpInstant(a.created_at,b.created_at)||cmp(a.fact_id,b.fact_id);
const startOf=(r:FactRow)=>r.period_start??r.period_end;
const naturalK=(r:FactRow)=>[r.concept,startOf(r),r.period_end,r.consolidation,r.unit].join(':');
const periodKey=(r:FactRow)=>`${startOf(r)}:${r.period_end}:${r.duration}`;
function groupBy<T>(xs:T[],key:(x:T)=>string):Map<string,T[]>{const m=new Map<string,T[]>();for(const x of xs){const k=key(x);const g=m.get(k);if(g)g.push(x);else m.set(k,[x]);}return m;}
const point=(r:FactRow)=>({factId:r.fact_id,value:r.value_text,filingId:r.filing_id,availableDate:r.available_date});

export function deriveIssuerEvents(input:DeriveEventsInput):EventInput[]{
 const {cutoff}=input;
 if(!DAY.test(cutoff)||Number.isNaN(Date.parse(`${cutoff}T00:00:00Z`)))throw new RangeError(`cutoff must be YYYY-MM-DD, got ${cutoff}`);
 const filings=input.filings.filter(f=>f.mappingGen>0&&f.availableDate<=cutoff);
 const ids=new Set(filings.map(f=>f.filingId));
 const rows=input.rows.filter(r=>r.status==='ok'&&r.available_date<=cutoff&&ids.has(r.filing_id));
 const out:EventInput[]=[];
 for(const f of filings)out.push({kind:'filing_published',natural_key:f.filingId,occurred_on:f.availableDate,period_end:f.periodEnd,concept:null,filing_id:f.filingId,
  payload:{formType:f.formType,fiscalYear:f.fiscalYear,fiscalPeriod:f.fiscalPeriod,periodEnd:f.periodEnd,availableDate:f.availableDate,sourceRef:f.sourceRef,factCount:f.factCount},meta:{}});
 const cons=rows.filter(r=>r.consolidation==='consolidated');
 // sequences per natural key; current = last in sequence order
 const current=new Map<string,FactRow>();
 for(const [k,g] of groupBy(cons,naturalK)){
  g.sort(seqOrder);current.set(k,g[g.length-1]);
  const days:FactRow[]=[];
  for(const r of g){if(days.length>0&&days[days.length-1].available_date===r.available_date)days[days.length-1]=r;else days.push(r);}
  for(let i=1;i<days.length;i++){
   const from=days[i-1],to=days[i];
   if(decimalEquals(from.value_text,to.value_text))continue;
   const rel=decimalRelChange(from.value_text,to.value_text);
   out.push({kind:'fact_revised',natural_key:`${k}:${to.available_date}`,occurred_on:to.available_date,period_end:to.period_end,concept:to.concept,filing_id:to.filing_id,
    payload:{concept:to.concept,statement:to.statement,periodStart:startOf(to),periodEnd:to.period_end,duration:to.duration,consolidation:'consolidated',unit:to.unit,from:point(from),to:point(to),...(rel===null?{}:{relChange:rel})},meta:{}});
  }
 }
 for(const [pk,g] of groupBy(cons,periodKey)){
  const first=[...g].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.available_date,b.available_date)||cmp(a.fact_id,b.fact_id))[0];
  const currents=[...current.values()].filter(r=>periodKey(r)===pk);
  const headline:Record<string,{factId:string;value:string;unit:string}>={};const ambiguousUnits:string[]=[];
  for(const c of HEADLINE_CONCEPTS){
   const hs=currents.filter(r=>r.concept===c);
   if(hs.length===1)headline[c]={factId:hs[0].fact_id,value:hs[0].value_text,unit:hs[0].unit};
   else if(hs.length>1)ambiguousUnits.push(c);
  }
  out.push({kind:'period_first_seen',natural_key:pk,occurred_on:first.available_date,period_end:first.period_end,concept:null,filing_id:first.filing_id,
   payload:{periodStart:startOf(first),periodEnd:first.period_end,duration:first.duration,filingId:first.filing_id,conceptCount:new Set(g.map(r=>r.concept)).size,headline,ambiguousUnits},meta:{headlineAsOf:cutoff}});
 }
 return out.sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.occurred_on,b.occurred_on)||cmp(a.kind,b.kind)||cmp(a.natural_key,b.natural_key));
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/coverage.ts
// issuer_coverage row of one (issuer, market) stream (spec §4.2, §6.3). Pure: counts and dates only,
// never a financial value (issuer_coverage stays public). facts_count = visible ok rows of the history
// envelope (one per disclosure); latest_available_date comes from the filings (zero-fact filings
// included); citation_summary counts FilingSummary.citation; scope_last_* are copied from
// fact_sync_scope (last_success_at / last_status) — no freshness status is stored (§4.2).
import type {FactRow,ScopeRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {CoverageInput,FilingSummary} from './types';

export type CoverageScope=Pick<ScopeRow,'last_success_at'|'last_status'>;
export function summarizeCoverage(input:{rows:FactRow[];filings:FilingSummary[];scope:CoverageScope|null}):CoverageInput{
 const rows=input.rows.filter(r=>r.status==='ok');
 const filings=input.filings.filter(f=>f.mappingGen>0);
 const ends=rows.map(r=>r.period_end).sort();
 const avail=filings.map(f=>f.availableDate).sort();
 const cite={linked:0,pending:0,edgar:0};
 for(const f of filings)cite[f.citation]++;
 return {filings_count:filings.length,facts_count:rows.length,concepts_covered:new Set(rows.map(r=>r.concept)).size,
  earliest_period_end:ends[0]??null,latest_period_end:ends[ends.length-1]??null,latest_available_date:avail[avail.length-1]??null,
  citation_summary:cite,scope_last_success_at:input.scope?.last_success_at??null,scope_last_status:input.scope?.last_status??null};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/fixture-manifest.ts
// Loader of src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest.json (spec §12.0, §0 #72). Acceptance tests call
// pendingExpectation(id) and skip while the owner-transcribed value is missing; expected values are
// never generated from implementation output.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';

export interface ManifestFixture{id:string;path:string;sha256:string;recorded_at:string;synthetic?:boolean}
export interface ManifestExpectation{id:string;kind:string;status:'pending'|'transcribed';request:Record<string,unknown>;expected:unknown;source:{document:string;page_or_row:string|null;url:string|null};transcribed_by:string|null;transcribed_at:string|null}
export interface FixtureManifest{version:number;note:string;fixtures:ManifestFixture[];expectations:ManifestExpectation[]}
const PATH=new URL('./fixtures/manifest.json',import.meta.url);
export function loadFixtureManifest():FixtureManifest{return JSON.parse(readFileSync(PATH,'utf8')) as FixtureManifest;}
export function expectationOf(id:string):ManifestExpectation|null{return loadFixtureManifest().expectations.find(e=>e.id===id)??null;}
export function pendingExpectation(id:string):boolean{const e=expectationOf(id);return e===null||e.status!=='transcribed'||e.expected===null;}
```

### Task 6: 证据索引构建器 `evidence-index.ts`、`pdf-locator.ts`、证据门槛 `evidence-gate.ts`

**规格依据**：§0.1 item 2 / 2' / 2''、§0 #62 #63、§5.6、§11、§12.1 evidence-gate.test。

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/company/evidence-index.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/company/evidence-index.test.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/company/pdf-locator.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/company/evidence-gate.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/company/evidence-gate.test.ts`

**要求清单：**

A. **快照读取器** `SnapshotObjectStore {list(prefix), get(path), meta(path)}`：`list` 返回 `prefix` 下**数据对象**的完整路径（只匹配 `<64 hex>.json`，排除 `.meta.json`），升序；`get` 返回字节或 `null`（对象不存在）；`meta` 读 `metaPath(path)` 的 sidecar JSON（不存在或不是 JSON → `null`）。两个实现：`memorySnapshotObjectStore(objects)`（包 `memorySnapshotStore().objects`）与 `supabaseSnapshotObjectStore(admin)`（`admin.storage.from(SNAPSHOT_BUCKET)`：`list(folder,{limit:1000,offset,sortBy:{column:'name',order:'asc'}})` 翻页到不足 1000；`download(path)`；不存在 → `null`；其他错误抛 `snapshot_list_failed` / `snapshot_download_failed`，只带固定码，不带响应内容）。

B. **构建器** `buildEvidenceIndex({reader}, {issuerId, market, rows, filings, cache?})` → `{rows: EvidenceIndexRow[], stats}`，供 `CompanyDb.replaceEvidence(issuer, market, rows)`（整流替换）。步骤：
 1. `source = US ? 'edgar' : 'tushare'`；列出 `${source}/${issuerId}/` 下全部对象。
 2. 每个对象：字节缺失 → `missingObject`；sidecar 缺失 → `missingSidecar`；`sha256(bytes)` ≠ 文件名中的哈希，或 sidecar 带 `sha256` 且不等，或 sidecar `source` ≠ 本流来源 → `hashMismatch`；以上都不写行。
 3. 用**已落地解析器**重新解析（只读 import）：EDGAR `parseCompanyFacts(snapshot, {sinceYear: 1900})`；Tushare **逐个快照** `parseTushareStatements([snapshot], {sinceYear: 1900})`（指挥决定：同一次抓取的多页里同一行不会重复出现，逐页解析得到的候选是同步时候选的超集；匹配靠全键，超集无害；而跨抓取批次合并解析会让同组只留第一页的 raw_hash，丢掉后来快照的关联）。`sinceYear: 1900` 保证不跳过任何期间。解析抛错 → `parseFailed`。候选集合 = `candidates ∪ ambiguous[*].candidates ∪ oddDuration`（都带运行时 `locator`）。
 4. 事实行：只看 `status='ok'`；对每行取 `raw_hash` 相同的候选，再要求**全部相等**：`concept`、`sourceConcept = source_concept`、`filingRef = 该行 filing 的 sourceRef`、`periodStart ?? '' = period_start ?? ''`、`periodEnd`、`unit`。0 个 → `unmatched`；>1 个 → `multiMatch`；恰 1 个但 `!decimalEquals(candidate.value, value_text)` → `valueMismatch`。都不写行，从不猜测。
 5. JSON pointer：EDGAR 定位串 `facts.<tax>.<tag>.units.<rawUnit>[<idx>](…)` → `/facts/<tax>/<tag>/units/<rawUnit>/<idx>`，各段按 RFC 6901 转义（`~`→`~0`、`/`→`~1`，所以 `USD/shares` 写作 `USD~1shares`），`field = null`；Tushare 定位串 `…,row=<n>]` → `/data/items/<n>`，`field` = `source_concept` 第一个 `.` 之后的部分（求和概念为 `a+b`，如 `sell_exp+admin_exp`）。**取值复核**：EDGAR 按 pointer 在 `decodeCompanyFacts(bytes)` 的文档上取到条目，`val` 规范值必须等于事实值；Tushare 在 `scanJsonNumbers(bytes)` 的 `data.fields/items` 上取该行字段（求和用 landed `addDecimals`），必须等于事实值。失败 → `pointerUnresolved`，不写行。
 6. 行字段：`fact_id, raw_hash, snapshot_sha256, snapshot_path, hash_locator`（解析器原样定位串）`, json_pointer, field, source, api`（sidecar `api ?? null`）`, url`（`url ?? null`）`, params`（去掉键名匹配 `/token|secret|password|api_?key/i` 的项；无则 `null`）`, captured_at`（sidecar `fetched_at`——"快照首次抓取时间"，不是本次运行时间）`, http_status, page`（`page ?? null`）`, index_version = EVIDENCE_INDEX_VERSION`。按 `fact_id` 升序。
 7. `cache`（同一次 digest 尝试内的 stale 重试复用）：按路径缓存解析结果或失败原因；命中时不再调用 `reader.get/meta`，统计照常计数。

C. **PDF 定位**：`PdfLocatorSource {locate(issuerId, market, factIds) → Map<factId, PdfLocator>}`；`emptyPdfLocatorSource` 恒空（规格三落地前的缺省，CN 公共值一律 `citation_pending`）；`staticPdfLocatorSource(record)` 供测试与 §0 #65 "注入了 PDF 定位的 CN 夹具"。

D. **证据 DTO 与门槛**（§0 #62 #63，所有含财务数值的路由共用）：
 - `toEvidenceDto(record, fact, filing, pdf)`：字段按 `EvidenceDto` 一一映射；`snapshot.download = source==='edgar' ? '/api/companies/snapshot?fact=<factId>' : null`（稳定端点，不是签名 URL）；`sourceDocument`：US 且 `filing.url` 非空 → `{kind:'edgar_index', url}`；CN 且 `citation='linked'` 且 `documentUrl` 非空 → `{kind:'cninfo_pdf', url: documentUrl}`；否则 `null`；`unitRule = 'unit_' + unitKindOf(fact.unit)`（`units.ts` 的规则名；未知单位 → `null`）。
 - `evidenceEligible(dto, fact, filing, market, {admin})` → `{ok:true} | {ok:false, reason}`：
   - **基础（`evidence_incomplete`，admin 也不豁免）**：`dto` 为 null；`dto.factId ≠ fact.fact_id`；`filing` 为 null 或 `filing.filingId ≠ fact.filing_id`；`dto.rawHash ≠ fact.raw_hash`；`snapshot.sha256` 不是 64 位十六进制、`locator.hashLocator` 为空，或 `rawHashOf(snapshot.sha256, hashLocator) ≠ rawHash`（指挥决定：#62 的读者回放链对两个市场都必须成立）；`snapshot.source` 与市场不符（US→edgar、CN→tushare）；`run.codeVersion` 空；`run.toolVersions` 为 null；`mappingVersion` 空。
   - **US 另须（`evidence_incomplete`）**：`locator.jsonPointer` 非空、`snapshot.download` 非空、`sourceDocument.kind='edgar_index'` 且 `url` 非空。
   - **CN 另须（`citation_pending`；`admin:true` 时整组豁免）**：`filing.citation='linked'`；`filing.documentUrl` 是非空 https URL；`locator.pdf` 存在且 `pdf.documentUrl === filing.documentUrl`（`pdf` 按 factId 取得，因此同时绑定该事实与该文档）。
   - 基础与 CN 条件同时缺失时报 `evidence_incomplete`（基础优先）。
 - `applyGate({factIds, facts, filings, records, pdf, market, admin})`（纯）→ `{evidence, eligibility, withheld}`：对去重后的每个 id，没有事实行 → `evidence_incomplete`；`evidence` 字典**只含合格事实**的 DTO；`withheld` 按不同 factId 计数 `{evidenceIncomplete, citationPending}`。
 - `gateFacts({db, pdf}, {issuerId, market, admin, factIds, facts, filings})`（异步，路由用）：`db.evidenceOf(去重升序 ids)`（`CompanyDb.evidenceOf` 内部按 ≤100 分批）；只对 CN 调 `pdf.locate`；无 id 时不调用任何依赖；然后 `applyGate`。
 - 消费者助手：`gateCell(cell, eligibility)`（事实格不合格 → `{kind:'withheld', reason, factId}`；派生格任一输入不合格 → 整格 withheld，原因取最严重者：有 `evidence_incomplete` 即它，否则 `citation_pending`，`factId` 为第一个不合格输入；`null`/withheld 原样）；`gateEventPayload(event, eligibility)`（`period_first_seen.headline` 每项不合格 → 该项的 `value` 换成 `{kind:'withheld',reason,factId}`（`factId`/`unit` 保留；与 `from/to` 同形，计划第 1 轮审计 P4）；`fact_revised` 的 `from/to` 不合格 → 其 `value` 换成 `{kind:'withheld',reason,factId}`，此时 `relChange`（若存在）换成 `{kind:'withheld',reason}`；`filing_published` 原样）；`metricWithheldReason(inputs, eligibility)`（指标行任一输入不合格 → 原因，否则 `null`）；`eventFactIds(event)`（headline 与 from/to 的 factId）。报表格、派生格 inputs、事件 headline/from/to/relChange、指标行各有"不合格 → withheld"用例在本任务；packet、抽屉序列、DCF 叶子三例在 Task 9/14/15 用这些同一助手各写一例。

 for(const s of snaps)await store.put(s,snapshotPath(source,ISSUER,s.sha256),budget());

 });

}

  expect(tusharePointer('income:rt1:p1[end_date=20231231,ann=20240403,update_flag=1,row=17]','income.total_revenue')).toEqual({pointer:'/data/items/17',field:'total_revenue'});
  expect(tusharePointer('nope','income.total_revenue')).toBeNull();
  expect(resolvePointer({a:{'b/c':[1,{d:2}]}},'/a/b~1c/1/d')).toBe(2);
  expect(resolvePointer({a:[1]},'/a/5')).toBeUndefined();
 });
});

```ts
// src/lib/company/evidence-index.ts
// Evidence index builder (spec §0.1 item 2): the verified association fact → raw snapshot that the
// landed facts layer does not store. For one (issuer, market) stream: list the snapshots under
// {source}/{issuer}/ (bucket disclosure-raw), verify the byte SHA-256 against the object name and
// the .meta.json sidecar, re-parse with the LANDED parsers (read-only imports; sinceYear 1900 so no
// period is skipped; Tushare one snapshot at a time — a superset of the sync candidates), and match
// each ok fact row on the FULL key (raw_hash, concept, source_concept, filing source_ref,
// period_start, period_end, unit, canonical value): a Tushare row shares one raw_hash across its
// concepts, so the hash alone is not enough. The JSON pointer is derived from the parser locator and
// re-resolved against the bytes; any doubt (missing object/sidecar, hash mismatch, parser error,
// zero or several matches, value or pointer mismatch) writes NO row (the fact stays
// evidence_incomplete). Output feeds CompanyDb.replaceEvidence (whole-stream replacement).
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {SNAPSHOT_BUCKET,metaPath} from '@/lib/facts/snapshot-store';
import {decodeCompanyFacts,parseCompanyFacts} from '@/lib/facts/providers/edgar-companyfacts';
import {addDecimals,parseTushareStatements} from '@/lib/facts/providers/tushare-statements';
import {canonicalDecimal,decimalEquals,isNumToken,scanJsonNumbers} from '@/lib/facts/json-numbers';
import type {FactCandidate,FactRow,Market,ParseResult,RawSnapshot,Source} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {EVIDENCE_INDEX_VERSION} from './types';
import type {EvidenceIndexRow,FilingSummary} from './types';

export interface SnapshotSidecar{source:Source;api?:string;url?:string;params?:Record<string,unknown>;fields?:string;fetched_at:string;http_status:number;has_more?:boolean;page?:number;sha256?:string;bytes?:number}
export interface SnapshotObjectStore{
 /** Full paths of the data objects (<sha256>.json, sidecars excluded) under prefix, ascending. */
 list(prefix:string):Promise<string[]>;
 get(path:string):Promise<Uint8Array|null>;
 meta(path:string):Promise<SnapshotSidecar|null>;
}
const OBJECT=/^[0-9a-f]{64}\.json$/;
const parseSidecar=(v:string|Uint8Array|null|undefined):SnapshotSidecar|null=>{
 if(v===null||v===undefined)return null;
 try{const j=JSON.parse(typeof v==='string'?v:new TextDecoder().decode(v));return j&&typeof j==='object'?j as SnapshotSidecar:null;}catch{return null;}
};
export function memorySnapshotObjectStore(objects:Map<string,string|Uint8Array>):SnapshotObjectStore{
 return {
  async list(prefix){return [...objects.keys()].filter(k=>k.startsWith(prefix)&&OBJECT.test(k.slice(prefix.length))).sort();},
  async get(path){const v=objects.get(path);return v===undefined?null:typeof v==='string'?new TextEncoder().encode(v):new Uint8Array(v);},
  async meta(path){return parseSidecar(objects.get(metaPath(path)));},
 };
}
interface StorageError{message:string;statusCode?:string|number;status?:number}
const notFound=(e:StorageError)=>['400','404'].includes(String(e.statusCode??e.status??''))||/not found/i.test(e.message);
export function supabaseSnapshotObjectStore(admin:SupabaseClient):SnapshotObjectStore{
 const bucket=()=>admin.storage.from(SNAPSHOT_BUCKET);
 const get=async(path:string):Promise<Uint8Array|null>=>{
  const {data,error}=await bucket().download(path);
  if(error){if(notFound(error as StorageError))return null;throw new Error('snapshot_download_failed');}
  return new Uint8Array(await data.arrayBuffer());
 };
 return {
  async list(prefix){
   const folder=prefix.replace(/\/$/,'');const out:string[]=[];
   for(let offset=0;;offset+=1000){
    const {data,error}=await bucket().list(folder,{limit:1000,offset,sortBy:{column:'name',order:'asc'}});
    if(error)throw new Error('snapshot_list_failed');
    for(const o of data??[])if(OBJECT.test(o.name))out.push(`${folder}/${o.name}`);
    if((data??[]).length<1000)break;
   }
   return out.sort();
  },
  get,
  async meta(path){return parseSidecar(await get(metaPath(path)));},
 };
}

// ---- pointers ----
const esc=(s:string)=>s.replace(/~/g,'~0').replace(/\//g,'~1');
const unesc=(s:string)=>s.replace(/~1/g,'/').replace(/~0/g,'~');
export function edgarPointer(locator:string):string|null{
 const m=/^facts\.([^.]+)\.([^.]+)\.units\.([^[]+)\[(\d+)\]\(/.exec(locator);
 return m?`/facts/${esc(m[1])}/${esc(m[2])}/units/${esc(m[3])}/${m[4]}`:null;
}
export function tusharePointer(locator:string,sourceConcept:string):{pointer:string;field:string}|null{
 const m=/,row=(\d+)\]$/.exec(locator);const dot=sourceConcept.indexOf('.');
 return m&&dot>0?{pointer:`/data/items/${m[1]}`,field:sourceConcept.slice(dot+1)}:null;
}
export function resolvePointer(doc:unknown,pointer:string):unknown{
 if(pointer==='')return doc;
 let cur:unknown=doc;
 for(const raw of pointer.split('/').slice(1)){
  const k=unesc(raw);
  if(Array.isArray(cur)){if(!/^\d+$/.test(k))return undefined;cur=cur[Number(k)];}
  else if(cur!==null&&typeof cur==='object'&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(cur,k))cur=(cur as Record<string,unknown>)[k];
  else return undefined;
 }
 return cur;
}
const cellDecimal=(v:unknown):string|null=>{
 try{if(isNumToken(v))return canonicalDecimal(v.__num);if(typeof v==='string'&&v!=='')return canonicalDecimal(v);}catch{/* not a decimal */}
 return null;
};
/** Value at the Tushare row pointer for `field` (a+b sums), or null. */
function tushareValue(json:unknown,pointer:string,field:string):string|null{
 const fields=resolvePointer(json,'/data/fields');const row=resolvePointer(json,pointer);
 if(!Array.isArray(fields)||!Array.isArray(row))return null;
 const parts=field.split('+').map(f=>{const i=fields.indexOf(f);return i<0?null:cellDecimal(row[i]);});
 return parts.every((p):p is string=>p!==null)?parts.reduce(addDecimals):null;
}

// ---- builder ----
type Located=FactCandidate&{locator:string};
export interface ParsedSnapshot{path:string;sha256:string;meta:SnapshotSidecar;candidates:Located[];doc:unknown}
export type SnapshotFailure='missingObject'|'missingSidecar'|'hashMismatch'|'parseFailed';
export type ParsedSnapshotCache=Map<string,ParsedSnapshot|{failed:SnapshotFailure}>;
export interface EvidenceIndexStats{objects:number;missingObject:number;missingSidecar:number;hashMismatch:number;parseFailed:number;facts:number;indexed:number;unmatched:number;multiMatch:number;valueMismatch:number;pointerUnresolved:number}
export interface EvidenceIndexResult{rows:EvidenceIndexRow[];stats:EvidenceIndexStats}
export interface EvidenceIndexInput{issuerId:string;market:Market;rows:FactRow[];filings:FilingSummary[];cache?:ParsedSnapshotCache}
export const EVIDENCE_SINCE_YEAR=1900;
const SECRET_PARAM=/token|secret|password|api_?key/i;
const scrub=(p:Record<string,unknown>|undefined)=>{if(!p)return null;const e=Object.entries(p).filter(([k])=>!SECRET_PARAM.test(k));return e.length?Object.fromEntries(e):null;};
const sha256=(b:Uint8Array)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const emptyStats=():EvidenceIndexStats=>({objects:0,missingObject:0,missingSidecar:0,hashMismatch:0,parseFailed:0,facts:0,indexed:0,unmatched:0,multiMatch:0,valueMismatch:0,pointerUnresolved:0});

async function loadSnapshot(reader:SnapshotObjectStore,path:string,prefix:string,source:Source):Promise<ParsedSnapshot|{failed:SnapshotFailure}>{
 const bytes=await reader.get(path);if(!bytes)return {failed:'missingObject'};
 const meta=await reader.meta(path);if(!meta)return {failed:'missingSidecar'};
 const sha=sha256(bytes);
 if(sha!==path.slice(prefix.length,-'.json'.length)||(meta.sha256!==undefined&&meta.sha256!==sha)||meta.source!==source)return {failed:'hashMismatch'};
 const snap:RawSnapshot={bytes,sha256:sha,meta:meta as RawSnapshot['meta']};
 try{
  const p:ParseResult=source==='edgar'?parseCompanyFacts(snap,{sinceYear:EVIDENCE_SINCE_YEAR}):parseTushareStatements([snap],{sinceYear:EVIDENCE_SINCE_YEAR});
  const candidates=[...p.candidates,...p.ambiguous.flatMap(a=>a.candidates),...p.oddDuration].filter((c):c is Located=>typeof (c as Partial<Located>).locator==='string');
  const doc=source==='edgar'?decodeCompanyFacts(bytes):scanJsonNumbers(bytes);
  return {path,sha256:sha,meta,candidates,doc};
 }catch{return {failed:'parseFailed'};}
}

export async function buildEvidenceIndex(deps:{reader:SnapshotObjectStore},input:EvidenceIndexInput):Promise<EvidenceIndexResult>{
 const source:Source=input.market==='US'?'edgar':'tushare';
 const prefix=`${source}/${input.issuerId}/`;
 const cache:ParsedSnapshotCache=input.cache??new Map();
 const stats=emptyStats();
 const byHash=new Map<string,{snap:ParsedSnapshot;cand:Located}[]>();
 for(const path of await deps.reader.list(prefix)){
  stats.objects++;
  let got=cache.get(path);
  if(got===undefined){got=await loadSnapshot(deps.reader,path,prefix,source);cache.set(path,got);}
  if('failed' in got){stats[got.failed]++;continue;}
  for(const cand of got.candidates){const list=byHash.get(cand.rawHash)??[];list.push({snap:got,cand});byHash.set(cand.rawHash,list);}
 }
 const refOf=new Map(input.filings.map(f=>[f.filingId,f.sourceRef]));
 const out:EvidenceIndexRow[]=[];
 for(const f of input.rows){
  if(f.status!=='ok')continue;
  stats.facts++;
  const ref=refOf.get(f.filing_id);
  const hits=(byHash.get(f.raw_hash)??[]).filter(({cand:c})=>ref!==undefined&&c.concept===f.concept&&c.sourceConcept===f.source_concept&&c.filingRef===ref
   &&(c.periodStart??'')===(f.period_start??'')&&c.periodEnd===f.period_end&&c.unit===f.unit);
  if(hits.length===0){stats.unmatched++;continue;}
  if(hits.length>1){stats.multiMatch++;continue;}
  const {snap,cand}=hits[0];
  if(!decimalEquals(cand.value,f.value_text)){stats.valueMismatch++;continue;}
  let pointer:string|null=null,field:string|null=null,resolved:string|null=null;
  if(source==='edgar'){
   pointer=edgarPointer(cand.locator);
   const entry=pointer===null?undefined:resolvePointer(snap.doc,pointer) as {val?:unknown}|undefined;
   resolved=entry&&typeof entry.val==='string'?entry.val:null;
  }else{
   const t=tusharePointer(cand.locator,cand.sourceConcept);
   if(t){pointer=t.pointer;field=t.field;resolved=tushareValue(snap.doc,t.pointer,t.field);}
  }
  if(pointer===null||resolved===null||!decimalEquals(resolved,f.value_text)){stats.pointerUnresolved++;continue;}
  out.push({fact_id:f.fact_id,raw_hash:f.raw_hash,snapshot_sha256:snap.sha256,snapshot_path:snap.path,hash_locator:cand.locator,json_pointer:pointer,field,source,
   api:snap.meta.api??null,url:snap.meta.url??null,params:scrub(snap.meta.params),captured_at:snap.meta.fetched_at??null,http_status:snap.meta.http_status??null,page:snap.meta.page??null,index_version:EVIDENCE_INDEX_VERSION});
  stats.indexed++;
 }
 out.sort((a,b)=>a.fact_id<b.fact_id?-1:a.fact_id>b.fact_id?1:0);
 return {rows:out,stats};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/pdf-locator.ts
// CN per-value PDF locators (spec §0.1 item 2'): produced by spec 3's cninfo per-value reconciliation,
// which has not landed. The default source returns nothing, so every public CN value is withheld as
// citation_pending; spec 3 injects a real source later. staticPdfLocatorSource serves tests and the
// injected CN acceptance fixture of §0 #65.
import type {Market} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {PdfLocator} from './types';

export interface PdfLocatorSource{locate(issuerId:string,market:Market,factIds:string[]):Promise<Map<string,PdfLocator>>}
export const emptyPdfLocatorSource:PdfLocatorSource={async locate(){return new Map();}};
export function staticPdfLocatorSource(byFact:Record<string,PdfLocator>):PdfLocatorSource{
 return {async locate(_issuer,_market,factIds){return new Map(factIds.filter(id=>byFact[id]!==undefined).map(id=>[id,byFact[id]]));}};
}
```

注意：若 lint 报 `_issuer`/`_market` 未使用，改成 `async locate(...args){const factIds=args[2];…}`，保持签名不变。

```ts
// src/lib/company/evidence-gate.ts
// The one evidence gate of the company module (spec §0 #62 #63, §5.6, §6.1). toEvidenceDto shapes an
// evidence-index record (company_fact_evidence) into the public DTO; evidenceEligible decides whether
// a value may be published: base evidence (record present and bound to the fact and its filing, the
// replay chain rawHash = sha256(sha + '\n' + hashLocator), code/tool/mapping versions) is never
// waived; US also needs pointer, stable download and the EDGAR index document; CN needs a linked
// cninfo filing with an https document URL and a per-value PDF locator bound to that document — the
// only part the admin variant waives. Every route that returns a financial value calls gateFacts and
// the consumer helpers below; an ineligible value never leaves the server (withheld, reason counted).
import {rawHashOf} from '@/lib/facts/providers/shared';
import {unitKindOf} from '@/lib/facts/units';
import type {FactRow,Market} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {PdfLocatorSource} from './pdf-locator';
import type {Cell,CompanyDb,EventKind,EvidenceDto,EvidenceRecord,FilingSummary,PdfLocator,WithheldCounts,WithheldReason} from './types';

export type Eligibility={ok:true}|{ok:false;reason:WithheldReason};
export type GateFact=Pick<FactRow,'fact_id'|'raw_hash'|'unit'|'filing_id'|'run_id'>;
export const snapshotDownloadPath=(factId:string)=>`/api/companies/snapshot?fact=${encodeURIComponent(factId)}`;
const HEX64=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const httpsUrl=(u:string|null|undefined)=>{if(!u)return false;try{return new URL(u).protocol==='https:';}catch{return false;}};

export function toEvidenceDto(record:EvidenceRecord,fact:GateFact,filing:FilingSummary|null,pdf:PdfLocator|null):EvidenceDto{
 const kind=unitKindOf(fact.unit);
 const sourceDocument:EvidenceDto['sourceDocument']=record.source==='edgar'
  ?(filing?.url?{kind:'edgar_index',url:filing.url}:null)
  :(filing?.citation==='linked'&&filing.documentUrl?{kind:'cninfo_pdf',url:filing.documentUrl}:null);
 return {factId:record.fact_id,rawHash:record.raw_hash,
  snapshot:{source:record.source,sha256:record.snapshot_sha256,path:record.snapshot_path,api:record.api,url:record.url,params:record.params,capturedAt:record.captured_at,httpStatus:record.http_status,page:record.page,download:record.source==='edgar'?snapshotDownloadPath(record.fact_id):null},
  locator:{hashLocator:record.hash_locator,jsonPointer:record.json_pointer,field:record.field,pdf},
  run:{runId:record.run_id,codeVersion:record.code_version,toolVersions:record.tool_versions},
  mappingVersion:record.mapping_version,unitRule:kind?`unit_${kind}`:null,sourceDocument};
}

const NO=(reason:WithheldReason):Eligibility=>({ok:false,reason});
export function evidenceEligible(dto:EvidenceDto|null,fact:GateFact,filing:FilingSummary|null,market:Market,opts:{admin:boolean}):Eligibility{
 if(!dto||dto.factId!==fact.fact_id||!filing||filing.filingId!==fact.filing_id||dto.rawHash!==fact.raw_hash)return NO('evidence_incomplete');
 if(!HEX64.test(dto.snapshot.sha256)||!dto.locator.hashLocator||rawHashOf(dto.snapshot.sha256,dto.locator.hashLocator)!==dto.rawHash)return NO('evidence_incomplete');
 if(dto.snapshot.source!==(market==='US'?'edgar':'tushare'))return NO('evidence_incomplete');
 if(!dto.run.codeVersion||dto.run.toolVersions===null||!dto.mappingVersion)return NO('evidence_incomplete');
 if(market==='US'){
  if(!dto.locator.jsonPointer||!dto.snapshot.download||dto.sourceDocument?.kind!=='edgar_index'||!dto.sourceDocument.url)return NO('evidence_incomplete');
  return {ok:true};
 }
 if(opts.admin)return {ok:true};
 const pdf=dto.locator.pdf;
 if(filing.citation!=='linked'||!httpsUrl(filing.documentUrl)||!pdf||pdf.documentUrl!==filing.documentUrl)return NO('citation_pending');
 return {ok:true};
}

export interface GateInput{factIds:Iterable<string>;facts:Map<string,GateFact>;filings:Map<string,FilingSummary>;records:Map<string,EvidenceRecord>;pdf:Map<string,PdfLocator>;market:Market;admin:boolean}
export interface GateResult{evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;eligibility:Map<string,Eligibility>;withheld:WithheldCounts}
export function applyGate(input:GateInput):GateResult{
 const evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>={};const eligibility=new Map<string,Eligibility>();const withheld:WithheldCounts={evidenceIncomplete:0,citationPending:0};
 for(const id of [...new Set(input.factIds)].sort()){
  const fact=input.facts.get(id);
  let e:Eligibility;let dto:EvidenceDto|null=null;
  if(!fact)e=NO('evidence_incomplete');
  else{
   const rec=input.records.get(id);const filing=input.filings.get(fact.filing_id)??null;
   dto=rec?toEvidenceDto(rec,fact,filing,input.pdf.get(id)??null):null;
   e=evidenceEligible(dto,fact,filing,input.market,{admin:input.admin});
  }
  eligibility.set(id,e);
  if(e.ok&&dto)evidence[id]=dto;
  else if(!e.ok){if(e.reason==='evidence_incomplete')withheld.evidenceIncomplete++;else withheld.citationPending++;}
 }
 return {evidence,eligibility,withheld};
}
export interface GateDeps{db:Pick<CompanyDb,'evidenceOf'>;pdf:PdfLocatorSource}
export async function gateFacts(deps:GateDeps,input:{issuerId:string;market:Market;admin:boolean;factIds:Iterable<string>;facts:Map<string,GateFact>;filings:Map<string,FilingSummary>}):Promise<GateResult>{
 const ids=[...new Set(input.factIds)].sort();
 if(ids.length===0)return {evidence:{},eligibility:new Map(),withheld:{evidenceIncomplete:0,citationPending:0}};
 const records=await deps.db.evidenceOf(ids);
 const pdf=input.market==='CN'?await deps.pdf.locate(input.issuerId,input.market,ids):new Map<string,PdfLocator>();
 return applyGate({factIds:ids,facts:input.facts,filings:input.filings,records,pdf,market:input.market,admin:input.admin});
}

// ---- consumer helpers ----
const reasonOf=(e:Eligibility|undefined):WithheldReason|null=>e?.ok?null:e?e.reason:'evidence_incomplete';
const worst=(rs:WithheldReason[])=>rs.includes('evidence_incomplete')?'evidence_incomplete' as const:'citation_pending' as const;
export function gateCell(cell:Cell,elig:Map<string,Eligibility>):Cell{
 if(cell===null||cell.kind==='withheld')return cell;
 if(cell.kind==='fact'){const r=reasonOf(elig.get(cell.factId));return r===null?cell:{kind:'withheld',reason:r,factId:cell.factId};}
 const bad=cell.inputs.map(i=>({id:i.factId,r:reasonOf(elig.get(i.factId))})).filter((x):x is {id:string;r:WithheldReason}=>x.r!==null);
 return bad.length===0?cell:{kind:'withheld',reason:worst(bad.map(b=>b.r)),factId:bad[0].id};
}
export function metricWithheldReason(inputs:{fact_id:string}[],elig:Map<string,Eligibility>):WithheldReason|null{
 const rs=inputs.map(i=>reasonOf(elig.get(i.fact_id))).filter((r):r is WithheldReason=>r!==null);
 return rs.length===0?null:worst(rs);
}
type Point={factId:string;value:unknown;[k:string]:unknown};
export function eventFactIds(ev:{kind:EventKind;payload:Record<string,unknown>}):string[]{
 if(ev.kind==='period_first_seen')return Object.values((ev.payload.headline??{}) as Record<string,Point>).map(h=>h.factId);
 if(ev.kind==='fact_revised')return [(ev.payload.from as Point).factId,(ev.payload.to as Point).factId];
 return [];
}
export function gateEventPayload(ev:{kind:EventKind;payload:Record<string,unknown>},elig:Map<string,Eligibility>):Record<string,unknown>{
 if(ev.kind==='period_first_seen'){
  const headline=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries((ev.payload.headline??{}) as Record<string,Point>).map(([c,h])=>{const r=reasonOf(elig.get(h.factId));return [c,r===null?h:{...h,value:{kind:'withheld',reason:r,factId:h.factId}}];}));
  return {...ev.payload,headline};
 }
 if(ev.kind==='fact_revised'){
  const from=ev.payload.from as Point,to=ev.payload.to as Point;
  const rf=reasonOf(elig.get(from.factId)),rt=reasonOf(elig.get(to.factId));
  if(rf===null&&rt===null)return ev.payload;
  const out:Record<string,unknown>={...ev.payload,
   from:rf===null?from:{...from,value:{kind:'withheld',reason:rf,factId:from.factId}},
   to:rt===null?to:{...to,value:{kind:'withheld',reason:rt,factId:to.factId}}};
  if('relChange' in ev.payload)out.relChange={kind:'withheld',reason:worst([rf,rt].filter((r):r is WithheldReason=>r!==null))};
  return out;
 }
 return ev.payload;
}
```

### Task 7: 显示格式化（`decimal.ts` 追加）、`metric-catalog.ts`、`statements-grid.ts`

**规格依据**：§5.3、§5.4、§0 #66、§0.1 item 1、§12.1 statements-grid.test。

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/lib/company/decimal.ts`（在 `// ---- display formatting (Task 7) ----` 标记后追加）
- Modify: `src/lib/company/decimal.test.ts`（追加一个 describe）
- Create: `src/lib/company/metric-catalog.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/company/metric-catalog.test.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/company/statements-grid.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/company/statements-grid.test.ts`

**要求清单：**

1. `formatDecimalText(valueText, divisor, fractionDigits)`：只做字符串/BigInt 运算（不经浮点）；`divisor` 为正 BigInt；`fractionDigits` 为 0–12 的整数（否则 `RangeError`）；结果 = `valueText ÷ divisor`，**四舍五入远离零**到 `fractionDigits` 位并补足尾零；结果为零时不带负号；支持 20 位整数、负数、小数与指数写法输入。`groupThousands(text)` 只给整数部分加 `,`。
2. `DisplayScale = 'raw'|'thousand'|'million'|'hundred_million'`；`divisorOf(scale)` → `1n/1000n/1000000n/100000000n`；`scaleFor(unit, locale)`：非货币单位（`unitKindOf(unit) !== 'money'`）→ `'raw'`；`CNY` + `zh` → `'hundred_million'`（亿）；其余货币（含 `USD` + `en`、`CNY` + `en`、`USD` + `zh`）→ `'million'`（指挥决定：规格只定了两个缺省组合，其余取百万）。缩放只作用于 money 行，`per_share`/`shares`/`ratio` 一律原值（由调用方按 `unitKind` 决定，本函数对非货币单位返回 `'raw'` 兜底）。
3. `METRIC_CATALOG`：按 `FORMULA_VERSION` 键控（`METRIC_CATALOG_VERSION = 'facts-derive/1.0'`，测试断言等于 landed `FORMULA_VERSION`，版本漂移即测试失败）；metric 集合 = `metricNames('US') ∪ metricNames('CN')`（测试断言集合相等）；每项 `{metric, formulaVersion, unitKind:'ratio'|'money', zh:{name,formula}, en:{name,formula}, inputs:{US?,CN?}, basisByMarket:{US?,CN?}}`；`inputs[m]` 只在 `metricNames(m)` 含该 metric 时存在，且 ⊆ `DERIVE_CONCEPTS[m]`；`basisByMarket` 取 `derive.ts` 的实际 basis 值；CN `q_single_revenue`/`ttm_revenue` 的说明是"营业总收入（revenue）"，**不**写成营业收入（§0 #66）；CN `gross_margin` 输入为 `revenue_operating` 与 `cost_of_revenue`。`catalogFor(formulaVersion)` 版本不同返回 `null`（UI 显示"公式版本不匹配"，不显示旧文本）。
4. `buildStatementsGrid(snapshot, {statement, basis, periods, market, asOf})` → `GridOutcome`：
   - `snapshot.truncated` → `{ok:false, error:'read_truncated'}`（不返回部分网格）；`basis='quarterly' && statement='BS'` → `{ok:false, error:'invalid_basis'}`（路由映射为 400 `invalid_parameter:basis`）。
   - 只看 `status='ok'`、`consolidation='consolidated'`、`market` 相符的行。
   - 行概念：`disclosed`/`annual` = 概念目录中 `statement` 相符的概念，目录顺序；BS 把 `shares_outstanding`（含 DEI 标签来的行，行的 `statement` 可能是 `'DEI'`，按 `concept` 归行）放在末行；`quarterly` = `Q_SINGLE_CONCEPTS[market]` 中属于该报表的概念（CN 单季收入行概念为 `revenue` = 营业总收入，§0 #66）。只输出本流至少有一个单元格的概念行（指挥决定：不显示本流从未披露的概念）。`gridReadConcepts(statement, basis, market)` 给路由用作 `readSnapshot` 的 `concepts`。
   - `disclosed`：全部时长；`annual`：只 `12M` 与 `INSTANT`（指挥决定：BS 的 annual 因此与 disclosed 相同——规格原文"12M 与 BS 的 INSTANT"，无可靠的财年末判定；记入 §17 偏差候选）；每个自然键只取当前行（`is_current===true`；history 信封与非 history 信封都适用）。行缺 `disclosure_seq` → 抛 `grid_sequence_missing`（读取契约被破坏，不猜）。
   - `quarterly`：在**同一信封**上 `deriveMetrics(rows, {market, asOf, basedOnRev: stateRev})`，只取 `q_single_<c>` 行（不含 `ttm_*`），转为 `DerivedCell`：`rule` 由 inputs 的 `ytd_rule` 得出（`same_filing`→`'a'`、`never_revised`→`'b'`，直接 3M 披露无 `rule` 键）。调用方必须给 `history:true` 的完整信封。
   - 期间键 `periodKeyOf = <period_start ?? period_end>:<period_end>:<duration>`；列 = 全部单元格期间键的并集，排序 `period_end` 降序 → `period_start` 降序（同期末短期在前）→ 时长序 `3M<6M<9M<12M<TTM<INSTANT`；取前 `periods` 列。
   - 主单位 `primaryUnitOf`：在该行**全部**期间（裁剪前）中按出现期间数最多的单位，并列取码点序最小者。单元格：该期有主单位值 → 该格（`FactCell.otherUnits` = 同期还有其他单位）；只有其他单位 → `null`，并在 `otherUnitOnly[concept]` 列出该期间键（`U` 徽标；指挥决定：共享契约的 `Cell` 为 `null` 时带不了标记，故放进 `GridResult` 自有字段）。
   - `GridRow`：`unit` = 主单位；`unitKind` = 概念目录 `unitKind`（quarterly 为 money）；`sourceConcepts` = 该概念在信封中出现过的全部 `source_concept`（去重升序）；`notes` = 目录 `notes ?? null`。
   - 结果附 `filings`（被单元格或派生输入引用的 `FilingSummary`，按 id）、`factIds`（全部事实格 id 与派生格输入 id，去重升序，供 Task 9 `gateFacts`）、`mappingGen`（所用行的最大 `mapping_gen`，无行为 `null`）、`stateRev`。本函数**不做**证据门槛（路由在其后调用 `gateFacts` + `gateCell`）。
5. `badgesOf(cell, filings, otherUnitOnly)` → `('R'|'n'|'!'|'U')[]`：`R` = `isRevision`；`n` = `disclosureSeq > 1` 且非修订；`!` = 引用 filing `citation='pending'`（派生格任一输入 filing pending）；`U` = `otherUnits` 或该格在 `otherUnitOnly` 中。

- [ ] **Step 3: 在 `decimal.ts` 标记后追加实现**（文件头 import 增加 `import {unitKindOf} from '@/lib/facts/units';`）

```ts
export type DisplayScale='raw'|'thousand'|'million'|'hundred_million';
const DIVISORS:Record<DisplayScale,bigint>={raw:1n,thousand:1000n,million:1_000_000n,hundred_million:100_000_000n};
export const divisorOf=(scale:DisplayScale):bigint=>DIVISORS[scale];
/** Default display scale (spec §5.3): CNY + zh → 亿, other money → 百万, non-money units unscaled. */
export function scaleFor(unit:string,locale:'zh'|'en'):DisplayScale{
 if(unitKindOf(unit)!=='money')return 'raw';
 return unit==='CNY'&&locale==='zh'?'hundred_million':'million';
}
/** valueText ÷ divisor, half away from zero, exactly fractionDigits places; string/BigInt only. */
export function formatDecimalText(valueText:string,divisor:bigint,fractionDigits:number):string{
 if(divisor<=0n)throw new RangeError('divisor must be positive');
 if(!Number.isInteger(fractionDigits)||fractionDigits<0||fractionDigits>12)throw new RangeError('fractionDigits must be 0..12');
 const d=parseDecimal(valueText);
 const q=roundDiv(d.n*pow10(fractionDigits),pow10(d.s)*divisor);
 const neg=q<0n;const digits=(neg?-q:q).toString().padStart(fractionDigits+1,'0');
 const body=fractionDigits>0?`${digits.slice(0,-fractionDigits)}.${digits.slice(-fractionDigits)}`:digits;
 return neg?`-${body}`:body;
}
export function groupThousands(text:string):string{
 const neg=text.startsWith('-');const [i,f]=(neg?text.slice(1):text).split('.');
 const g=i.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g,',');
 return `${neg?'-':''}${g}${f!==undefined?`.${f}`:''}`;
}
```

（`q` 为 0 时 `neg` 为 false，所以不会出现 `-0.00`。）

```ts
// src/lib/company/metric-catalog.ts
// Formula texts of the derived metrics (spec §0.1 item 1, §5.4), keyed by the landed FORMULA_VERSION:
// the facts layer exports deriveMetrics / metricNames but no human-readable formula. The catalogue
// must cover metricNames('US') ∪ metricNames('CN') exactly and describe derive.ts as it is (inputs,
// basis values); a FORMULA_VERSION bump fails metric-catalog.test.ts until the texts are reviewed.
// CN q_single_revenue / ttm_revenue are 营业总收入 (concept revenue), never 营业收入 (§0 #66).
import {Q_SINGLE_CONCEPTS} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import type {Market} from '@/lib/facts/types';

export const METRIC_CATALOG_VERSION='facts-derive/1.0';
export interface MetricText{name:string;formula:string}
export interface MetricCatalogEntry{metric:string;formulaVersion:string;unitKind:'ratio'|'money';zh:MetricText;en:MetricText;inputs:Partial<Record<Market,readonly string[]>>;basisByMarket:Partial<Record<Market,string>>}

const QL:Record<string,{zh:string;en:string}>={
 revenue:{zh:'收入（美股营业收入；A 股营业总收入）',en:'Revenue (US revenue; CN total operating revenue)'},
 net_income_parent:{zh:'归母净利润',en:'Net income attributable to parent'},
 operating_income:{zh:'营业利润',en:'Operating income'},
 operating_cash_flow:{zh:'经营活动现金流净额',en:'Net cash from operating activities'},
 capex:{zh:'购建固定资产支出',en:'Purchases of property, plant and equipment'},
 capex_incl_intangibles:{zh:'购建固定资产、无形资产和其他长期资产支付的现金',en:'Cash paid for fixed, intangible and other long-term assets'},
};
const QUARTER_RULE_ZH='披露的 3 个月数值；无 3 个月披露时取相邻累计期之差，仅当两者来自同一文件（规则 a）或两条序列都从未修订（规则 b），且差额本身是一个季度';
const QUARTER_RULE_EN='the disclosed 3-month value; otherwise the difference of adjacent year-to-date periods, only when both come from the same filing (rule a) or neither sequence was ever revised (rule b), and the difference is itself one quarter';
const BASIS_Q=(m:Market,c:string)=>m==='CN'&&c==='capex_incl_intangibles'?'cn_incl_intangibles':m==='US'?'us_standard':'cn_standard';
const entry=(metric:string,unitKind:'ratio'|'money',zh:MetricText,en:MetricText,inputs:MetricCatalogEntry['inputs'],basisByMarket:MetricCatalogEntry['basisByMarket']):MetricCatalogEntry=>({metric,formulaVersion:METRIC_CATALOG_VERSION,unitKind,zh,en,inputs,basisByMarket});
const STD={US:'us_standard',CN:'cn_standard'};

const fixed:MetricCatalogEntry[]=[
 entry('gross_margin','ratio',
  {name:'毛利率',formula:'美股：毛利 ÷ 营业收入；无毛利披露时为（营业收入 − 营业成本）÷ 营业收入。A 股：（营业收入 revenue_operating − 营业成本）÷ 营业收入。同期间、同单位精确匹配；分母为 0 不产出'},
  {name:'Gross margin',formula:'US: gross profit ÷ revenue, or (revenue − cost of revenue) ÷ revenue when gross profit is not disclosed. CN: (operating revenue − cost of revenue) ÷ operating revenue. Exact period and unit match; zero denominator → not produced'},
  {US:['revenue','gross_profit','cost_of_revenue'],CN:['revenue_operating','cost_of_revenue']},STD),
 entry('net_margin','ratio',
  {name:'净利率',formula:'归母净利润 ÷ 营业收入（美股 revenue；A 股营业收入 revenue_operating）；同期间、同单位'},
  {name:'Net margin',formula:'Net income attributable to parent ÷ revenue (US revenue; CN operating revenue); same period and unit'},
  {US:['net_income_parent','revenue'],CN:['net_income_parent','revenue_operating']},STD),
 entry('fcf','money',
  {name:'自由现金流',formula:'经营活动现金流净额 − 资本开支（美股：购建固定资产支出；A 股：购建固定资产、无形资产和其他长期资产支付的现金）'},
  {name:'Free cash flow',formula:'Net cash from operating activities − capital expenditure (US: purchases of PP&E; CN: cash paid for fixed, intangible and other long-term assets)'},
  {US:['operating_cash_flow','capex'],CN:['operating_cash_flow','capex_incl_intangibles']},{US:'us_standard',CN:'cn_incl_intangibles'}),
 entry('borrowings_total','money',
  {name:'有息借款合计',formula:'美股：短期借款 + 长期借款；A 股：短期借款 + 长期借款 + 应付债券；同一时点、同单位'},
  {name:'Total borrowings',formula:'US: short-term + long-term borrowings; CN: short-term + long-term borrowings + bonds payable; same instant and unit'},
  {US:['short_term_borrowings','long_term_borrowings'],CN:['short_term_borrowings','long_term_borrowings','bonds_payable']},{US:'us_standard',CN:'cn_incl_bonds'}),
 entry('revenue_yoy','ratio',
  {name:'收入同比',formula:'（本期收入 − 上年同期）÷ |上年同期|；收入为 revenue（A 股营业总收入）；上年同期为同时长、同单位、期末早 350–380 天的唯一事实；上年同期为 0 不产出'},
  {name:'Revenue YoY',formula:'(revenue − prior) ÷ |prior|; revenue is concept revenue (CN total operating revenue); prior = the unique same-duration, same-unit fact ending 350–380 days earlier; zero prior → not produced'},
  {US:['revenue'],CN:['revenue']},STD),
 entry('net_income_yoy','ratio',
  {name:'归母净利润同比',formula:'（本期归母净利润 − 上年同期）÷ |上年同期|；上年同期规则同收入同比'},
  {name:'Net income YoY',formula:'(net income attributable to parent − prior) ÷ |prior|; prior chosen as for revenue YoY'},
  {US:['net_income_parent'],CN:['net_income_parent']},STD),
 entry('roe','ratio',
  {name:'净资产收益率（TTM）',formula:'近四季归母净利润 × 2 ÷（期初归母权益 + 期末归母权益）；期初为 TTM 窗口开始前一日的时点值；平均权益 ≤ 0 不产出'},
  {name:'Return on equity (TTM)',formula:'TTM net income attributable to parent × 2 ÷ (opening + closing parent equity); opening is the instant one day before the TTM window; non-positive average equity → not produced'},
  {US:['net_income_parent','equity_parent'],CN:['net_income_parent','equity_parent']},STD),
];
const quarterly:MetricCatalogEntry[]=[...new Set([...Q_SINGLE_CONCEPTS.US,...Q_SINGLE_CONCEPTS.CN])].flatMap(c=>{
 const markets=(['US','CN'] as Market[]).filter(m=>Q_SINGLE_CONCEPTS[m].includes(c));
 const inputs=Object.fromEntries(markets.map(m=>[m,[c]]));
 const basis=Object.fromEntries(markets.map(m=>[m,BASIS_Q(m,c)]));
 const l=QL[c];
 return [
  entry(`q_single_${c}`,'money',{name:`单季${l.zh}`,formula:`单季 ${l.zh}：${QUARTER_RULE_ZH}`},{name:`Single-quarter ${l.en}`,formula:`Single-quarter ${l.en}: ${QUARTER_RULE_EN}`},inputs,basis),
  entry(`ttm_${c}`,'money',{name:`近四季${l.zh}`,formula:`近四季 ${l.zh}：四个首尾相接、各自唯一的单季之和（单季规则同上）`},{name:`TTM ${l.en}`,formula:`TTM ${l.en}: sum of four exactly adjacent, each unique, single quarters (single-quarter rule as above)`},inputs,basis),
 ];
});
export const METRIC_CATALOG:Readonly<Record<string,MetricCatalogEntry>>=Object.fromEntries([...fixed,...quarterly].map(e=>[e.metric,e]));
export function catalogFor(formulaVersion:string):Readonly<Record<string,MetricCatalogEntry>>|null{return formulaVersion===METRIC_CATALOG_VERSION?METRIC_CATALOG:null;}
```

（`QL` 必须覆盖 `Q_SINGLE_CONCEPTS` 两个市场的全部概念；若 landed 列表变化，`QL[c]` 为 undefined 会让测试在 `l.zh` 处抛错——这是期望的失败信号。）

```ts
// src/lib/company/statements-grid.ts
// Statements grid (spec §5.3, §0 #66). Pure: one company_read_snapshot envelope → columns keyed by
// <period_start>:<period_end>:<duration> (INSTANT start = end), newest first; rows in catalogue
// order (shares_outstanding last on BS, DEI tags included by concept); one primary unit per row
// (most periods, tie → smallest code unit) with other-unit facts flagged (U). disclosed / annual
// read the current disclosure of each natural key; quarterly runs the landed deriveMetrics on the
// SAME history envelope and keeps q_single_* only (CN q_single_revenue is concept revenue = 营业总收入).
// A truncated envelope is an error, never a partial grid. The evidence gate runs afterwards in the
// route (gateFacts + gateCell) over factIds.
import {FACT_CONCEPTS,conceptById} from '@/lib/facts/concepts';
import {Q_SINGLE_CONCEPTS,deriveMetrics} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import type {FactRow,Market,MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {Basis,Cell,DerivedCell,FactCell,FilingSummary,GridRow,PeriodCol,ReadSnapshotResult,StatementKind} from './types';

export const GRID_PERIOD_CHOICES=[8,20,40] as const;
export type GridPeriods=typeof GRID_PERIOD_CHOICES[number];
export interface GridOptions{statement:StatementKind;basis:Basis;periods:GridPeriods;market:Market;asOf:string}
export interface GridResult{ok:true;statement:StatementKind;basis:Basis;stateRev:number;mappingGen:number|null;periods:PeriodCol[];rows:GridRow[];filings:Record<string,FilingSummary>;factIds:string[];otherUnitOnly:Record<string,string[]>}
export type GridOutcome=GridResult|{ok:false;error:'read_truncated'|'invalid_basis'};
export type Badge='R'|'n'|'!'|'U';

const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const DUR_ORDER:Record<string,number>={'3M':0,'6M':1,'9M':2,'12M':3,TTM:4,INSTANT:5};
export const periodKeyOf=(p:{period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:string})=>`${p.period_start??p.period_end}:${p.period_end}:${p.duration}`;
export function statementConcepts(statement:StatementKind):string[]{
 const ids=FACT_CONCEPTS.filter(c=>c.statement===statement).map(c=>c.id);
 return statement==='BS'?[...ids.filter(id=>id!=='shares_outstanding'),'shares_outstanding']:ids;
}
export function quarterlyConcepts(statement:StatementKind,market:Market):string[]{
 return statement==='BS'?[]:Q_SINGLE_CONCEPTS[market].filter(c=>conceptById(c)?.statement===statement);
}
/** `concepts` for readSnapshot: the statement's concepts, or (quarterly) its single-quarter concepts — derive needs only the same concept's history. */
export function gridReadConcepts(statement:StatementKind,basis:Basis,market:Market):string[]{
 return basis==='quarterly'?quarterlyConcepts(statement,market):statementConcepts(statement);
}
export function primaryUnitOf(entries:Iterable<{period:string;unit:string}>):string|null{
 const per=new Map<string,Set<string>>();
 for(const {period,unit} of entries){const s=per.get(unit)??new Set<string>();s.add(period);per.set(unit,s);}
 let best:string|null=null,n=-1;
 for(const [u,s] of per)if(s.size>n||(s.size===n&&best!==null&&u<best)){best=u;n=s.size;}
 return best;
}
const colOrder=(a:PeriodCol,b:PeriodCol)=>cmp(b.periodEnd,a.periodEnd)||cmp(b.periodStart,a.periodStart)||(DUR_ORDER[a.duration]??9)-(DUR_ORDER[b.duration]??9);
/** Exported for the overview / packet handlers (Task 10, 15): one FactCell / DerivedCell shape everywhere. */
export const factCellOf=(r:FactRow,otherUnits=false):FactCell=>{
 if(r.disclosure_seq===undefined||r.is_revision===undefined)throw new Error(`grid_sequence_missing:${r.fact_id}`);
 return {kind:'fact',factId:r.fact_id,value:r.value_text,unit:r.unit,availableDate:r.available_date,filingId:r.filing_id,disclosureSeq:r.disclosure_seq,isRevision:r.is_revision,mappingGen:r.mapping_gen,rawHash:r.raw_hash,runId:r.run_id,otherUnits};
};
export const derivedCellOf=(m:MetricRow):DerivedCell=>{
 const rules=new Set(m.inputs.map(i=>i.ytd_rule).filter(Boolean));
 const rule=rules.has('same_filing')?'a' as const:rules.has('never_revised')?'b' as const:null;
 return {kind:'derived',metric:m.metric,value:m.value,unit:m.unit,inputUnit:m.input_unit,basis:m.basis,formulaVersion:m.formula_version,
  inputs:m.inputs.map(i=>({factId:i.fact_id,concept:i.concept,filingId:i.filing_id,availableDate:i.available_date})),...(rule?{rule}:{})};
};
interface Entry{period:PeriodCol;unit:string;cell:FactCell|DerivedCell;mappingGen:number|null}

export function buildStatementsGrid(snapshot:ReadSnapshotResult,opts:GridOptions):GridOutcome{
 if(snapshot.truncated)return {ok:false,error:'read_truncated'};
 if(opts.basis==='quarterly'&&opts.statement==='BS')return {ok:false,error:'invalid_basis'};
 const concepts=gridReadConcepts(opts.statement,opts.basis,opts.market);
 const wanted=new Set(concepts);
 const rows=snapshot.rows.filter(r=>r.status==='ok'&&r.consolidation==='consolidated'&&r.market===opts.market);
 const byConcept=new Map<string,Entry[]>();
 const push=(c:string,e:Entry)=>{const l=byConcept.get(c)??[];l.push(e);byConcept.set(c,l);};
 if(opts.basis==='quarterly'){
  for(const m of deriveMetrics(rows,{market:opts.market,asOf:opts.asOf,basedOnRev:snapshot.stateRev})){
   if(!m.metric.startsWith('q_single_'))continue;
   const c=m.metric.slice('q_single_'.length);if(!wanted.has(c))continue;
   push(c,{period:{key:`${m.period_start}:${m.period_end}:3M`,periodStart:m.period_start,periodEnd:m.period_end,duration:'3M'},unit:m.unit,cell:derivedCellOf(m),mappingGen:null});
  }
 }else{
  for(const r of rows){
   if(r.is_current!==true||!wanted.has(r.concept))continue;
   if(opts.basis==='annual'&&r.duration!=='12M'&&r.duration!=='INSTANT')continue;
   push(r.concept,{period:{key:periodKeyOf(r),periodStart:r.period_start??r.period_end,periodEnd:r.period_end,duration:r.duration},unit:r.unit,cell:factCellOf(r),mappingGen:r.mapping_gen});
  }
 }
 const cols=new Map<string,PeriodCol>();
 for(const es of byConcept.values())for(const e of es)cols.set(e.period.key,e.period);
 const periods=[...cols.values()].sort(colOrder).slice(0,opts.periods);
 const filingById=new Map(snapshot.filings.map(f=>[f.filingId,f]));
 const filings:Record<string,FilingSummary>={};const factIds=new Set<string>();const otherUnitOnly:Record<string,string[]>={};
 let mappingGen:number|null=null;
 const useFiling=(id:string)=>{const f=filingById.get(id);if(f)filings[id]=f;};
 const out:GridRow[]=[];
 for(const c of concepts){
  const es=byConcept.get(c);if(!es||es.length===0)continue;
  const primary=primaryUnitOf(es.map(e=>({period:e.period.key,unit:e.unit})));
  const def=conceptById(c);
  const cells:Record<string,Cell>={};
  for(const p of periods){
   const here=es.filter(e=>e.period.key===p.key);
   const main=here.find(e=>e.unit===primary);const others=here.some(e=>e.unit!==primary);
   if(!main){cells[p.key]=null;if(others)(otherUnitOnly[c]??=[]).push(p.key);continue;}
   const cell=main.cell.kind==='fact'?{...main.cell,otherUnits:others}:main.cell;
   cells[p.key]=cell;
   if(main.mappingGen!==null)mappingGen=Math.max(mappingGen??0,main.mappingGen);
   if(cell.kind==='fact'){factIds.add(cell.factId);useFiling(cell.filingId);}
   else for(const i of cell.inputs){factIds.add(i.factId);useFiling(i.filingId);}
  }
  const sourceConcepts=[...new Set(snapshot.rows.filter(r=>r.concept===c).map(r=>r.source_concept))].sort();
  out.push({concept:c,unit:primary,unitKind:def?.unitKind??'money',sourceConcepts,notes:def?.notes??null,cells});
 }
 if(opts.basis==='quarterly'){
  for(const r of rows)if(factIds.has(r.fact_id))mappingGen=Math.max(mappingGen??0,r.mapping_gen);
 }
 return {ok:true,statement:opts.statement,basis:opts.basis,stateRev:snapshot.stateRev,mappingGen,periods,rows:out,filings,factIds:[...factIds].sort(),otherUnitOnly};
}

export function badgesOf(cell:Cell,filings:Record<string,FilingSummary>,otherUnitOnly:Record<string,string[]>,concept:string,periodKey:string):Badge[]{
 const out:Badge[]=[];
 if(cell?.kind==='fact'){
  if(cell.isRevision)out.push('R');else if(cell.disclosureSeq>1)out.push('n');
  if(filings[cell.filingId]?.citation==='pending')out.push('!');
  if(cell.otherUnits)out.push('U');
 }else if(cell?.kind==='derived'){
  if(cell.inputs.some(i=>filings[i.filingId]?.citation==='pending'))out.push('!');
 }
 if(cell===null&&otherUnitOnly[concept]?.includes(periodKey))out.push('U');
 return out;
}
```

### Task 8: 物化作业 `digest.ts` + 依赖装配 `deps.ts` + cron 路由 + 脚本 + `vercel.json` + 回放集成用例

**规格依据**：§6.3、§4.4、§4.6（调用侧语义）、§11 digest 各行、§12.1 digest.test、§12.2、§1.1 成功标准第 4 条、§0.1 item 2/6、§0 #70。

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/company/digest.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/company/digest.test.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/company/deps.ts`
- Create: `src/app/api/cron/company-digest/route.ts`
- Create: `src/app/api/cron/company-digest/route.test.ts`
- Create: `scripts/company/digest.ts`
- Modify: `vercel.json`（只在 `crons` 数组末尾追加一个对象）
- Modify: `src/lib/company/company-research.integration.test.ts`（文件末尾追加一个 `describe`；import 合并到文件顶部）

**要求清单：**

1. `runCompanyDigest(deps, {mode, issuerIds?, market?, limit?, now?, dryRun?, triggeredBy?})`：
   - `issuerIds` 只允许 `mode='full'`，否则抛 `DigestError('invalid_options')`；`limit` 为正整数（缺省 200）。
   - 非 dry-run 且 `deps.codeVersion` 为空 → 抛 `DigestError('code_version_missing')`，**不**写批次（拒绝 apply）。
   - `startBatch({producer:'company-digest', dataset:'company.events', toolVersions:{events:EVENTS_VERSION, mappingGen:String(MAPPING_GEN), formulaVersion:FORMULA_VERSION, evidenceIndex:EVIDENCE_INDEX_VERSION}, codeVersion, triggeredBy})`。
2. 选流 `selectStreams`：
   - `incremental`：`digestDue(now, ceil(4·limit/5))` 与 `sweepDue(now − 7 d, now, floor(limit/5))`（整数运算，避免 `0.2*limit` 的浮点误差）；按 `(issuerId, market)` 去重——两边都选中的流留在 incremental 列表并以 `sweep=true` 处理；然后**交错**：每 4 个 incremental 后插 1 个 sweep，一方用完后顺序接上另一方；给了 `market` 时两份列表都按市场过滤。
   - `full`：给了 `issuerIds` → 每个市场（`market` 或 US、CN）`scopeRows(market, 去重 ids)`；否则 `scopeAll(market)`（含 priority 0 的退役范围——它们仍有事实）；按 `issuer_id` 排序；全部 `sweep=true`；忽略 `limit`。
3. 每流（非 dry-run）：`attemptId = beginAttempt(issuer, market, now)` → 循环最多两次：`readSnapshot(issuer, market, {concepts:null, asOf: today(UTC), history:true})` → `truncated` → `markDigestFailed`，码 `read_truncated` → `buildEvidenceIndex`（同一信封的 rows/filings；同一尝试内共享解析缓存）→ `replaceEvidence(issuer, market, rows)`（**先于事件**；失败 → `evidence_index_failed`）→ `scopeRows(market,[issuer])` 取 `last_success_at/last_status` → `deriveIssuerEvents({rows, filings, cutoff: today})` + `summarizeCoverage` → `replaceDigest(…, attemptId, 新 rebuildId, basedOnRev = 信封 stateRev, sweep, events, coverage)`。异常：`stale_computation` 第一次 → 同一 attemptId 重读重算（`retried=true`），第二次 → `markDigestFailed`、码 `stale_computation`；`stale_attempt` → 跳过（不调用 `markDigestFailed`）；`unknown_stream`（`beginAttempt` 或 `replaceDigest` 抛出）→ 跳过；`invalid_event` → `markDigestFailed`、码 `invalid_event`（指挥决定：SQL 失败函数总会退避，规格 §11"不退避"无对应函数；修复 bug 后用脚本 `--full` 重建，脚本不看 `next_attempt_at`）；其他异常 → `markDigestFailed`、码 `digest_issuer_failed`。`markDigestFailed` 自身抛错 → 额外记 `{code:'mark_failed_error'}`，流仍算失败。
4. 截止：`deps.deadline` 非空且剩余 < 30 s 时不再开始新流，`errors` 追加 `{code:'deadline_hit', message: JSON.stringify({not_started:n})}`（`deadline_hit` 已在 `INFO_CODES`，不降级批次）。
5. 批次计数**按流**：`fetched` = 开始的流数；成功且 `changed + retired + revived > 0` → `inserted`；成功但无变化 → `duplicates`；`stale_attempt`/`unknown_stream` → `duplicates`，并各记一条 `{code:'skipped_summary', key:'<issuer>:<market>', message:'{"stale_attempt":1}'}`（或 `unknown_stream`）且计入 `detail.skippedStale/skippedUnknown`；失败 → `failed` + `{code, key}`；`versioned = quarantined = 0`。保证 `fetched === inserted + duplicates + versioned + quarantined + failed`（单测在真实 `finishBatch` 上断言无 `unaccounted`）。
6. `detail = {events:{upserted, changed, retired, revived}, attempted, succeeded, failed, skippedStale, skippedUnknown, swept, idle, backlogFailed, evidence:{indexed, facts}}`；`backlogFailed = db.backlog().failedStreams`（在处理完之后读）；`finishBatch` 后 `recordAttempt('company.events', {ok: failed===0 && backlogFailed===0, cadence:'daily', now, detail})`。基础设施异常（选流、`backlog`、`finishBatch` 之外抛出）→ 关闭批次（`errors` 加 `{code:'unknown'}`）、`recordAttempt(ok:false)`，再抛出。
7. dry-run：不写批次、不调用 `beginAttempt/replaceEvidence/replaceDigest/markDigestFailed`；每流读取、建索引（只计数）、推导，`outcome='planned'`，`events` 为事件数；`status:'dry_run'`。
8. cron `GET|POST /api/cron/company-digest`：`dynamic='force-dynamic'`、`maxDuration=300`；`CRON_SECRET` 缺失 → 503 `cron_unavailable`；`authorizedCronRequest` 失败 → 401；`limit` 至多一次、1..200（缺省 200），否则 400 `invalid_parameter:limit`；`resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false})`（landed `src/lib/facts/deps.ts`，只认 40 位 `VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA`）为空 → 503 `code_version_unavailable`；`productionDigestDeps({deadline: start + 240 s, codeVersion})` → `runCompanyDigest(deps, {mode:'incremental', limit, triggeredBy:'cron'})`；200 回执只含码、键与计数（无 message）；异常 → 500，只带码（`DigestError.code` 或 `digest_failed`）；全部响应 `Cache-Control: no-store`。
9. `deps.ts`：`productionDigestDeps({deadline, codeVersion, admin?, now?})`（全部 service_role：`supabaseCompanyDb`、`supabaseTableClient`、`readSnapshot(admin,…)`、`supabaseFactsDb`（`scopeRows/scopeAll`）、`supabaseSnapshotObjectStore`）。**整合决定**：读路由的装配（`ReadDeps`、`productionReadDeps()`、`EventGateDeps`、`productionEventGateDeps()`）不在本任务建，由 Task 9 Step 1 追加到同一文件（成员见 Task 9；`company` = service_role `CompanyDb` 用于 §0 #64 事件与证据读取，`publicCompany` = anon `CompanyDb` 用于覆盖读取，`snapshot` 走 anon，`pdf = emptyPdfLocatorSource`）。
10. 脚本 `scripts/company/digest.ts [--full] [--issuer <ticker>]... [--market US|CN] [--limit n] [--apply]`：缺省 dry-run；`--issuer` 需要 `--full`，ticker 以今天的归属 `resolveIssuer` 解析，未知 → 退出 2；`--apply` 需要代码版本（`resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true})`），没有 → 退出 2；输出 JSON 回执；apply 时批次非 success、dry-run 时有失败流 → 退出 1。cron 与脚本不同时运行（runbook 在 Task 19 写）。
11. `vercel.json`：`crons` 末尾追加 `{"path": "/api/cron/company-digest", "schedule": "20 * * * *"}`，不改其他条目、不重排（JSON 无注释，所以不加 `// COMPANY` 标记；合并冲突按"保留两边全部 cron"解决）。
12. 集成用例（真实 PostgreSQL，§1.1 第 4 条）：用 landed `runFactsSync` 回放 AAPL 修剪夹具（改写成合成发行人，避免与 `sync-us.integration.test.ts` 共享 `source_ref`）→ digest 两次：第二次 `changed=0、retired=0`，事件行与 `first_seen_at` 逐行不变；换成修订夹具再同步 → digest 后**恰好**新增一条 `fact_revised`；把该修订行 `ok→quarantined`（并 `state_rev+1`，模拟裁决）→ digest 后该事件 `retired_at` 非空；`promote_quarantined` 提升 → digest 后 `retired_at` 回到 null 且 `first_seen_at` 等于首次值。
