```ts
// src/lib/company/digest.test.ts
// runCompanyDigest on memoryCompanyDb + memoryFactsDb (spec §6.3, §12.1). Real startBatch/finishBatch/
// recordAttempt over a memory TableClient so batch status and the "no unaccounted" invariant are real.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '@/lib/db/memory-table-client';
import {factInsert,filingInsert} from '@/lib/facts/db-contract';
import {memoryFactsDb} from '@/lib/facts/memory-facts-db';
import type {MemoryFactsDb} from '@/lib/facts/memory-facts-db';
import type {Market} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {DigestError,interleave,runCompanyDigest,selectStreams} from './digest';
import type {DigestDeps} from './digest';
import {deriveIssuerEvents} from './events';
import {memorySnapshotObjectStore} from './evidence-index';
import {memoryCompanyDb} from './memory-company-db';
import type {MemoryCompanyDb} from './memory-company-db';
import {memorySnapshotReader} from './snapshot-read';
import {summarizeCoverage} from './coverage';
import {CompanyDbError} from './types';
import type {CompanyDb,DueStream} from './types';

const CODE='a'.repeat(40);
function harness(){
 const tables=memoryTableClient({dq_quarantine:['id'],dq_freshness:['dataset'],ingest_batches:['batch_id']});
 const facts=memoryFactsDb(tables);
 const mem=memoryCompanyDb({facts});
 // memoryCompanyDb has no ingest_batches table: every batch id the digest passes was opened by startBatch
 // (producer 'company-digest', status 'running'), so register it on the way in.
 const db:MemoryCompanyDb={...mem,replaceDigest:(i,m,b,...rest)=>{mem.registerBatch(b);return mem.replaceDigest(i,m,b,...rest);}};
 const deps:DigestDeps={db,tables,readSnapshot:memorySnapshotReader(facts),facts,reader:memorySnapshotObjectStore(new Map()),now:()=>new Date(),deadline:null,codeVersion:CODE};
 return {tables,facts,db,deps};
}
type H=ReturnType<typeof harness>;
async function stream(h:H,market:Market='US'){const id=randomUUID();await h.facts.reconcileScope(market,[{issuer_id:id,reasons:['t'],priority:1,fetch_key:`k-${id}`}]);return id;}
async function disclose(facts:MemoryFactsDb,issuer:string,availableDate:string,value:string,concept='revenue'){
 const b=randomUUID();
 expect(await facts.claimLease(issuer,'US',b,600)).toBe(true);
 const run=await facts.beginRun(issuer,'US',b,1);
 const f=filingInsert(issuer,{availableDate,periodEnd:'2023-12-31'});
 await facts.stageFilings(run,[f]);
 const x=factInsert(issuer,f,{value,concept,period_start:'2023-01-01',period_end:'2023-12-31',duration:'12M'});
 await facts.stageFacts(run,[x]);await facts.publishRun(run,[f.filing_id]);
 await facts.releaseLease(issuer,'US',b,'success',new Date(Date.now()+86_400_000).toISOString());
 return {factId:x.fact_id,filingId:f.filing_id};
}
const batchRow=(h:H)=>h.tables.rows('ingest_batches').at(-1)!;
const freshness=(h:H)=>h.tables.rows('dq_freshness').find(r=>r.dataset==='company.events')!;
const active=async(db:CompanyDb,issuer:string)=>(await db.eventsOfIssuer(issuer,'US',{limit:200})).rows;
const due=(issuerId:string,stateRev=1,digestedRev=0,market:Market='US'):DueStream=>({issuerId,market,stateRev,digestedRev});

describe('selection',()=>{
 it('interleaves four incremental streams with one sweep stream, then drains the rest',()=>{
  expect(interleave([1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9],['a','b','c'])).toEqual([1,2,3,4,'a',5,6,7,8,'b',9,'c']);
  expect(interleave([],['a','b'])).toEqual(['a','b']);expect(interleave([1,2],[])).toEqual([1,2]);
 });
 it('80/20 budget with integer arithmetic, 7-day sweep age, dedupe (both lists → sweep=true in place), market filter',async()=>{
  const digestDue=vi.fn(async()=>[due('i1'),due('i2'),due('x'),due('c1',1,0,'CN')]);
  const sweepDue=vi.fn(async()=>[due('x',1,1),due('s1',1,1)]);
  const now=new Date('2026-11-06T12:00:00.000Z');
  const deps={db:{digestDue,sweepDue}} as unknown as DigestDeps;

  expect(digestDue).toHaveBeenCalledWith(now,160);
  expect(sweepDue).toHaveBeenCalledWith(new Date('2026-10-30T12:00:00.000Z'),now,40);
  expect(plan.map(p=>[p.issuerId,p.sweep,p.source])).toEqual([['i1',false,'incremental'],['i2',false,'incremental'],['x',true,'incremental'],['c1',false,'incremental'],['s1',true,'sweep']]);
  expect((await selectStreams(deps,{mode:'incremental',limit:7,market:'CN'},now)).map(p=>p.issuerId)).toEqual(['c1']);
  expect(digestDue).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(now,6);expect(sweepDue).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith(expect.any(Date),now,1);
  sweepDue.mockClear();await selectStreams(deps,{mode:'incremental',limit:4},now);expect(sweepDue).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
 });
 it('full mode: explicit issuers via scopeRows per market, otherwise scopeAll; all sweep; issuerIds without full is rejected',async()=>{
  const h=harness();const a=await stream(h),b=await stream(h),c=await stream(h,'CN');
  const all=await selectStreams(h.deps,{mode:'full'},new Date());
  expect(all.filter(p=>p.market==='US').map(p=>p.issuerId)).toEqual([a,b].sort());
  expect(all.filter(p=>p.market==='CN').map(p=>p.issuerId)).toEqual([c]);
  expect(all.every(p=>p.sweep&&p.source==='full')).toBe(true);
  expect((await selectStreams(h.deps,{mode:'full',issuerIds:[b,b],market:'US'},new Date())).map(p=>p.issuerId)).toEqual([b]);
  await expect(runCompanyDigest(h.deps,{mode:'incremental',issuerIds:[a]})).rejects.toMatchObject({code:'invalid_options'});
 });
});

 it('two replaces of one stream in one batch: the second omits an event → it is retired',async()=>{

  const r=await h.db.replaceDigest(a,'US',batchId,await h.db.beginAttempt(a,'US',new Date()),randomUUID(),env.stateRev,false,events.filter(e=>e.kind!=='fact_revised'),cov);
  expect(r.retired).toBe(1);
  expect((await active(h.db,a)).some(e=>e.kind==='fact_revised')).toBe(false);
 });
 it('deadline: no new stream with < 30 s left; the interleaved sweep has already run; deadline_hit is informational',async()=>{
  const h=harness();
  const old:string[]=[await stream(h),await stream(h)];for(const id of old)await disclose(h.facts,id,'2024-02-01','1');
  await runCompanyDigest(h.deps,{mode:'incremental',limit:2});   // digested; swept_at stays null for the sweep below
  const fresh:string[]=[];for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const id=await stream(h);await disclose(h.facts,id,'2024-02-01',String(i+2));fresh.push(id);}
  let t=Date.now();const start=t;
  const oldDue=(await h.db.sweepDue(new Date(),new Date(),10)).filter(d=>old.includes(d.issuerId));
  const db:CompanyDb={...h.db,sweepDue:async()=>oldDue,beginAttempt:async(...x)=>{t+=50_000;return h.db.beginAttempt(...x);}};
  const r=await runCompanyDigest({...h.deps,db,now:()=>new Date(t),deadline:new Date(start+240_000)},{mode:'incremental',limit:10,now:new Date(start)});
  expect(r.streams).toHaveLength(5);
  expect(r.streams.map(s=>s.sweep)).toEqual([false,false,false,false,true]);
  expect(r.errors).toContainEqual({code:'deadline_hit',message:JSON.stringify({not_started:5})});
  expect(r.status).toBe('success');
 });
 it('dry run writes nothing and reports planned streams with their event counts',async()=>{
  const h=harness();const a=await stream(h);await disclose(h.facts,a,'2024-02-01','100');
  const replace=vi.spyOn(h.db,'replaceDigest'),begin=vi.spyOn(h.db,'beginAttempt'),ev=vi.spyOn(h.db,'replaceEvidence');
  const r=await runCompanyDigest({...h.deps,codeVersion:null,db:{...h.db,replaceDigest:replace,beginAttempt:begin,replaceEvidence:ev}},{mode:'full',dryRun:true});
  expect(r).toMatchObject({batchId:null,status:'dry_run'});
  expect(r.streams).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({issuerId:a,outcome:'planned',events:2})]);
  expect(replace).not.toHaveBeenCalled();expect(begin).not.toHaveBeenCalled();expect(ev).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  expect(h.tables.rows('ingest_batches')).toEqual([]);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/digest.ts
// Company digest (spec §6.3, §4.4, §11): materializes issuer_events + issuer_coverage per (issuer, market)
// stream from one company_read_snapshot envelope (all concepts, history, asOf = today UTC). Per stream:
// beginAttempt → read → evidence index (company_fact_evidence, BEFORE events) → derive → replace with
// basedOnRev = envelope state_rev. stale_computation re-reads once with the same attempt id;
// stale_attempt / unknown_stream are skips (duplicates + skipped_summary); everything else marks the
// attempt failed (backoff in SQL). Selection: incremental 80 % (digestDue) + sweep 20 % (sweepDue,
// older than 7 days), deduped, interleaved 4:1 so a deadline still leaves sweeps their share; full =
// every scope row (script). Batch counters are per STREAM and always balance
// (fetched = inserted + duplicates + versioned + quarantined + failed); freshness ok = no failed stream
// in this run and no failed stream in backoff (CompanyDb.backlog). code_version missing → refuse apply.
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import type {TableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import {emptyCounts,finishBatch,startBatch} from '@/lib/dq/batches';
import type {BatchCounts,BatchError,BatchStatus,TriggeredBy} from '@/lib/dq/batches';
import {recordAttempt} from '@/lib/dq/freshness';
import {MAPPING_GEN} from '@/lib/facts/concepts';
import {FORMULA_VERSION} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import type {FactsDb,Market,ScopeRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {summarizeCoverage} from './coverage';
import {EVENTS_VERSION,deriveIssuerEvents} from './events';
import {buildEvidenceIndex} from './evidence-index';
import type {ParsedSnapshotCache,SnapshotObjectStore} from './evidence-index';
import {CompanyDbError,EVIDENCE_INDEX_VERSION} from './types';
import type {CompanyDb,ReadSnapshotOptions,ReadSnapshotResult,ReplaceResult} from './types';

export const DIGEST_PRODUCER='company-digest';
export const DIGEST_DATASET='company.events';
export const DEFAULT_DIGEST_LIMIT=200;
export const SWEEP_AGE_MS=7*86_400_000;
export const STREAM_MIN_MS=30_000;
export type ReadSnapshotFn=(issuer:string,market:Market,opts:ReadSnapshotOptions)=>Promise<ReadSnapshotResult>;
export interface DigestDeps{
 db:CompanyDb;tables:TableClient;readSnapshot:ReadSnapshotFn;
 facts:Pick<FactsDb,'scopeRows'|'scopeAll'>;reader:SnapshotObjectStore;
 now:()=>Date;deadline:Date|null;codeVersion:string|null;
}
export interface DigestOptions{mode:'incremental'|'full';issuerIds?:string[];market?:Market;limit?:number;now?:Date;dryRun?:boolean;triggeredBy?:TriggeredBy}
export class DigestError extends Error{constructor(public code:'code_version_missing'|'invalid_options',message?:string){super(message??code);this.name='DigestError';}}
export interface PlannedStream{issuerId:string;market:Market;stateRev:number;sweep:boolean;source:'incremental'|'sweep'|'full'}
export type StreamOutcomeKind='changed'|'unchanged'|'skipped_stale'|'skipped_unknown'|'failed'|'planned';
export interface StreamOutcome{issuerId:string;market:Market;sweep:boolean;outcome:StreamOutcomeKind;code?:string;attemptId:number|null;basedOnRev:number|null;events:number;result:ReplaceResult|null;evidence:{indexed:number;facts:number}|null;retried:boolean;markFailedError?:boolean}
export interface DigestDetail{events:ReplaceResult;attempted:number;succeeded:number;failed:number;skippedStale:number;skippedUnknown:number;swept:number;idle:boolean;backlogFailed:number;evidence:{indexed:number;facts:number}}
export interface DigestReceipt{batchId:string|null;status:BatchStatus|'dry_run';counts:BatchCounts;errors:BatchError[];streams:StreamOutcome[];idle:boolean;detail:DigestDetail}

const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const keyOf=(s:{issuerId:string;market:Market})=>`${s.issuerId}:${s.market}`;
const isoDay=(d:Date)=>d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
const errMsg=(e:unknown)=>(e instanceof Error?e.message:String(e)).slice(0,200);
const dbCode=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof CompanyDbError?e.code:null;

export function interleave<A,B>(inc:A[],sweep:B[],ratio=4):(A|B)[]{
 const out:(A|B)[]=[];let i=0,j=0;
 while(i<inc.length||j<sweep.length){for(let k=0;k<ratio&&i<inc.length;k++)out.push(inc[i++]);if(j<sweep.length)out.push(sweep[j++]);}
 return out;
}
export async function selectStreams(deps:Pick<DigestDeps,'db'|'facts'>,opts:DigestOptions,now:Date):Promise<PlannedStream[]>{
 if(opts.mode==='full'){
  const markets:Market[]=opts.market?[opts.market]:['US','CN'];const out:PlannedStream[]=[];
  for(const m of markets){
   const rows:ScopeRow[]=opts.issuerIds?await deps.facts.scopeRows(m,[...new Set(opts.issuerIds)]):await deps.facts.scopeAll(m);
   for(const r of [...rows].sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.issuer_id,b.issuer_id)))out.push({issuerId:r.issuer_id,market:m,stateRev:r.state_rev,sweep:true,source:'full'});
  }
  return out;
 }
 const limit=opts.limit??DEFAULT_DIGEST_LIMIT;
 const incN=Math.ceil(limit*4/5),swN=Math.floor(limit/5);
 const inMarket=(s:{market:Market})=>!opts.market||s.market===opts.market;
 const inc=(await deps.db.digestDue(now,incN,opts.market)).filter(inMarket);   // market filtered in SQL before the limit (Q6); local filter kept as a guard
 const sw=swN>0?(await deps.db.sweepDue(new Date(now.getTime()-SWEEP_AGE_MS),now,swN,opts.market)).filter(inMarket):[];
 const swKeys=new Set(sw.map(keyOf)),incKeys=new Set(inc.map(keyOf));
 return interleave(
  inc.map(s=>({issuerId:s.issuerId,market:s.market,stateRev:s.stateRev,sweep:swKeys.has(keyOf(s)),source:'incremental' as const})),
  sw.filter(s=>!incKeys.has(keyOf(s))).map(s=>({issuerId:s.issuerId,market:s.market,stateRev:s.stateRev,sweep:true,source:'sweep' as const})));
}

interface Ctx{batchId:string|null;today:string;now:Date;cache:ParsedSnapshotCache;dryRun:boolean}
async function digestStream(deps:DigestDeps,ctx:Ctx,p:PlannedStream):Promise<StreamOutcome>{
 const out:StreamOutcome={issuerId:p.issuerId,market:p.market,sweep:p.sweep,outcome:'failed',attemptId:null,basedOnRev:null,events:0,result:null,evidence:null,retried:false};
 let attemptId=0;
 if(!ctx.dryRun){
  try{attemptId=await deps.db.beginAttempt(p.issuerId,p.market,ctx.now);}
  catch(e){if(dbCode(e)==='unknown_stream'){out.outcome='skipped_unknown';out.code='unknown_stream';}else out.code='digest_issuer_failed';return out;}
  out.attemptId=attemptId;
 }
 const fail=async(code:string)=>{
  out.outcome='failed';out.code=code;
  if(!ctx.dryRun){try{await deps.db.markDigestFailed(p.issuerId,p.market,attemptId,deps.now());}catch{out.markFailedError=true;}}
  return out;
 };
 for(let attempt=0;attempt<2;attempt++){
  let env:ReadSnapshotResult;
  try{env=await deps.readSnapshot(p.issuerId,p.market,{concepts:null,asOf:ctx.today,history:true});}catch{return fail('digest_issuer_failed');}
  if(env.truncated)return fail('read_truncated');
  try{
   const built=await buildEvidenceIndex({reader:deps.reader},{issuerId:p.issuerId,market:p.market,rows:env.rows,filings:env.filings,cache:ctx.cache});
   if(!ctx.dryRun)await deps.db.replaceEvidence(p.issuerId,p.market,built.rows);
   out.evidence={indexed:built.rows.length,facts:built.stats.facts};
  }catch{return fail('evidence_index_failed');}
  let events,coverage;
  try{
   const [scope]=await deps.facts.scopeRows(p.market,[p.issuerId]);
   events=deriveIssuerEvents({rows:env.rows,filings:env.filings,cutoff:ctx.today});
   coverage=summarizeCoverage({rows:env.rows,filings:env.filings,scope:scope??null});
  }catch{return fail('digest_issuer_failed');}
  out.events=events.length;out.basedOnRev=env.stateRev;
  if(ctx.dryRun){out.outcome='planned';return out;}
  try{
   const r=await deps.db.replaceDigest(p.issuerId,p.market,ctx.batchId!,attemptId,randomUUID(),env.stateRev,p.sweep,events,coverage);
   out.result=r;out.outcome=r.changed+r.retired+r.revived>0?'changed':'unchanged';delete out.code;return out;
  }catch(e){
   const code=dbCode(e);
   if(code==='stale_computation'&&attempt===0){out.retried=true;continue;}
   if(code==='stale_attempt'){out.outcome='skipped_stale';out.code='stale_attempt';return out;}
   if(code==='unknown_stream'){out.outcome='skipped_unknown';out.code='unknown_stream';return out;}
   return fail(code==='stale_computation'||code==='invalid_event'?code:'digest_issuer_failed');
  }
 }
 return fail('stale_computation');
}

const zeroEvents=():ReplaceResult=>({upserted:0,changed:0,retired:0,revived:0});
export async function runCompanyDigest(deps:DigestDeps,opts:DigestOptions):Promise<DigestReceipt>{
 if(opts.issuerIds!==undefined&&opts.mode!=='full')throw new DigestError('invalid_options','issuerIds requires mode full');
 const limit=opts.limit??DEFAULT_DIGEST_LIMIT;
 if(!Number.isInteger(limit)||limit<1)throw new DigestError('invalid_options','limit must be a positive integer');
 const now=opts.now??deps.now();const today=isoDay(now);
 const dryRun=opts.dryRun===true;
 if(!dryRun&&!deps.codeVersion)throw new DigestError('code_version_missing');
 const counts=emptyCounts();const errors:BatchError[]=[];const streams:StreamOutcome[]=[];
 const events=zeroEvents();const evidence={indexed:0,facts:0};
 let attempted=0,succeeded=0,failed=0,skippedStale=0,skippedUnknown=0,swept=0,idle=false;
 let batchId:string|null=null;
 if(!dryRun)({batchId}=await startBatch(deps.tables,{producer:DIGEST_PRODUCER,dataset:DIGEST_DATASET,
  toolVersions:{events:EVENTS_VERSION,mappingGen:String(MAPPING_GEN),formulaVersion:FORMULA_VERSION,evidenceIndex:EVIDENCE_INDEX_VERSION},codeVersion:deps.codeVersion!,triggeredBy:opts.triggeredBy??'script'}));
 const ctx:Ctx={batchId,today,now,cache:new Map(),dryRun};
 const detailOf=(backlogFailed:number):DigestDetail=>({events:{...events},attempted,succeeded,failed,skippedStale,skippedUnknown,swept,idle,backlogFailed,evidence:{...evidence}});
 try{
  const planned=await selectStreams(deps,opts,now);idle=planned.length===0;
  for(let i=0;i<planned.length;i++){
   if(deps.deadline&&deps.deadline.getTime()-deps.now().getTime()<STREAM_MIN_MS){errors.push({code:'deadline_hit',message:JSON.stringify({not_started:planned.length-i})});break;}
   const p=planned[i];attempted++;counts.fetched++;
   const o=await digestStream(deps,ctx,p);streams.push(o);
   if(o.evidence){evidence.indexed+=o.evidence.indexed;evidence.facts+=o.evidence.facts;}
   const key=keyOf(p);
   switch(o.outcome){
    case 'changed':case 'unchanged':
     succeeded++;if(o.outcome==='changed')counts.inserted++;else counts.duplicates++;
     if(p.sweep)swept++;
     for(const k of ['upserted','changed','retired','revived'] as const)events[k]+=o.result![k];
     break;
    case 'skipped_stale':counts.duplicates++;skippedStale++;errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key,message:JSON.stringify({stale_attempt:1})});break;
    case 'skipped_unknown':counts.duplicates++;skippedUnknown++;errors.push({code:'skipped_summary',key,message:JSON.stringify({unknown_stream:1})});break;
    case 'planned':counts.duplicates++;break;
    default:
     counts.failed++;failed++;errors.push({code:o.code??'digest_issuer_failed',key});
     if(o.markFailedError)errors.push({code:'mark_failed_error',key});
   }
  }
  if(dryRun)return {batchId:null,status:'dry_run',counts,errors,streams,idle,detail:detailOf(0)};
  const backlogFailed=(await deps.db.backlog()).failedStreams;
  const detail=detailOf(backlogFailed);
  const status=await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId!,{counts,errors},deps.now());
  await recordAttempt(deps.tables,DIGEST_DATASET,{ok:failed===0&&backlogFailed===0,cadence:'daily',now:deps.now(),detail:{...detail}});
  return {batchId,status,counts,errors,streams,idle,detail};
 }catch(e){
  if(dryRun)throw e;
  errors.push({code:'unknown',message:errMsg(e)});
  try{await finishBatch(deps.tables,batchId!,{counts,errors},deps.now());}catch{/* left running; runbook marks it failed */}
  try{await recordAttempt(deps.tables,DIGEST_DATASET,{ok:false,cadence:'daily',now:deps.now(),detail:{...detailOf(-1),error:errMsg(e)}});}catch{/* same */}
  throw e;
 }
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/deps.ts
// Production wiring (plan Task 8). Digest: every dependency service_role (company_digest_state,
// issuer_events, company_fact_evidence and fact_sync_scope are not readable by anon, §0 #64).
// The read-route wiring (ReadDeps / productionReadDeps / productionEventGateDeps) is appended by

import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../db/table-client';

export function productionDigestDeps(opts:ProductionDigestOptions):DigestDeps{

 return {db:supabaseCompanyDb(sb),tables:supabaseTableClient(sb),readSnapshot:(i,m,o)=>readSnapshot(sb,i,m,o),facts:supabaseFactsDb(sb),
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 实现路由**

```ts
// src/app/api/cron/company-digest/route.ts
// Company digest trigger (spec §6.3): CRON_SECRET bearer, limit 1..200 (default 200), maxDuration 300
// with a 240 s deadline handed to runCompanyDigest (no new stream with < 30 s left → deadline_hit).
// code_version = VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA only (missing → 503, like facts-sync). The HTTP receipt carries
// codes, keys and counts only — never messages. Hourly at :20 (vercel.json).
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {DigestError,runCompanyDigest} from '@/lib/company/digest';
import type {DigestReceipt} from '@/lib/company/digest';
import {productionDigestDeps} from '@/lib/company/deps';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '@/lib/facts/deps';
import {authorizedCronRequest} from '@/lib/observability/cron-auth';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=300;
const DEADLINE_MS=240_000,DEFAULT_LIMIT=200,MAX_LIMIT=200;
const NO_STORE={'Cache-Control':'no-store'};
const err=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>NextResponse.json({error:{code,message}},{status,headers:NO_STORE});
function publicReceipt(r:DigestReceipt){
 return {batchId:r.batchId,status:r.status,counts:r.counts,idle:r.idle,detail:r.detail,
  errors:r.errors.map(e=>e.key===undefined?{code:e.code}:{code:e.code,key:e.key}),
  streams:r.streams.map(s=>s.code===undefined?{issuerId:s.issuerId,market:s.market,sweep:s.sweep,outcome:s.outcome}:{issuerId:s.issuerId,market:s.market,sweep:s.sweep,outcome:s.outcome,code:s.code})};
}
async function run(request:Request):Promise<NextResponse>{
 const secret=process.env.CRON_SECRET;
 if(!secret)return err('cron_unavailable','Cron unavailable',503);
 if(!authorizedCronRequest(request.headers.get('authorization'),secret))return err('unauthorized','Unauthorized',401);
 const url=new URL(request.url);
 const limits=url.searchParams.getAll('limit');
 if(limits.length>1)return err('invalid_parameter:limit','limit may be given once',400);
 let limit=DEFAULT_LIMIT;
 if(limits.length===1){if(!/^\d{1,3}$/.test(limits[0])||Number(limits[0])<1||Number(limits[0])>MAX_LIMIT)return err('invalid_parameter:limit',`limit must be 1..${MAX_LIMIT}`,400);limit=Number(limits[0]);}
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:false});
 if(!codeVersion)return err('code_version_unavailable','VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA not set',503);
 const started=new Date();
 try{
  const deps=productionDigestDeps({deadline:new Date(started.getTime()+DEADLINE_MS),codeVersion});
  const receipt=await runCompanyDigest(deps,{mode:'incremental',limit,triggeredBy:'cron'});
  return NextResponse.json({ok:receipt.status==='success',limit,started_at:started.toISOString(),receipt:publicReceipt(receipt)},{status:200,headers:NO_STORE});
 }catch(e){
  return err(e instanceof DigestError?e.code:'digest_failed','Company digest failed',500);
 }
}
export async function GET(request:Request){return run(request);}
export async function POST(request:Request){return run(request);}
```

```ts
/**
 * Company digest from the command line (spec §6.3 item 5). Dry run by default (no batch, no writes).
 *
 *   node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/company/digest.ts [--full] [--issuer <ticker>]...
 *        [--market US|CN] [--limit n] [--apply]
 *
 * --full rebuilds every stream (or the --issuer streams) regardless of next_attempt_at — run it after
 * EVENTS_VERSION, MAPPING_GEN or FORMULA_VERSION changes, or after fixing an invalid_event bug. Without
 * --full it is one incremental cron pass (--limit, default 200). --issuer needs --full and resolves by
 * today's ownership (unknown → exit 2). --apply needs a code version (VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or a git
 * checkout). Never run it while the cron is running (recordAttempt assumes one producer).
 * Exit 0 success, 1 when the batch (apply) is not success or any stream failed (dry run), 2 bad arguments.
 */
import {supabaseTableClient} from '../../src/lib/db/table-client';
import {productionDigestDeps} from '../../src/lib/company/deps';
import {runCompanyDigest} from '../../src/lib/company/digest';
import {resolveIssuer} from '../../src/lib/entities/resolve';
import {resolveCodeVersion} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import type {Market} from '../../src/lib/facts/types';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';

const USAGE='usage: digest.ts [--full] [--issuer <ticker>]... [--market US|CN] [--limit n] [--apply]';
interface Args{full:boolean;issuers:string[];market?:Market;limit:number;apply:boolean}
function parseArgs(argv:string[]):Args{
 const a:Args={full:false,issuers:[],limit:200,apply:false};
 const next=(i:number)=>{const v=argv[i+1];if(v===undefined||v.startsWith('--')){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}return v;};
 for(let i=0;i<argv.length;i++){
  const x=argv[i];
  if(x==='--full')a.full=true;
  else if(x==='--issuer')a.issuers.push(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--market'){const m=next(i++);if(m!=='US'&&m!=='CN'){console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}a.market=m;}
  else if(x==='--limit')a.limit=Number(next(i++));
  else if(x==='--apply')a.apply=true;
  else{console.error(USAGE);process.exit(2);}
 }
 if(!Number.isInteger(a.limit)||a.limit<1||a.limit>1000){console.error('--limit must be 1..1000');process.exit(2);}
 if(a.issuers.length>0&&!a.full){console.error('--issuer needs --full');process.exit(2);}
 return a;
}
async function main(){
 const args=parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
 const codeVersion=resolveCodeVersion({allowGit:true});
 if(args.apply&&!codeVersion){console.error('code version unavailable (set VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA or run inside a git checkout); refusing --apply');process.exit(2);}
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();
 const deps=productionDigestDeps({deadline:null,codeVersion,admin});
 let issuerIds:string[]|undefined;
 if(args.issuers.length>0){
  const tables=supabaseTableClient(admin);const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);issuerIds=[];
  for(const t of args.issuers){const r=await resolveIssuer(tables,{ticker:t},{today});if(!r){console.error(`unknown ticker: ${t}`);process.exit(2);}issuerIds.push(r.issuer_id);}
 }
 const receipt=await runCompanyDigest(deps,{mode:args.full?'full':'incremental',issuerIds,market:args.market,limit:args.limit,dryRun:!args.apply,triggeredBy:'script'});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({mode:args.apply?'apply':'dry-run (no batch written; pass --apply to write)',codeVersion,...receipt},null,1));
 const failed=args.apply?receipt.status!=='success':receipt.streams.some(s=>s.outcome==='failed');
 process.exit(failed?1:0);
}
main().catch(e=>{console.error(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:e);process.exit(1);});
```

本组对 Task 11–13（UI）的 DTO 约定：每个组合路由响应都带 `evidence`（只含合格事实）与 `withheld:{evidenceIncomplete,citationPending}`；HK 票据 → 404 `market_not_served`；`DcfStudio` 新签名 `({ticker, asOf?, onOpenFact?})`。

**指挥决定（本组通用）：**
- 路由处理函数放在 `src/lib/company/handlers/*.ts`，公共与 admin 两个 `route.ts` 只是 `companyRoute({mode})` 的薄壳——Next 15 的 route 文件不允许导出 `GET`/配置之外的名字，共享逻辑只能在 lib 里；每次请求从 `readSnapshot` 重新组装，模块级无缓存，因此 admin 与公共不可能共享已构建 DTO。
- HK 票据（`inferCoreMarket(ticker)==='HK'`）：组合路由一律 404 `market_not_served`（`no-store`），不解析、不回落 US；页头身份由页面另读 `/api/entities/resolve`（§0 #69）。
- `evidence` 字典只含**合格**事实的 DTO；被置 `withheld` 的事实不出 DTO（少暴露，前端只需要原因码）。
- 派生格 / 指标行的任一输入不合格 → 整格 `withheld`；原因取 `evidence_incomplete` 优先，否则 `citation_pending`；`factId` 为该不合格输入的 id。

```ts
// --- read side (Tasks 9, 10, 14, 15) --------------------------------------------------------
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import {getAnonSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/anon';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import {supabaseTableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import type {TableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import {publicClients} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {SNAPSHOT_BUCKET} from '@/lib/facts/snapshot-store';
import type {FactsDb,Market} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {audit} from '@/lib/research/store';
import type {ResearchSupabase} from '@/lib/research/store';
import {supabaseCompanyDb} from './db';
import {readSnapshot} from './snapshot-read';
import {emptyPdfLocatorSource} from './pdf-locator';
import type {PdfLocatorSource} from './pdf-locator';
import {metricsComputedAt} from './metrics-computed-at';
import type {ComputedAtMap} from './metrics-computed-at';
import type {CompanyDb,ReadSnapshotOptions,ReadSnapshotResult} from './types';

/** Everything a composed read route needs (spec §6, §0 #64). Public data via anon; events/evidence via service_role. */
export interface ReadDeps{
 tables:TableClient;                                                         // anon: issuers, issuer_securities
 facts:Pick<FactsDb,'readFacts'|'factsByIds'|'filingsOfIssuer'|'metricsOfIssuer'>;   // anon
 stateRev(issuer:string,market:Market):Promise<number>;                     // anon fact_state_rev
 snapshot(issuer:string,market:Market,opts:ReadSnapshotOptions):Promise<ReadSnapshotResult>;   // anon company_read_snapshot
 company:CompanyDb;                                                          // service_role: eventsOfIssuer(s), evidenceOf
 publicCompany:CompanyDb;                                                    // anon: coverageOf, listCoverage
 pdf:PdfLocatorSource;
 metricsComputedAt(issuer:string,market:Market,formulaVersion:string):Promise<ComputedAtMap>;   // anon select financial_metrics.computed_at
 freshnessTables():TableClient;                                              // service_role (dq_freshness)
 signSnapshot(path:string,seconds:number):Promise<string>;                  // service_role storage signed URL
 audit(userId:string,action:string,objectId:string,detail:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<void>;   // research_audit_log via service_role
}
/** What the shared event gate (Task 10 event-dto.ts gateEvents / gateEventRows) reads: evidence via service_role, facts/filings via anon, CN PDF locators. */
export type EventGateDeps=Pick<ReadDeps,'company'|'facts'|'pdf'>;
export function productionReadDeps():ReadDeps{
 const anon=getAnonSupabase() as unknown as SupabaseClient;
 const {tables,db,stateRev}=publicClients();
 let admin:SupabaseClient|null=null;
 const adminClient=()=>admin??=(getAdminSupabase() as unknown as SupabaseClient);
 let service:CompanyDb|null=null;
 return {
  tables,facts:db,stateRev,
  snapshot:(issuer,market,opts)=>readSnapshot(anon,issuer,market,opts),
  get company(){return service??=supabaseCompanyDb(adminClient());},
  publicCompany:supabaseCompanyDb(anon),
  pdf:emptyPdfLocatorSource,
  metricsComputedAt:(issuer,market,v)=>metricsComputedAt(anon,issuer,market,v),
  freshnessTables:()=>supabaseTableClient(adminClient()),
  signSnapshot:async(path,seconds)=>{
   const {data,error}=await adminClient().storage.from(SNAPSHOT_BUCKET).createSignedUrl(path,seconds);
   if(error||!data?.signedUrl)throw new Error('snapshot_sign_failed');
   return data.signedUrl;
  },
  audit:(userId,action,objectId,detail)=>audit({supabase:adminClient() as unknown as ResearchSupabase,userId},action,objectId,detail),
 };
}
/** Tracking inbox (Task 16): the same members as the read routes, so the inbox and /api/companies/[ticker]/events gate identically. */
export const productionEventGateDeps=():EventGateDeps=>productionReadDeps();
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/metrics-computed-at.ts
// financial_metrics.computed_at for the materialised rows (spec §0.1 item 3: MetricRow does not carry it;
// anon already has select on financial_metrics). Key = derive.ts row key: metric|period_end|period_start|input_unit|basis.
// Paged to exhaustion (PostgREST max_rows = 1000). Interface request §10.1 #3 / plan 接口请求 4.
import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import type {Market,MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';

export type ComputedAtMap=Map<string,{computedAt:string;basedOnRev:number}>;
export const metricKey=(m:Pick<MetricRow,'metric'|'period_end'|'period_start'|'input_unit'|'basis'>)=>`${m.metric}|${m.period_end}|${m.period_start}|${m.input_unit}|${m.basis}`;
const PAGE=1000;
export async function metricsComputedAt(sb:SupabaseClient,issuer:string,market:Market,formulaVersion:string):Promise<ComputedAtMap>{
 const out:ComputedAtMap=new Map();
 for(let from=0;;from+=PAGE){
  const {data,error}=await sb.from('financial_metrics').select('metric,period_start,period_end,input_unit,basis,computed_at,based_on_rev')
   .eq('issuer_id',issuer).eq('market',market).eq('formula_version',formulaVersion)
   .order('metric').order('period_end').order('period_start').order('input_unit').order('basis').range(from,from+PAGE-1);
  if(error)throw new Error('metrics_computed_at_failed');
  const rows=(data??[]) as {metric:string;period_start:string;period_end:string;input_unit:string;basis:string;computed_at:string;based_on_rev:number|string}[];
  for(const r of rows)out.set(metricKey(r),{computedAt:r.computed_at,basedOnRev:Number(r.based_on_rev)});
  if(rows.length<PAGE)return out;
 }
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/route-test-kit.ts
// Test-only kit for the company route tests (plan Tasks 9, 10, 14, 15): memory issuer tables read by the
// REAL resolveIssuer (§0 #69 ticker cases), FactRow / FilingSummary / EvidenceRecord builders, a ReadDeps
// stub of vi.fn members, and a deterministic double of applyGate (Task 6 owns the real rules and their
// tests; route code calls applyGate directly so this double replaces it): no fact / no evidence record → evidence_incomplete; CN non-admin without a linked filing AND a PDF locator
// → citation_pending; admin exempts only the CN conditions. Never imported by application code.
import {vi} from 'vitest';
import {memoryTableClient} from '@/lib/db/memory-table-client';
import type {TableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import type {FactRow,FilingRow,Market,MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {ReadDeps} from './deps';
import type {Eligibility,GateInput,GateResult} from './evidence-gate';
import type {CompanyDb,EvidenceDto,EvidenceRecord,FilingSummary,PdfLocator,ReadSnapshotResult,WithheldReason} from './types';

export const kid=(n:number)=>`${String(n).repeat(8)}-${String(n).repeat(4)}-4${String(n).repeat(3)}-8${String(n).repeat(3)}-${String(n).repeat(12)}`;
export const US=kid(1),BRKA=kid(2),CN=kid(4),HK=kid(5),OLD=kid(6),AMB1=kid(7),AMB2=kid(8);
const issuerRow=(id:string,status='active',merged_into:string|null=null)=>({issuer_id:id,status,merged_into,lei:null,cik:null,usci:null,cninfo_org_id:null,hkex_stock_code_primary:null,canonical_name_zh:null,canonical_name_en:`Co ${id.slice(0,2)}`,country_code:null,provenance:{},created_at:'2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z',updated_at:'2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'});
export const secRow=(issuer:string,ticker:string,p:Record<string,unknown>={})=>({issuer_id:issuer,ticker,isin:null,figi:null,share_class:'common',is_primary:true,valid_from:'2000-01-01',valid_to:null,...p});
/** AAPL (US), BRK.A, 600519.SH (CN, share_class A), 00700.HK, OLDX merged into AAPL's issuer, AMBG owned by two issuers. */
export async function seededTables():Promise<TableClient>{
 const c=memoryTableClient({issuers:['issuer_id'],issuer_securities:['issuer_id','ticker','valid_from']});
 for(const [id,t,cls] of [[US,'AAPL','common'],[BRKA,'BRK.A','common'],[CN,'600519.SH','A'],[HK,'00700.HK','H']] as const){await c.insert('issuers',issuerRow(id));await c.insert('issuer_securities',secRow(id,t,{share_class:cls}));}
 await c.insert('issuers',issuerRow(OLD,'merged',US));await c.insert('issuer_securities',secRow(OLD,'OLDX'));
 for(const id of [AMB1,AMB2]){await c.insert('issuers',issuerRow(id));await c.insert('issuer_securities',secRow(id,'AMBG'));}
 return c;
}
export const FIL_US='f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001',FIL_CN_LINKED='f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002',FIL_CN_PENDING='f0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003';
let seq=0;
export const fid=()=>`a${String(++seq).padStart(7,'0')}-0000-4000-8000-000000000000`;
export const fact=(p:Partial<FactRow>={}):FactRow=>({fact_id:fid(),issuer_id:US,market:'US',filing_id:FIL_US,run_id:'r0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000',concept:'revenue',source_concept:'Revenues',statement:'IS',period_start:'2022-09-25',period_end:'2023-09-30',duration:'12M',value:'383285000000',value_text:'383285000000',unit:'USD',consolidation:'consolidated',available_date:'2023-11-03',mapping_gen:1,mapping_version:'facts-map/1',status:'ok',raw_hash:'h'.repeat(64),created_at:'2023-11-03T00:00:00Z',disclosure_seq:1,is_current:true,is_revision:false,...p});
export const cnFact=(p:Partial<FactRow>={}):FactRow=>fact({issuer_id:CN,market:'CN',filing_id:FIL_CN_PENDING,source_concept:'revenue',concept:'revenue_operating',unit:'CNY',period_start:'2023-01-01',period_end:'2023-12-31',value:'147693604994.14',value_text:'147693604994.14',available_date:'2024-04-03',...p});
export const summary=(p:Partial<FilingSummary>={}):FilingSummary=>({filingId:FIL_US,formType:'10-K',fiscalYear:2023,fiscalPeriod:'FY',periodEnd:'2023-09-30',availableDate:'2023-11-03',sourceRef:'0000320193-23-000106',source:'edgar',url:'https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/',documentUrl:null,citation:'edgar',linkAttempts:0,factCount:1,mappingGen:1,...p});
export const cnSummary=(p:Partial<FilingSummary>={}):FilingSummary=>summary({filingId:FIL_CN_PENDING,formType:'annual',periodEnd:'2023-12-31',availableDate:'2024-04-03',sourceRef:'600519.SH:annual:20231231',source:'tushare',url:null,documentUrl:null,citation:'pending',...p});
export const filingRow=(p:Partial<FilingRow>={}):FilingRow=>({filing_id:FIL_US,issuer_id:US,market:'US',source:'edgar',origin:'sec',form_type:'10-K',fiscal_year:2023,fiscal_period:'FY',period_end:'2023-09-30',available_date:'2023-11-03',source_ref:'0000320193-23-000106',url:'https://www.sec.gov/x',document_ref:null,document_url:null,link_attempts:0,mapping_gen:1,run_id:'r0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000',created_at:'2023-11-03T00:00:00Z',...p});
export const metricRow=(p:Partial<MetricRow>={}):MetricRow=>({issuer_id:US,market:'US',metric:'gross_margin',period_start:'2022-09-25',period_end:'2023-09-30',duration:'12M',value:'0.4413',unit:'pure',input_unit:'USD',basis:'us_standard',formula_version:'facts-derive/1.0',inputs:[],based_on_rev:3,as_of:'2024-06-01',...p});
export const record=(factId:string,p:Partial<EvidenceRecord>={}):EvidenceRecord=>({fact_id:factId,raw_hash:'h'.repeat(64),snapshot_sha256:'s'.repeat(64),snapshot_path:`edgar/${US}/${'s'.repeat(64)}.json`,hash_locator:'us-gaap/Revenues/USD/0',json_pointer:'/facts/us-gaap/Revenues/units/USD/0',field:null,source:'edgar',api:null,url:'https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000320193.json',params:null,captured_at:'2026-11-06T00:00:00Z',http_status:200,page:null,index_version:'company-evidence/1',run_id:'r0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000',code_version:'abc123',tool_versions:{mapping_gen:'1'},mapping_version:'facts-map/1',...p});
export const emptySnapshot=(p:Partial<ReadSnapshotResult>={}):ReadSnapshotResult=>({stateRev:1,rows:[],truncated:false,filings:[],...p});

/** ReadDeps of vi.fn members. `noEvidence`: fact ids evidenceOf omits. `pdfFor`: fact ids the PDF source locates. */
export function makeDeps(tables:TableClient,opts:{noEvidence?:Set<string>;pdfFor?:Set<string>}={}):ReadDeps&{noEvidence:Set<string>;pdfFor:Set<string>}{
 const noEvidence=opts.noEvidence??new Set<string>(),pdfFor=opts.pdfFor??new Set<string>();
 const company={
  evidenceOf:vi.fn(async(ids:string[])=>new Map(ids.filter(id=>!noEvidence.has(id)).map(id=>[id,record(id)]))),
  eventsOfIssuer:vi.fn(async()=>({rows:[],nextCursor:null})),
  eventsOfIssuers:vi.fn(async()=>({rows:[],nextCursor:null})),
 } as unknown as CompanyDb;
 return {
  noEvidence,pdfFor,tables,
  facts:{readFacts:vi.fn(),factsByIds:vi.fn(async()=>[]),filingsOfIssuer:vi.fn(async()=>[]),metricsOfIssuer:vi.fn(async()=>[])},
  stateRev:vi.fn(async()=>1),
  snapshot:vi.fn(async()=>emptySnapshot()),
  company,
  publicCompany:{coverageOf:vi.fn(async()=>[]),listCoverage:vi.fn(async()=>({rows:[],total:0}))} as unknown as CompanyDb,
  pdf:{locate:vi.fn(async(_issuer:string,_market:Market,ids:string[])=>new Map<string,PdfLocator>(ids.filter(id=>pdfFor.has(id)).map(id=>[id,{page:12,table:'合并利润表',row:'营业收入',column:'本期发生额',documentUrl:'https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2024-04-03/1219574887.PDF'}])))},
  metricsComputedAt:vi.fn(async()=>new Map()),
  freshnessTables:vi.fn(),
  signSnapshot:vi.fn(async(path:string,seconds:number)=>`https://storage.example/sign/${path}?expires=${seconds}`),
  audit:vi.fn(async()=>{}),
 };
}
const dtoOf=(r:EvidenceRecord,pdf:PdfLocator|null):EvidenceDto=>({factId:r.fact_id,rawHash:r.raw_hash,
 snapshot:{source:r.source,sha256:r.snapshot_sha256,path:r.snapshot_path,api:r.api,url:r.url,params:r.params,capturedAt:r.captured_at,httpStatus:r.http_status,page:r.page,download:r.source==='edgar'?`/api/companies/snapshot?fact=${r.fact_id}`:null},
 locator:{hashLocator:r.hash_locator,jsonPointer:r.json_pointer,field:r.field,pdf},run:{runId:r.run_id,codeVersion:r.code_version,toolVersions:r.tool_versions},
 mappingVersion:r.mapping_version,unitRule:null,sourceDocument:null});
/** Deterministic double of Task 6 applyGate (same GateInput → GateResult). Tests install it with
 * vi.mock('<…>/evidence-gate', async(orig)=>({...await orig(), applyGate: fakeApplyGate})) so every other
 * Task 6 export (gateEventPayload, eventFactIds, …) stays real. */
export function fakeApplyGate(input:GateInput):GateResult{
 const evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>={};const eligibility=new Map<string,Eligibility>();const withheld={evidenceIncomplete:0,citationPending:0};
 const no=(id:string,reason:WithheldReason)=>{eligibility.set(id,{ok:false,reason});if(reason==='evidence_incomplete')withheld.evidenceIncomplete++;else withheld.citationPending++;};
 for(const id of [...new Set(input.factIds)].sort()){
  const f=input.facts.get(id);const rec=input.records.get(id);
  if(!f||!rec||!rec.code_version){no(id,'evidence_incomplete');continue;}
  if(input.market==='CN'&&!input.admin){
   const fl=input.filings.get(f.filing_id);
   if(!fl||fl.citation!=='linked'||!fl.documentUrl||!input.pdf.has(id)){no(id,'citation_pending');continue;}
  }
  eligibility.set(id,{ok:true});evidence[id]=dtoOf(rec,input.pdf.get(id)??null);
 }
 return {evidence,eligibility,withheld};
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/route.test.ts
import {beforeEach,describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';

vi.mock('./deps',()=>({productionReadDeps:()=>mocks.deps}));
vi.mock('./evidence-gate',async(orig)=>({...(await orig<typeof import('./evidence-gate')>()),applyGate:(await import('./route-test-kit')).fakeApplyGate}));
vi.mock('@/lib/admin/auth',()=>{class AdminUnauthenticated extends Error{}class AdminForbidden extends Error{}return {AdminUnauthenticated,AdminForbidden,requireAdminUser:mocks.requireAdmin};});

 beforeEach(async()=>{vi.clearAllMocks();mocks.deps=makeDeps(await seededTables());mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue({id:'u-admin'});});
 it('§0 #69 ticker cases over the real resolveIssuer',async()=>{

  const hk=await call('public','00700.HK');expect(hk.status).toBe(404);expect((await hk.json()).error.code).toBe('market_not_served');
  expect((await (await call('public','700')).json()).error.code).toBe('market_not_served');
  const nf=await call('public','ZZZZ');expect(nf.status).toBe(404);expect((await nf.json()).error.code).toBe('unknown_ticker');
  expect((await call('public','AA PL')).status).toBe(400);
 });
 it('asOf: defaults to today, ≤ today, duplicate → 400; past asOf → long shared cache',async()=>{
  const today=new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const r=await call('public','AAPL');expect((await r.json()).asOf).toBe(today);
  expect(r.headers.get('cache-control')).toMatch(/^public, s-maxage=\d+, stale-while-revalidate=600$/);
  const past=await call('public','AAPL','asOf=2024-06-30');expect(past.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('public, max-age=600, s-maxage=3600');
  for(const qs of ['asOf=2999-01-01','asOf=2024-02-30','asOf=2024-01-01&asOf=2024-01-02']){const b=await call('public','AAPL',qs);expect(b.status).toBe(400);expect(b.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('no-store');}
 });
 it('public mode never reads the session; admin mode gates and is private, no-store on success and error',async()=>{
  await call('public','AAPL');expect(mocks.requireAdmin).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  const a=await call('admin','AAPL','asOf=2024-06-30');
  expect(a.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('private, no-store');expect((await a.json())).toMatchObject({admin:true,userId:'u-admin'});
  const {AdminUnauthenticated,AdminForbidden}=await import('@/lib/admin/auth');

  const u=await call('admin','AAPL');expect(u.status).toBe(401);expect(u.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('private, no-store');
  mocks.requireAdmin.mockRejectedValueOnce(new AdminForbidden('x'));
  const f=await call('admin','AAPL');expect(f.status).toBe(403);expect(f.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('private, no-store');
  const nf=await call('admin','ZZZZ');expect(nf.status).toBe(404);expect(nf.headers.get('cache-control')).toBe('private, no-store');
 });

 });

describe('buildGated / gateCell',()=>{

 });
 it('fetches unknown fact rows of THIS stream only and loads filings when not given',async()=>{
  const a=fact(),foreign=fact({issuer_id:CN});
  (mocks.deps.facts.factsByIds as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>).mockResolvedValue([a,foreign]);
  (mocks.deps.facts.filingsOfIssuer as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>).mockResolvedValue([(await import('./route-test-kit')).filingRow()]);
  const g=await buildGated({deps:mocks.deps,admin:false,issuer:ok},[a.fact_id,foreign.fact_id],[],[]);
  expect(g.reasonOf(a.fact_id)).toBeNull();expect(g.reasonOf(foreign.fact_id)).toBe('evidence_incomplete');
  expect(g.fact(a.fact_id)).toEqual(a);
 });
 it('gateCell: fact → withheld; derived → withheld if any input fails (evidence_incomplete wins); counts',async()=>{
  const a=fact(),b=fact({concept:'cost_of_revenue'});mocks.deps.noEvidence.add(b.fact_id);
  const g=await buildGated({deps:mocks.deps,admin:false,issuer:ok},[a.fact_id,b.fact_id],[a,b],[summary()]);
  const fc={kind:'fact',factId:b.fact_id} as FactCell;
  const dc={kind:'derived',metric:'gross_margin',value:'0.4',inputs:[{factId:a.fact_id,concept:'revenue',filingId:a.filing_id,availableDate:a.available_date},{factId:b.fact_id,concept:'cost_of_revenue',filingId:b.filing_id,availableDate:b.available_date}]} as DerivedCell;
  const cells:Cell[]=[gateCell(fc,g),gateCell(dc,g),gateCell({kind:'fact',factId:a.fact_id} as FactCell,g),null];
  expect(cells[0]).toEqual({kind:'withheld',reason:'evidence_incomplete',factId:b.fact_id});
  expect(cells[1]).toEqual({kind:'withheld',reason:'evidence_incomplete',factId:b.fact_id});
  expect(cells[2]).toMatchObject({kind:'fact'});
  expect(countWithheld(cells)).toEqual({evidenceIncomplete:2,citationPending:0});
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 实现 `src/lib/company/route.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/company/route.ts
// Shared layer of the composed company routes (spec §6 common conventions, §6.4, §0 #57 #62 #63 #64 #69).
// companyRoute() is the one GET factory: public mode never reads the session and caches with
// successHeaders(now, asOf given ? asOf : undefined, empty); admin mode calls requireAdminUser() FIRST
// and every response (success or error) is `private, no-store`. Ticker → issuer via resolvePublicIssuer
// (exact-first, normalised fallback, merge redirect; market from the matched security); HK → 404
// market_not_served (F3 state on the page, never a US fallback). Handlers assemble every DTO per
// request from readSnapshot (no module cache), so public and admin never share a built object.
// buildGated() is the single evidence gate (fact rows + filings → evidenceOf + CN pdf.locate → Task 6
// applyGate) every financial value goes through; gateCell() applies it to grid cells (a derived cell is
// withheld as a whole). Events use the same applyGate through event-dto.ts gateEvents.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {AdminForbidden,AdminUnauthenticated,requireAdminUser} from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import {TICKER_RE,asOfParam,decodeTicker,errorResponse,failureResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams,resolvePublicIssuer,successHeaders,utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import type {PublicIssuer} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {inferCoreMarket} from '@/lib/securities/ticker';
import type {FactRow,FilingRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {productionReadDeps} from './deps';
import type {ReadDeps} from './deps';
import {applyGate} from './evidence-gate';
import type {Eligibility} from './evidence-gate';
import {filingSummaryOf} from './snapshot-read';
import type {Cell,EvidenceDto,EvidenceRecord,FilingSummary,PdfLocator,WithheldCell,WithheldCounts,WithheldReason} from './types';

export type Mode='public'|'admin';
export const PRIVATE_NO_STORE='private, no-store';
export class RouteError extends Error{constructor(public readonly code:string,public readonly status:number,message?:string){super(message??code);this.name='RouteError';}}
export interface RouteCtx{mode:Mode;admin:boolean;now:Date;today:string;asOf:string;asOfGiven:boolean;issuer:PublicIssuer;params:Map<string,string>;deps:ReadDeps;userId:string|null}
export interface HandlerResult{body:unknown;status?:number;empty:boolean;cacheControl?:string}
export type Handler=(ctx:RouteCtx,req:Request)=>Promise<HandlerResult|Response>;

/** requireAdminUser() → user id, or the 401/403/500 response. */
export async function adminGate():Promise<string|Response>{
 try{return (await requireAdminUser()).id;}
 catch(e){
  if(e instanceof AdminUnauthenticated)return errorResponse('not_authenticated','authentication required',401);
  if(e instanceof AdminForbidden)return errorResponse('forbidden','admin role required',403);
  return failureResponse(e,'admin','admin check failed');
 }
}
export function privateResponse(res:Response):Response{res.headers.set('Cache-Control',PRIVATE_NO_STORE);return res;}

export function companyRoute(spec:{tag:string;mode:Mode;params:readonly string[];handler:Handler}){
 return async function GET(req:Request,{params}:{params:Promise<{ticker:string}>}):Promise<Response>{
  const now=new Date(),today=utcDate(now);
  const finish=(res:Response)=>spec.mode==='admin'?privateResponse(res):res;
  let userId:string|null=null;
  if(spec.mode==='admin'){const a=await adminGate();if(a instanceof Response)return finish(a);userId=a;}
  const {ticker:raw}=await params;const ticker=decodeTicker(raw);
  if(ticker===null||!TICKER_RE.test(ticker))return finish(errorResponse('invalid_parameter:ticker','invalid ticker',400));
  let p:Map<string,string>,asOf:string,asOfGiven:boolean;
  try{p=readParams(new URL(req.url),spec.params);asOfGiven=p.has('asOf');asOf=spec.params.includes('asOf')?asOfParam(p,today):today;}
  catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return finish(r);throw e;}
  if(inferCoreMarket(ticker.trim())==='HK')return finish(errorResponse('market_not_served','HK disclosure facts await the document pipeline (F3)',404));
  try{
   const deps=productionReadDeps();
   const issuer=await resolvePublicIssuer(deps.tables,ticker,today);
   if(!issuer)return finish(errorResponse('unknown_ticker','no issuer for ticker',404));
   const out=await spec.handler({mode:spec.mode,admin:spec.mode==='admin',now,today,asOf,asOfGiven,issuer,params:p,deps,userId},req);
   if(out instanceof Response)return finish(out);
   const headers=spec.mode==='admin'?{'Cache-Control':PRIVATE_NO_STORE}:out.cacheControl?{'Cache-Control':out.cacheControl}:successHeaders(now,asOfGiven?asOf:undefined,out.empty);
   return NextResponse.json(out.body,{status:out.status??200,headers});
  }catch(e){
   const pr=paramErrorResponse(e);if(pr)return finish(pr);
   if(e instanceof RouteError)return finish(errorResponse(e.code,e.message,e.status));
   return finish(failureResponse(e,spec.tag,`${spec.tag} read failed`));
  }
 };
}

/** A published filings row as the gate's FilingSummary (factCount unknown here → 0; the gate never reads it). */
export const gateFilingOf=(f:FilingRow):FilingSummary=>filingSummaryOf(f,0);
export interface Gated{
 evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;
 /** Task 6 Eligibility per requested id (feed to gateEventPayload / metricWithheldReason). */
 eligibility:Map<string,Eligibility>;
 /** The caller's snapshot filings plus any published filing loaded for an unknown fact. */
 filings:Map<string,FilingSummary>;
 /** null = eligible; unknown or foreign ids are evidence_incomplete. */
 reasonOf(factId:string):WithheldReason|null;
 withheld(factId:string):WithheldCell|null;
 fact(factId:string):FactRow|undefined;
}
/**
 * The one evidence gate (§5.6, §0 #63): rows not in `known` are read with factsByIds and kept only when they
 * belong to this (issuer, market); filings not in `filings` come from filingsOfIssuer (published only);
 * evidence via the service_role company_fact_evidence read; CN PDF locators via the injected source.
 */
export async function buildGated(ctx:{deps:ReadDeps;admin:boolean;issuer:PublicIssuer},factIds:Iterable<string>,known:readonly FactRow[],filings:readonly FilingSummary[]):Promise<Gated>{
 const {deps,issuer}=ctx;
 const ids=[...new Set(factIds)];
 const byId=new Map<string,FactRow>();
 for(const r of known)byId.set(r.fact_id,r);
 const unknown=ids.filter(id=>!byId.has(id));
 if(unknown.length>0)for(const r of await deps.facts.factsByIds(unknown))if(r.issuer_id===issuer.issuerId&&r.market===issuer.market&&r.status==='ok')byId.set(r.fact_id,r);
 const facts=ids.map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter((r):r is FactRow=>r!==undefined);
 const filingMap=new Map<string,FilingSummary>(filings.map(f=>[f.filingId,f]));
 if(facts.some(r=>!filingMap.has(r.filing_id)))
  for(const f of await deps.facts.filingsOfIssuer(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{}))if(f.mapping_gen>0&&!filingMap.has(f.filing_id))filingMap.set(f.filing_id,gateFilingOf(f));
 const present=facts.map(r=>r.fact_id);
 const [records,pdf]=present.length>0
  ?await Promise.all([deps.company.evidenceOf(present),issuer.market==='CN'?deps.pdf.locate(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,present):Promise.resolve(new Map<string,PdfLocator>())])
  :[new Map<string,EvidenceRecord>(),new Map<string,PdfLocator>()];
 const g=applyGate({factIds:ids,facts:new Map(facts.map(r=>[r.fact_id,r])),filings:filingMap,records,pdf,market:issuer.market,admin:ctx.admin});
 const reasonOf=(id:string):WithheldReason|null=>{const e=g.eligibility.get(id);return !e?'evidence_incomplete':e.ok?null:e.reason;};
 return {evidence:g.evidence,eligibility:g.eligibility,filings:filingMap,reasonOf,fact:id=>byId.get(id),withheld:id=>{const r=reasonOf(id);return r?{kind:'withheld',reason:r,factId:id}:null;}};
}
export const cellFactIds=(c:Cell):string[]=>!c||c.kind==='withheld'?[]:c.kind==='fact'?[c.factId]:c.inputs.map(i=>i.factId);
/** A fact cell is withheld when its fact fails; a derived cell when ANY input fails (evidence_incomplete wins). */
export function gateCell(cell:Cell,g:Gated):Cell{
 if(!cell||cell.kind==='withheld')return cell;
 if(cell.kind==='fact')return g.withheld(cell.factId)??cell;
 const bad=cell.inputs.map(i=>({id:i.factId,r:g.reasonOf(i.factId)})).filter((x):x is {id:string;r:WithheldReason}=>x.r!==null);
 if(bad.length===0)return cell;
 const pick=bad.find(x=>x.r==='evidence_incomplete')??bad[0];
 return {kind:'withheld',reason:pick.r,factId:pick.id};
}
export function countWithheld(cells:Iterable<Cell|WithheldCell|{kind:string;reason?:string}|null>):WithheldCounts{
 const n={evidenceIncomplete:0,citationPending:0};
 for(const c of cells)if(c&&c.kind==='withheld'){if((c as WithheldCell).reason==='evidence_incomplete')n.evidenceIncomplete++;else n.citationPending++;}
 return n;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: 实现 statements 处理器与两个路由壳**

```ts
// src/lib/company/handlers/statements.ts
// GET /api/companies/[ticker]/statements (spec §5.3, §6.1, §0 #66): one snapshot read of
// gridReadConcepts(statement, basis, market) (history only for quarterly) → Task 7 buildStatementsGrid
// (disclosed/annual = current disclosures; quarterly = deriveMetrics q_single_* on the SAME envelope; CN
// q_single_revenue is 营业总收入). BS has no quarterly basis. Every displayed factId (grid.factIds: fact cells
// and all inputs of derived cells) goes through buildGated; truncated → 200 truncated:true with nothing
// partial. otherUnitOnly (Task 7) is passed through so the UI renders "—" + U for other-unit-only periods.
import {MAPPING_GEN} from '@/lib/facts/concepts';
import {QueryError} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {buildStatementsGrid,gridReadConcepts} from '../statements-grid';
import type {GridPeriods} from '../statements-grid';
import {buildGated,countWithheld,gateCell} from '../route';
import type {Handler} from '../route';
import type {Basis,EvidenceDto,FilingSummary,GridRow,PeriodCol,StatementKind,WithheldCounts} from '../types';

export const STATEMENTS_PARAMS=['statement','basis','periods','asOf'] as const;
const STATEMENTS=new Set<StatementKind>(['IS','BS','CF']);
const BASES=new Set<Basis>(['disclosed','annual','quarterly']);
const PERIODS=new Set(['8','20','40']);
export interface StatementsDto{
 issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:'US'|'CN';asOf:string;mappingGen:number;stateRev:number;truncated:boolean;statement:StatementKind;basis:Basis;
 periods:PeriodCol[];rows:GridRow[];filings:Record<string,FilingSummary>;
 /** concept → period keys where only a non-primary unit was disclosed (cell is null; UI shows "—" + U). */
 otherUnitOnly:Record<string,string[]>;
 evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;withheld:WithheldCounts;
}
export const statementsHandler:Handler=async(ctx)=>{
 const {params:p,issuer,deps,asOf}=ctx;
 const statement=p.get('statement') as StatementKind|undefined;
 if(!statement||!STATEMENTS.has(statement))throw new QueryError('statement');
 const basis=(p.get('basis')??'disclosed') as Basis;
 if(!BASES.has(basis)||(basis==='quarterly'&&statement==='BS'))throw new QueryError('basis');
 const periods=p.get('periods')??'8';
 if(!PERIODS.has(periods))throw new QueryError('periods');
 const quarterly=basis==='quarterly';
 const concepts=gridReadConcepts(statement,basis,issuer.market);
 const snap=await deps.snapshot(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{concepts,asOf,history:quarterly});
 const head={issuerId:issuer.issuerId,ticker:issuer.ticker,market:issuer.market,asOf,mappingGen:MAPPING_GEN,stateRev:snap.stateRev,truncated:snap.truncated,statement,basis};
 const none={periods:[],rows:[],filings:{},otherUnitOnly:{},evidence:{},withheld:{evidenceIncomplete:0,citationPending:0}};
 if(snap.truncated){const body:StatementsDto={...head,...none};return {body,empty:true};}
 const grid=buildStatementsGrid(snap,{statement,basis,periods:Number(periods) as GridPeriods,market:issuer.market,asOf});
 if(!grid.ok){if(grid.error==='invalid_basis')throw new QueryError('basis');const body:StatementsDto={...head,truncated:true,...none};return {body,empty:true};}
 const g=await buildGated(ctx,grid.factIds,snap.rows,snap.filings);
 const rows=grid.rows.map(r=>({...r,cells:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(r.cells).map(([k,c])=>[k,gateCell(c,g)]))}));
 const body:StatementsDto={...head,periods:grid.periods,rows,filings:grid.filings,otherUnitOnly:grid.otherUnitOnly,evidence:g.evidence,withheld:countWithheld(rows.flatMap(r=>Object.values(r.cells)))};
 return {body,empty:grid.periods.length===0};
};
```

- [ ] **Step 8: 实现 facts 处理器与两个路由壳**

```ts
// src/lib/company/handlers/facts.ts
// GET /api/companies/[ticker]/facts?concept=&periodStart=&periodEnd=&unit=&asOf= — the disclosure-history
// drawer series (spec §5.6, §0 #68): company_read_snapshot(history:true) narrowed to the natural key
// (concept, periodStart [INSTANT: = periodEnd], periodEnd, consolidated, unit), ascending by
// disclosure_seq. Each entry carries the transform chain (sourceConcept → concept, mappingVersion,
// mappingGen, unitRule from the evidence DTO); values gated; delta / relChange only between two
// adjacent ELIGIBLE entries so a withheld value never leaks through a difference. Facts of the same key in
// OTHER units are listed too (spec §5.3: "主单位以外的事实在抽屉列出"), gated the same way, in otherUnitSeries.
import {CONCEPT_IDS,MAPPING_GEN} from '@/lib/facts/concepts';
import {QueryError,dateParam} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import type {FactRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {decimalRelChange,decimalSub} from '../decimal';
import {buildGated,countWithheld} from '../route';
import type {Handler} from '../route';
import type {EvidenceDto,FilingSummary,WithheldCounts,WithheldReason} from '../types';

export const FACTS_PARAMS=['concept','periodStart','periodEnd','unit','asOf'] as const;
const CONCEPTS=new Set(CONCEPT_IDS);
const UNIT_RE=/^[A-Za-z0-9_.:\/-]{1,32}$/;
interface SeriesBase{factId:string;availableDate:string;filingId:string;disclosureSeq:number|null;isCurrent:boolean|null;isRevision:boolean|null;sourceConcept:string;mappingVersion:string;mappingGen:number;unit:string}
export type SeriesEntry=(SeriesBase&{kind:'fact';value:string;rawHash:string;runId:string;unitRule:string|null;delta:string|null;relChange:string|null})|(SeriesBase&{kind:'withheld';reason:WithheldReason});
export interface FactSeriesDto{
 issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:'US'|'CN';asOf:string;mappingGen:number;stateRev:number;truncated:boolean;history:true;
 concept:string;periodStart:string;periodEnd:string;unit:string;otherUnits:string[];series:SeriesEntry[];
 /** Same natural key in other units (ascending, delta/relChange always null); feeds the drawer's other-units table. */
 otherUnitSeries:SeriesEntry[];
 filings:Record<string,FilingSummary>;evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;withheld:WithheldCounts;
}
const cmp=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
export const factsHandler:Handler=async(ctx)=>{
 const {params:p,issuer,deps,asOf}=ctx;
 const concept=p.get('concept');if(!concept||!CONCEPTS.has(concept))throw new QueryError('concept');
 const periodStart=dateParam(p,'periodStart');if(!periodStart)throw new QueryError('periodStart');
 const periodEnd=dateParam(p,'periodEnd');if(!periodEnd)throw new QueryError('periodEnd');
 const unit=p.get('unit');if(!unit||!UNIT_RE.test(unit))throw new QueryError('unit');
 const snap=await deps.snapshot(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{concepts:[concept],asOf,from:periodEnd,to:periodEnd,history:true});
 const head={issuerId:issuer.issuerId,ticker:issuer.ticker,market:issuer.market,asOf,mappingGen:MAPPING_GEN,stateRev:snap.stateRev,truncated:snap.truncated,history:true as const,concept,periodStart,periodEnd,unit};
 if(snap.truncated){const body:FactSeriesDto={...head,otherUnits:[],series:[],otherUnitSeries:[],filings:{},evidence:{},withheld:{evidenceIncomplete:0,citationPending:0}};return {body,empty:true};}
 const sameKey=(r:FactRow)=>r.concept===concept&&r.consolidation==='consolidated'&&(r.period_start??r.period_end)===periodStart&&r.period_end===periodEnd;
 const seqOrder=(a:FactRow,b:FactRow)=>(a.disclosure_seq??0)-(b.disclosure_seq??0)||cmp(a.available_date,b.available_date)||cmp(a.created_at,b.created_at)||cmp(a.fact_id,b.fact_id);
 const series=snap.rows.filter(r=>sameKey(r)&&r.unit===unit).sort(seqOrder);
 const others=snap.rows.filter(r=>sameKey(r)&&r.unit!==unit).sort((a,b)=>cmp(a.unit,b.unit)||seqOrder(a,b));
 const otherUnits=[...new Set(others.map(r=>r.unit))].sort(cmp);
 const g=await buildGated(ctx,[...series,...others].map(r=>r.fact_id),[...series,...others],snap.filings);
 const baseOf=(r:FactRow):SeriesBase=>({factId:r.fact_id,availableDate:r.available_date,filingId:r.filing_id,disclosureSeq:r.disclosure_seq??null,isCurrent:r.is_current??null,isRevision:r.is_revision??null,sourceConcept:r.source_concept,mappingVersion:r.mapping_version,mappingGen:r.mapping_gen,unit:r.unit});
 const entryOf=(r:FactRow,before:FactRow|null):SeriesEntry=>{
  const reason=g.reasonOf(r.fact_id);
  if(reason)return {...baseOf(r),kind:'withheld',reason};
  return {...baseOf(r),kind:'fact',value:r.value_text,rawHash:r.raw_hash,runId:r.run_id,unitRule:g.evidence[r.fact_id]?.unitRule??null,
   delta:before?decimalSub(r.value_text,before.value_text):null,relChange:before?decimalRelChange(before.value_text,r.value_text):null};
 };
 let prev:FactRow|null=null;
 const entries:SeriesEntry[]=series.map(r=>{const e=entryOf(r,prev);prev=e.kind==='fact'?r:null;return e;});
 const otherUnitSeries:SeriesEntry[]=others.map(r=>entryOf(r,null));
 const used=new Set([...series,...others].map(r=>r.filing_id));
 const body:FactSeriesDto={...head,otherUnits,series:entries,otherUnitSeries,filings:Object.fromEntries(snap.filings.filter(f=>used.has(f.filingId)).map(f=>[f.filingId,f])),evidence:g.evidence,withheld:countWithheld([...entries,...otherUnitSeries])};
 return {body,empty:entries.length===0};
};
```

**指挥决定：**
- overview 无 `asOf`：一次 `snapshot(concepts=DERIVE_CONCEPTS[market], history:true)` 供速览与 `latestFiling`，事件读物化表（`eventsOfIssuer limit 3`）；有 `asOf`：一次 `snapshot(concepts=null, history:true)` 供速览、`latestFiling` 与现算事件（同一信封）。速览期间 = 当前市场头条收入概念（US `revenue`、CN `revenue_operating`）的当前非 INSTANT 事实中 `period_end` 最大者，同 `period_end` 取最长期（12M>9M>6M>3M）；同期同概念多单位 → 该格 `null`（不猜主单位）。
- events 现算模式的游标是本模块自定的 `base64url("<occurredOn>~<eventId>")`，排序与物化一致 `(occurred_on desc, event_id desc)`；物化模式的游标原样交给 `CompanyDb.eventsOfIssuer`（`invalid_read` → 400 `invalid_parameter:cursor`）。
- 事件 payload 的门槛：`headline[k].value`、`from.value`、`to.value` 被替换为 `WithheldCell`；任一侧不合格 → `relChange` 也替换为该侧的 `WithheldCell`；`filing_published` 无财务数值，不过门槛。
- 指标行 DTO 用 `cell: DerivedCell | WithheldCell`（与网格同一种 Cell，前端一套渲染）；`computedAt` 物化行取 `financial_metrics.computed_at`（`based_on_rev` 不等则 `null`），实时行为本次计算时刻。
- admin snapshot：先写审计 `research_audit_log`（action `facts.snapshot.download`，`object_type` 由 `audit()` 取 `facts`，`object_id`=factId，`detail={source,path,sha256}`），审计失败 → 500 不签名（fail closed）。表结构（`20260705000000_research_os_tables.sql:189`）：`id, user_id, actor, action, object_type, object_id uuid, detail jsonb, created_at`，复用 `src/lib/research/store.ts::audit`（经 `ReadDeps.audit`）。

- [ ] **Step 3: 实现 `event-dto.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/company/event-dto.ts
// Public event DTO and its evidence gate (spec §6.1 events, §6.2 inbox, §0 #64): events are read with
// service_role and every value in a payload (period_first_seen headline values, fact_revised from/to
// values and relChange) is replaced by a withheld marker when the referenced fact fails the gate. The
// payload rule is Task 6's gateEventPayload (the only implementation); the gate is Task 6's applyGate
// (evidenceOf + CN pdf.locate per stream here). Shared by the events / overview handlers and the tracking
// inbox (gateEventRows, Task 16), so the company page and the inbox gate identically.
import type {FactRow,Market} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {EventGateDeps} from './deps';
import {applyGate,eventFactIds,gateEventPayload} from './evidence-gate';
import type {Eligibility} from './evidence-gate';
import {filingSummaryOf} from './snapshot-read';
import type {EventInput,EventKind,EventRow,EvidenceDto,EvidenceRecord,FilingSummary,PdfLocator,WithheldCounts} from './types';

export {eventFactIds};
/** One event as every public/tracking response carries it (Task 11–13, 17 render this shape). */
export interface PublicEvent{
 eventId:string;issuerId:string;market:Market;kind:EventKind;naturalKey:string;occurredOn:string;periodEnd:string|null;concept:string|null;filingId:string|null;
 payload:Record<string,unknown>;meta:Record<string,unknown>;firstSeenAt:string|null;payloadChangedAt:string|null;
 filing:{formType:string;url:string|null;documentUrl:string|null;citation:'edgar'|'linked'|'pending'}|null;
}
export interface GateEventItem{e:EventInput|EventRow;eventId:string;issuerId:string;market:Market}
export interface GatedEvents{events:PublicEvent[];evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;withheld:WithheldCounts}
const filingRef=(f:FilingSummary|undefined):PublicEvent['filing']=>f?{formType:f.formType,url:f.url,documentUrl:f.documentUrl,citation:f.citation}:null;
/** Shapes one event; payload values gated with gateEventPayload over `elig` (missing ids → evidence_incomplete). */
export function toPublicEvent(item:GateEventItem,elig:Map<string,Eligibility>,filing:FilingSummary|undefined):PublicEvent{
 const {e}=item;const row=e as Partial<EventRow>;
 return {eventId:item.eventId,issuerId:item.issuerId,market:item.market,kind:e.kind,naturalKey:e.natural_key,occurredOn:e.occurred_on,periodEnd:e.period_end,concept:e.concept,filingId:e.filing_id,
  payload:gateEventPayload(e,elig),meta:e.meta,firstSeenAt:row.first_seen_at??null,payloadChangedAt:row.payload_changed_at??null,filing:filingRef(e.filing_id?filing:undefined)};
}
/**
 * Gates events of any number of (issuer, market) streams; output order = input order. Per stream: fact rows
 * from `known` (same snapshot) else factsByIds (kept only when they belong to the stream and are ok);
 * filings from `filings` else filingsOfIssuer (published only); one evidenceOf; pdf.locate only for CN.
 */
export async function gateEvents(items:GateEventItem[],deps:EventGateDeps,opts:{admin:boolean;known?:readonly FactRow[];filings?:readonly FilingSummary[]}):Promise<GatedEvents>{
 const evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>={};const withheld:WithheldCounts={evidenceIncomplete:0,citationPending:0};
 const elig=new Map<string,Eligibility>();const filingsOf=new Map<string,Map<string,FilingSummary>>();
 const groups=new Map<string,GateEventItem[]>();
 for(const it of items){const k=`${it.issuerId}:${it.market}`;const g=groups.get(k);if(g)g.push(it);else groups.set(k,[it]);}
 for(const [k,group] of groups){
  const {issuerId,market}=group[0];
  const ids=[...new Set(group.flatMap(x=>eventFactIds(x.e)))].sort();
  const facts=new Map<string,FactRow>();
  for(const r of opts.known??[])if(r.issuer_id===issuerId&&r.market===market&&r.status==='ok')facts.set(r.fact_id,r);
  const missing=ids.filter(id=>!facts.has(id));
  if(missing.length>0)for(const r of await deps.facts.factsByIds(missing))if(r.issuer_id===issuerId&&r.market===market&&r.status==='ok')facts.set(r.fact_id,r);
  const filings=new Map<string,FilingSummary>((opts.filings??[]).map(f=>[f.filingId,f]));
  if(group.some(x=>x.e.filing_id!==null&&!filings.has(x.e.filing_id))||[...facts.values()].some(r=>!filings.has(r.filing_id)))
   for(const f of await deps.facts.filingsOfIssuer(issuerId,market,{}))if(f.mapping_gen>0&&!filings.has(f.filing_id))filings.set(f.filing_id,filingSummaryOf(f,0));
  filingsOf.set(k,filings);
  const present=ids.filter(id=>facts.has(id));
  const [records,pdf]=present.length>0
   ?await Promise.all([deps.company.evidenceOf(present),market==='CN'?deps.pdf.locate(issuerId,market,present):Promise.resolve(new Map<string,PdfLocator>())])
   :[new Map<string,EvidenceRecord>(),new Map<string,PdfLocator>()];
  const g=applyGate({factIds:ids,facts,filings,records,pdf,market,admin:opts.admin});
  for(const [id,e] of g.eligibility)elig.set(id,e);
  Object.assign(evidence,g.evidence);
  withheld.evidenceIncomplete+=g.withheld.evidenceIncomplete;withheld.citationPending+=g.withheld.citationPending;
 }
 const events=items.map(it=>toPublicEvent(it,elig,it.e.filing_id?filingsOf.get(`${it.issuerId}:${it.market}`)?.get(it.e.filing_id):undefined));
 return {events,evidence,withheld};
}
/** Materialized rows (any issuers, e.g. the tracking inbox) → gated PublicEvents, order kept. */
export const gateEventRows=(rows:EventRow[],deps:EventGateDeps,opts:{admin:boolean}):Promise<GatedEvents>=>
 gateEvents(rows.map(r=>({e:r,eventId:r.event_id,issuerId:r.issuer_id,market:r.market})),deps,opts);
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 实现 events 处理器与路由壳**

```ts
// src/lib/company/handlers/events.ts
// GET /api/companies/[ticker]/events (spec §6.1, §7.2, §0 #64). Without asOf: materialized issuer_events
// (retired_at is null) read server-side with service_role, keyset paged by CompanyDb. With asOf: one
// company_read_snapshot(concepts null, history:true) → deriveIssuerEvents(cutoff=asOf), no firstSeenAt,
// computed 'live', own keyset over (occurred_on desc, event_id asc) — the order Task 3 eventsOfIssuer pages
// the materialized table; truncated → 400 replay_truncated. Payload values pass the shared event gate
// (event-dto.ts gateEvents, the same function the tracking inbox uses) in both modes.
import {QueryError,dateParam,intParam,listParam} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import type {FactRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {eventIdOf} from '../canonical';
import {gateEvents} from '../event-dto';
import type {PublicEvent} from '../event-dto';
import {deriveIssuerEvents} from '../events';
import {RouteError} from '../route';
import type {Handler} from '../route';
import {CompanyDbError,EVENT_KINDS} from '../types';
import type {EventInput,EventKind,EventRow,EvidenceDto,FilingSummary,WithheldCounts} from '../types';

export const EVENTS_PARAMS=['since','until','kinds','cursor','limit','asOf'] as const;
const KINDS=new Set<string>(EVENT_KINDS);
const CURSOR_RE=/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}$/;
export interface EventsDto{issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:'US'|'CN';asOf:string|null;computed:'materialized'|'live';stateRev:number|null;rows:PublicEvent[];nextCursor:string|null;evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;withheld:WithheldCounts}
const enc=(occ:string,id:string)=>Buffer.from(`${occ}~${id}`,'utf8').toString('base64url');
function dec(c:string):{occ:string;id:string}{
 const s=Buffer.from(c,'base64url').toString('utf8');const m=/^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})~([0-9a-f]{64})$/.exec(s);
 if(!m)throw new QueryError('cursor');return {occ:m[1],id:m[2]};
}
export interface LiveEvent{input:EventInput;eventId:string}
/** Live events in materialized order, filtered; `after` is a decoded keyset position. */
export function pageLive(all:LiveEvent[],f:{since?:string;until?:string;kinds?:string[];cursor?:string;limit:number}):{rows:LiveEvent[];nextCursor:string|null}{
 const after=f.cursor?dec(f.cursor):null;
 const xs=all.filter(e=>(!f.since||e.input.occurred_on>=f.since)&&(!f.until||e.input.occurred_on<=f.until)&&(!f.kinds||f.kinds.includes(e.input.kind)))
  .sort((a,b)=>a.input.occurred_on<b.input.occurred_on?1:a.input.occurred_on>b.input.occurred_on?-1:a.eventId<b.eventId?-1:a.eventId>b.eventId?1:0)
  .filter(e=>!after||e.input.occurred_on<after.occ||(e.input.occurred_on===after.occ&&e.eventId>after.id));
 const rows=xs.slice(0,f.limit);
 return {rows,nextCursor:xs.length>f.limit?enc(rows[rows.length-1].input.occurred_on,rows[rows.length-1].eventId):null};
}
export const eventsHandler:Handler=async(ctx)=>{
 const {params:p,issuer,deps,asOf}=ctx;
 const since=dateParam(p,'since'),until=dateParam(p,'until');
 const kinds=listParam(p,'kinds',KINDS,KINDS.size) as EventKind[]|undefined;
 const limit=intParam(p,'limit',50,200);
 const cursor=p.get('cursor');if(cursor!==undefined&&!CURSOR_RE.test(cursor))throw new QueryError('cursor');
 let items:{e:EventInput|EventRow;eventId:string}[],nextCursor:string|null,known:FactRow[]=[],filings:FilingSummary[]=[],stateRev:number|null=null;
 if(!ctx.asOfGiven){
  let page:{rows:EventRow[];nextCursor:string|null};
  try{page=await deps.company.eventsOfIssuer(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{since,until,kinds,cursor:cursor??null,limit});}
  catch(e){if(e instanceof CompanyDbError&&e.code==='invalid_read')throw new QueryError('cursor');throw e;}
  items=page.rows.map(r=>({e:r,eventId:r.event_id}));nextCursor=page.nextCursor;
 }else{
  const snap=await deps.snapshot(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{concepts:null,asOf,history:true});
  if(snap.truncated)throw new RouteError('replay_truncated',400,'replay read truncated');
  const all=deriveIssuerEvents({rows:snap.rows,filings:snap.filings,cutoff:asOf}).map(e=>({input:e,eventId:eventIdOf(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,e.kind,e.natural_key)}));
  const page=pageLive(all,{since,until,kinds,cursor,limit});
  items=page.rows.map(x=>({e:x.input,eventId:x.eventId}));nextCursor=page.nextCursor;known=snap.rows;filings=snap.filings;stateRev=snap.stateRev;
 }
 const gated=await gateEvents(items.map(x=>({e:x.e,eventId:x.eventId,issuerId:issuer.issuerId,market:issuer.market})),deps,{admin:ctx.admin,known,filings});
 const rows=gated.events;
 const body:EventsDto={issuerId:issuer.issuerId,ticker:issuer.ticker,market:issuer.market,asOf:ctx.asOfGiven?asOf:null,computed:ctx.asOfGiven?'live':'materialized',stateRev,rows,nextCursor,evidence:gated.evidence,withheld:gated.withheld};
 return {body,empty:rows.length===0};
};
```
