```ts
// src/lib/company/handlers/metrics.ts
// GET /api/companies/[ticker]/metrics — the page's metrics proxy (spec §5.4, §6.1, §0 #67). Without asOf:
// fact_state_rev → metricsOfIssuer → fact_state_rev, every row's based_on_rev must equal both reads,
// otherwise (or metrics_unstable) {metrics: [], stale: true} with STALE_CACHE_CONTROL; current rows use
// FRESH_METRICS_CACHE_CONTROL (both from the landed /api/facts/[ticker]/metrics). computedAt of
// materialized rows is selected from financial_metrics (MetricRow lacks it). With asOf: live deriveMetrics
// on one history snapshot (computedAtKind 'live'). Any ineligible input fact withholds the whole row.
import {MAPPING_GEN} from '@/lib/facts/concepts';
import {DERIVE_CONCEPTS,FORMULA_VERSION,deriveMetrics,metricNames} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import {FRESH_METRICS_CACHE_CONTROL,QueryError,STALE_CACHE_CONTROL,dateParam,intParam,listParam} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {FactsDbError} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {FactRow,MetricDuration,MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {metricKey} from '../metrics-computed-at';
import {buildGated,countWithheld,gateCell} from '../route';
import type {Handler} from '../route';
import {derivedCellOf} from '../statements-grid';
import type {DerivedCell,EvidenceDto,FilingSummary,WithheldCell,WithheldCounts} from '../types';

// 计划第 3 轮审计 R5: company-only `periods` (8|20|40) keeps ALL metric rows of the newest N period keys;
// the landed row `limit` applies only when `periods` is absent (it would otherwise eat later metric names).
export const METRICS_PARAMS=['metrics','from','to','asOf','limit','periods'] as const;
const METRIC_PERIOD_CHOICES=new Set(['8','20','40']);
// 计划第 3 轮审计 R6: inputUnit / basis are part of a landed metric's identity; top-level so a withheld cell
// still tells same-period alternatives (USD vs EUR FCF) apart.
export interface MetricDto{metric:string;periodStart:string;periodEnd:string;duration:MetricDuration;inputUnit:string;basis:string;basedOnRev:number;computedAt:string|null;computedAtKind:'materialized'|'live';cell:DerivedCell|WithheldCell}
export interface MetricsDto{issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:'US'|'CN';asOf:string|null;mappingGen:number;formulaVersion:string;truncated:boolean;stale:boolean;metrics:MetricDto[];evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;withheld:WithheldCounts}
export const metricsHandler:Handler=async(ctx)=>{
 const {params:p,issuer,deps,asOf}=ctx;
 const from=dateParam(p,'from'),to=dateParam(p,'to'),limit=intParam(p,'limit',200,1000);
 const periodsRaw=p.get('periods');
 if(periodsRaw!==undefined&&!METRIC_PERIOD_CHOICES.has(periodsRaw))throw new QueryError('periods');
 const names=metricNames(issuer.market);
 const wanted=listParam(p,'metrics',new Set(names),names.length);
 let rows:MetricRow[]=[],truncated=false,stale=false,known:FactRow[]=[],filings:FilingSummary[]=[];
 let computedAt:(m:MetricRow)=>string|null;
 if(!ctx.asOfGiven){
  const rev=await deps.stateRev(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market);
  try{rows=await deps.facts.metricsOfIssuer(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,FORMULA_VERSION);}
  catch(e){if(e instanceof FactsDbError&&e.message==='metrics_unstable'){rows=[];stale=true;}else throw e;}
  const after=stale?rev:await deps.stateRev(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market);   // always re-read, even for an empty result (§0 #67)
  if(stale||after!==rev||rows.some(m=>m.based_on_rev!==rev)){rows=[];stale=true;}
  const at=rows.length>0?await deps.metricsComputedAt(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,FORMULA_VERSION):new Map();
  computedAt=m=>{const x=at.get(metricKey(m));return x&&x.basedOnRev===m.based_on_rev?x.computedAt:null;};
 }else{
  const snap=await deps.snapshot(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{concepts:[...DERIVE_CONCEPTS[issuer.market]],asOf,history:true});
  truncated=snap.truncated;known=snap.rows;filings=snap.filings;
  rows=truncated?[]:deriveMetrics(snap.rows,{market:issuer.market,asOf,basedOnRev:snap.stateRev});
  const at=ctx.now.toISOString();computedAt=()=>at;
 }
 const set=wanted?new Set(wanted):null;
 rows=rows.filter(m=>(!set||set.has(m.metric))&&(from===undefined||m.period_end>=from)&&(to===undefined||m.period_end<=to));
 if(periodsRaw!==undefined){
  // Same column key and order as the UI (metrics-model.ts): periodEnd desc, then key asc; keep every row of those keys.
  const keyOf=(m:MetricRow)=>`${m.period_start}:${m.period_end}:${m.duration}`;
  const cols=new Map<string,string>();for(const m of rows)cols.set(keyOf(m),m.period_end);
  const keep=new Set([...cols.entries()].sort((a,b)=>b[1].localeCompare(a[1])||a[0].localeCompare(b[0])).slice(0,Number(periodsRaw)).map(([k])=>k));
  rows=rows.filter(m=>keep.has(keyOf(m)));
 }else rows=rows.slice(0,limit);
 const g=await buildGated(ctx,rows.flatMap(m=>m.inputs.map(i=>i.fact_id)),known,filings);
 const metrics:MetricDto[]=rows.map(m=>({metric:m.metric,periodStart:m.period_start,periodEnd:m.period_end,duration:m.duration,inputUnit:m.input_unit,basis:m.basis,basedOnRev:m.based_on_rev,computedAt:computedAt(m),computedAtKind:ctx.asOfGiven?'live':'materialized',cell:gateCell(derivedCellOf(m),g) as DerivedCell|WithheldCell}));
 const body:MetricsDto={issuerId:issuer.issuerId,ticker:issuer.ticker,market:issuer.market,asOf:ctx.asOfGiven?asOf:null,mappingGen:MAPPING_GEN,formulaVersion:FORMULA_VERSION,truncated,stale,metrics,evidence:g.evidence,withheld:countWithheld(metrics.map(x=>x.cell))};
 const cacheControl=stale?STALE_CACHE_CONTROL:!ctx.asOfGiven&&metrics.length>0?FRESH_METRICS_CACHE_CONTROL:undefined;
 return {body,empty:metrics.length===0||truncated,cacheControl};
};
```

路由壳（公共 / admin）照 events 的两个壳写，`tag` 分别为 `companies/metrics`、`admin/companies/metrics`，`params:METRICS_PARAMS,handler:metricsHandler`，文件头注释写 "Metrics proxy (spec §6.1, §0 #67)"。

- [ ] **Step 9: 实现 overview 处理器与路由壳**

```ts
// src/lib/company/handlers/overview.ts
// GET /api/companies/[ticker]/overview (spec §5.8, §5.10, §6.1). One snapshot envelope feeds the latest
// block (current facts of the headline concepts at the latest period + gross_margin/revenue_yoy derived
// on the SAME envelope, never the materialized table) and latestFiling (that snapshot's filings).
// Without asOf the recent events are the materialized ones (≤ 3); with asOf the envelope reads every
// concept and the events are derived live from it. All values gated.
import {resolveIssuer} from '@/lib/entities/resolve';
import type {ResolvedIssuer} from '@/lib/entities/resolve';
import {DERIVE_CONCEPTS,deriveMetrics} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import type {FactRow,Market,MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {eventIdOf} from '../canonical';
import {eventFactIds,toPublicEvent} from '../event-dto';
import type {PublicEvent} from '../event-dto';
import {deriveIssuerEvents} from '../events';
import {buildGated,cellFactIds,countWithheld,gateCell} from '../route';
import type {Handler} from '../route';
import {derivedCellOf,factCellOf,periodKeyOf} from '../statements-grid';
import type {Cell,CoverageRow,EventInput,EventRow,EvidenceDto,FilingSummary,WithheldCounts} from '../types';

export const OVERVIEW_PARAMS=['asOf'] as const;
export const HEADLINE:Record<Market,readonly string[]>={US:['revenue','net_income_parent','operating_cash_flow'],CN:['revenue_operating','net_income_parent','operating_cash_flow']};
const DERIVED=['gross_margin','revenue_yoy'] as const;
const DUR_RANK:Record<string,number>={'12M':4,'9M':3,'6M':2,'3M':1};
export interface LatestBlock{periodKey:string|null;facts:Record<string,Cell>;derived:Record<string,Cell>;stateRev:number;truncated:boolean}
export interface OverviewDto{issuer:ResolvedIssuer|null;ticker:string;market:Market;asOf:string;coverage:CoverageRow|null;coverageOtherMarket:CoverageRow|null;latestFiling:FilingSummary|null;latest:LatestBlock|null;recentEvents:PublicEvent[];eventsComputed:'materialized'|'live';evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;withheld:WithheldCounts}

/** Ungated latest block of one envelope (pure; exported for the packet). */
export function latestBlock(rows:FactRow[],market:Market,asOf:string,stateRev:number):LatestBlock|null{
 const cur=rows.filter(r=>r.is_current===true&&r.consolidation==='consolidated'&&r.duration!=='INSTANT'&&r.period_start!==null);
 const anchors=cur.filter(r=>r.concept===HEADLINE[market][0]);
 if(anchors.length===0)return null;
 const a=anchors.reduce((best,r)=>r.period_end>best.period_end||(r.period_end===best.period_end&&(DUR_RANK[r.duration]??0)>(DUR_RANK[best.duration]??0))?r:best);
 const same=(r:{period_start:string|null;period_end:string;duration:string})=>r.period_start===a.period_start&&r.period_end===a.period_end&&r.duration===a.duration;
 const facts:Record<string,Cell>={};
 for(const c of HEADLINE[market]){const xs=cur.filter(r=>r.concept===c&&same(r));facts[c]=xs.length===1?factCellOf(xs[0],false):null;}
 const metrics:MetricRow[]=deriveMetrics(rows,{market,asOf,basedOnRev:stateRev});
 const derived:Record<string,Cell>={};
 for(const name of DERIVED){const xs=metrics.filter(m=>m.metric===name&&same(m));derived[name]=xs.length===1?derivedCellOf(xs[0]):null;}
 return {periodKey:periodKeyOf(a),facts,derived,stateRev,truncated:false};
}
export const overviewHandler:Handler=async(ctx)=>{
 const {issuer,deps,asOf}=ctx;const live=ctx.asOfGiven;
 const [snap,resolved,coverage]=await Promise.all([
  deps.snapshot(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{concepts:live?null:[...DERIVE_CONCEPTS[issuer.market]],asOf,history:true}),
  resolveIssuer(deps.tables,{ticker:issuer.ticker},{today:ctx.today}),
  deps.publicCompany.coverageOf([issuer.issuerId]),
 ]);
 const latestFiling=[...snap.filings].sort((x,y)=>x.availableDate<y.availableDate?1:x.availableDate>y.availableDate?-1:x.filingId<y.filingId?1:-1)[0]??null;
 const latest:LatestBlock|null=snap.truncated?{periodKey:null,facts:{},derived:{},stateRev:snap.stateRev,truncated:true}:latestBlock(snap.rows,issuer.market,asOf,snap.stateRev);
 let events:{e:EventInput|EventRow;eventId:string}[]=[];
 if(live){
  if(!snap.truncated)events=deriveIssuerEvents({rows:snap.rows,filings:snap.filings,cutoff:asOf})
   .map(e=>({e,eventId:eventIdOf(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,e.kind,e.natural_key)}))
   .sort((x,y)=>x.e.occurred_on<y.e.occurred_on?1:x.e.occurred_on>y.e.occurred_on?-1:x.eventId<y.eventId?-1:1).slice(0,3);
 }else events=(await deps.company.eventsOfIssuer(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{limit:3})).rows.map(r=>({e:r,eventId:r.event_id}));
 const cells=latest?[...Object.values(latest.facts),...Object.values(latest.derived)]:[];
 const g=await buildGated(ctx,[...cells.flatMap(cellFactIds),...events.flatMap(x=>eventFactIds(x.e))],snap.rows,snap.filings);
 const gatedLatest=latest&&{...latest,facts:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(latest.facts).map(([k,c])=>[k,gateCell(c,g)])),derived:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(latest.derived).map(([k,c])=>[k,gateCell(c,g)]))};
 const recentEvents=events.map(x=>toPublicEvent({e:x.e,eventId:x.eventId,issuerId:issuer.issuerId,market:issuer.market},g.eligibility,x.e.filing_id?g.filings.get(x.e.filing_id):undefined));
 const eventIds=[...new Set(events.flatMap(x=>eventFactIds(x.e)))];
 const body:OverviewDto={issuer:resolved,ticker:issuer.ticker,market:issuer.market,asOf,
  coverage:coverage.find(c=>c.market===issuer.market)??null,coverageOtherMarket:coverage.find(c=>c.market!==issuer.market)??null,
  latestFiling,latest:gatedLatest,recentEvents,eventsComputed:live?'live':'materialized',evidence:g.evidence,
  withheld:countWithheld([...(gatedLatest?[...Object.values(gatedLatest.facts),...Object.values(gatedLatest.derived)]:[]),...eventIds.map(id=>g.withheld(id))])};
 return {body,empty:!latest&&recentEvents.length===0&&coverage.length===0};
};
```

```ts
// src/app/api/companies/freshness/route.ts
// Dataset freshness for the company pages (spec §6.1): dq_freshness is service_role only, so the server
// reads it with the service client, recomputes status at `now` (freshnessOf — a stopped producer turns
// stale), and returns ONLY {dataset, status, lastOkAt, lastAttemptAt} for the three datasets.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {productionReadDeps} from '@/lib/company/deps';
import {freshnessOf} from '@/lib/dq/freshness';
import {failureResponse} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const DATASETS=['facts.us','facts.cn','company.events'] as const;
export async function GET(){
 try{
  const rows=await freshnessOf(productionReadDeps().freshnessTables(),new Date());
  const by=new Map(rows.map(r=>[String(r.dataset),r]));
  const datasets=DATASETS.map(d=>{const r=by.get(d);return {dataset:d,status:r?r.status:'missing',lastOkAt:(r?.last_ok_at as string|null|undefined)??null,lastAttemptAt:(r?.last_attempt_at as string|null|undefined)??null};});
  return NextResponse.json({datasets},{headers:{'Cache-Control':'public, max-age=60'}});
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'companies/freshness','freshness read failed');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/companies/snapshot/route.ts
// Stable public download of an EDGAR snapshot by fact id (spec §0.1 item 2'', §0 #62, §6.4): the evidence
// index gives the exact Storage path; only source 'edgar' (US public data) is served, by a 60 s signed URL
// minted on EVERY call and a 302 with no-store, so cacheable JSON only ever embeds this stable URL.
// Tushare → 403 not_redistributable; no index row → 404.
import {productionReadDeps} from '@/lib/company/deps';
import {UUID_RE,errorResponse,failureResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const SIGNED_URL_SECONDS=60;
export async function GET(req:Request){
 let fact:string|undefined;
 try{fact=readParams(new URL(req.url),['fact']).get('fact');}catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return r;throw e;}
 if(!fact||!UUID_RE.test(fact))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:fact','invalid fact id',400);
 try{
  const deps=productionReadDeps();
  const rec=(await deps.company.evidenceOf([fact])).get(fact);
  if(!rec)return errorResponse('not_found','no verified snapshot for fact',404);
  if(rec.source!=='edgar')return errorResponse('not_redistributable','source terms forbid redistribution',403);
  const url=await deps.signSnapshot(rec.snapshot_path,SIGNED_URL_SECONDS);
  return new Response(null,{status:302,headers:{Location:url,'Cache-Control':'no-store'}});
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'companies/snapshot','snapshot download failed');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/admin/companies/snapshot/route.ts
// Admin snapshot download (spec §6.4): any source (incl. Tushare), requireAdminUser, audited in
// research_audit_log ('facts.snapshot.download') BEFORE a URL is minted (fail closed), private, no-store.
import {productionReadDeps} from '@/lib/company/deps';
import {adminGate,privateResponse} from '@/lib/company/route';
import {UUID_RE,errorResponse,failureResponse,paramErrorResponse,readParams} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export async function GET(req:Request){
 const user=await adminGate();if(user instanceof Response)return privateResponse(user);
 let fact:string|undefined;
 try{fact=readParams(new URL(req.url),['fact']).get('fact');}catch(e){const r=paramErrorResponse(e);if(r)return privateResponse(r);throw e;}
 if(!fact||!UUID_RE.test(fact))return privateResponse(errorResponse('invalid_parameter:fact','invalid fact id',400));
 try{
  const deps=productionReadDeps();
  const rec=(await deps.company.evidenceOf([fact])).get(fact);
  if(!rec)return privateResponse(errorResponse('not_found','no verified snapshot for fact',404));
  await deps.audit(user,'facts.snapshot.download',fact,{source:rec.source,path:rec.snapshot_path,sha256:rec.snapshot_sha256});
  const url=await deps.signSnapshot(rec.snapshot_path,60);
  return privateResponse(new Response(null,{status:302,headers:{Location:url}}));
 }catch(e){return privateResponse(failureResponse(e,'admin/companies/snapshot','snapshot download failed'));}
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/handlers/filings.ts
// GET /api/companies/[ticker]/filings?asOf= (spec §5.5, §0.1 item 3; moved here from Task 11 at integration):
// every published filing (mapping_gen > 0) with available_date <= asOf as FilingSummary (fiscal period,
// citation, linkAttempts, factCount) from ONE company_read_snapshot statement — its filings sub-select is
// independent of the facts limit, so the facts part is one concept with limit 1. No financial values → no
// evidence gate; the admin twin has the same body (private, no-store). Newest available_date first.
import type {Handler} from '../route';
import type {FilingSummary} from '../types';

export const FILINGS_PARAMS=['asOf'] as const;
export interface FilingsDto{issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:'US'|'CN';asOf:string|null;stateRev:number;filings:FilingSummary[]}
export const filingsHandler:Handler=async(ctx)=>{
 const {issuer,deps,asOf}=ctx;
 const snap=await deps.snapshot(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{concepts:['revenue'],asOf,history:false,limit:1});
 const filings=[...snap.filings].sort((a,b)=>a.availableDate<b.availableDate?1:a.availableDate>b.availableDate?-1:a.filingId<b.filingId?1:a.filingId>b.filingId?-1:0);
 const body:FilingsDto={issuerId:issuer.issuerId,ticker:issuer.ticker,market:issuer.market,asOf:ctx.asOfGiven?asOf:null,stateRev:snap.stateRev,filings};
 return {body,empty:filings.length===0};
};
```

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/company/dcf-seed.ts`、`src/lib/company/dcf-seed.test.ts`、`src/lib/company/dcf-seed.test-rows.ts`（测试行构造器，非 `.test.ts`）
- Create: `src/lib/dcf/bridge.ts`、`src/lib/dcf/bridge.test.ts`
- Modify (rewrite): `src/lib/dcf/assemble.ts`、`src/lib/dcf/assemble.test.ts`
- Modify (rewrite): `src/app/api/dcf/[ticker]/route.ts`
- Create: `src/app/api/dcf/[ticker]/route.test.ts`
- Modify (rewrite): `src/components/DcfStudio.tsx`
- Modify: `messages/zh/market.json`、`messages/en/market.json`（`dcf` 下追加键）

**指挥决定：**
- `/api/dcf/[ticker]` 增加 `GET`：只返回种子与股权桥（无 LLM、无引擎），供 `DcfStudio` 挂载时展示"股权桥输入"面板——这不是"挂载即运行"（§5.4 禁止的是挂载即估值）。`POST` 才运行；股权桥不全时 `POST` 返回 200 `{status:'unavailable', code:'dcf_bridge_missing'}` 且**不调用 LLM**（省 token，结果相同）。两者 `Cache-Control: no-store`。
- 种子读取：一次 `snapshot(concepts=SEED_CONCEPTS[market], asOf=今天, from=今天−1100 天, history:true)`；`from` 只为限制行数（派生只需同期与同日 instant），`deriveMetrics` 在同一信封上算 `gross_margin` 与 `borrowings_total`。
- 股数日期：取与最近 12M 收入**同一 `period_end`** 的 instant `shares_outstanding`（§9.1 字面），没有 → `period_mismatch`；该日有多个当前事实（多单位/多类别）→ `multi_class_shares`。
- 叶子不合格的原因码沿用门槛原因（`evidence_incomplete` 或 `citation_pending`），比单一 `evidence_incomplete` 更可读；两者都使股权桥转为"需用户确认"。
- `currency/currencyUnit` 不接受用户或 LLM 覆盖（由事实单位或市场决定）；`nonRecurring` 本次不接受任何来源（引擎缺省 0）。
- `warnings` 改为结构化 `{code, detail?}[]`，UI 按 `market.dcf.warnings.<code>` 翻译。

```ts
   expect(seedFromFacts(snap,{shareClass,openSecuritiesInMarket:1},o).missing).toEqual([{field:'sharesDiluted',reason:'share_basis_unverified'}]);
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 实现 `dcf-seed.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/company/dcf-seed.ts
// DCF fact seed (spec §9.1, §0 #65). Pure: ONE company_read_snapshot envelope (history:true) and the
// current security. Leaves: revenueLines[0].baseRevenue ← latest 12M revenue (CN revenue_operating);
// grossMarginPct ← gross_margin derived on the SAME envelope for that period; sharesDiluted ← the single
// current instant shares_outstanding at the revenue period_end, only for share_class common|A and one open
// security in the market; netDebt ← borrowings_total (derived, same envelope) − cash (US, basis us_standard)
// or − monetary_funds (CN, basis cn_borrowings_less_monetary_funds_incl_restricted), same date and unit.
// Money and shares use the SAME divisor (USD 1e6 百万, CNY 1e8 亿) so equity / shares is per-share currency.
// Every fact behind a leaf must pass the evidence gate, else the leaf is missing with the gate's reason.
import {deriveMetrics} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import type {FactRow,Market,MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {DcfSeedResponse,SeedBridgeField} from '@/lib/dcf/bridge';
import {decimalSub,formatDecimalText} from './decimal';
import {applyGate} from './evidence-gate';
import type {EvidenceDto,EvidenceRecord,PdfLocator,ReadSnapshotResult,WithheldReason} from './types';

export const SEED_CONCEPTS:Record<Market,readonly string[]>={
 US:['revenue','gross_profit','cost_of_revenue','shares_outstanding','cash','short_term_borrowings','long_term_borrowings'],
 CN:['revenue_operating','cost_of_revenue','shares_outstanding','monetary_funds','short_term_borrowings','long_term_borrowings','bonds_payable'],
};
const UNITS:Record<string,{currencyUnit:string;divisor:string}>={USD:{currencyUnit:'百万',divisor:'1000000'},CNY:{currencyUnit:'亿',divisor:'100000000'}};
export const SEED_FIELDS=['revenueLines[0].baseRevenue','grossMarginPct','sharesDiluted','netDebt'] as const;
export type SeedField=typeof SEED_FIELDS[number];
export type SeedMissingReason='no_fact'|'period_mismatch'|'unit_mismatch'|'share_basis_unverified'|'multi_class_shares'|WithheldReason;
export interface SeedLeaf{source:'fact';value:number;factIds:string[];metric?:string;divisor:string;basis:string;periodEnd:string;unit:string}
export interface SeedResult{
 seed:{baseRevenue?:number;grossMarginPct?:number;sharesDiluted?:number;netDebt?:number};
 provenance:Partial<Record<SeedField,SeedLeaf>>;missing:{field:SeedField;reason:SeedMissingReason}[];
 meta:{currency:string|null;currencyUnit:string|null;divisor:string|null};evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;
}
export interface SeedSecurity{shareClass:string;openSecuritiesInMarket:number}
interface Cand{field:SeedField;factIds:string[];value:()=>number;metric?:string;basis:string;divisor:string;unit:string}
const KEY:Record<SeedField,keyof SeedResult['seed']>={'revenueLines[0].baseRevenue':'baseRevenue',grossMarginPct:'grossMarginPct',sharesDiluted:'sharesDiluted',netDebt:'netDebt'};
const scaled=(v:string,divisor:string)=>Number(formatDecimalText(v,BigInt(divisor),6));

export function seedFromFacts(snapshot:ReadSnapshotResult,security:SeedSecurity,opts:{market:Market;asOf:string;evidence:ReadonlyMap<string,EvidenceRecord>;pdf:ReadonlyMap<string,PdfLocator>;admin:boolean}):SeedResult{
 const {market}=opts;
 const out:SeedResult={seed:{},provenance:{},missing:[],meta:{currency:null,currencyUnit:null,divisor:null},evidence:{}};
 const missAll=(reason:SeedMissingReason)=>{for(const f of SEED_FIELDS)out.missing.push({field:f,reason});return out;};
 const rows=snapshot.rows.filter(r=>r.consolidation==='consolidated');
 const cur=rows.filter(r=>r.is_current===true);
 const revC=market==='US'?'revenue':'revenue_operating';
 const revs=cur.filter(r=>r.concept===revC&&r.duration==='12M');
 if(revs.length===0)return missAll('no_fact');
 const end=revs.reduce((m,r)=>r.period_end>m?r.period_end:m,revs[0].period_end);
 const at=revs.filter(r=>r.period_end===end);
 if(at.length!==1)return missAll('unit_mismatch');
 const rev=at[0];const u=UNITS[rev.unit];
 if(!u)return missAll('unit_mismatch');
 out.meta={currency:rev.unit,currencyUnit:u.currencyUnit,divisor:u.divisor};
 const metrics:MetricRow[]=deriveMetrics(rows,{market,asOf:opts.asOf,basedOnRev:snapshot.stateRev});
 const cands:Cand[]=[];const miss=(field:SeedField,reason:SeedMissingReason)=>out.missing.push({field,reason});
 cands.push({field:'revenueLines[0].baseRevenue',factIds:[rev.fact_id],value:()=>scaled(rev.value_text,u.divisor),basis:revC,divisor:u.divisor,unit:rev.unit});
 const gm=metrics.filter(m=>m.metric==='gross_margin'&&m.period_start===rev.period_start&&m.period_end===end&&m.duration==='12M'&&m.input_unit===rev.unit);
 if(gm.length===1)cands.push({field:'grossMarginPct',factIds:gm[0].inputs.map(i=>i.fact_id),value:()=>Number(gm[0].value),metric:'gross_margin',basis:gm[0].basis,divisor:'1',unit:'pure'});
 else miss('grossMarginPct','no_fact');
 // shares: affirmative applicability checks first (§9.1)
 if(!['common','A'].includes(security.shareClass)||security.openSecuritiesInMarket!==1)miss('sharesDiluted','share_basis_unverified');
 else{
  const all=cur.filter(r=>r.concept==='shares_outstanding'&&r.duration==='INSTANT');
  const sh=all.filter(r=>r.period_end===end);
  if(sh.length>1)miss('sharesDiluted','multi_class_shares');
  else if(sh.length===0)miss('sharesDiluted',all.length?'period_mismatch':'no_fact');
  else cands.push({field:'sharesDiluted',factIds:[sh[0].fact_id],value:()=>scaled(sh[0].value_text,u.divisor),basis:'shares_outstanding',divisor:u.divisor,unit:sh[0].unit});
 }
 // net debt: borrowings_total (same envelope) − cash leg, same date and unit
 const cashC=market==='US'?'cash':'monetary_funds';
 const btAll=metrics.filter(m=>m.metric==='borrowings_total');
 const bt=btAll.filter(m=>m.period_end===end&&m.input_unit===rev.unit);
 const cashAll=cur.filter(r=>r.concept===cashC&&r.duration==='INSTANT');
 const cashAtEnd=cashAll.filter(r=>r.period_end===end);
 const cash=cashAtEnd.filter(r=>r.unit===rev.unit);
 if(bt.length!==1)miss('netDebt',btAll.some(m=>m.period_end===end)?'unit_mismatch':btAll.length?'period_mismatch':'no_fact');
 else if(cash.length!==1)miss('netDebt',cashAtEnd.length?'unit_mismatch':cashAll.length?'period_mismatch':'no_fact');
 else cands.push({field:'netDebt',factIds:[...bt[0].inputs.map(i=>i.fact_id),cash[0].fact_id],value:()=>scaled(decimalSub(bt[0].value,cash[0].value_text),u.divisor),metric:'borrowings_total',
  basis:market==='US'?'us_standard':'cn_borrowings_less_monetary_funds_incl_restricted',divisor:u.divisor,unit:rev.unit});
 // one gate over every candidate fact
 const byId=new Map(rows.map(r=>[r.fact_id,r]));
 const ids=[...new Set(cands.flatMap(c=>c.factIds))];
 const facts=ids.map(id=>byId.get(id)).filter((r):r is FactRow=>r!==undefined);
 const g=applyGate({factIds:ids,facts:new Map(facts.map(r=>[r.fact_id,r])),filings:new Map(snapshot.filings.map(f=>[f.filingId,f])),records:new Map(opts.evidence),pdf:new Map(opts.pdf),market,admin:opts.admin});
 const reasonOf=(id:string):WithheldReason|null=>{const e=g.eligibility.get(id);return !byId.has(id)||!e?'evidence_incomplete':e.ok?null:e.reason;};
 for(const c of cands){
  const bad=c.factIds.map(reasonOf).filter((r):r is WithheldReason=>r!==null);
  if(bad.length){miss(c.field,bad.includes('evidence_incomplete')?'evidence_incomplete':bad[0]);continue;}
  const value=c.value();
  if(!Number.isFinite(value)){miss(c.field,'unit_mismatch');continue;}
  out.seed[KEY[c.field]]=value;
  out.provenance[c.field]={source:'fact',value,factIds:c.factIds,...(c.metric?{metric:c.metric}:{}),divisor:c.divisor,basis:c.basis,periodEnd:end,unit:c.unit};
  for(const id of c.factIds)if(g.evidence[id])out.evidence[id]=g.evidence[id];
 }
 out.missing.sort((a,b)=>SEED_FIELDS.indexOf(a.field)-SEED_FIELDS.indexOf(b.field));
 return out;
}

/** GET /api/dcf/[ticker] body: the seed as the equity-bridge panel shows it. */
export function seedResponse(ticker:string,market:Market,s:SeedResult,fallback:{currency:string;currencyUnit:string;divisor:string}):DcfSeedResponse{
 const field=(f:SeedField):SeedBridgeField=>{const p=s.provenance[f];const m=s.missing.find(x=>x.field===f);
  return p?{value:p.value,source:'fact',factIds:p.factIds,basis:p.basis,periodEnd:p.periodEnd,divisor:p.divisor,reason:null}:{value:null,source:null,factIds:[],basis:null,periodEnd:null,divisor:null,reason:m?.reason??'no_fact'};};
 return {status:'seed',ticker,market,
  meta:s.meta.currency?{currency:s.meta.currency,currencyUnit:s.meta.currencyUnit!,divisor:s.meta.divisor!}:fallback,
  bridge:{baseRevenue:field('revenueLines[0].baseRevenue'),sharesDiluted:field('sharesDiluted'),netDebt:field('netDebt')},
  grossMarginPct:{value:s.provenance.grossMarginPct?.value??null,factIds:s.provenance.grossMarginPct?.factIds??[]},
  missing:s.missing,evidence:s.evidence};
}
```

（`formatDecimalText(valueText, divisor:bigint, digits)` 按 Task 7 契约输出无千分位的纯十进制字符串（分组另由 `groupThousands` 做），所以可直接 `Number()`。）

```ts
// src/lib/dcf/bridge.ts
// Client-safe contract of the DCF equity-bridge panel (spec §5.4, §9.1, §0 #65): response types of
// GET/POST /api/dcf/[ticker] and the pure rules the panel uses — a bridge field is `user` when the user
// typed a finite number, else `fact` when the seed has one, else `missing`; Run appears only when all
// three are fact or user; only user-sourced fields are sent as overrides (facts are re-read server-side).
import type {EvidenceDto} from '@/lib/company/types';
import type {DcfResult} from './engine';

export type BridgeKey='baseRevenue'|'sharesDiluted'|'netDebt';
export const BRIDGE_KEYS:readonly BridgeKey[]=['baseRevenue','sharesDiluted','netDebt'];
export const BRIDGE_PATH:Record<BridgeKey,string>={baseRevenue:'revenueLines[0].baseRevenue',sharesDiluted:'sharesDiluted',netDebt:'netDebt'};
export interface SeedBridgeField{value:number|null;source:'fact'|null;factIds:string[];basis:string|null;periodEnd:string|null;divisor:string|null;reason:string|null}
export interface DcfMeta{currency:string;currencyUnit:string;divisor:string}
export interface DcfSeedResponse{status:'seed';ticker:string;market:'US'|'CN';meta:DcfMeta;bridge:Record<BridgeKey,SeedBridgeField>;grossMarginPct:{value:number|null;factIds:string[]};missing:{field:string;reason:string}[];evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>}
export interface DcfRunResponse{
 status:'ok'|'unavailable';code?:'dcf_bridge_missing';ticker:string;market:'US'|'CN';meta:DcfMeta;
 assumptions:Record<string,unknown>|null;provenance:Record<string,'fact'|'llm'|'default'|'user'>;missing:{field:string;reason:string}[];
 result:DcfResult|null;warnings:{code:string;detail?:string}[];evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;
}
export interface BridgeField{value:number|null;source:'fact'|'user'|'missing';factIds:string[];basis:string|null;reason:string|null}
export function bridgeFields(seed:DcfSeedResponse,user:Partial<Record<BridgeKey,string>>):Record<BridgeKey,BridgeField>{
 const out={} as Record<BridgeKey,BridgeField>;
 for(const k of BRIDGE_KEYS){
  const raw=user[k]?.trim();const n=raw?Number(raw):NaN;const s=seed.bridge[k];
  if(raw&&Number.isFinite(n))out[k]={value:n,source:'user',factIds:[],basis:null,reason:null};
  else if(s.source==='fact'&&s.value!==null)out[k]={value:s.value,source:'fact',factIds:s.factIds,basis:s.basis,reason:null};
  else out[k]={value:null,source:'missing',factIds:[],basis:null,reason:s.reason};
 }
 return out;
}
export const canRun=(f:Record<BridgeKey,BridgeField>)=>BRIDGE_KEYS.every(k=>f[k].source!=='missing'&&f[k].value!==null&&Number.isFinite(f[k].value));
export function bridgeOverrides(f:Record<BridgeKey,BridgeField>):Record<string,unknown>{
 const o:Record<string,unknown>={};
 if(f.baseRevenue.source==='user')o.revenueLines=[{baseRevenue:f.baseRevenue.value}];
 if(f.sharesDiluted.source==='user')o.sharesDiluted=f.sharesDiluted.value;
 if(f.netDebt.source==='user')o.netDebt=f.netDebt.value;
 return o;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/dcf/bridge.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {bridgeFields,bridgeOverrides,canRun} from './bridge';
import type {DcfSeedResponse,SeedBridgeField} from './bridge';

const fact=(value:number):SeedBridgeField=>({value,source:'fact',factIds:['f'],basis:'b',periodEnd:'2023-09-30',divisor:'1000000',reason:null});
const missing=(reason:string):SeedBridgeField=>({value:null,source:null,factIds:[],basis:null,periodEnd:null,divisor:null,reason});
const seed=(shares:SeedBridgeField):DcfSeedResponse=>({status:'seed',ticker:'AAPL',market:'US',meta:{currency:'USD',currencyUnit:'百万',divisor:'1000000'},bridge:{baseRevenue:fact(383285),sharesDiluted:shares,netDebt:fact(75138)},grossMarginPct:{value:0.44,factIds:[]},missing:[],evidence:{}});

describe('equity bridge panel rules',()=>{
 it('Run only when all three are fact or user; a missing field blocks it',()=>{
  const f=bridgeFields(seed(missing('share_basis_unverified')),{});
  expect(f.sharesDiluted).toMatchObject({source:'missing',reason:'share_basis_unverified'});
  expect(canRun(f)).toBe(false);
 });
 it('a typed finite number is a user source and the only thing sent as an override',()=>{
  const f=bridgeFields(seed(missing('share_basis_unverified')),{sharesDiluted:' 15550.061 ',netDebt:'abc'});
  expect(f.sharesDiluted).toMatchObject({source:'user',value:15550.061});
  expect(f.netDebt.source).toBe('fact');
  expect(canRun(f)).toBe(true);
  expect(bridgeOverrides(f)).toEqual({sharesDiluted:15550.061});
  expect(bridgeOverrides(bridgeFields(seed(fact(1)),{baseRevenue:'1'}))).toEqual({revenueLines:[{baseRevenue:1}]});
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/dcf/assemble.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
vi.mock('@/lib/llm/resolve',()=>({resolveUserLlm:async()=>null}));
vi.mock('@/lib/data/sources/llm',()=>({chatResolved:vi.fn(),extractJson:(s:string)=>JSON.parse(s)}));
import {assembleAssumptions,layerOf,mergeLayers,factLayer} from './assemble';
import type {DcfWarning,LlmFill} from './assemble';
import type {SeedResult} from '@/lib/company/dcf-seed';

const leaf=(value:number,divisor='1000000')=>({source:'fact' as const,value,factIds:['f'],divisor,basis:'b',periodEnd:'2023-09-30',unit:'USD'});
const fullSeed=():SeedResult=>({seed:{baseRevenue:383285,grossMarginPct:0.44,sharesDiluted:15550.061,netDebt:75138},
 provenance:{'revenueLines[0].baseRevenue':leaf(383285),grossMarginPct:{...leaf(0.44,'1'),metric:'gross_margin'},sharesDiluted:leaf(15550.061),netDebt:leaf(75138)},
 missing:[],meta:{currency:'USD',currencyUnit:'百万',divisor:'1000000'},evidence:{}});
const noShares=():SeedResult=>{const s=fullSeed();delete s.seed.sharesDiluted;delete s.provenance.sharesDiluted;s.missing=[{field:'sharesDiluted',reason:'share_basis_unverified'}];return s;};

describe('assembleAssumptions (spec §9.1)',()=>{
 it('merge order defaults < LLM < facts < user by leaf; LLM cagr kept while baseRevenue stays fact',async()=>{
  const llm=vi.fn<LlmFill>(async()=>({revenueLines:[{cagr:0.12}],grossMarginPct:0.9,sgaPct:0.2}));
  const r=await assembleAssumptions('AAPL','US',fullSeed(),{wacc:0.09},llm);
  expect(r.status).toBe('ok');
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 重写 `src/lib/dcf/assemble.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/dcf/assemble.ts
// DCF assumptions with leaf-level provenance (spec §9.1, §0 #65). Merge order by LEAF PATH:
// defaults < LLM < facts < user overrides. revenueLines is fixed at ONE line: LLM and defaults may write
// only revenueLines[0].cagr; revenueLines[0].baseRevenue comes only from facts or the user; any other
// write (extra lines, LLM baseRevenue) is dropped with dcf_revenue_line_rejected. The equity bridge
// (revenueLines[0].baseRevenue, sharesDiluted, netDebt) must be `fact` or `user`, otherwise the result is
// status 'unavailable' (dcf_bridge_missing) and the LLM is not called. The LLM is asked only for cagr and
// cost ratios, in the stated currency unit; currency/currencyUnit follow the facts (or the market).
import {chatResolved,extractJson} from '@/lib/data/sources/llm';
import {resolveUserLlm} from '@/lib/llm/resolve';
import type {Market} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import type {SeedResult} from '@/lib/company/dcf-seed';
import type {DcfAssumptions} from './engine';

export type Provenance='fact'|'llm'|'default'|'user';
export type DcfWarningCode='dcf_revenue_line_rejected'|'dcf_llm_field_rejected'|'dcf_llm_failed'|'dcf_llm_unconfigured'|'dcf_no_facts'|'dcf_estimates';
export interface DcfWarning{code:DcfWarningCode;detail?:string}
export const BRIDGE_LEAVES=['revenueLines[0].baseRevenue','sharesDiluted','netDebt'] as const;
const RATIOS=['grossMarginPct','sgaPct','rdPct','sbcPct','daPct','capexPct','wcPctOfRev','taxRate'] as const;
const OTHER=['wacc','terminalG','forecastYears','exitEvEbitda'] as const;
export type Leaf='revenueLines[0].name'|'revenueLines[0].baseRevenue'|'revenueLines[0].cagr'|typeof RATIOS[number]|typeof OTHER[number]|'sharesDiluted'|'netDebt';
const LEAVES:readonly Leaf[]=['revenueLines[0].name','revenueLines[0].baseRevenue','revenueLines[0].cagr',...RATIOS,...OTHER,'sharesDiluted','netDebt'];
/** Defaults never contain a bridge leaf. */
export const DEFAULTS:ReadonlyMap<Leaf,number|string>=new Map<Leaf,number|string>([['revenueLines[0].name','合计'],['revenueLines[0].cagr',0.08],['grossMarginPct',0.4],['sgaPct',0.15],['rdPct',0.05],['sbcPct',0.02],['daPct',0.04],['capexPct',0.05],['wcPctOfRev',0.05],['taxRate',0.25],['wacc',0.1],['terminalG',0.025],['forecastYears',8],['exitEvEbitda',12]]);
export const MARKET_UNITS:Record<Market,{currency:string;currencyUnit:string;divisor:string}>={US:{currency:'USD',currencyUnit:'百万',divisor:'1000000'},CN:{currency:'CNY',currencyUnit:'亿',divisor:'100000000'}};
export type Layer=Map<Leaf,number|string>;
const finite=(v:unknown):v is number=>typeof v==='number'&&Number.isFinite(v);
const asObj=(v:unknown)=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)?v as Record<string,unknown>:null;

/** JSON from the LLM or the user → leaf layer. The LLM may write only revenueLines[0].cagr and the cost ratios. */
export function layerOf(src:'llm'|'user',input:unknown,warnings:DcfWarning[]):Layer{
 const out:Layer=new Map();const o=asObj(input);if(!o)return out;
 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(o)){
  if(k==='revenueLines'){
   if(!Array.isArray(v)){warnings.push({code:'dcf_revenue_line_rejected',detail:`${src}:not_array`});continue;}
   if(v.length!==1)warnings.push({code:'dcf_revenue_line_rejected',detail:`${src}:length=${v.length}`});
   const first=asObj(v[0]);if(!first)continue;
   for(const [f,x] of Object.entries(first)){
    if(f==='cagr'&&finite(x))out.set('revenueLines[0].cagr',x);
    else if(src==='user'&&f==='baseRevenue'&&finite(x))out.set('revenueLines[0].baseRevenue',x);
    else if(src==='user'&&f==='name'&&typeof x==='string'&&x.trim())out.set('revenueLines[0].name',x.trim().slice(0,40));
    else if(f==='baseRevenue')warnings.push({code:'dcf_revenue_line_rejected',detail:`${src}:baseRevenue`});
   }
   continue;
  }
  const allowed:readonly string[]=src==='llm'?RATIOS:[...RATIOS,...OTHER,'sharesDiluted','netDebt'];
  if(allowed.includes(k)&&finite(v))out.set(k as Leaf,v);
  else if(src==='llm'&&(k==='sharesDiluted'||k==='netDebt'))warnings.push({code:'dcf_llm_field_rejected',detail:k});
 }
 return out;
}
export function factLayer(seed:SeedResult):Layer{
 const out:Layer=new Map();const s=seed.seed;
 if(s.baseRevenue!==undefined)out.set('revenueLines[0].baseRevenue',s.baseRevenue);
 if(s.grossMarginPct!==undefined)out.set('grossMarginPct',s.grossMarginPct);
 if(s.sharesDiluted!==undefined)out.set('sharesDiluted',s.sharesDiluted);
 if(s.netDebt!==undefined)out.set('netDebt',s.netDebt);
 return out;
}
export function mergeLayers(layers:{defaults:ReadonlyMap<Leaf,number|string>;llm:Layer;facts:Layer;user:Layer}):{values:Map<Leaf,number|string>;provenance:Record<string,Provenance>}{
 const values=new Map<Leaf,number|string>();const provenance:Record<string,Provenance>={};
 const order=[['user',layers.user],['fact',layers.facts],['llm',layers.llm],['default',layers.defaults]] as const;
 for(const leaf of LEAVES)for(const [src,layer] of order)if(layer.has(leaf)){values.set(leaf,layer.get(leaf)!);provenance[leaf]=src;break;}
 return {values,provenance};
}
export function bridgeMissing(provenance:Record<string,Provenance>,seed:SeedResult):{field:string;reason:string}[]{
 return BRIDGE_LEAVES.filter(l=>provenance[l]!=='fact'&&provenance[l]!=='user').map(l=>({field:l,reason:seed.missing.find(m=>m.field===l)?.reason??'no_fact'}));
}
function toAssumptions(v:Map<Leaf,number|string>,meta:{currency:string;currencyUnit:string}):DcfAssumptions{
 const n=(l:Leaf)=>Number(v.get(l));
 return {revenueLines:[{name:String(v.get('revenueLines[0].name')??'合计'),baseRevenue:n('revenueLines[0].baseRevenue'),cagr:n('revenueLines[0].cagr')}],
  grossMarginPct:n('grossMarginPct'),sgaPct:n('sgaPct'),rdPct:n('rdPct'),sbcPct:n('sbcPct'),daPct:n('daPct'),capexPct:n('capexPct'),wcPctOfRev:n('wcPctOfRev'),taxRate:n('taxRate'),
  wacc:n('wacc'),terminalG:n('terminalG'),forecastYears:n('forecastYears'),sharesDiluted:n('sharesDiluted'),netDebt:n('netDebt'),exitEvEbitda:n('exitEvEbitda'),
  currency:meta.currency,currencyUnit:meta.currencyUnit};
}
export interface AssembleResult{status:'ok'|'unavailable';assumptions:DcfAssumptions|null;provenance:Record<string,Provenance>;missing:{field:string;reason:string}[];warnings:DcfWarning[];meta:{currency:string;currencyUnit:string;divisor:string}}
/** Returns parsed JSON, or null when the user has no LLM configured; throws on failure. */
export type LlmFill=(prompt:string)=>Promise<unknown|null>;
async function userLlm(prompt:string):Promise<unknown|null>{
 const llm=await resolveUserLlm();if(!llm)return null;
 const resp=await chatResolved(llm,{system:'You are a sell-side analyst. Output ONLY JSON with exactly the requested keys.',messages:[{role:'user',content:prompt}],max_tokens:400,responseJson:true});
 return extractJson(resp.content);
}
function extractPrompt(ticker:string,meta:{currency:string;currencyUnit:string;divisor:string},seed:SeedResult):string{
 return [
  `为 ${ticker} 估计 DCF 的收入增速与成本结构比率。金额单位：${meta.currencyUnit} ${meta.currency}（原值 ÷ ${meta.divisor}）。`,
  `已披露事实（不要修改、不要返回）：基期收入 ${seed.seed.baseRevenue??'未知'}；毛利率 ${seed.seed.grossMarginPct??'未知'}。`,
  '只返回 JSON，仅含这些键（比率为小数）：',
  '{"revenueLines":[{"cagr":0}],"grossMarginPct":0,"sgaPct":0,"rdPct":0,"sbcPct":0,"daPct":0,"capexPct":0,"wcPctOfRev":0,"taxRate":0}',
 ].join('\n');
}
export async function assembleAssumptions(ticker:string,market:Market,seed:SeedResult,overrides:unknown,llm:LlmFill=userLlm):Promise<AssembleResult>{
 const warnings:DcfWarning[]=[];
 const meta=seed.meta.currency?{currency:seed.meta.currency,currencyUnit:seed.meta.currencyUnit!,divisor:seed.meta.divisor!}:MARKET_UNITS[market];
 const facts=factLayer(seed),user=layerOf('user',overrides,warnings);
 const pre=mergeLayers({defaults:DEFAULTS,llm:new Map(),facts,user});
 const missing=bridgeMissing(pre.provenance,seed);
 if(missing.length>0)return {status:'unavailable',assumptions:null,provenance:pre.provenance,missing,warnings,meta};
 let llmLayer:Layer=new Map();
 try{const out=await llm(extractPrompt(ticker,meta,seed));if(out===null)warnings.push({code:'dcf_llm_unconfigured'});else llmLayer=layerOf('llm',out,warnings);}
 catch{warnings.push({code:'dcf_llm_failed'});}
 const merged=mergeLayers({defaults:DEFAULTS,llm:llmLayer,facts,user});
 if(!Object.values(merged.provenance).includes('fact'))warnings.push({code:'dcf_no_facts'});   // final provenance, not the seed (plan audit Q7)
 warnings.push({code:'dcf_estimates'});
 return {status:'ok',assumptions:toAssumptions(merged.values,meta),provenance:merged.provenance,missing:[],warnings,meta};
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: 重写 `/api/dcf/[ticker]/route.ts`**

```ts
// src/app/api/dcf/[ticker]/route.ts
// DCF over disclosure facts (spec §9.1, §0 #65). No self-call to /api/financials: the seed comes from ONE
// company_read_snapshot envelope read server-side, gated (public rules, admin:false). GET → the equity-bridge
// panel seed (no LLM, no engine). POST {overrides} → assemble (defaults < LLM < facts < user) and run;
// an incomplete bridge → 200 {status:'unavailable', code:'dcf_bridge_missing'} without a valuation.
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {productionReadDeps} from '@/lib/company/deps';
import {SEED_CONCEPTS,seedFromFacts,seedResponse} from '@/lib/company/dcf-seed';
import type {SeedResult} from '@/lib/company/dcf-seed';
import {MARKET_UNITS,assembleAssumptions} from '@/lib/dcf/assemble';
import {computeComposite} from '@/lib/dcf/engine';
import {isCurrentSecurity} from '@/lib/entities/resolve';
import {addDays} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import {TICKER_RE,decodeTicker,errorResponse,failureResponse,publicMarketOf,resolvePublicIssuer,utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import type {PublicIssuer} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {inferCoreMarket} from '@/lib/securities/ticker';
import type {EvidenceRecord,PdfLocator} from '@/lib/company/types';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration=60;
interface Ctx{params:Promise<{ticker:string}>}
const NO_STORE={'Cache-Control':'no-store'};
const SEED_WINDOW_DAYS=1100;

async function loadSeed(raw:string):Promise<{issuer:PublicIssuer;seed:SeedResult}|Response>{
 const today=utcDate(new Date());
 const ticker=decodeTicker(raw);
 if(ticker===null||!TICKER_RE.test(ticker))return errorResponse('invalid_parameter:ticker','invalid ticker',400);
 if(inferCoreMarket(ticker.trim())==='HK')return errorResponse('market_not_served','HK disclosure facts await the document pipeline (F3)',404);
 const deps=productionReadDeps();
 const issuer=await resolvePublicIssuer(deps.tables,ticker,today);
 if(!issuer)return errorResponse('unknown_ticker','no issuer for ticker',404);
 const secs=(await deps.tables.select('issuer_securities',{issuer_id:issuer.issuerId})).filter(r=>isCurrentSecurity(r,today)&&publicMarketOf(String(r.ticker))===issuer.market);
 const own=secs.find(r=>String(r.ticker)===issuer.ticker);
 const snapshot=await deps.snapshot(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{concepts:[...SEED_CONCEPTS[issuer.market]],asOf:today,from:addDays(today,-SEED_WINDOW_DAYS),history:true});
 const ids=snapshot.rows.filter(r=>r.is_current===true).map(r=>r.fact_id);
 const [evidence,pdf]=ids.length>0
  ?await Promise.all([deps.company.evidenceOf(ids),issuer.market==='CN'?deps.pdf.locate(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,ids):Promise.resolve(new Map<string,PdfLocator>())])
  :[new Map<string,EvidenceRecord>(),new Map<string,PdfLocator>()];
 const seed=seedFromFacts(snapshot,{shareClass:own?String(own.share_class):'unknown',openSecuritiesInMarket:secs.length},{market:issuer.market,asOf:today,evidence,pdf,admin:false});
 return {issuer,seed};
}

export async function GET(_req:Request,{params}:Ctx){
 try{
  const r=await loadSeed((await params).ticker);if(r instanceof Response)return r;
  return NextResponse.json(seedResponse(r.issuer.ticker,r.issuer.market,r.seed,MARKET_UNITS[r.issuer.market]),{headers:NO_STORE});
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'dcf','dcf seed failed');}
}

/** POST /api/dcf/[ticker]  body: {overrides?} → {status, assumptions, provenance, factProvenance, result, warnings, evidence, meta} */
export async function POST(req:Request,{params}:Ctx){
 let overrides:unknown={};
 try{overrides=((await req.json()) as {overrides?:unknown})?.overrides??{};}catch{/* empty body ok */}
 try{
  const r=await loadSeed((await params).ticker);if(r instanceof Response)return r;
  const a=await assembleAssumptions(r.issuer.ticker,r.issuer.market,r.seed,overrides);
  const base={ticker:r.issuer.ticker,market:r.issuer.market,meta:a.meta,provenance:a.provenance,factProvenance:r.seed.provenance,missing:a.missing,warnings:a.warnings,evidence:r.seed.evidence};
  if(a.status==='unavailable')return NextResponse.json({status:'unavailable',code:'dcf_bridge_missing',...base,assumptions:null,result:null},{headers:NO_STORE});
  return NextResponse.json({status:'ok',...base,assumptions:a.assumptions,result:computeComposite(a.assumptions!)},{headers:NO_STORE});
 }catch(e){return failureResponse(e,'dcf','dcf failed');}
}
```

```tsx
'use client';
// Valuation model (spec §5.4, §5.10, §9.1, §0 #65): never runs on mount. On mount it GETs the fact seed and
// shows the equity-bridge panel (base revenue, shares outstanding, net debt — each with its source label,
// basis note and fact links); "Run" appears only when all three are fact- or user-sourced (typing a number
// makes it `user`). Hidden in replay mode (asOf set). Warnings are codes translated under market.dcf.warnings.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { BRIDGE_KEYS, bridgeFields, bridgeOverrides, canRun } from '@/lib/dcf/bridge';
import type { BridgeKey, DcfRunResponse, DcfSeedResponse } from '@/lib/dcf/bridge';

const VARIANT_KEYS = ['fcff', 'adjusted', 'exSbc', 'ebitda'] as const;
const fmt = (n: number) => (Number.isFinite(n) ? n.toFixed(2) : '—');
const pct = (n: number) => (Number.isFinite(n) ? `${(n * 100).toFixed(0)}%` : '—');
const num = (n: number | null) => (n === null ? '—' : n.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 6 }));

export function DcfStudio({ ticker, asOf = null, onOpenFact }: { ticker: string; asOf?: string | null; onOpenFact?: (factId: string) => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('market.dcf');
  const [seed, setSeed] = useState<DcfSeedResponse | null>(null);
  const [seedErr, setSeedErr] = useState('');
  const [user, setUser] = useState<Partial<Record<BridgeKey, string>>>({});
  const [data, setData] = useState<DcfRunResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState('');
  const [wacc, setWacc] = useState(0.1);
  const [terminalG, setTerminalG] = useState(0.025);
  const [forecastYears, setForecastYears] = useState(8);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (asOf) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    setSeed(null); setSeedErr(''); setData(null); setUser({});
    fetch(`/api/dcf/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}`, { cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(async (r) => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`); return (await r.json()) as DcfSeedResponse; })
      .then((j) => { if (!cancelled) setSeed(j); })
      .catch((e) => { if (!cancelled) setSeedErr(String(e)); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [ticker, asOf]);

  const fields = useMemo(() => (seed ? bridgeFields(seed, user) : null), [seed, user]);

  const run = async () => {
    if (!fields || !canRun(fields)) return;
    setLoading(true); setErr('');
    try {
      const r = await fetch(`/api/dcf/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ overrides: { ...bridgeOverrides(fields), wacc, terminalG, forecastYears } }),
      });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${r.status}`);
      setData((await r.json()) as DcfRunResponse);
    } catch (e) { setErr(String(e)); }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  if (asOf) return <div className="card-base text-sm text-text-dim">{t('replayHidden')}</div>;

  const v = data?.status === 'ok' ? data.result?.valuation : undefined;
  const range = v?.rangePerShare;
  const factLink = (id: string, i: number) => onOpenFact
    ? <button key={id} type="button" onClick={() => onOpenFact(id)} className="text-[11px] text-accent underline">{t('factLink', { n: i + 1 })}</button>
    : <a key={id} href={`/api/facts/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}?factIds=${id}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="text-[11px] text-accent underline">{t('factLink', { n: i + 1 })}</a>;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 border-t border-border pt-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-text-dim">{t('modelHeading')}</div>
        {loading && <span className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('calculating')}</span>}
      </div>
      {seedErr && <div className="card-base text-sm text-down">{seedErr}</div>}
      {!seed && !seedErr && <div className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('loadingSeed')}</div>}

      {seed && fields && (
        <div className="card-base space-y-2">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-text-dim">{t('bridgeHeading')}</div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">{t('unitNote', { unit: seed.meta.currencyUnit, currency: seed.meta.currency, divisor: seed.meta.divisor })}</div>
          {BRIDGE_KEYS.map((k) => {
            const f = fields[k];
            return (
              <div key={k} className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1 sm:grid-cols-[12rem_1fr_12rem] sm:items-center">
                <div className="text-xs">{t(`bridge.${k}`)}</div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm tabular-nums">
                  <span>{num(f.value)}</span>
                  <span className="rounded bg-bg-elevated px-1 text-[10px] text-text-dim">{t(`source.${f.source}`)}</span>
                  {f.source === 'missing' && f.reason && <span className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">{t(`missingReason.${f.reason}`)}</span>}
                  {f.basis && <span className="text-[11px] text-text-muted">{t(`basis.${f.basis}`)}</span>}
                  {f.factIds.map(factLink)}
                </div>
                <input type="number" inputMode="decimal" aria-label={t(`bridge.${k}`)} placeholder={t('userPlaceholder', { unit: k === 'sharesDiluted' ? `÷${seed.meta.divisor}` : seed.meta.currencyUnit })}
                  value={user[k] ?? ''} onChange={(e) => setUser((u) => ({ ...u, [k]: e.target.value }))}
                  className="w-full rounded bg-bg-card px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
              </div>
            );
          })}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-2">
            <label className="text-xs">{t('wacc')}
              <input type="number" step="0.005" value={wacc} onChange={(e) => setWacc(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="mt-1 w-full rounded bg-bg-card px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
            </label>
            <label className="text-xs">{t('terminalG')}
              <input type="number" step="0.005" value={terminalG} onChange={(e) => setTerminalG(parseFloat(e.target.value))} className="mt-1 w-full rounded bg-bg-card px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
            </label>
            <label className="text-xs">{t('forecastYears')}
              <input type="number" step="1" value={forecastYears} onChange={(e) => setForecastYears(parseInt(e.target.value, 10))} className="mt-1 w-full rounded bg-bg-card px-2 py-1 text-sm" />
            </label>
          </div>
          {canRun(fields) && (
            <button type="button" onClick={run} disabled={loading} className="mt-2 rounded-md bg-accent px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">{t('run')}</button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {err && <div className="card-base text-sm text-down">{err}</div>}
      {data?.status === 'unavailable' && <div className="card-base text-sm text-text-dim">{t('unavailable')}</div>}

      {range && (
        <div className="card-base">
          <div className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('rangeHeading')}</div>
          <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-3">
            <span className="text-sm text-text-dim">{fmt(range.min)}</span>
            <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-accent">{fmt(range.median)}</span>
            <span className="text-sm text-text-dim">{fmt(range.max)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {v && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
          {VARIANT_KEYS.map((key) => (
            <div key={key} className="rounded-md bg-bg-card p-3 text-center">
              <div className="text-[11px] text-text-dim">{t(`variants.${key}`)}</div>
              <div className="text-lg font-bold tabular-nums">{fmt(v[key].perShare)}</div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-text-muted">{t('terminalPct', { pct: pct(v[key].terminalPctEv) })}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {data?.warnings?.length ? (
        <div className="card-base text-[11px] text-text-muted">
          {data.warnings.map((w, i) => <div key={i}>{t(`warnings.${w.code}`)}</div>)}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```

（`border-border`、`bg-bg-elevated` 等类名以 `globals.css` 现有 tokens 为准；若无 `border-border`，换成该文件里分隔线所用的 token 类。旧 `heading`/`assumptionsHeading`/`recalculate` 键保留不删，`/tools/dcf` 页仍可用。）

**指挥决定：**
- 六个指标 = `gross_margin, net_margin, fcf, revenue_yoy, net_income_yoy, roe`（`borrowings_total` 是余额不是比率/流量，留在报表外）；只收与所选期间同 `period_end` 的行（含 `TTM`）。
- packet 不附 `evidence` 字典：每值已带 `factId`，32 KB 上限装不下 DTO（每个约 600 B）；需要证据的读者用 `/api/companies/<ticker>/facts?…` 或 `/api/facts/<ticker>?factIds=`。门槛照常执行（不合格值为 `{withheld, factId}`）。
- packet 不接受 `asOf`（规格 §6.1 只列两个参数）；读取为今天，`from = 今天 − (annualPeriods+2)×366 天` 以限制行数；网格只喂当前行（`is_current`），派生在同一信封全量行上。
- 裁剪：先建完整 packet，序列化 > 32 768 字节时每次从期数较多的一侧（相等时先裁 recent）减一期重建；到 1/1 仍超限则清空报表与指标、`clipped` 记满（保证上限，不出部分错误数据）。

```ts
// src/app/api/companies/[ticker]/packet/route.test.ts
import {beforeEach,describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import type {KitDeps} from '@/lib/company/route-test-kit';

const mocks=vi.hoisted(()=>({deps:null as unknown as KitDeps,requireAdmin:vi.fn()}));
vi.mock('@/lib/company/deps',()=>({productionReadDeps:()=>mocks.deps}));
vi.mock('@/lib/company/evidence-gate',async(orig)=>({...(await orig<typeof import('@/lib/company/evidence-gate')>()),applyGate:(await import('@/lib/company/route-test-kit')).fakeApplyGate}));
vi.mock('@/lib/admin/auth',()=>{class AdminUnauthenticated extends Error{}class AdminForbidden extends Error{}return {AdminUnauthenticated,AdminForbidden,requireAdminUser:mocks.requireAdmin};});

import {GET} from './route';
import {GET as ADMIN_GET} from '../../../admin/companies/[ticker]/packet/route';
import {FACT_CONCEPTS,MAPPING_GEN} from '@/lib/facts/concepts';
import {FORMULA_VERSION} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import type {FactRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {PACKET_MAX_BYTES} from '@/lib/company/handlers/packet';
import {US,emptySnapshot,fact,makeDeps,seededTables,summary} from '@/lib/company/route-test-kit';

const get=(h:typeof GET,ticker:string,qs='')=>h(new Request(`https://alpha.example/api/companies/${ticker}/packet?${qs}`),{params:Promise.resolve({ticker})});
const fn=(x:unknown)=>x as ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
/** `years` fiscal years of every US concept (12M or INSTANT) + 3M quarters of the last year: large enough to exceed 32 KB uncut. */
function bigRows(years:number):FactRow[]{
 const out:FactRow[]=[];
 const usConcepts=FACT_CONCEPTS.filter(c=>c.usGaap.length>0);
 for(let i=0;i<years;i++){
  const y=2023-i,end=`${y}-12-31`,start=`${y}-01-01`;
  for(const c of usConcepts){
   const instant=c.nature==='instant';
   out.push(fact({concept:c.id,statement:c.statement,period_start:instant?null:start,period_end:end,duration:instant?'INSTANT':'12M',unit:c.unitKind==='shares'?'shares':c.unitKind==='per_share'?'USD/shares':'USD',value:String(1000000000+i*7+c.id.length),value_text:String(1000000000+i*7+c.id.length),available_date:`${y+1}-02-15`}));
  }
 }
 for(const [s,e] of [['2023-01-01','2023-03-31'],['2023-04-01','2023-06-30'],['2023-07-01','2023-09-30']] as const)
  for(const c of usConcepts.filter(c=>c.nature==='duration'))out.push(fact({concept:c.id,statement:c.statement,period_start:s,period_end:e,duration:'3M',value:'123456789',value_text:'123456789',available_date:'2023-11-01'}));
 return out;
}

describe('GET /api/companies/[ticker]/packet (spec §6.1, §9.2)',()=>{
 beforeEach(async()=>{vi.clearAllMocks();mocks.deps=makeDeps(await seededTables());mocks.requireAdmin.mockResolvedValue({id:'u'});});
 it('defaults 5 annual / 4 recent; three statements; six metrics; every value has factId + availableDate; provenance; one envelope',async()=>{
  const rev=fact(),gp=fact({concept:'gross_profit',value:'169148000000',value_text:'169148000000'});
  fn(mocks.deps.snapshot).mockResolvedValue(emptySnapshot({stateRev:8,rows:[rev,gp],filings:[summary()]}));
  const res=await get(GET,'AAPL');
  const body=await res.json();
  expect(mocks.deps.snapshot).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  expect(mocks.deps.snapshot).toHaveBeenCalledWith(US,'US',expect.objectContaining({concepts:null,history:true}));
  expect(body).toMatchObject({market:'US',provenance:{mappingGen:MAPPING_GEN,formulaVersion:FORMULA_VERSION,stateRev:8},clipped:{annual:0,recent:0},truncated:false});
  const revRow=body.annual.IS.find((r:{concept:string})=>r.concept==='revenue');
  expect(Object.values(revRow.values)[0]).toEqual({value:'383285000000',factId:rev.fact_id,availableDate:'2023-11-03'});
  expect(body.metrics.find((m:{metric:string})=>m.metric==='gross_margin')).toMatchObject({value:expect.any(String),factIds:expect.arrayContaining([rev.fact_id,gp.fact_id]),availableDate:'2023-11-03'});
  expect(body.metrics.every((m:{metric:string})=>['gross_margin','net_margin','fcf','revenue_yoy','net_income_yoy','roe'].includes(m.metric))).toBe(true);
  expect(body.evidence).toBeUndefined();
 });
 it('gate: an ineligible fact is {withheld, factId} with no value; metric on it withheld too',async()=>{
  const rev=fact({value:'383285000777',value_text:'383285000777'}),gp=fact({concept:'gross_profit'});
  mocks.deps.noEvidence.add(rev.fact_id);
  fn(mocks.deps.snapshot).mockResolvedValue(emptySnapshot({rows:[rev,gp],filings:[summary()]}));
  const body=await (await get(GET,'AAPL')).json();
  expect(JSON.stringify(body)).not.toContain('383285000777');
  expect(Object.values(body.annual.IS.find((r:{concept:string})=>r.concept==='revenue').values)[0]).toEqual({withheld:'evidence_incomplete',factId:rev.fact_id});
  expect(body.metrics.find((m:{metric:string})=>m.metric==='gross_margin')).toMatchObject({withheld:'evidence_incomplete'});
  expect(body.withheld.evidenceIncomplete).toBeGreaterThan(0);
 });
 it('JSON ≤ 32 KB guaranteed by clipping periods; clipped counts reported',async()=>{
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 实现 packet 处理器与两个路由壳**

```ts
// src/lib/company/handlers/packet.ts
// GET /api/companies/[ticker]/packet — the Copilot financials packet (spec §6.1, §9.2). One snapshot envelope
// (history:true, bounded by `from`): the three statements' annual rows (annualPeriods ≤ 10, default 5) and the
// most recent disclosed periods (recentPeriods ≤ 8, default 4) from the same grid builder as the page, plus six
// derived metrics on the same envelope. Every value carries factId + availableDate and passes the evidence gate
// (ineligible → {withheld, factId}); provenance {mappingGen, formulaVersion, stateRev}. The serialized JSON is
// ≤ 32 KB, guaranteed by clipping periods (reported in `clipped`). No evidence dictionary (size; see plan note).
import {MAPPING_GEN} from '@/lib/facts/concepts';
import {FORMULA_VERSION,addDays,deriveMetrics} from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import {intParam} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import type {Market,MetricRow} from '@/lib/facts/types';
import {buildGated,cellFactIds,countWithheld,gateCell} from '../route';
import type {Gated,Handler} from '../route';
import {buildStatementsGrid,periodKeyOf} from '../statements-grid';
import type {Basis,Cell,PeriodCol,StatementKind,WithheldCounts,WithheldReason} from '../types';

export const PACKET_PARAMS=['annualPeriods','recentPeriods'] as const;
export const PACKET_METRICS=['gross_margin','net_margin','fcf','revenue_yoy','net_income_yoy','roe'] as const;
export const PACKET_MAX_BYTES=32*1024;
const STATEMENTS:StatementKind[]=['IS','BS','CF'];
export type PacketValue={value:string;factId:string;availableDate:string}|{withheld:WithheldReason;factId:string};
export interface PacketRow{concept:string;unit:string|null;values:Record<string,PacketValue>}
export interface PacketSection{periods:PeriodCol[];IS:PacketRow[];BS:PacketRow[];CF:PacketRow[]}
export type PacketMetric={metric:string;periodKey:string;unit:string;basis:string;factIds:string[];availableDate:string}&({value:string}|{withheld:WithheldReason});
export interface PacketDto{
 issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:Market;asOf:string;truncated:boolean;
 provenance:{mappingGen:number;formulaVersion:string;stateRev:number};
 annual:PacketSection;recent:PacketSection;metrics:PacketMetric[];clipped:{annual:number;recent:number};withheld:WithheldCounts;
}
const emptySection=():PacketSection=>({periods:[],IS:[],BS:[],CF:[]});
const bytes=(x:unknown)=>Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(x),'utf8');

function valueOf(c:Cell):PacketValue|null{
 if(!c)return null;
 if(c.kind==='withheld')return {withheld:c.reason,factId:c.factId};
 if(c.kind==='fact')return {value:c.value,factId:c.factId,availableDate:c.availableDate};
 return null;   // annual/disclosed grids carry fact cells only
}
interface Built{sections:Record<'annual'|'recent',Record<StatementKind,{periods:PeriodCol[];rows:{concept:string;unit:string|null;cells:Record<string,Cell>}[]}>>;metrics:MetricRow[]}
// Same column order as Task 7's grid: period_end desc → period_start desc → 3M<6M<9M<12M<TTM<INSTANT.
const DUR_ORDER:Record<string,number>={'3M':0,'6M':1,'9M':2,'12M':3,TTM:4,INSTANT:5};
const cmpStr=(a:string,b:string)=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0;
const colOrder=(a:PeriodCol,b:PeriodCol)=>cmpStr(b.periodEnd,a.periodEnd)||cmpStr(b.periodStart,a.periodStart)||(DUR_ORDER[a.duration]??9)-(DUR_ORDER[b.duration]??9);
// 计划第 3 轮审计 R4: out.periods is the union of every statement's retained (clipped) periods, so every
// values key is declared — an annual IS 12M key and a BS INSTANT key both appear; clipping stays per statement.
function sectionOf(b:Built['sections']['annual'],n:number,g:Gated):PacketSection{
 const out=emptySection();
 const periodsByKey=new Map<string,PeriodCol>();
 for(const s of STATEMENTS){
  const periods=b[s].periods.slice(0,n);
  for(const p of periods)periodsByKey.set(p.key,p);
  out[s]=b[s].rows.map(r=>({concept:r.concept,unit:r.unit,values:Object.fromEntries(periods.flatMap(p=>{const v=valueOf(gateCell(r.cells[p.key]??null,g));return v?[[p.key,v]]:[];}))})).filter(r=>Object.keys(r.values).length>0);
 }
 out.periods=[...periodsByKey.values()].sort(colOrder);
 return out;
}
function metricsOf(ms:MetricRow[],ends:Set<string>,g:Gated):PacketMetric[]{
 return ms.filter(m=>(PACKET_METRICS as readonly string[]).includes(m.metric)&&ends.has(m.period_end)).map(m=>{
  const factIds=m.inputs.map(i=>i.fact_id);
  const availableDate=m.inputs.reduce((d,i)=>i.available_date>d?i.available_date:d,'');
  const bad=factIds.map(id=>g.reasonOf(id)).filter((r):r is WithheldReason=>r!==null);
  const base={metric:m.metric,periodKey:periodKeyOf(m),unit:m.unit,basis:m.basis,factIds,availableDate};
  return bad.length?{...base,withheld:bad.includes('evidence_incomplete')?'evidence_incomplete':bad[0]}:{...base,value:m.value};
 });
}
export const packetHandler:Handler=async(ctx)=>{
 const {params:p,issuer,deps,asOf}=ctx;
 const annualN=intParam(p,'annualPeriods',5,10),recentN=intParam(p,'recentPeriods',4,8);
 const snap=await deps.snapshot(issuer.issuerId,issuer.market,{concepts:null,asOf,from:addDays(asOf,-(annualN+2)*366),history:true});
 const head={issuerId:issuer.issuerId,ticker:issuer.ticker,market:issuer.market,asOf,truncated:snap.truncated,provenance:{mappingGen:MAPPING_GEN,formulaVersion:FORMULA_VERSION,stateRev:snap.stateRev}};
 if(snap.truncated){const body:PacketDto={...head,annual:emptySection(),recent:emptySection(),metrics:[],clipped:{annual:0,recent:0},withheld:{evidenceIncomplete:0,citationPending:0}};return {body,empty:true};}
 // Task 7 grid on the same envelope (current disclosures only for annual/disclosed); 40 columns, sectionOf clips to n.
 const grid=(basis:Basis,s:StatementKind)=>{const o=buildStatementsGrid(snap,{statement:s,basis,periods:40,market:issuer.market,asOf});return o.ok?{periods:o.periods,rows:o.rows}:{periods:[],rows:[]};};
 const built:Built={sections:{annual:{} as Built['sections']['annual'],recent:{} as Built['sections']['recent']},metrics:deriveMetrics(snap.rows,{market:issuer.market,asOf,basedOnRev:snap.stateRev})};
 for(const s of STATEMENTS){built.sections.annual[s]=grid('annual',s);built.sections.recent[s]=grid('disclosed',s);}
 const ids=[...STATEMENTS.flatMap(s=>[...built.sections.annual[s].rows,...built.sections.recent[s].rows].flatMap(r=>Object.values(r.cells).flatMap(cellFactIds))),...built.metrics.flatMap(m=>m.inputs.map(i=>i.fact_id))];
 const g=await buildGated(ctx,ids,snap.rows,snap.filings);
 const make=(a:number,r:number):PacketDto=>{
  const annual=sectionOf(built.sections.annual,a,g),recent=sectionOf(built.sections.recent,r,g);
  const ends=new Set([...annual.periods,...recent.periods].map(x=>x.periodEnd));
  const metrics=metricsOf(built.metrics,ends,g);
  const all=[...annual.IS,...annual.BS,...annual.CF,...recent.IS,...recent.BS,...recent.CF].flatMap(row=>Object.values(row.values));
  const withheld=countWithheld([...all,...metrics].filter(v=>'withheld' in v).map(v=>({kind:'withheld',reason:(v as {withheld:WithheldReason}).withheld})));
  return {...head,annual,recent,metrics,clipped:{annual:annualN-a,recent:recentN-r},withheld};
 };
 let a=annualN,r=recentN,body=make(a,r);
 while(bytes(body)>PACKET_MAX_BYTES&&(a>1||r>1)){if(r>1&&(r>=a||a===1))r--;else a--;body=make(a,r);}
 if(bytes(body)>PACKET_MAX_BYTES)body={...head,annual:emptySection(),recent:emptySection(),metrics:[],clipped:{annual:annualN,recent:recentN},withheld:body.withheld};
 return {body,empty:body.annual.periods.length===0&&body.recent.periods.length===0};
};
```

```ts
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { isTushareConfigured, fetchTushareReportRc, TushareError } from '@/lib/data/sources/tushare-cached';
import { deriveConsensus } from '@/lib/stocks/consensus';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
export const revalidate = 3600; // 1h cache

interface Ctx { params: Promise<{ ticker: string }> }

/**
 * GET /api/consensus/[ticker]
 *
 * Broker consensus target price from a licensed source only (company-research spec §9.4, decision D):
 *   1. A-share + TUSHARE_TOKEN configured → report_rc (real broker research)
 *   2. Anything else (non-A-share, no token, Tushare error, no usable reports) → { source: 'none', consensus: null }
 * The former mock fallback (fabricated broker_reports) is closed.
 */
export async function GET(_req: Request, { params }: Ctx) {
  const { ticker: raw } = await params;
  const ticker = decodeURIComponent(raw);
  const isAShare = /\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$/i.test(ticker);

  if (isAShare && isTushareConfigured()) {
    try {
      const reports = await fetchTushareReportRc(ticker);
      const consensus = deriveConsensus(reports);
      if (consensus !== null) return NextResponse.json({ source: 'tushare', ticker, consensus });
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (!(e instanceof TushareError)) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { source: 'error', ticker, error: e?.message || 'unknown', consensus: null },
          { status: 502 }
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return NextResponse.json({ source: 'none', ticker, consensus: null });
}
```

## Part D：公司页 UI（Tasks 11–13）

### 依赖的跨组接口（Part D 消费；字段名逐字使用，整合代理按 Part C/E 实际产出核对）

Part D 只在客户端消费下列 JSON；客户端 DTO 类型在 `src/lib/company/client.ts` 里独立声明（服务端路由文件引入 `next/server`，客户端不能 import），与 Task 9/10 的服务端构造逐字段一致。任何不一致以服务端为准、在复审时改 `client.ts` 一处。

1. **Task 3 / 共享契约**：`src/lib/company/types.ts` 的 `Cell`、`FactCell`、`DerivedCell`、`WithheldCell`、`WithheldReason`、`WithheldCounts`、`PeriodCol`、`GridRow`、`FilingSummary`、`EvidenceDto`、`CoverageRow`、`StatementKind`、`Basis`、`EventKind`（客户端只 `import type`）。`supabaseCompanyDb(client)`（`src/lib/company/db.ts`）返回 `CompanyDb`，本部分只用 `coverageOf(issuerIds)`。`readSnapshot(client, issuerId, market, opts)`（`src/lib/company/snapshot-read.ts`）：`client` 为 `getAnonSupabase()` 返回的 Supabase 客户端，`opts: ReadSnapshotOptions`，返回 `ReadSnapshotResult`；`filings` 子集与 `rows` 的 `limit`/`truncated` 无关（同一 SELECT 的独立子查询，按 §0.1 item 3 已是 `mapping_gen > 0 and available_date <= asOf`）。
2. **Task 5/7 `decimal.ts`**（整合核对）：`decimalSub(a: string, b: string): string`（精确十进制 a−b，规范形）、`decimalRelChange(from: string, to: string): string | null`（10 位小数后去尾零，如 `'0.1'`；`from=0` 返回 `null`）；显示缩放复用 `formatDecimalText(valueText, divisor: bigint, digits)`、`groupThousands`、`scaleFor(unit, locale)`、`DisplayScale`（Task 12 `format.ts` 是它们的薄适配层，整合决定：不另写一套十进制缩放）。`METRIC_CATALOG: Record<string /*FORMULA_VERSION*/, Record<string /*metric*/, {formula: {zh: string; en: string}; inputs: string[]; basisByMarket: Partial<Record<Market, string>>}>>`。
3. **Task 9 `GET /api/companies/[ticker]/statements`**（admin 变体 `/api/admin/companies/[ticker]/statements` 同形）：`StatementsDto = {issuerId, ticker, market, asOf: string, mappingGen: number, stateRev: number, truncated: boolean, statement, basis, periods: PeriodCol[], rows: GridRow[], filings: Record<filingId, FilingSummary>, otherUnitOnly: Record<concept, periodKey[]>, evidence: Record<factId, EvidenceDto>, withheld: WithheldCounts}`；`otherUnitOnly`（Task 7 `GridResult.otherUnitOnly`）列出"该期只有非主单位事实"的格（格为 `null`，页面渲染"—"+ `U`，共享契约 `Cell` 不变）；`truncated=true` 时 `rows` 为空，客户端只显示截断错误卡。BS + `basis=quarterly` → 400 `invalid_parameter:basis`（客户端在 BS 下禁用"单季"按钮，不会发出）。
4. **Task 9 `GET /api/companies/[ticker]/facts?concept=&periodStart=&periodEnd=&unit=&asOf=`**（admin 同形；整合核对后的实际 DTO）：`FactSeriesDto = {issuerId, ticker, market, asOf: string, mappingGen, stateRev, truncated, history: true, concept, periodStart, periodEnd, unit, otherUnits: string[], series: SeriesEntry[], otherUnitSeries: SeriesEntry[], filings, evidence, withheld}`；`SeriesEntry = SeriesBase & ({kind:'fact', value, rawHash, runId, unitRule, delta, relChange} | {kind:'withheld', reason})`，`SeriesBase = {factId, availableDate, filingId, disclosureSeq: number|null, isCurrent: boolean|null, isRevision: boolean|null, sourceConcept, mappingVersion, mappingGen, unit}`；按 `disclosure_seq` 升序。`unit` **必填**；INSTANT 的 `periodStart` 传 `periodEnd`。`U` 徽标的"其他单位"表直接用同一响应的 `otherUnitSeries`（不发第二个请求）。
5. **规格二 `GET /api/facts/[ticker]?factIds=<id>`**（已落地）：只用来把派生输入 / 事件引用的 `factId` 解析成 `{concept, periodStart|null, periodEnd, duration, unit}` 以打开抽屉；其 `value` 不显示（§0 #68）。
6. **Task 10 `GET /api/companies/[ticker]/overview?asOf=`**（admin 同形）：`OverviewDto = {issuer, ticker, market, asOf, coverage: CoverageRow|null, coverageOtherMarket: CoverageRow|null, latestFiling: FilingSummary|null, latest: {periodKey: string|null, facts: Record<'revenue'|'revenue_operating'|'net_income_parent'|'operating_cash_flow', Cell>, derived: Record<'gross_margin'|'revenue_yoy', Cell>, stateRev: number, truncated: boolean} | null, recentEvents: PublicEvent[], eventsComputed: 'materialized'|'live', evidence, withheld}`（`periodKey` 只在 `truncated` 时为 null）。`PublicEvent`（`src/lib/company/event-dto.ts`，客户端 `import type`）`= {eventId, issuerId, market, kind, naturalKey, occurredOn, periodEnd: string|null, concept: string|null, filingId: string|null, payload, meta, firstSeenAt: string|null, payloadChangedAt: string|null, filing: {formType, url, documentUrl, citation}|null}`；payload 中经门槛置空的 headline 单项与 `fact_revised` 的 `from.value`/`to.value` 被替换为 `{kind:'withheld', reason, factId}`，`relChange` 替换为 `{kind:'withheld', reason}`（Task 6 `gateEventPayload`）。
7. **Task 10 `GET /api/companies/[ticker]/metrics?asOf=&periods=`**（admin 同形）：`MetricsDto = {issuerId, ticker, market, asOf: string|null, mappingGen: number, formulaVersion: string, stale: boolean, truncated: boolean, metrics: MetricEntry[], evidence, withheld}`，`MetricEntry = {metric, periodStart, periodEnd, duration, inputUnit: string, basis: string, basedOnRev: number, computedAt: string|null, computedAtKind: 'materialized'|'live', cell: DerivedCell | WithheldCell}`（`computedAtKind` 在每行，不在响应顶层）；`stale=true` 时 `metrics=[]`。计划第 3 轮审计 R5：`periods` ∈ `8|20|40`（仅本组合路由），给出时保留最新 N 个期间键的**全部**指标行、不再套 `limit`（缺省 200 只在无 `periods` 时生效），其他值 400 `invalid_parameter:periods`；指标视图总带 `periods`。计划第 3 轮审计 R6：`inputUnit`/`basis` 在行顶层（取自 `m.input_unit`/`m.basis`，门槛前填入，置空格也保留），同一指标同一期间的不同输入货币/口径是不同的行。
8. **Task 10 `GET /api/companies/freshness`**：`{datasets: {dataset: 'facts.us'|'facts.cn'|'company.events', status: 'fresh'|'stale'|'error'|'missing', lastOkAt: string|null, lastAttemptAt: string|null}[]}`。
9. **Task 10 `GET /api/companies/snapshot?fact=`**：只作为 `EvidenceDto.snapshot.download` 的链接目标，客户端不构造它。
10. **Task 14**（整合核对）：`<DcfStudio ticker={ticker} asOf? onOpenFact? />`（`src/components/DcfStudio.tsx`，Task 14 重写后的签名 `({ticker, asOf?, onOpenFact?})`；股权桥面板与"不挂载即运行"在其内部；Task 13 传 `onOpenFact` 打开 `historyByFact` 抽屉；回放时不挂载）。
11. **Task 16**（跟踪按钮占位用）：`GET /api/tracking/watches` → `200 {count, limit, unreadComplete, watches: WatchCard[]}`（占位按钮只读 `watches[].issuerId`）；`POST /api/tracking/watches` body `{issuerId}` → 201（新建）/200（已存在），409 `{error:{code:'watch_limit'}}`；`DELETE /api/tracking/watches/[issuerId]` → 200，未跟踪 404 `watch_not_found`；未登录 401。路由尚未落地时（404）占位按钮显示"跟踪暂不可用"并禁用。
12. **Task 17**（整合决定）：公司页"跟踪"页签渲染 `src/components/company/tracking/CompanyTrackingView.tsx` 的 `CompanyTrackingView({issuerId, ticker, market, asOf})`（`market` 为 `data.market`；HK/无市场 → 事实状态卡），页头渲染 `src/components/company/tracking/TrackButton.tsx` 的 `TrackButton({issuerId})`（`data-testid="track-button"`）。Task 11 建两个可用占位；**Task 17 整文件覆盖这两个文件**（保持导出名、props 与 testid），公司页与页头不再改。
13. **F3 / F4**：仓库当前没有 `src/components/documents/SourceDrawer*` 与 `src/components/judgments/JudgmentCard*`。Task 13 用本地适配器 `src/components/company/f3-source-drawer.tsx`（`F3_SOURCE_DRAWER_AVAILABLE=false` + 渲染 `null`）与 `src/components/company/judgment-card-adapter.tsx`（本地最小渲染器）；F3/F4 落地时只改这两个适配器文件。

**模块自有文件列表路由**（整合决定：由 **Task 10** 建立公共 + admin 两个路由，见 Task 10 Step 11b）：`GET /api/companies/[ticker]/filings?asOf=` → `FilingsDto = {issuerId, ticker, market, asOf: string|null, stateRev, filings: FilingSummary[]}`（`available_date` 降序，`available_date ≤ asOf`，来自同一 `company_read_snapshot`）。理由：文件视图需要 `fiscalPeriod/linkAttempts/factCount`，规格二 `/api/filings` 不含这些字段且只读不可改；页头回放"最近文件"也需要它。Task 11/13 只消费。

```ts
// COMPANY — company research module domains (plan 2026-11-06 Task 11)
describe('company module translations', () => {
  const read = (locale: 'en' | 'zh', file: 'company' | 'tracking') =>
    JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), 'messages', locale, `${file}.json`), 'utf8')) as unknown;
  const leaves = (value: unknown, prefix = ''): [string, string][] =>
    typeof value === 'string' ? [[prefix, value]]
      : Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>).flatMap(([k, v]) => leaves(v, prefix ? `${prefix}.${k}` : k));
  for (const file of ['company', 'tracking'] as const) {
    it(`${file}: zh and en keys and placeholders are in parity`, () => {
      const zh = new Map(leaves(read('zh', file)));
      const en = new Map(leaves(read('en', file)));
      expect([...zh.keys()].sort()).toEqual([...en.keys()].sort());
      for (const [key, value] of en) expect(placeholders(zh.get(key) ?? '')).toEqual(placeholders(value));
    });
  }
});
// /COMPANY
```
