```ts
// src/lib/company/client.ts
// Client-side helpers of the company page (plan 2026-11-06 Task 11; spec §5.1, §5.10, §6.1):
// view/asOf parsing, hrefs, api urls, one fetch wrapper, and the client view of every route DTO
// the page consumes. Only `import type` from ./types and ./event-dto (erased at build), so client
// components may import this file.
import type {Market,Cell,DerivedCell,WithheldCell,WithheldReason,WithheldCounts,PeriodCol,GridRow,FilingSummary,EvidenceDto,CoverageRow,StatementKind,Basis} from './types';
import type {PublicEvent} from './event-dto';

export const VIEW_IDS=['overview','statements','metrics','filings','tracking','judgments','ai','signals','holdings'] as const;
export type ViewId=typeof VIEW_IDS[number];
export const REPLAY_UNSUPPORTED:ReadonlySet<ViewId>=new Set<ViewId>(['ai','signals','holdings']);
/** Views whose content comes from the facts store (need a published stream). */
export const FACT_VIEWS:ReadonlySet<ViewId>=new Set<ViewId>(['overview','statements','metrics','filings']);
const VIEW_SET=new Set<string>(VIEW_IDS);
const first=(v:string|string[]|undefined)=>Array.isArray(v)?v[0]:v;
/** `news` is retired (decision D) and lands on overview, like any unknown value. */
export function parseView(raw:string|string[]|undefined):ViewId{const v=first(raw);return v!==undefined&&VIEW_SET.has(v)?v as ViewId:'overview';}
/** A real calendar date YYYY-MM-DD not after `today` (UTC); anything else is ignored (no replay). */
export function parseAsOf(raw:string|string[]|undefined,today:string):string|null{
 const v=first(raw);if(v===undefined||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v))return null;
 const ms=Date.parse(`${v}T00:00:00Z`);if(Number.isNaN(ms)||new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0,10)!==v)return null;
 return v<=today?v:null;
}
export const utcToday=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
const qs=(params:Record<string,string|null|undefined>)=>{const u=new URLSearchParams();for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(params))if(v!=null&&v!=='')u.set(k,v);const s=u.toString();return s?`?${s}`:'';};
/** Page link; `view=overview` is the default and omitted; asOf is preserved by every caller. */
export function companyHref(ticker:string,o:{view:ViewId;asOf:string|null;extra?:Record<string,string|null|undefined>}):string{
 return `/stock/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}${qs({view:o.view==='overview'?null:o.view,asOf:o.asOf,...o.extra})}`;
}
export type CompanyRoute='statements'|'facts'|'overview'|'events'|'metrics'|'filings';
/** Public route, or the admin variant (Task 9/10 build an admin twin of every composed route, filings included). */
export function companyApi(route:CompanyRoute,ticker:string,params:Record<string,string|null|undefined>,admin=false):string{
 const base=admin?'/api/admin/companies':'/api/companies';
 return `${base}/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}/${route}${qs(params)}`;
}
export type FetchResult<T>={status:'ok';data:T}|{status:'error';httpStatus:number;code:string};
/** One GET; never throws. 5xx → code 'internal' (the page shows an error card, never a fallback source). */
export async function fetchCompanyJson<T>(url:string,signal?:AbortSignal):Promise<FetchResult<T>>{
 let res:Response;
 try{res=await fetch(url,{signal,cache:'no-store',headers:{Accept:'application/json'}});}
 catch(e){return {status:'error',httpStatus:0,code:e instanceof DOMException&&e.name==='AbortError'?'aborted':'network'};}
 if(res.status>=500)return {status:'error',httpStatus:res.status,code:'internal'};
 let body:unknown=null;try{body=await res.json();}catch{body=null;}
 if(!res.ok){const code=(body as {error?:{code?:unknown}}|null)?.error?.code;return {status:'error',httpStatus:res.status,code:typeof code==='string'?code:`http_${res.status}`};}
 return {status:'ok',data:body as T};
}
export const isWithheld=(x:unknown):x is WithheldCell=>typeof x==='object'&&x!==null&&(x as {kind?:unknown}).kind==='withheld';
export const flagOn=(v:string|undefined)=>v==='1'||v==='true';
// NEXT_PUBLIC_* must be referenced literally to be inlined into the client bundle.
export const F3_DRAWER_FLAG=flagOn(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPANY_F3_DRAWER);
export const JUDGMENTS_FLAG=flagOn(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPANY_JUDGMENTS);

// ---- client view of the route DTOs (Task 9/10; see part D "依赖的跨组接口") ----
// Field-for-field the server DTOs of Task 9 (handlers/statements.ts StatementsDto, handlers/facts.ts FactSeriesDto),
// Task 10 (event-dto.ts PublicEvent, handlers/overview.ts OverviewDto, handlers/metrics.ts MetricsDto,
// handlers/filings.ts FilingsDto). Declared here because client components must not import handler modules.
export interface StatementsResponse{issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:Market;asOf:string;mappingGen:number;stateRev:number;truncated:boolean;statement:StatementKind;basis:Basis;periods:PeriodCol[];rows:GridRow[];filings:Record<string,FilingSummary>;
 /** concept → period keys with only a non-primary unit (cell null → render "—" + U). */
 otherUnitOnly:Record<string,string[]>;evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;withheld:WithheldCounts}
interface SeriesBase{factId:string;availableDate:string;filingId:string;disclosureSeq:number|null;isCurrent:boolean|null;isRevision:boolean|null;sourceConcept:string;mappingVersion:string;mappingGen:number;unit:string}
export type SeriesEntry=(SeriesBase&{kind:'fact';value:string;rawHash:string;runId:string;unitRule:string|null;delta:string|null;relChange:string|null})|(SeriesBase&{kind:'withheld';reason:WithheldReason});
export interface FactSeriesResponse{issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:Market;asOf:string;mappingGen:number;stateRev:number;truncated:boolean;history:true;concept:string;periodStart:string;periodEnd:string;unit:string;
 otherUnits:string[];series:SeriesEntry[];otherUnitSeries:SeriesEntry[];filings:Record<string,FilingSummary>;evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;withheld:WithheldCounts}
export type {PublicEvent} from './event-dto';
export interface OverviewResponse{ticker:string;market:Market;asOf:string;coverage:CoverageRow|null;coverageOtherMarket:CoverageRow|null;latestFiling:FilingSummary|null;
 latest:{periodKey:string|null;facts:Record<string,Cell>;derived:Record<string,Cell>;stateRev:number;truncated:boolean}|null;recentEvents:PublicEvent[];eventsComputed:'materialized'|'live';evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;withheld:WithheldCounts}
// inputUnit / basis mirror MetricDto (计划第 3 轮审计 R6): grid rows key on (metric, inputUnit, basis).
export interface MetricEntry{metric:string;periodStart:string;periodEnd:string;duration:string;inputUnit:string;basis:string;basedOnRev:number;computedAt:string|null;computedAtKind:'materialized'|'live';cell:DerivedCell|WithheldCell}
export interface MetricsResponse{issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:Market;asOf:string|null;mappingGen:number;formulaVersion:string;stale:boolean;truncated:boolean;metrics:MetricEntry[];evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;withheld:WithheldCounts}
export type FreshnessStatus='fresh'|'stale'|'error'|'missing';
export interface FreshnessResponse{datasets:{dataset:string;status:FreshnessStatus;lastOkAt:string|null;lastAttemptAt:string|null}[]}
export interface CompanyFilingsResponse{issuerId:string;ticker:string;market:Market;asOf:string|null;stateRev:number;filings:FilingSummary[]}
/** Spec-2 /api/facts?factIds= row, used only to locate a fact's natural key (its value is never displayed, §0 #68). */
export interface FactKeyRow{factId:string;concept:string;periodStart:string|null;periodEnd:string;duration:string;unit:string}
export interface FactIdsResponse{facts:FactKeyRow[]}
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/header-model.ts
// Pure header view model of the company page (plan 2026-11-06 Task 11; spec §5.2, §5.7, §0 #69).
// Shared by the server loader (page-data.ts) and the client header; no server imports.
import type {ResolvedIssuer,ResolvedSecurity} from '@/lib/entities/resolve';
import type {CoverageRow,Market} from './types';

export type SecurityMarket=Market|'HK'|'OTHER';
export type FactState='ok'|'no_issuer'|'no_facts'|'hk_pending';
export interface Chip{ticker:string;primary:boolean;current:boolean;market:SecurityMarket}
export interface StreamOption{market:Market;ticker:string}

export function displayNames(names:{zh:string|null;en:string|null},locale:'zh'|'en',ticker:string):{title:string;subtitle:string|null}{
 const own=locale==='zh'?names.zh:names.en,other=locale==='zh'?names.en:names.zh;
 if(own)return {title:own,subtitle:other&&other!==own?other:null};
 if(other)return {title:other,subtitle:null};
 return {title:ticker,subtitle:null};
}
/** Same suffix rule as the facts layer: .SH/.SZ/.BJ → CN, .HK → HK, other suffixed forms OTHER, plain/dotted share class → US. */
export function securityMarket(ticker:string):SecurityMarket{
 const t=ticker.toUpperCase();
 if(/\.(SH|SZ|BJ)$/.test(t))return 'CN';
 if(/\.HK$/.test(t))return 'HK';
 if(/^[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]*(\.[A-Z])?$/.test(t))return 'US';
 return 'OTHER';
}
export const datasetOf=(m:Market)=>m==='US'?'facts.us':'facts.cn';
export function securityChips(secs:ResolvedSecurity[],current:string):Chip[]{
 const cur=current.toUpperCase();
 return [...secs].sort((a,b)=>Number(b.is_primary)-Number(a.is_primary)||a.ticker.localeCompare(b.ticker))
  .map(s=>({ticker:s.ticker,primary:s.is_primary,current:s.ticker.toUpperCase()===cur,market:securityMarket(s.ticker)}));
}
export function padCik(cik:string|null):string|null{return cik&&/^\d{1,10}$/.test(cik)?cik.padStart(10,'0'):cik;}
/** Switch options only when the issuer has coverage rows for BOTH markets; each goes to that market's primary (else first) current ticker. */
export function streamOptions(issuer:ResolvedIssuer,coverage:CoverageRow[]):StreamOption[]{
 const out:StreamOption[]=[];
 for(const m of ['US','CN'] as const){
  if(!coverage.some(c=>c.market===m))continue;
  const s=securityChips(issuer.securities,'').find(c=>c.market===m);
  if(s)out.push({market:m,ticker:s.ticker});
 }
 return out.length>=2?out:[];
}
export function factStateOf(issuer:ResolvedIssuer|null,market:Market|null,coverage:CoverageRow|null):FactState{
 if(!issuer)return 'no_issuer';
 if(market===null){
  const ms=issuer.securities.map(s=>securityMarket(s.ticker));
  return ms.length>0&&ms.every(m=>m==='HK')?'hk_pending':'no_facts';
 }
 return coverage?'ok':'no_facts';
}
```

- [ ] **Step 10: 实现 `page-data.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/company/page-data.ts
// Server loader of /stock/[ticker] (plan 2026-11-06 Task 11; spec §5.1, §5.2, §5.7, §0 #69):
// resolveIssuer (header identity, today's ownership, one merge hop) and resolvePublicIssuer (market
// from the matched security row) run in parallel, then ONE coverageOf for the issuer. Never throws:
// failures become errorCode and the page renders an error card, never a fallback source.
import type {TableClient} from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import {resolveIssuer,type ResolvedIssuer} from '@/lib/entities/resolve';
import {resolvePublicIssuer} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import type {CoverageRow,Market} from './types';
import {factStateOf,streamOptions,type FactState,type StreamOption} from './header-model';

export interface CompanyPageData{
 ticker:string;today:string;issuer:ResolvedIssuer|null;market:Market|null;publicTicker:string|null;
 coverage:CoverageRow|null;coverageAll:CoverageRow[];streams:StreamOption[];factState:FactState;errorCode:'ambiguous_ticker'|'internal'|null;
}
export interface PageDataDeps{tables:TableClient;coverageOf:(issuerIds:string[])=>Promise<CoverageRow[]>}

export async function loadCompanyPageData(deps:PageDataDeps,rawTicker:string,today:string):Promise<CompanyPageData>{
 const base:CompanyPageData={ticker:rawTicker,today,issuer:null,market:null,publicTicker:null,coverage:null,coverageAll:[],streams:[],factState:'no_issuer',errorCode:null};
 try{
  const given=rawTicker.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/\//g,'.');
  const [issuer,pub]=await Promise.all([resolveIssuer(deps.tables,{ticker:given},{today}),resolvePublicIssuer(deps.tables,given,today)]);
  if(!issuer)return base;
  const coverageAll=await deps.coverageOf([issuer.issuer_id]);
  const market=pub?.market??null;
  const coverage=market?coverageAll.find(c=>c.market===market)??null:null;
  return {...base,issuer,market,publicTicker:pub?.ticker??null,coverage,coverageAll,streams:streamOptions(issuer,coverageAll),factState:factStateOf(issuer,market,coverage)};
 }catch(e){
  const ambiguous=e instanceof Error&&e.message==='ambiguous_owner';
  if(!ambiguous)console.error('[company/page-data]',e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
  return {...base,errorCode:ambiguous?'ambiguous_ticker':'internal'};
 }
}
```

```tsx
// src/app/(app)/stock/[ticker]/page.tsx
// Company page entry (plan 2026-11-06 Task 11; spec §5.1): server component. Resolves the issuer and
// its coverage once on the server, parses view/asOf, and hands everything to the client shell.
// Identity no longer comes from getStockOrStub(); quote row, K-line and quote ratios are removed (decision J).
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { getLocale } from 'next-intl/server';
import { getAnonSupabase } from '@/lib/supabase/anon';
import { supabaseTableClient } from '@/lib/db/table-client';
import { supabaseCompanyDb } from '@/lib/company/db';
import { loadCompanyPageData } from '@/lib/company/page-data';
import { parseAsOf, parseView } from '@/lib/company/client';
import { requireAdminUser } from '@/lib/admin/auth';
import { CompanyPage } from './CompanyPage';

// Auth-gated server component — must render dynamically per request (see briefs/page.tsx).
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

type Search = Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>;

async function isAdminViewer(): Promise<boolean> {
  try { await requireAdminUser(); return true; } catch { return false; }
}

/** Spec §5.7 "未知 ticker": no issuer AND not a known security → the framework 404 (stocks_universe is public-read). Fails open. */
async function knownSecurity(anon: ReturnType<typeof getAnonSupabase>, ticker: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await anon.from('stocks_universe').select('ticker').eq('ticker', ticker.trim().toUpperCase()).limit(1);
    return error ? true : (data?.length ?? 0) > 0;
  } catch { return true; }
}

export default async function StockPage({ params, searchParams }: { params: Promise<{ ticker: string }>; searchParams: Promise<Search> }) {
  const [{ ticker: raw }, query] = await Promise.all([params, searchParams]);
  let ticker = raw;
  try { ticker = decodeURIComponent(raw); } catch { /* keep raw */ }
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const anon = getAnonSupabase();
  const company = supabaseCompanyDb(anon);
  const [data, isAdmin, locale] = await Promise.all([
    loadCompanyPageData({ tables: supabaseTableClient(anon), coverageOf: (ids) => company.coverageOf(ids) }, ticker, today),
    isAdminViewer(),
    getLocale(),
  ]);
  if (!data.issuer && !data.errorCode && !(await knownSecurity(anon, ticker))) notFound();   // e2e Task 19 #10: HTTP 404
  const highlight = typeof query.highlight === 'string' && /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(query.highlight) ? query.highlight : null;
  return (
    <CompanyPage
      data={data}
      view={parseView(query.view)}
      asOf={parseAsOf(query.asOf, today)}
      highlight={highlight}
      isAdmin={isAdmin}
      locale={locale === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh'}
    />
  );
}
```

```ts
// src/components/company/useCompanyFetch.ts
'use client';
// One GET per url change with abort on change/unmount and a retry nonce (plan 2026-11-06 Task 11).
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { fetchCompanyJson, type FetchResult } from '@/lib/company/client';

export type FetchState<T> = { status: 'idle' } | { status: 'loading' } | FetchResult<T>;

export function useCompanyFetch<T>(url: string | null): { state: FetchState<T>; retry: () => void } {
  const [state, setState] = useState<FetchState<T>>(url ? { status: 'loading' } : { status: 'idle' });
  const [nonce, setNonce] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!url) { setState({ status: 'idle' }); return; }
    const ac = new AbortController();
    setState({ status: 'loading' });
    void fetchCompanyJson<T>(url, ac.signal).then((r) => { if (!ac.signal.aborted) setState(r); });
    return () => ac.abort();
  }, [url, nonce]);
  const retry = useCallback(() => setNonce((n) => n + 1), []);
  return { state, retry };
}
```

```ts
/** Track button state from GET /api/tracking/watches (Task 16): 404 = routes not deployed yet. */
export type TrackState='loading'|'tracked'|'untracked'|'login'|'unavailable';
export function trackStateOf(r:FetchResult<{watches?:{issuerId?:unknown}[]}>,issuerId:string):TrackState{
 if(r.status==='ok')return (r.data.watches??[]).some(w=>w.issuerId===issuerId)?'tracked':'untracked';
 if(r.httpStatus===401)return 'login';
 return 'unavailable';
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/tracking/TrackButton.tsx
'use client';
// Header track toggle against the tracking API (plan 2026-11-06 Task 11 → Task 16 routes; spec §6.2).
// Fails closed: 404 (routes not deployed) disables the button; watch_limit shows the fixed message.
// Placeholder: Task 17 overwrites this file (same export TrackButton({issuerId}), same data-testid).
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';
import { fetchCompanyJson, trackStateOf, type TrackState } from '@/lib/company/client';
import { useToast } from '@/components/Toast';

export function TrackButton({ issuerId }: { issuerId: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('tracking.button');
  const { show } = useToast();
  const [state, setState] = useState<TrackState>('loading');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const ac = new AbortController();
    void fetchCompanyJson<{ watches?: { issuerId?: unknown }[] }>('/api/tracking/watches', ac.signal)
      .then((r) => { if (!ac.signal.aborted) setState(trackStateOf(r, issuerId)); });
    return () => ac.abort();
  }, [issuerId]);

  async function toggle() {
    if (busy || (state !== 'tracked' && state !== 'untracked')) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = state === 'tracked'
        ? await fetch(`/api/tracking/watches/${encodeURIComponent(issuerId)}`, { method: 'DELETE', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } })
        : await fetch('/api/tracking/watches', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ issuerId }) });
      if (res.ok) { setState(state === 'tracked' ? 'untracked' : 'tracked'); return; }
      const body = await res.json().catch(() => null) as { error?: { code?: string } } | null;
      show(body?.error?.code === 'watch_limit' ? t('limit') : t('error'));
    } catch {
      show(t('error'));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  const label = state === 'tracked' ? t('tracking') : state === 'login' ? t('loginRequired') : state === 'unavailable' ? t('unavailable') : t('track');
  return (
    <Button
      variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={toggle} aria-pressed={state === 'tracked'} data-testid="track-button"
      disabled={busy || state === 'loading' || state === 'login' || state === 'unavailable'}
      className={state === 'tracked' ? 'border-[var(--border-active)] text-[var(--accent)]' : undefined}
    >
      {label}
    </Button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/CompanyHeader.tsx
'use client';
// Company header (plan 2026-11-06 Task 11; spec §5.2, §5.9, decision J; canvas Main/Overview/M-Company).
// No quote row, no PE/PB/ROE/dividend yield. Data status = coverage of the current market + dataset
// freshness recomputed at read time; in replay the latest filing is recomputed (available_date <= asOf).
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Button, Card, Tag } from '@/components/ui';
import { useToast } from '@/components/Toast';
import { useWatchlist } from '@/lib/hooks/useWatchlist';
import { companyApi, companyHref, type CompanyFilingsResponse, type FreshnessResponse, type ViewId } from '@/lib/company/client';
import { datasetOf, displayNames, padCik, securityChips } from '@/lib/company/header-model';
import type { CompanyPageData } from '@/lib/company/page-data';
import { useCompanyFetch } from './useCompanyFetch';
import { TrackButton } from './tracking/TrackButton';

function WatchlistButton({ ticker }: { ticker: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.header');
  const ts = useTranslations('market.stock');
  const { show } = useToast();
  const { groups, hydrated, setGroups } = useWatchlist();
  const [inList, setInList] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => { if (hydrated) setInList(groups.some((g) => g.tickers.includes(ticker))); }, [groups, hydrated, ticker]);
  function toggle() {
    if (!hydrated) return;
    if (inList) {
      setGroups(groups.map((g) => ({ ...g, tickers: g.tickers.filter((x) => x !== ticker) })));
      setInList(false); show(ts('removedToast', { ticker }));
      return;
    }
    const targetId = groups.find((g) => g.id === 'opportunity')?.id || groups[0]?.id;
    if (!targetId) return;
    setGroups(groups.map((g) => (g.id === targetId ? { ...g, tickers: Array.from(new Set([...g.tickers, ticker])) } : g)));
    setInList(true); show(ts('addedToast', { group: groups.find((g) => g.id === targetId)?.name || ts('notFound.watchlist') }));
  }
  return <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={toggle} disabled={!hydrated}>{inList ? t('inWatchlist') : t('addWatchlist')}</Button>;
}

function AnalyzeMenu({ ticker }: { ticker: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.header');
  const ts = useTranslations('market.stock');
  const q = encodeURIComponent(ticker);
  return (
    <details className="relative">
      <summary className="inline-flex cursor-pointer list-none items-center rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-elevated)] px-2.5 py-1 text-xs">{t('analyze')}</summary>
      <div className="absolute z-20 mt-1 flex min-w-[200px] flex-col gap-1 rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-elevated)] p-2 text-xs">
        <Link href={`/copilot?ticker=${q}` as never}>{ts('analyzeWithJohn')}</Link>
        <Link href={`/copilot?method=hiphon-pm-deepdive&ticker=${q}` as never}>{ts('deepDive')}</Link>
        <Link href={`/copilot?method=company-diligence&ticker=${q}` as never}>{ts('companyDiligence')}</Link>
      </div>
    </details>
  );
}

const dot: Record<string, string> = { fresh: 'bg-[var(--bearish)]', stale: 'bg-[var(--warn)]', error: 'bg-[var(--danger)]', missing: 'bg-[var(--text-muted)]' };

export function CompanyHeader({ data, view, asOf, locale }: { data: CompanyPageData; view: ViewId; asOf: string | null; locale: 'zh' | 'en' }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.header');
  const tf = useTranslations('company.header.freshness');
  const issuer = data.issuer;
  const ticker = data.publicTicker ?? data.ticker;
  const freshness = useCompanyFetch<FreshnessResponse>(data.market ? '/api/companies/freshness' : null).state;
  const replayFilings = useCompanyFetch<CompanyFilingsResponse>(asOf && data.coverage ? companyApi('filings', ticker, { asOf }) : null).state;
  const names = issuer ? displayNames(issuer.names, locale, ticker) : { title: data.ticker, subtitle: null };
  const chips = issuer ? securityChips(issuer.securities, ticker) : [];
  const cov = data.coverage;
  const ds = data.market && freshness.status === 'ok' ? freshness.data.datasets.find((d) => d.dataset === datasetOf(data.market!)) : undefined;
  const latestFiling = asOf
    ? (replayFilings.status === 'ok' ? replayFilings.data.filings[0]?.availableDate ?? '—' : '…')
    : cov?.latest_available_date ?? '—';
  const marketLabel = (m: string) => (m === 'CN' ? t('marketCN') : m === 'US' ? t('marketUS') : m === 'HK' ? t('marketHK') : m);

  return (
    <section className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-4 sm:gap-6" data-testid="company-header">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
          {names.title}{names.subtitle && <span className="ml-2 text-base font-normal text-[var(--text-dim)]">{names.subtitle}</span>}
        </h1>
        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap pb-0.5 text-xs">
          {chips.map((c) => (
            <Link key={c.ticker} href={companyHref(c.ticker, { view, asOf }) as never} aria-current={c.current ? 'true' : undefined} data-testid="security-chip"
              title={c.primary ? t('primary') : undefined}
              className={`num inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 no-underline ${c.current ? 'border-[var(--accent)] bg-[var(--accent-wash)] text-[var(--accent)]' : 'border-[var(--border)] text-[var(--text-dim)]'}`}>
              {c.ticker}{c.current ? ' ◉' : ''}
            </Link>
          ))}
          {data.market && <Tag>{marketLabel(data.market)}</Tag>}
          {issuer && (
            <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">
              {t('cik')} <span className="num">{padCik(issuer.identifiers.cik) ?? t('none')}</span> · {t('lei')} <span className="num">{issuer.identifiers.lei ?? t('none')}</span> · {t('usci')} <span className="num">{issuer.identifiers.usci ?? t('none')}</span>
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {issuer?.redirected_from && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--warn)]">{t('redirected', { name: names.title })}</p>}
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-2 sm:ml-auto sm:items-end">
        {data.streams.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('streamLabel')}</span>
            <div role="group" aria-label={t('streamLabel')} className="inline-flex overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] text-xs">
              {data.streams.map((s) => (
                <Link key={s.market} href={companyHref(s.ticker, { view, asOf }) as never} aria-current={s.market === data.market ? 'true' : undefined}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 no-underline ${s.market === data.market ? 'bg-[var(--accent-wash)] text-[var(--accent)]' : 'text-[var(--text-dim)]'}`}>
                  {s.market === 'US' ? t('streamUS') : t('streamCN')}
                </Link>
              ))}
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('streamHint')}</span>
          </div>
        )}
        {issuer && data.market && (
          <Card className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-5 gap-y-1 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs sm:grid-cols-3">
            {cov ? (
              <>
                <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('latestPeriod')}</span>
                <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('latestFiling')}{asOf ? ` ${t('latestFilingReplay')}` : ''}</span>
                <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('citations')}</span>
                <span className="num">{cov.latest_period_end ?? '—'}</span>
                <span className="num">{latestFiling}</span>
                <span className="num">
                  {data.market === 'US'
                    ? t('citationEdgar', { n: cov.citation_summary.edgar })
                    : `${t('citationLinked', { n: cov.citation_summary.linked })} · ${t('citationPending', { n: cov.citation_summary.pending })}`}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{cov.scope_last_status === 'failed' ? t('lastSyncFailed') : t('lastSync')}</span>
                <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('dataset')}</span>
                <span />
                <span className="num">{cov.scope_last_success_at?.slice(0, 10) ?? '—'}</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <span className="col-span-2 text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('noFacts')}</span>
            )}
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5" data-testid="data-status">
              <span className="num">{datasetOf(data.market)}</span>
              <span aria-hidden className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${dot[ds?.status ?? 'missing']}`} />
              <span>{ds ? tf(ds.status) : tf('unknown')}</span>
            </span>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex basis-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <WatchlistButton ticker={ticker} />
        {issuer && <TrackButton issuerId={issuer.issuer_id} />}
        <AnalyzeMenu ticker={ticker} />
        <span className="ml-auto text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('quoteRemoved')}</span>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/app/(app)/stock/[ticker]/legacy/AiView.tsx
'use client';
// Former "AI 观点" tab (plan 2026-11-06 Task 11; decision E): renamed 模型观点（未校准）, the
// consensus x.x/10 number is removed; counts and the button-triggered generation stay unchanged.
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { PerspectiveCard } from '@/components/PerspectiveCard';
import { QuotaNotice } from '@/components/QuotaNotice';
import { usePerspectives } from '@/lib/hooks/useQuote';

export function AiView({ ticker }: { ticker: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('market.stock');
  const tc = useTranslations('company.legacy');
  const pers = usePerspectives(ticker);
  const perspectives = pers.perspectives;
  const bullish = perspectives.filter((p) => p.stance === 'bullish');
  const neutral = perspectives.filter((p) => p.stance === 'neutral');
  const bearish = perspectives.filter((p) => p.stance === 'bearish');
  return (
    <div className="card-base">
      <div className="mb-1 text-sm font-semibold text-text-dim">{tc('aiHeading')}</div>
      <p className="mb-3 text-xs text-text-dim">{tc('aiNote')}</p>
      {pers.quota && <div className="mb-3"><QuotaNotice {...pers.quota} /></div>}
      {pers.loading ? (
        <div className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-text-dim">{t('ai.generating')}</div>
      ) : perspectives.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-text-dim">
          {t('ai.pendingLine1')}
          {pers.error && <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-down">{t('ai.errorLine', { error: pers.error })}</div>}
          <br />
          <button onClick={pers.refetch} className="mt-3 rounded bg-accent-dim px-4 py-2 text-white">{t('ai.generate')}</button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="mb-3 text-xs text-text-dim">{tc('aiCounts', { bullish: bullish.length, neutral: neutral.length, bearish: bearish.length })}</div>
          {bullish.length > 0 && <h3 className="mb-2 mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-bullish">{t('ai.bullishHeading', { count: bullish.length })}</h3>}
          {bullish.map((p) => <PerspectiveCard key={p.persona} {...p} />)}
          {neutral.length > 0 && <h3 className="mb-2 mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-neutral">{t('ai.neutralHeading', { count: neutral.length })}</h3>}
          {neutral.map((p) => <PerspectiveCard key={p.persona} {...p} />)}
          {bearish.length > 0 && <h3 className="mb-2 mt-3 text-sm font-semibold text-bearish">{t('ai.bearishHeading', { count: bearish.length })}</h3>}
          {bearish.map((p) => <PerspectiveCard key={p.persona} {...p} />)}
          <button onClick={pers.refetch} className="mt-3 rounded border border-accent-dim/60 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-accent-dim">{t('ai.regenerate')}</button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/app/(app)/stock/[ticker]/CompanyPage.tsx
'use client';
// Company page client shell (plan 2026-11-06 Task 11; spec §5.1, §5.2, §5.7, §5.9, §5.10):
// header, stream switch, nine tabs by ?view=, asOf replay bar, special states, legacy tabs.
// Fact views are wired in Tasks 12/13 by replacing renderFactView only.
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Disclaimer } from '@/components/Disclaimer';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui';
import { useQuote } from '@/lib/hooks/useQuote';
import { REPLAY_UNSUPPORTED, type ViewId } from '@/lib/company/client';
import type { CompanyPageData } from '@/lib/company/page-data';
import { CompanyHeader } from '@/components/company/CompanyHeader';
import { ViewTabs } from '@/components/company/ViewTabs';
import { ReplayBar, ReplayOpener, ReplayUnsupportedBanner } from '@/components/company/ReplayBar';
import { ErrorCard, FactStateCallout } from '@/components/company/StateCallout';
import { CompanyTrackingView } from '@/components/company/tracking/CompanyTrackingView';
import { AiView } from './legacy/AiView';
import { SignalsView } from './legacy/SignalsView';
import { HoldingsView } from './legacy/HoldingsView';

export interface CompanyPageProps {
  data: CompanyPageData; view: ViewId; asOf: string | null; highlight: string | null; isAdmin: boolean; locale: 'zh' | 'en';
}

export function CompanyPage(props: CompanyPageProps) {
  const { data } = props;
  const ts = useTranslations('market.stock');
  const t = useTranslations('company.states');
  // Unknown vs "quote but no issuer" (spec §5.7) needs the quote endpoint only when resolve found nothing.
  const quote = useQuote(data.issuer || data.errorCode ? null : data.ticker);

  if (data.errorCode) {
    return <ErrorCard message={data.errorCode === 'ambiguous_ticker' ? t('ambiguous') : t('internal')} onRetry={() => window.location.reload()} />;
  }
  if (!data.issuer) {
    if (quote.loading) return <div className="card-base py-10 text-center text-sm text-text-dim">{ts('loadingQuote', { ticker: data.ticker })}</div>;
    if (!quote.data) {
      const key = quote.notFound ? 'notFound' : 'unavailable';
      return (
        <div className="card-base text-center">
          <h2 className="mb-2 text-lg font-bold">{ts(`${key}.title`, { ticker: data.ticker })}</h2>
          <p>{ts(`${key}.bodyPrefix`)}<Link href="/">{ts('notFound.home')}</Link>{ts('notFound.or')}<Link href="/watchlist">{ts('notFound.watchlist')}</Link></p>
        </div>
      );
    }
  }
  return <CompanyShell {...props} />;
}

function CompanyShell({ data, view, asOf, highlight, isAdmin, locale }: CompanyPageProps) {
  const ticker = data.publicTicker ?? data.ticker;
  const issuer = data.issuer;
  const extra = view === 'statements' && highlight ? { highlight } : undefined;

  function renderBody() {
    if (REPLAY_UNSUPPORTED.has(view)) {
      const body = view === 'ai' ? <AiView ticker={ticker} /> : view === 'signals' ? <SignalsView /> : <HoldingsView ticker={ticker} />;
      return <>{asOf && <ReplayUnsupportedBanner ticker={ticker} view={view} />}{body}</>;
    }
    if (view === 'tracking') {
      if (issuer && data.market) return <CompanyTrackingView issuerId={issuer.issuer_id} ticker={ticker} market={data.market} asOf={asOf} />;
      return <FactStateCallout state={issuer ? (data.factState === 'ok' ? 'no_facts' : data.factState as 'no_issuer' | 'no_facts' | 'hk_pending') : 'no_issuer'} isAdmin={isAdmin} />;
    }
    return renderFactView();
  }

  // ---- Task 11: placeholder; Task 12 and Task 13 replace this whole function. ----
  function renderFactView() {
    if (view !== 'judgments' && data.factState !== 'ok') return <FactStateCallout state={data.factState as 'no_issuer' | 'no_facts' | 'hk_pending'} isAdmin={isAdmin} />;
    return <PendingView />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <CompanyHeader data={data} view={view} asOf={asOf} locale={locale} />
      {asOf && <ReplayBar ticker={ticker} view={view} asOf={asOf} extra={extra} />}
      <ViewTabs ticker={ticker} view={view} asOf={asOf} right={asOf ? undefined : <ReplayOpener ticker={ticker} view={view} />} />
      <div>{renderBody()}</div>
      <Disclaimer />
    </div>
  );
}

function PendingView() {
  const t = useTranslations('company.states');
  return <Card className="text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('viewPending')}</Card>;
}
```

注意：`highlight` 在 Task 11 未使用会触发 `no-unused-vars` 时，保留在 `extra` 计算中（已使用）。

**实施要点：**
- 控件：报表 IS/BS/CF（缺省 IS）· 口径 按披露/年度/单季（缺省按披露；BS 下"单季"禁用并在 title 写"资产负债表没有单季口径"，切到 BS 时若是单季自动回到按披露）· 期数 8/20/40（缺省 8）· 显示缩放 原值/千/百万/亿（缺省 = Task 7 `scaleFor(币种, 界面语言)`：CNY+zh → 亿，其余货币 → 百万，无币种 → 原值；整合决定：与 Task 7 的同一规则，不另立按币种的规则）· 固定芯片"合并 consolidated"· "导出 CSV"· 管理员可见"管理员：未脱敏视图"开关（打开后同一请求改走 `/api/admin/companies/…`，只有这时 `!` 徽标可能出现）。
- 缩放只作用于 `unitKind='money'` 行；`per_share`、`shares`、`ratio` 行显示原值（`ratio`/单位 `pure` 显示为百分比两位小数）。显示格式化复用 Task 7 `formatDecimalText`/`groupThousands`（四舍五入远离零，**不经浮点**）；原值不四舍五入、只加千分位。
- 网格：首列冻结（`sticky left-0`），列 = 期间键降序（表头两行：`periodEnd` + 期间时长），累计期与单季期同 `periodEnd` 是两列。单元格：事实 → 按钮（打开披露历史）+ 徽标；派生 → 按钮（打开公式抽屉）；`withheld/citation_pending` → "— 待挂接"（title 全文）；`withheld/evidence_incomplete` → "来源记录不完整"；`null` → "—"（title "该期无此概念的可见披露"）。点 withheld 格打开只含原因的抽屉，不请求数据。
- 徽标（描边小方块）：`R` = `isRevision`；`n` = `disclosureSeq>1` 且非修订；`!` = 该格所属 filing `citation='pending'`（公共响应中这样的格已置空，所以只在管理员视图出现）；`U` = `otherUnits`。
- 网格顶部计数条：`withheld.citationPending>0` 与 `withheld.evidenceIncomplete>0` 各一条（文案见消息 `statements.withheldPending/withheldIncomplete`），右侧徽标图例。
- `truncated=true` → 截断错误卡（含"改为 8 期"与"重试"），不渲染网格；`periods` 为空且有 `asOf` → "截至该日尚无可见披露。"；为空且无 `asOf` → "尚无披露事实。"；5xx/其他错误 → 错误卡 + 重试（不回退）。
- 迷你柱：每行行头旁"迷你柱"开关（`< 640px` 隐藏开关与柱行，CSS `hidden sm:…`），打开后在该行下插入一行内联 SVG，柱色 `var(--accent)` 透明度 .55，置空/缺失格画虚线框；表格仍是主视图；SVG 带 `role="img"` 与 `aria-label`。柱高可用 `Number(value)`（仅作图，不作显示文本）。
- CSV 列：`concept,unit,period_key,period_start,period_end,duration,kind,fact_id,filing_id,available_date,value_text,withheld_reason`；`value_text` 原样（不缩放）；文件名 `<ticker>_<statement>_<basis>_<asOf|latest>.csv`。
- 行头按钮 → 概念说明浮层：`sourceConcepts`（逗号分隔）、`notes`（无则"—"）、响应顶层 `mappingGen`；Esc 关闭并把焦点还给行头按钮。
- 披露历史抽屉（§5.6）：请求 `GET /api/companies/[ticker]/facts?concept=&periodStart=&periodEnd=&unit=&asOf=`（管理员视图走 admin 变体；`unit` 必填），INSTANT 的 `periodStart` 传 `periodEnd`；同一响应的 `otherUnitSeries`（Task 9，已过门槛）在"其他单位的事实"表列出非主单位行（整合决定：不再发第二个去掉 `unit` 的请求）。e2e 钩子：可得日期按钮 `data-testid="drawer-available-date"`、变换链列头 `drawer-transform-chain`、代码版本格 `drawer-code-version`。列：可得日期 · 文件（`formType sourceRef`，链接：edgar→`url`，linked→`documentUrl`，pending 标"（引用待挂接）"不链接）· 值·单位（`value_text` 原样 + unit；置空行显示原因文本）· 修订（计划第 3 轮审计 R3：差值取服务端 `entry.delta`（Task 9 的 `decimalSub(本值, 前值)`）按当前缩放显示带符号 + `entry.relChange` 显示为 4 位百分比，前端不重算；首条（`i===0`）"—"；之后 `delta===null`（前一条被扣留）→ "前值已扣留 · 不计差值"；本条被扣留 → 同一扣留标注；非修订 → "0 · 同值"）· 变换链（① 映射 `sourceConcept → concept`（`mappingVersion · gen`）② 单位规则 `unitRule`（null → "原值"）④ 显示缩放 `÷1e8`/不缩放；派生格的 ③ 只在公式抽屉）· 代码版本 `run.codeVersion` 前 7 位。点行选择该行为"证据"区内容（缺省最后一条非置空行）。证据区：rawHash、snapshot（source、sha256、path、api/url、params JSON、"快照首次抓取时间" capturedAt、httpStatus、page）、locator（hashLocator、jsonPointer、field、pdf：page/table/row/column/documentUrl）、sourceDocument 链接、run（runId、codeVersion、toolVersions JSON）、mappingVersion、unitRule、download（非空 → 链接；空 → "null（Tushare 对象不可再分发）"）、回放步骤一句话。底部"复制可复现查询"把请求的绝对 URL 写入剪贴板。
- 公式抽屉：标题 `metric 名 · 期间`，值（比率百分比 / 货币缩放）；公式文本取 `catalogFor(cell.formulaVersion)?.[metric]?.[locale].formula`（Task 7 的目录按 metric 键控，条目形如 `{zh:{formula},en:{formula}}`）（当前语言为主、另一语言为副行；缺失 → "公式文本缺失（formula_version x 不在目录中）"）；kv：basis、inputUnit、formulaVersion、rule（a → "a（同一披露）"，b → "b（均未修订）"，无 → "—"）、asOf（无 → "—（最新）"）、computedAt（`computedAtKind='live'` → "本次请求实时计算"，否则时间串 + "物化时刻"）、basedOnRev；inputs 表每行（概念名、可得日期、filingId 前 8 位）是按钮，打开该 `factId` 的披露历史（先经 `/api/facts/[ticker]?factIds=<id>` 取自然键，**不显示其 value**）。
- 抽屉外壳：`role="dialog" aria-modal="true"`；打开时焦点到关闭按钮；Tab 在抽屉内循环；Esc / 背景点击关闭；关闭后焦点回到打开它的元素；抽屉可叠放（公式 → 输入历史），关闭只关最上层。`< 640px` 为全屏底部抽屉（顶部抓手条），`≥ 640px` 为右侧抽屉（宽 `min(760px,100vw)`）。

```ts
// src/components/company/format.ts
// Display formatting of decimal value_text (plan 2026-11-06 Task 12; spec §5.3, §5.4). Integration
// decision: the scaling, rounding and grouping are Task 7's (src/lib/company/decimal.ts formatDecimalText /
// groupThousands / scaleFor — string/BigInt, half away from zero, never floating point); this file only
// adapts them to the page (exponent-based scale ids, percent display, invalid text passed through).
// value_text itself is never altered; only the display string is derived.
import {formatDecimalText,groupThousands,scaleFor,type DisplayScale} from '@/lib/company/decimal';
export type ScaleId=DisplayScale;
export const SCALES:readonly ScaleId[]=['raw','thousand','million','hundred_million'];
export const SCALE_EXP:Record<ScaleId,number>={raw:0,thousand:3,million:6,hundred_million:8};
export type UnitKind='money'|'shares'|'per_share'|'ratio';

/** Default scale = Task 7 scaleFor(currency, locale) (spec §5.3: CNY + zh → 亿, other money → 百万); no currency → raw. */
export function defaultScale(currency:string|null,locale:'zh'|'en'):ScaleId{return currency===null?'raw':scaleFor(currency,locale);}
export function unitKindOfUnit(unit:string):UnitKind{
 if(unit==='pure')return 'ratio';
 if(unit==='shares')return 'shares';
 if(unit.includes('/'))return 'per_share';
 return 'money';
}
interface Parts{neg:boolean;int:string;frac:string}
function parse(t:string):Parts|null{const m=/^(-?)(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?$/.exec(t);return m?{neg:m[1]==='-',int:m[2],frac:m[3]??''}:null;}
function join(neg:boolean,int:string,frac:string):string{
 const i=int.replace(/^0+(?=\d)/,'')||'0';const zero=/^0*$/.test(i+frac);
 return (neg&&!zero?'-':'')+i+(frac?`.${frac}`:'');
}
/** value / 10^exp exactly (exp < 0 multiplies); trailing fraction zeros are dropped. Invalid input is returned unchanged. */
export function shiftDecimal(t:string,exp:number):string{
 const p=parse(t);if(!p)return t;
 let digits=p.int+p.frac,point=p.int.length-exp;
 if(point<=0){digits='0'.repeat(1-point)+digits;point=1;}
 if(point>digits.length)digits=digits+'0'.repeat(point-digits.length);
 return join(p.neg,digits.slice(0,point),digits.slice(point).replace(/0+$/,''));
}
/** Fixed `d` fraction digits, half away from zero, no negative zero (Task 7 formatDecimalText with divisor 1). */
export function roundDecimal(t:string,d:number):string{
 if(!parse(t))return t;
 return formatDecimalText(t,1n,d);
}
export function groupNumber(t:string):string{return parse(t)?groupThousands(t):t;}
/** value ÷ 10^exp to `digits` places (Task 7 formatDecimalText), grouped; exp 0 = the raw value grouped, unrounded. */
export function formatScaled(t:string,exp:number,digits=2):string{
 if(exp===0||!parse(t))return groupNumber(t);
 return groupThousands(formatDecimalText(t,10n**BigInt(exp),digits));
}
export function formatPercent(t:string,digits=2):string{const s=roundDecimal(shiftDecimal(t,-2),digits);return parse(s)?`${groupNumber(s)}%`:t;}
export function formatValue(t:string,kind:UnitKind,exp:number):string{
 if(kind==='ratio')return formatPercent(t);
 if(kind==='money')return formatScaled(t,exp);
 return groupNumber(t);
}
export const signed=(s:string)=>/^\d/.test(s)&&!/^0(\.0+)?%?$/.test(s)?`+${s}`:s;
export const divisorLabel=(exp:number)=>`1e${exp}`;
```

```ts
// src/components/company/statements-model.ts
// Pure view model of the statements grid (plan 2026-11-06 Task 12; spec §5.3, §5.7).
import type {Cell,FactCell,FilingSummary,GridRow,PeriodCol,WithheldReason} from '@/lib/company/types';
import type {StatementsResponse} from '@/lib/company/client';
import {formatValue,unitKindOfUnit,type UnitKind} from './format';

export type Badge={code:'R'|'n'|'!'|'U';seq?:number};
export type CellView=
 |{kind:'fact';text:string;badges:Badge[];cell:FactCell}
 |{kind:'derived';text:string;cell:Extract<Cell,{kind:'derived'}>}
 |{kind:'withheld';reason:WithheldReason;factId:string}
 |{kind:'missing';otherUnitOnly?:true};

export function badgesOf(c:FactCell,filings:Record<string,FilingSummary>):Badge[]{
 const out:Badge[]=[];
 if(c.isRevision)out.push({code:'R'});else if(c.disclosureSeq>1)out.push({code:'n',seq:c.disclosureSeq});
 if(filings[c.filingId]?.citation==='pending')out.push({code:'!'});
 if(c.otherUnits)out.push({code:'U'});
 return out;
}
const rowKind=(r:GridRow):UnitKind=>r.unitKind;
/** `otherUnitOnly`: Task 7 GridResult.otherUnitOnly lists this period for the row (cell null → "—" + U, spec §5.3). */
export function cellView(c:Cell,row:GridRow,scaleExp:number,filings:Record<string,FilingSummary>,otherUnitOnly=false):CellView{
 if(c===null)return otherUnitOnly?{kind:'missing',otherUnitOnly:true}:{kind:'missing'};
 if(c.kind==='withheld')return {kind:'withheld',reason:c.reason,factId:c.factId};
 if(c.kind==='derived')return {kind:'derived',text:formatValue(c.value,c.unit==='pure'?'ratio':unitKindOfUnit(c.unit),scaleExp),cell:c};
 return {kind:'fact',text:formatValue(c.value,rowKind(row),scaleExp),badges:badgesOf(c,filings),cell:c};
}
export function periodKeyParts(key:string):{periodStart:string;periodEnd:string;duration:string}{
 const [periodStart,periodEnd,duration]=key.split(':');return {periodStart,periodEnd,duration};
}
export function moneyCurrency(rows:GridRow[]):string|null{return rows.find(r=>r.unitKind==='money'&&r.unit)?.unit??null;}
export function gridEmptyState(r:StatementsResponse,asOf:string|null):'before_first'|'empty'|null{
 if(r.periods.length>0&&r.rows.length>0)return null;
 return asOf?'before_first':'empty';
}
const esc=(v:string|number|null|undefined)=>{const s=v==null?'':String(v);return /[",\n\r]/.test(s)?`"${s.replace(/"/g,'""')}"`:s;};
export const CSV_HEADER=['concept','unit','period_key','period_start','period_end','duration','kind','fact_id','filing_id','available_date','value_text','withheld_reason'];
/** Every non-null cell; value_text verbatim (never scaled). */
export function statementsCsv(r:StatementsResponse):string{
 const lines=[CSV_HEADER.join(',')];
 for(const row of r.rows)for(const p of r.periods){
  const c=row.cells[p.key];if(!c)continue;
  const base=[row.concept,row.unit??'',p.key,p.periodStart,p.periodEnd,p.duration];
  if(c.kind==='fact')lines.push([...base,'fact',c.factId,c.filingId,c.availableDate,c.value,''].map(esc).join(','));
  else if(c.kind==='derived')lines.push([...base,'derived','','','',c.value,''].map(esc).join(','));
  else lines.push([...base,'withheld',c.factId,'','','',c.reason].map(esc).join(','));
 }
 return lines.join('\n')+'\n';
}
/** Bar heights only (Number() is used for drawing, never for displayed text). */
export function barSeries(row:GridRow,periods:PeriodCol[]):{key:string;value:number|null;blank:boolean}[]{
 return periods.map(p=>{
  const c=row.cells[p.key];
  if(!c||c.kind==='withheld')return {key:p.key,value:null,blank:true};
  const v=Number(c.value);return Number.isFinite(v)?{key:p.key,value:v,blank:false}:{key:p.key,value:null,blank:true};
 });
}
```

```ts
// src/components/company/drawer-model.ts
// Pure model of the disclosure-history drawer (plan 2026-11-06 Task 12; spec §5.6, §0 #62, #68).
// Revision differences are the server's exact entry.delta / entry.relChange (Task 9), formatted only (计划第 3 轮审计 R3).
import {companyApi,type FactKeyRow,type FactSeriesResponse,type SeriesEntry} from '@/lib/company/client';
import type {EvidenceDto,FilingSummary} from '@/lib/company/types';
import {formatPercent,formatScaled,signed} from './format';

export interface SeriesKey{concept:string;periodStart:string|null;periodEnd:string;unit:string|null}
export type Revision={kind:'first'}|{kind:'same'}|{kind:'withheld'}|{kind:'diff';abs:string;rel:string|null};
export interface DrawerRow{entry:SeriesEntry;valueText:string|null;revision:Revision;codeVersion:string|null;evidence:EvidenceDto|null}

// 计划第 3 轮审计 R3: revision differences come from the server's entry.delta / entry.relChange, which
// Task 9 nulls after a withheld predecessor; the drawer never recomputes across a withheld disclosure.
export function drawerRows(r:FactSeriesResponse,scaleExp:number):DrawerRow[]{
 return r.series.map((entry,i)=>{
  const evidence=r.evidence[entry.factId]??null;
  const codeVersion=evidence?.run.codeVersion?.slice(0,7)??null;
  if(entry.kind==='withheld')return {entry,valueText:null,revision:{kind:'withheld'},codeVersion,evidence};
  let revision:Revision;
  if(i===0)revision={kind:'first'};
  else if(entry.delta===null)revision={kind:'withheld'};
  else if(entry.isRevision)revision={kind:'diff',abs:signed(formatScaled(entry.delta,scaleExp)),rel:entry.relChange===null?null:signed(formatPercent(entry.relChange,4))};
  else revision={kind:'same'};
  return {entry,valueText:entry.value,revision,codeVersion,evidence};
 });
}
/** The evidence block shows the latest non-withheld row by default. */
export function defaultSelected(rows:DrawerRow[]):string|null{
 for(let i=rows.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(rows[i].valueText!==null)return rows[i].entry.factId;
 return null;
}
export function factsRequest(ticker:string,k:SeriesKey,asOf:string|null,admin:boolean):string{
 return companyApi('facts',ticker,{concept:k.concept,periodStart:k.periodStart??k.periodEnd,periodEnd:k.periodEnd,unit:k.unit,asOf},admin);
}
export function keyFromFactRow(f:FactKeyRow):SeriesKey{return {concept:f.concept,periodStart:f.periodStart??f.periodEnd,periodEnd:f.periodEnd,unit:f.unit};}
export function filingLink(f:FilingSummary|undefined|null):string|null{
 if(!f)return null;
 if(f.citation==='edgar')return f.url;
 if(f.citation==='linked')return f.documentUrl;
 return null;
}
const str=(v:unknown)=>v==null?'—':typeof v==='object'?JSON.stringify(v):String(v);
export function evidenceFields(d:EvidenceDto):[string,string][]{
 const pdf=d.locator.pdf;
 return [
  ['rawHash',d.rawHash],['snapshot.source',d.snapshot.source],['snapshot.sha256',d.snapshot.sha256],['snapshot.path',d.snapshot.path],
  ['snapshot.api',str(d.snapshot.api)],['snapshot.url',str(d.snapshot.url)],['snapshot.params',str(d.snapshot.params)],['snapshot.capturedAt',str(d.snapshot.capturedAt)],
  ['snapshot.httpStatus',str(d.snapshot.httpStatus)],['snapshot.page',str(d.snapshot.page)],
  ['locator.hashLocator',d.locator.hashLocator],['locator.jsonPointer',d.locator.jsonPointer],['locator.field',str(d.locator.field)],
  ['locator.pdf',pdf?`page ${pdf.page} · ${pdf.table??'—'} · ${pdf.row} · ${pdf.column}`:'—'],
  ['run.runId',d.run.runId],['run.codeVersion',str(d.run.codeVersion)],['run.toolVersions',str(d.run.toolVersions)],
  ['mappingVersion',d.mappingVersion],['unitRule',str(d.unitRule)],
 ];
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

export function Seg<T extends string | number>({ label, value, options, onChange }: {
  label: string; value: T; options: { value: T; label: string; disabled?: boolean; title?: string }[]; onChange: (v: T) => void;
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/DrawerShell.tsx
'use client';
// Accessible drawer shell (plan 2026-11-06 Task 12; spec §5.9, §14; canvas Drawer / M-Drawer): modal
// dialog, focus on open, Tab trapped, Esc / backdrop close; full-screen bottom sheet under 640px,
// right drawer above. Focus return to the opener is handled by DrawerHost.
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';

const FOCUSABLE = 'a[href],button:not([disabled]),input,select,textarea,[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';

export function DrawerShell({ label, kicker, title, onClose, children }: {
  label: string; kicker: string; title: React.ReactNode; onClose: () => void; children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.drawer');
  const panel = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const closeBtn = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => { closeBtn.current?.focus(); }, []);
  function onKeyDown(e: React.KeyboardEvent) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.stopPropagation(); onClose(); return; }
    if (e.key !== 'Tab' || !panel.current) return;
    const items = Array.from(panel.current.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE));
    if (items.length === 0) return;
    const first = items[0], last = items[items.length - 1];
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  }
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-end sm:items-stretch sm:justify-end" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>
      <div aria-hidden className="absolute inset-0 bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--bg)_70%,transparent)]" onClick={onClose} />
      <div ref={panel} role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label={label}
        className="relative flex h-[100dvh] w-full flex-col overflow-y-auto border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-elevated)] sm:h-full sm:w-[min(760px,100vw)] sm:border-l">
        <div aria-hidden className="mx-auto mt-2 h-1 w-10 rounded-full bg-[var(--text-muted)] sm:hidden" />
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 border-b border-[var(--border)] px-4 py-3">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--accent)]">{kicker}</div>
            <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold">{title}</div>
          </div>
          <button ref={closeBtn} type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label={t('close')}
            className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-[var(--text-dim)] hover:bg-[var(--accent-wash)] focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--accent)]">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" aria-hidden><path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" /></svg>
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 p-4">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/MiniBars.tsx
'use client';
// Inline bars of one grid row (plan 2026-11-06 Task 12; spec §5.3): the table stays primary; withheld
// or missing cells are dashed outlines; negative values hang below the zero line.
export function MiniBars({ series, label }: { series: { key: string; value: number | null; blank: boolean }[]; label: string }) {
  const w = 100, h = 46, pad = 15;
  const vals = series.map((s) => s.value).filter((v): v is number => v !== null);
  const max = Math.max(0, ...vals), min = Math.min(0, ...vals);
  const span = max - min || 1;
  const zero = h * (max / span);
  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${series.length * w} ${h}`} width="100%" height={h} role="img" aria-label={label} preserveAspectRatio="none">
      <line x1={0} x2={series.length * w} y1={zero} y2={zero} stroke="var(--border)" />
      {series.map((s, i) => {
        if (s.value === null) return <rect key={s.key} x={i * w + pad} y={h - 6} width={w - 2 * pad} height={6} fill="none" stroke="var(--text-muted)" strokeDasharray="3 3" />;
        const bh = Math.max(1, (Math.abs(s.value) / span) * h);
        return <rect key={s.key} x={i * w + pad} y={s.value >= 0 ? zero - bh : zero} width={w - 2 * pad} height={bh} fill="var(--accent)" fillOpacity={0.55} />;
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/DrawerHost.tsx
'use client';
// Drawer stack of the company page (plan 2026-11-06 Task 12): any view opens a disclosure-history,
// withheld-reason or formula drawer; drawers stack (formula → input history); closing pops the top
// and returns focus to the element that opened it.
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { DerivedCell, WithheldReason } from '@/lib/company/types';
import type { SeriesKey } from './drawer-model';
import { DisclosureDrawer, WithheldDrawer } from './DisclosureDrawer';
import { FormulaDrawer } from './FormulaDrawer';

export type DrawerTarget =
  | { kind: 'history'; key: SeriesKey; duration: string; otherUnits: boolean; scaleExp: number }
  | { kind: 'historyByFact'; factId: string; scaleExp: number }
  | { kind: 'withheld'; reason: WithheldReason; title: string }
  | { kind: 'formula'; metric: string; cell: DerivedCell; periodLabel: string; computedAt: string | null; computedAtKind: 'materialized' | 'live'; basedOnRev: number | null; scaleExp: number };

interface Ctx { open: (t: DrawerTarget) => void }
const DrawerCtx = createContext<Ctx>({ open: () => {} });
export const useDrawers = () => useContext(DrawerCtx);

export function DrawerHost({ ticker, asOf, admin, children }: { ticker: string; asOf: string | null; admin: boolean; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [stack, setStack] = useState<DrawerTarget[]>([]);
  const openers = useRef<(HTMLElement | null)[]>([]);
  const open = useCallback((t: DrawerTarget) => {
    openers.current.push(document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null);
    setStack((s) => [...s, t]);
  }, []);
  const close = useCallback(() => {
    const el = openers.current.pop();
    setStack((s) => s.slice(0, -1));
    requestAnimationFrame(() => el?.focus());
  }, []);
  const top = stack[stack.length - 1];
  return (
    <DrawerCtx.Provider value={{ open }}>
      {children}
      {top?.kind === 'history' && <DisclosureDrawer ticker={ticker} asOf={asOf} admin={admin} target={top} onClose={close} />}
      {top?.kind === 'historyByFact' && <DisclosureDrawer ticker={ticker} asOf={asOf} admin={admin} target={top} onClose={close} />}
      {top?.kind === 'withheld' && <WithheldDrawer reason={top.reason} title={top.title} onClose={close} />}
      {top?.kind === 'formula' && <FormulaDrawer asOf={asOf} target={top} onClose={close} onOpenInput={(factId) => open({ kind: 'historyByFact', factId, scaleExp: top.scaleExp })} />}
    </DrawerCtx.Provider>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/DisclosureDrawer.tsx
'use client';
// Disclosure-history drawer (plan 2026-11-06 Task 12; spec §5.6, §0 #62, #68; canvas Drawer A/D/E,
// M-Drawer): the full series of one natural key, ascending, from /api/companies/[ticker]/facts with
// its evidence; a fact id is first resolved to its key through spec-2 /api/facts?factIds= (value unused).
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';
import type { FactIdsResponse, FactSeriesResponse } from '@/lib/company/client';
import type { WithheldReason } from '@/lib/company/types';
import { useCompanyFetch } from './useCompanyFetch';
import { DrawerShell } from './DrawerShell';
import { defaultSelected, drawerRows, evidenceFields, factsRequest, filingLink, keyFromFactRow, type SeriesKey } from './drawer-model';
import { divisorLabel, formatScaled, groupNumber } from './format';
import type { DrawerTarget } from './DrawerHost';

type HistoryTarget = Extract<DrawerTarget, { kind: 'history' | 'historyByFact' }>;

export function WithheldDrawer({ reason, title, onClose }: { reason: WithheldReason; title: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.drawer');
  return (
    <DrawerShell label={t('historyTitle')} kicker={t('historyTitle')} title={title} onClose={onClose}>
      <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('withheldOnly', { reason: reason === 'citation_pending' ? t('reasonPending') : t('reasonIncomplete') })}</p>
    </DrawerShell>
  );
}

export function DisclosureDrawer({ ticker, asOf, admin, target, onClose }: { ticker: string; asOf: string | null; admin: boolean; target: HistoryTarget; onClose: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.drawer');
  const byFact = useCompanyFetch<FactIdsResponse>(target.kind === 'historyByFact' ? `/api/facts/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}?factIds=${target.factId}` : null).state;
  const key: SeriesKey | null = target.kind === 'history' ? target.key
    : byFact.status === 'ok' && byFact.data.facts[0] ? keyFromFactRow(byFact.data.facts[0]) : null;
  const otherUnits = target.kind === 'history' && target.otherUnits;
  if (target.kind === 'historyByFact' && byFact.status === 'error') {
    return <DrawerShell label={t('historyTitle')} kicker={t('historyTitle')} title="—" onClose={onClose}><p className="text-sm">{t('loadFailed', { code: byFact.code })}</p></DrawerShell>;
  }
  return <SeriesDrawer ticker={ticker} asOf={asOf} admin={admin} seriesKey={key} otherUnits={otherUnits} scaleExp={target.scaleExp} onClose={onClose} />;
}

function SeriesDrawer({ ticker, asOf, admin, seriesKey, otherUnits, scaleExp, onClose }: {
  ticker: string; asOf: string | null; admin: boolean; seriesKey: SeriesKey | null; otherUnits: boolean; scaleExp: number; onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.drawer');
  const tc = useTranslations('company.concepts');
  const tf = useTranslations('company.filings.types');
  const url = seriesKey ? factsRequest(ticker, seriesKey, asOf, admin) : null;
  const main = useCompanyFetch<FactSeriesResponse>(url).state;
  const rows = useMemo(() => (main.status === 'ok' ? drawerRows(main.data, scaleExp) : []), [main, scaleExp]);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const sel = selected ?? defaultSelected(rows);
  const selRow = rows.find((r) => r.entry.factId === sel) ?? null;
  const last = rows.length ? rows[rows.length - 1] : null;
  const money = seriesKey && !/\//.test(seriesKey.unit ?? '') && seriesKey.unit !== 'shares' && seriesKey.unit !== 'pure';
  const exp = money ? scaleExp : 0;
  const label = seriesKey ? `${tc.has(seriesKey.concept) ? tc(seriesKey.concept) : seriesKey.concept} ${seriesKey.concept}` : '…';
  const title = seriesKey ? `${label} · ${seriesKey.periodStart ?? seriesKey.periodEnd} → ${seriesKey.periodEnd}` : '…';
  const formLabel = (form: string) => (tf.has(form) ? tf(form) : form);

  return (
    <DrawerShell label={t('historyTitle')} kicker={t('historyTitle')} title={title} onClose={onClose}>
      {main.status === 'loading' || main.status === 'idle' ? <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">…</p> : null}
      {main.status === 'error' && <p role="alert" className="text-sm">{t('loadFailed', { code: main.code })}</p>}
      {main.status === 'ok' && (
        <>
          {last?.valueText && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="num text-2xl font-medium">{formatScaled(last.valueText, exp)}</span>
              <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{last.entry.unit} · {exp ? t('displayTransform', { divisor: divisorLabel(exp) }) : t('displayRaw')}</span>
              {last.entry.isRevision && <span className="num rounded-sm border border-[var(--border)] px-1 text-[10px]">R</span>}
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('series')}</div>
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[640px] text-xs">
              <thead className="text-left text-[var(--text-dim)]">
                <tr><th className="py-1.5 pr-2">{t('colAvailable')}</th><th className="pr-2">{t('colFiling')}</th><th className="pr-2 text-right">{t('colValue')}</th><th className="pr-2 text-right">{t('colRevision')}</th><th className="pr-2" data-testid="drawer-transform-chain">{t('colTransforms')}</th><th>{t('colCode')}</th></tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.map((r) => {
                  const f = main.data.filings[r.entry.filingId];
                  const link = filingLink(f);
                  const ev = r.evidence;
                  return (
                    <tr key={r.entry.factId} aria-selected={r.entry.factId === sel}
                      className={`border-t border-[var(--border)] ${r.entry.factId === sel ? 'bg-[var(--accent-wash)]' : ''}`}>
                      <td className="num py-1.5 pr-2">
                        <button type="button" onClick={() => setSelected(r.entry.factId)} className="num underline-offset-2 hover:underline" data-testid="drawer-available-date">{r.entry.availableDate}</button>
                      </td>
                      <td className="pr-2">
                        {f ? (link
                          ? <a href={link} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{formLabel(f.formType)} {f.sourceRef} ↗</a>
                          : <span>{formLabel(f.formType)} {f.sourceRef} <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{f.citation === 'pending' ? t('pendingFiling') : ''}</span></span>) : '—'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="num pr-2 text-right">
                        {r.valueText !== null ? `${groupNumber(r.valueText)} ${r.entry.unit}` : <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{r.entry.kind === 'withheld' && r.entry.reason === 'citation_pending' ? t('reasonPending') : t('reasonIncomplete')}</span>}
                      </td>
                      <td className="num pr-2 text-right">
                        {/* 计划第 3 轮审计 R3: explicit withheld branch, never falls through to firstDisclosure */}
                        {r.revision.kind === 'diff' ? `${r.revision.abs}${r.revision.rel ? ` · ${r.revision.rel}` : ''}`
                          : r.revision.kind === 'same' ? t('sameValue')
                          : r.revision.kind === 'withheld' ? <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]" data-testid="drawer-revision-withheld">{t('revisionWithheld')}</span>
                          : t('firstDisclosure')}
                      </td>
                      <td className="pr-2 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">
                        {t('tMap', { source: r.entry.sourceConcept, concept: main.data.concept, version: r.entry.mappingVersion, gen: r.entry.mappingGen })}{' '}
                        {ev?.unitRule ? t('tUnit', { rule: ev.unitRule }) : t('tUnitNone')}{' '}
                        {exp ? t('tScale', { divisor: divisorLabel(exp) }) : t('tScaleNone')}
                      </td>
                      <td className="num text-[var(--text-dim)]" data-testid="drawer-code-version">{r.codeVersion ?? '—'}</td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {(otherUnits || main.data.otherUnitSeries.length > 0) && main.data.otherUnitSeries.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <div className="mb-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('otherUnits')}</div>
              <table className="w-full text-xs"><tbody>
                {main.data.otherUnitSeries.map((s) => (
                  <tr key={s.factId} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]">
                    <td className="num py-1">{s.unit}</td><td className="num text-right">{s.kind === 'fact' ? groupNumber(s.value) : '—'}</td>
                    <td className="num pl-2">{s.availableDate}</td><td className="pl-2 text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('unitOther')}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody></table>
            </div>
          )}

          <section className="rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-card)] p-3">
            <div className="mb-2 flex items-center gap-2"><span className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('evidence')}</span><span className="ml-auto text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('evidenceNote')}</span></div>
            {selRow?.evidence ? (
              <>
                <dl className="grid grid-cols-[150px_1fr] gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs">
                  {evidenceFields(selRow.evidence).map(([k, v]) => (
                    <div key={k} className="contents"><dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{k === 'snapshot.capturedAt' ? `${k} · ${t('capturedAt')}` : k}</dt><dd className="num break-all">{v}</dd></div>
                  ))}
                  <dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">sourceDocument</dt>
                  <dd>{selRow.evidence.sourceDocument ? <a href={selRow.evidence.sourceDocument.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">{selRow.evidence.sourceDocument.kind} ↗</a> : '—'}</dd>
                  <dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">download</dt>
                  <dd>{selRow.evidence.snapshot.download ? <a className="num" href={selRow.evidence.snapshot.download}>{selRow.evidence.snapshot.download}</a> : t('downloadNull')}</dd>
                </dl>
                <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('replaySteps')}</p>
              </>
            ) : <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('evidenceMissing')}</p>}
          </section>

          {url && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => { void navigator.clipboard?.writeText(`${window.location.origin}${url}`).then(() => setCopied(true)); }}>
                {copied ? t('copied') : t('copyQuery')}
              </Button>
              <code className="break-all text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{url}</code>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </DrawerShell>
  );
}
```

（`tc.has` / `tf.has` 是 next-intl 4 的 API。`DrawerHost` 与两个抽屉文件之间只有类型级循环引用，运行时无环。）

```tsx
// src/components/company/FormulaDrawer.tsx
'use client';
// Formula drawer for derived cells (plan 2026-11-06 Task 12; spec §5.4, §5.6; canvas Drawer B).
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { catalogFor } from '@/lib/company/metric-catalog';
import { DrawerShell } from './DrawerShell';
import { formatValue, unitKindOfUnit } from './format';
import type { DrawerTarget } from './DrawerHost';

export function FormulaDrawer({ asOf, target, onClose, onOpenInput }: {
  asOf: string | null; target: Extract<DrawerTarget, { kind: 'formula' }>; onClose: () => void; onOpenInput: (factId: string) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.drawer');
  const tm = useTranslations('company.metrics.names');
  const tc = useTranslations('company.concepts');
  const locale = useLocale() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh';
  const { cell, metric } = target;
  const entry = catalogFor(cell.formulaVersion)?.[metric];
  const name = tm.has(metric) ? tm(metric) : metric;
  const value = formatValue(cell.value, cell.unit === 'pure' ? 'ratio' : unitKindOfUnit(cell.unit), target.scaleExp);
  const rows: [string, string][] = [
    [t('basis'), cell.basis], [t('inputUnit'), cell.inputUnit], [t('formulaVersion'), cell.formulaVersion],
    [t('rule'), cell.rule === 'a' ? t('ruleA') : cell.rule === 'b' ? t('ruleB') : '—'],
    [t('asOf'), asOf ?? t('asOfLatest')],
    [t('computedAt'), target.computedAtKind === 'live' ? t('computedLive') : `${target.computedAt ?? '—'} · ${t('computedMaterialized')}`],
    [t('basedOnRev'), target.basedOnRev === null ? '—' : String(target.basedOnRev)],
  ];
  return (
    <DrawerShell label={t('formulaTitle')} kicker={t('formulaTitle')} title={`${name} ${metric} · ${target.periodLabel}`} onClose={onClose}>
      <div className="num text-2xl font-medium">{value}</div>
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-card)] p-3 text-sm">
        {entry ? (<>{entry[locale].formula}<div className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{entry[locale === 'zh' ? 'en' : 'zh'].formula}</div></>)
          : <span className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('formulaMissing', { version: cell.formulaVersion })}</span>}
      </div>
      <dl className="grid grid-cols-[120px_1fr] gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-xs">
        {rows.map(([k, v]) => <div key={k} className="contents"><dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{k}</dt><dd className="num">{v}</dd></div>)}
      </dl>
      <div>
        <div className="mb-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('inputs')}</div>
        <table className="w-full text-xs"><tbody>
          {cell.inputs.map((i) => (
            <tr key={i.factId} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]">
              <td className="py-1.5">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => onOpenInput(i.factId)} className="text-left text-[var(--accent)] underline-offset-2 hover:underline focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--accent)]">
                  {tc.has(i.concept) ? tc(i.concept) : i.concept} <span className="num text-[var(--text-dim)]">{i.concept}</span>
                </button>
              </td>
              <td className="num text-[var(--text-dim)]">{i.availableDate}</td>
              <td className="num text-[var(--text-dim)]">{i.filingId.slice(0, 8)}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody></table>
        <p className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('inputsNote')}</p>
      </div>
    </DrawerShell>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/ConceptPopover.tsx
'use client';
// Concept notes popover from a row header (plan 2026-11-06 Task 12; spec §5.3; canvas Drawer C).
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import type { GridRow } from '@/lib/company/types';

export function ConceptPopover({ row, mappingGen, label, onClose }: { row: GridRow; mappingGen: number; label: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.drawer');
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => { ref.current?.focus(); }, []);
  return (
    <div ref={ref} tabIndex={-1} role="dialog" aria-label={t('conceptTitle')}
      onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.stopPropagation(); onClose(); } }}
      onBlur={(e) => { if (!e.currentTarget.contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) onClose(); }}
      className="absolute left-2 top-full z-30 mt-1 w-[300px] rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-elevated)] p-3 text-xs shadow-[var(--shadow)] focus:outline-none">
      <div className="text-[10px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--accent)]">{t('conceptTitle')}</div>
      <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold">{label} <span className="num text-[var(--text-dim)]">{row.concept}</span></div>
      <dl className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-[110px_1fr] gap-x-2 gap-y-1">
        <dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('sourceConcepts')}</dt><dd className="num break-all">{row.sourceConcepts.join(', ') || '—'}</dd>
        <dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('mappingGen')}</dt><dd className="num">{mappingGen}</dd>
        <dt className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('notes')}</dt><dd>{row.notes ?? t('noNotes')}</dd>
      </dl>
    </div>
  );
}
```
