```tsx
// src/components/company/StatementsView.tsx
'use client';
// Statements view (plan 2026-11-06 Task 12; spec §5.3, §5.7, §5.9; canvas Main, Replay, M-Company, States).
// Table is the primary view; values are display strings from value_text; withheld cells never show a value.
import { Fragment, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Button, Tag } from '@/components/ui';
import { companyApi, companyHref, type StatementsResponse } from '@/lib/company/client';
import type { Basis, GridRow, PeriodCol, StatementKind } from '@/lib/company/types';
import { useCompanyFetch } from './useCompanyFetch';
import { Seg } from './Seg';
import { useDrawers } from './DrawerHost';
import { ConceptPopover } from './ConceptPopover';
import { MiniBars } from './MiniBars';
import { Callout, ErrorCard, LoadingGrid, TruncatedCard } from './StateCallout';
import { SCALES, SCALE_EXP, defaultScale, type ScaleId } from './format';
import { barSeries, cellView, gridEmptyState, moneyCurrency, statementsCsv, type Badge } from './statements-model';

const PERIODS = [8, 20, 40] as const;
const SCALE_KEYS: Record<ScaleId, string> = { raw: 'scaleRaw', thousand: 'scaleThousand', million: 'scaleMillion', hundred_million: 'scaleHundredMillion' };

function BadgeMark({ b }: { b: Badge }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.badges');
  const title = b.code === 'R' ? t('R') : b.code === 'n' ? t('n', { seq: b.seq ?? 2 }) : b.code === 'U' ? t('U') : t('pending');
  return (
    <span title={title} aria-label={title}
      className={`num ml-1 inline-flex h-4 min-w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-sm border px-0.5 text-[10px] leading-none ${b.code === '!' ? 'border-[var(--warn)] text-[var(--warn)]' : 'border-[var(--border)] text-[var(--text-dim)]'}`}>
      {b.code}
    </span>
  );
}

export function StatementsView({ ticker, asOf, isAdmin, highlight }: { ticker: string; asOf: string | null; isAdmin: boolean; highlight: string | null }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.statements');
  const ts = useTranslations('company.states');
  const tc = useTranslations('company.concepts');
  const td = useTranslations('company.durations');
  const tab = useTranslations('company.tabs');
  const router = useRouter();
  const drawers = useDrawers();
  const [statement, setStatement] = useState<StatementKind>('IS');
  const [basis, setBasis] = useState<Basis>('disclosed');
  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState<(typeof PERIODS)[number]>(8);
  const [scale, setScale] = useState<ScaleId | null>(null);
  const [adminView, setAdminView] = useState(false);
  const [bars, setBars] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [popover, setPopover] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const headRefs = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLButtonElement>());

  const url = companyApi('statements', ticker, { statement, basis, periods: String(periods), asOf }, isAdmin && adminView);
  const { state, retry } = useCompanyFetch<StatementsResponse>(url);
  const data = state.status === 'ok' ? state.data : null;
  const locale = useLocale() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh';
  const scaleId = scale ?? defaultScale(data ? moneyCurrency(data.rows) : null, locale);
  const exp = SCALE_EXP[scaleId];
  const label = (c: string) => (tc.has(c) ? tc(c) : c);
  const durLabel = (d: string) => (td.has(d) ? td(d) : d);

  function pickStatement(s: StatementKind) { setStatement(s); if (s === 'BS' && basis === 'quarterly') setBasis('disclosed'); }
  function exportCsv(r: StatementsResponse) {
    const blob = new Blob([statementsCsv(r)], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = `${ticker}_${r.statement}_${r.basis}_${asOf ?? 'latest'}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
  }
  function openCell(row: GridRow, p: PeriodCol) {
    const v = cellView(row.cells[p.key] ?? null, row, exp, data?.filings ?? {});
    const title = `${label(row.concept)} · ${p.periodEnd} ${durLabel(p.duration)}`;
    if (v.kind === 'fact') {
      drawers.open({ kind: 'history', key: { concept: row.concept, periodStart: p.periodStart, periodEnd: p.periodEnd, unit: v.cell.unit }, duration: p.duration, otherUnits: v.cell.otherUnits, scaleExp: row.unitKind === 'money' ? exp : 0 });
    } else if (v.kind === 'derived') {
      drawers.open({ kind: 'formula', metric: v.cell.metric, cell: v.cell, periodLabel: `${p.periodEnd} ${durLabel(p.duration)}`, computedAt: null, computedAtKind: 'live', basedOnRev: data?.stateRev ?? null, scaleExp: exp });
    } else if (v.kind === 'withheld') {
      drawers.open({ kind: 'withheld', reason: v.reason, title });
    }
  }
  function closePopover(concept: string) { setPopover(null); requestAnimationFrame(() => headRefs.current.get(concept)?.focus()); }

  const hl = highlight && data?.filings[highlight];

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
        <Seg label={t('statement')} value={statement} onChange={pickStatement}
          options={(['IS', 'BS', 'CF'] as const).map((s) => ({ value: s, label: t(s) }))} />
        <Seg label={t('basis')} value={basis} onChange={setBasis}
          options={[{ value: 'disclosed' as Basis, label: t('disclosed') }, { value: 'annual' as Basis, label: t('annual') },
            { value: 'quarterly' as Basis, label: t('quarterly'), disabled: statement === 'BS', title: statement === 'BS' ? t('quarterlyBsDisabled') : undefined }]} />
        <Seg label={t('periods')} value={periods} onChange={setPeriods} options={PERIODS.map((n) => ({ value: n, label: String(n) }))} />
        <Seg label={t('scale')} value={scaleId} onChange={setScale} options={SCALES.map((s) => ({ value: s, label: t(SCALE_KEYS[s]) }))} />
        <Tag>{t('consolidated')}</Tag>
        {isAdmin && (
          <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[var(--accent)]">
            <input type="checkbox" checked={adminView} onChange={(e) => setAdminView(e.target.checked)} />{t('adminToggle')}
          </label>
        )}
        <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" className="sm:ml-auto" disabled={!data || data.truncated} onClick={() => data && exportCsv(data)}>{t('exportCsv')}</Button>
      </div>

      {hl && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
          <Tag tone="accent">{t('highlight', { label: `${hl.formType} ${hl.sourceRef}` })}</Tag>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => router.push(companyHref(ticker, { view: 'statements', asOf }) as never)}>{t('clearHighlight')}</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {(state.status === 'loading' || state.status === 'idle') && <LoadingGrid />}
      {state.status === 'error' && <ErrorCard message={ts('routeError', { view: tab('statements'), code: state.code })} onRetry={retry} />}
      {data && data.truncated && <TruncatedCard onRetry={retry} onEightPeriods={periods === 8 ? undefined : () => setPeriods(8)} />}
      {data && !data.truncated && gridEmptyState(data, asOf) && <Callout>{gridEmptyState(data, asOf) === 'before_first' ? ts('beforeFirst') : t('empty')}</Callout>}

      {data && !data.truncated && !gridEmptyState(data, asOf) && (
        <>
          {(data.withheld.citationPending > 0 || data.withheld.evidenceIncomplete > 0) && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] px-3 py-2 text-xs">
              {data.withheld.citationPending > 0 && <span><span aria-hidden className="mr-2 inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--warn)]" />{t('withheldPending', { n: data.withheld.citationPending })}</span>}
              {data.withheld.evidenceIncomplete > 0 && <span><span aria-hidden className="mr-2 inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--warn)]" />{t('withheldIncomplete', { n: data.withheld.evidenceIncomplete })}</span>}
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('badgeLegend')}</div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-card)]">
            <table className="w-max min-w-full text-sm">
              <thead>
                <tr className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">
                  <th scope="col" className="sticky left-0 z-10 min-w-[160px] bg-[var(--bg-card)] px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium sm:min-w-[220px]">{t('conceptHeader')}</th>
                  {data.periods.map((p) => (
                    <th key={p.key} scope="col" className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-medium">
                      <span className="num block text-[var(--text)]">{p.periodEnd}</span><span className="block text-[11px]">{durLabel(p.duration)}</span>
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {data.rows.map((row) => (
                  <Fragment key={row.concept}>
                    <tr className="border-t border-[var(--border)]" data-testid={`grid-row-${row.concept}`}>
                      <th scope="row" className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-[var(--bg-card)] px-3 py-1.5 text-left font-normal">
                        <div className="relative flex items-center gap-2">
                          <button type="button" ref={(el) => { if (el) headRefs.current.set(row.concept, el); }}
                            onClick={() => setPopover(popover === row.concept ? null : row.concept)} aria-expanded={popover === row.concept}
                            className="text-left focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--accent)]">
                            {label(row.concept)}
                            <span className="num block text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{row.concept}{row.unit ? ` · ${row.unit}` : ''}</span>
                          </button>
                          <button type="button" aria-pressed={bars.has(row.concept)}
                            onClick={() => setBars((s) => { const n = new Set(s); if (n.has(row.concept)) n.delete(row.concept); else n.add(row.concept); return n; })}
                            className={`hidden rounded-full border px-2 text-[10px] sm:inline-flex ${bars.has(row.concept) ? 'border-[var(--accent)] text-[var(--accent)]' : 'border-[var(--border)] text-[var(--text-dim)]'}`}>
                            {t('miniBars')}
                          </button>
                          {popover === row.concept && <ConceptPopover row={row} mappingGen={data.mappingGen} label={label(row.concept)} onClose={() => closePopover(row.concept)} />}
                        </div>
                      </th>
                      {data.periods.map((p) => {
                        const v = cellView(row.cells[p.key] ?? null, row, exp, data.filings, data.otherUnitOnly[row.concept]?.includes(p.key) ?? false);
                        const isHl = !!highlight && v.kind === 'fact' && v.cell.filingId === highlight;
                        return (
                          <td key={p.key} className={`num whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-1.5 text-right ${isHl ? 'bg-[var(--accent-wash)]' : ''}`}>
                            {v.kind === 'missing' && <span className="text-[var(--text-muted)]" title={t('cellMissingTitle')}>—</span>}
                            {v.kind === 'missing' && v.otherUnitOnly && <BadgeMark b={{ code: 'U' }} />}
                            {v.kind === 'withheld' && (
                              <button type="button" onClick={() => openCell(row, p)} className="text-[var(--text-dim)]" data-testid={`cell-${row.concept}-${p.key}`}
                                title={v.reason === 'citation_pending' ? t('cellPendingTitle') : t('cellIncompleteTitle')}>
                                {v.reason === 'citation_pending' ? t('cellPending') : t('cellIncomplete')}
                              </button>
                            )}
                            {(v.kind === 'fact' || v.kind === 'derived') && (
                              <button type="button" onClick={() => openCell(row, p)} data-testid={`cell-${row.concept}-${p.key}`}
                                aria-label={`${label(row.concept)} ${p.periodEnd} ${durLabel(p.duration)} ${v.text}`}
                                className="underline decoration-dotted underline-offset-4 hover:text-[var(--accent)] focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--accent)]">
                                {v.text}
                              </button>
                            )}
                            {v.kind === 'fact' && v.badges.map((b) => <BadgeMark key={b.code} b={b} />)}
                          </td>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tr>
                    {bars.has(row.concept) && (
                      <tr className="hidden sm:table-row">
                        <td className="sticky left-0 bg-[var(--bg-card)] px-3 text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('miniBarsNote')}</td>
                        <td colSpan={data.periods.length} className="px-3 py-1.5">
                          <MiniBars series={barSeries(row, data.periods)} label={t('miniBarsAria', { concept: label(row.concept) })} />
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                  </Fragment>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('footnote')}</p>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**实施要点：**
- **指标视图**：数据只来自 `GET /api/companies/[ticker]/metrics?asOf=`（本页从不直接调用规格二 `/metrics`）。行 = `metricNames(market)` 的全部指标（顺序照抄；响应里出现但不在列表中的指标按名字追加；计划第 3 轮审计 R6：同一指标按 `(metric, inputUnit, basis)` 分成多行，不同输入货币/口径不互相覆盖，行头副行显示 `metric · inputUnit · basis`），列 = 期间键 `periodStart:periodEnd:duration` 按 `periodEnd` 降序、同 `periodEnd` 按键升序，裁到期数 8/20/40（计划第 3 轮审计 R5：请求带 `periods`，服务端按最新 N 期间键返回全部指标行）。比率（`unit='pure'`）显示百分比两位小数；货币按缩放；股数原值。置空格同报表（"— 待挂接" / "来源记录不完整"）；无条目的格显示"未产出"，title 固定为"缺输入、单位不一致、分母为 0、期间匹配不唯一或版本不一致（规格二 §8）"——不推断具体原因。顶部芯片：无 `asOf` → "读物化表 · basedOnRev {rev} · formula_version {v}"；有 `asOf` → "回放：实时派生 · formula_version {v}"。`stale=true` → 只显示"指标待重算：物化后事实可见性已变化，稍后自动重算。不显示旧值。"（不是"未产出"、不显示表）；`truncated` → 截断卡。行头与每格点击打开公式抽屉（`computedAt`、`computedAtKind` 来自条目/响应）。
- **估值模型区**：在指标表下方，灰色分隔线"以下不是事实 · Below is a model, not facts"，标题"估值模型"+芯片"假设含模型/默认/用户估计；不是事实"，内容 `<DcfStudio ticker={ticker} onOpenFact={…} />`（Task 14 已改为不挂载即运行、带股权桥面板；`onOpenFact` 打开该事实的披露历史抽屉）；回放模式下整块替换为"回放模式下不运行估值模型"。e2e 钩子：估值区 `data-testid="valuation-section"`、指标行 `metric-row-<metric>`（同一指标多个输入货币/口径时第一行仍是该名，其余为 `metric-row-<metric>-<n>`，计划第 3 轮审计 R6）、文件行 `filing-row`。
- **文件视图**：`GET /api/companies/[ticker]/filings?asOf=`（Task 11 的路由，已按 `available_date ≤ asOf` 与 `mapping_gen>0` 过滤）。分组"定期报告"表：可得日期 · 类型（CN：`annual` 年报 / `semiannual` 半年报 / `q1` 一季报 / `q3` 三季报 / `restatement` 更正 / 其他；US 原样 `10-K` 等）· 财期（`fiscalYear fiscalPeriod`）· `period_end` · 来源（`EDGAR` / `Tushare → 巨潮`）· 引用徽标（`edgar` → 链接 `url` "edgar · 索引页 ↗"；`linked` → 链接 `documentUrl` "linked · 巨潮 PDF ↗"；`pending` → 灰色"巨潮公告未挂接"，`linkAttempts ≥ 5` → 警示色"挂接失败，待人工（n 次）"）· 事实数 · 操作："在报表中高亮"（跳到 `?view=statements&highlight=<filingId>`，保留 `asOf`）、"原文 ↗"（只在有可链接 URL 时出现；`NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPANY_F3_DRAWER` 关或 F3 组件未接入 → `target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"` 打开 `documentUrl ?? url`；开且已接入 → 打开 `<SourceDrawerAdapter filingId>`）。表后分组"纪要与其他"：只有"待文档管道（F3）。"。
- **概览视图**（决策 J：无 K 线、无行情卡、无 PE/PB/ROE/股息率/市值卡）：左列"最新财期速览"卡（`overview.latest`：CN 用 `revenue_operating`、US 用 `revenue`，加 `net_income_parent`、`operating_cash_flow`、派生 `gross_margin`、`revenue_yoy`；每个值是打开抽屉的按钮；期间芯片 `periodStart → periodEnd · duration`；脚注"同一信封 · state_rev {rev}"；同比用中性色与 `+`/`-` 符号，不用涨跌色）+"最近事件"三条（`新文件` → "文件 →" 链接 `?view=filings`；`新财期`、`修订` → "报表 →" 链接 `?view=statements&asOf=<occurredOn>`；数值是打开抽屉的按钮；置空值显示"— 待挂接"/"来源记录不完整"；`payloadChangedAt` 非空加"已更新"标）+"全部 → 跟踪"链接 `?view=tracking`。右列"信号"卡：文案"今日无触发"（现有信号卡不变，不接新数据）。`latest.truncated` → 截断卡；`latest=null` → "尚无可速览的财期。"。

- [ ] **Step 2: 实现 `metrics-model.ts`**

```ts
// src/components/company/metrics-model.ts
// Pure model of the metrics view (plan 2026-11-06 Task 13; spec §5.4).
import type {MetricEntry,MetricsResponse} from '@/lib/company/client';
import {formatValue,unitKindOfUnit} from './format';

export interface MetricCol{key:string;periodStart:string;periodEnd:string;duration:string}
/** One grid row = one landed metric identity (metric, inputUnit, basis); `alt` numbers a metric's rows (计划第 3 轮审计 R6). */
export interface MetricGridRow{id:string;metric:string;inputUnit:string|null;basis:string|null;alt:number;cells:Record<string,MetricEntry>}
export const metricKey=(e:{periodStart:string;periodEnd:string;duration:string})=>`${e.periodStart}:${e.periodEnd}:${e.duration}`;
const rowIdOf=(e:{metric:string;inputUnit:string;basis:string})=>JSON.stringify([e.metric,e.inputUnit,e.basis]);
export function metricsGrid(r:MetricsResponse,names:readonly string[],periods:number):{cols:MetricCol[];rows:MetricGridRow[]}{
 const cols=new Map<string,MetricCol>();
 for(const e of r.metrics)cols.set(metricKey(e),{key:metricKey(e),periodStart:e.periodStart,periodEnd:e.periodEnd,duration:e.duration});
 const ordered=[...cols.values()].sort((a,b)=>b.periodEnd.localeCompare(a.periodEnd)||a.key.localeCompare(b.key)).slice(0,periods);
 const keep=new Set(ordered.map(c=>c.key));
 const extras=[...new Set(r.metrics.map(e=>e.metric))].filter(m=>!names.includes(m)).sort();
 // Group by (metric, inputUnit, basis) — same-period alternatives in different currencies never overwrite each other.
 const groups=new Map<string,MetricGridRow>();
 for(const e of r.metrics){
  const id=rowIdOf(e);
  const g=groups.get(id)??{id,metric:e.metric,inputUnit:e.inputUnit,basis:e.basis,alt:0,cells:{}};
  if(keep.has(metricKey(e)))g.cells[metricKey(e)]=e;
  groups.set(id,g);
 }
 const rows:MetricGridRow[]=[];
 for(const metric of [...names,...extras]){
  const mine=[...groups.values()].filter(g=>g.metric===metric).sort((a,b)=>(a.inputUnit??'').localeCompare(b.inputUnit??'')||(a.basis??'').localeCompare(b.basis??''));
  if(mine.length===0)rows.push({id:JSON.stringify([metric,null,null]),metric,inputUnit:null,basis:null,alt:0,cells:{}});
  else mine.forEach((g,i)=>rows.push({...g,alt:i}));
 }
 return {cols:ordered,rows};
}
export function metricText(e:MetricEntry,scaleExp:number):string|null{
 if(e.cell.kind!=='derived')return null;
 return formatValue(e.cell.value,e.cell.unit==='pure'?'ratio':unitKindOfUnit(e.cell.unit),scaleExp);
}
export const basedOnRevOf=(r:MetricsResponse)=>r.metrics[0]?.basedOnRev??null;
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/MetricsView.tsx
'use client';
// Metrics view + valuation-model area (plan 2026-11-06 Task 13; spec §5.4, §5.10; canvas Metrics).
// Reads only the company metrics proxy; stale → "pending recomputation", never "not produced" or old values.
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Tag } from '@/components/ui';
import { DcfStudio } from '@/components/DcfStudio';
import { metricNames } from '@/lib/facts/derive';
import { companyApi, type MetricEntry, type MetricsResponse } from '@/lib/company/client';
import type { Market } from '@/lib/company/types';
import { useCompanyFetch } from './useCompanyFetch';
import { useDrawers } from './DrawerHost';
import { Seg } from './Seg';
import { Callout, ErrorCard, LoadingGrid, TruncatedCard } from './StateCallout';
import { SCALES, SCALE_EXP, defaultScale, type ScaleId } from './format';
import { basedOnRevOf, metricText, metricsGrid, type MetricCol, type MetricGridRow } from './metrics-model';

const PERIODS = [8, 20, 40] as const;
const SCALE_KEYS: Record<ScaleId, string> = { raw: 'scaleRaw', thousand: 'scaleThousand', million: 'scaleMillion', hundred_million: 'scaleHundredMillion' };

export function MetricsView({ ticker, market, asOf }: { ticker: string; market: Market; asOf: string | null }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.metrics');
  const tn = useTranslations('company.metrics.names');
  const tst = useTranslations('company.statements');
  const ts = useTranslations('company.states');
  const td = useTranslations('company.durations');
  const tab = useTranslations('company.tabs');
  const tr = useTranslations('company.replay');
  const drawers = useDrawers();
  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState<(typeof PERIODS)[number]>(8);
  const locale = useLocale() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh';
  const [scale, setScale] = useState<ScaleId>(defaultScale(market === 'CN' ? 'CNY' : 'USD', locale));
  // 计划第 3 轮审计 R5: the server keeps every metric row of the newest `periods` keys (no silent 200-row cut).
  const { state, retry } = useCompanyFetch<MetricsResponse>(companyApi('metrics', ticker, { asOf, periods: String(periods) }));
  const exp = SCALE_EXP[scale];
  const name = (m: string) => (tn.has(m) ? tn(m) : m);
  const dur = (d: string) => (td.has(d) ? td(d) : d);
  // 计划第 3 轮审计 R6: the row label names the surviving input unit and basis.
  const rowSub = (row: MetricGridRow) => (row.inputUnit === null ? row.metric : `${row.metric} · ${row.inputUnit} · ${row.basis}`);

  function open(e: MetricEntry, c: MetricCol, r: MetricsResponse) {
    if (e.cell.kind === 'withheld') { drawers.open({ kind: 'withheld', reason: e.cell.reason, title: `${name(e.metric)} · ${c.periodEnd} ${dur(c.duration)}` }); return; }
    drawers.open({ kind: 'formula', metric: e.metric, cell: e.cell, periodLabel: `${c.periodEnd} ${dur(c.duration)}`, computedAt: e.computedAt, computedAtKind: e.computedAtKind, basedOnRev: e.basedOnRev, scaleExp: exp });
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
        <Seg label={tst('periods')} value={periods} onChange={setPeriods} options={PERIODS.map((n) => ({ value: n, label: String(n) }))} />
        <Seg label={tst('scale')} value={scale} onChange={setScale} options={SCALES.map((s) => ({ value: s, label: tst(SCALE_KEYS[s]) }))} />
        {state.status === 'ok' && (
          <Tag>{state.data.asOf ? t('live', { version: state.data.formulaVersion }) : t('materialized', { rev: String(basedOnRevOf(state.data) ?? '—'), version: state.data.formulaVersion })}</Tag>
        )}
        <span className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)] sm:ml-auto">{t('note')}</span>
      </div>

      {(state.status === 'loading' || state.status === 'idle') && <LoadingGrid />}
      {state.status === 'error' && <ErrorCard message={ts('routeError', { view: tab('metrics'), code: state.code })} onRetry={retry} />}
      {state.status === 'ok' && state.data.stale && <Callout>{t('stale')}</Callout>}
      {state.status === 'ok' && !state.data.stale && state.data.truncated && <TruncatedCard onRetry={retry} />}
      {state.status === 'ok' && !state.data.stale && !state.data.truncated && (() => {
        const r = state.data;
        const g = metricsGrid(r, metricNames(market), periods);
        if (g.cols.length === 0) return <Callout>{asOf ? ts('beforeFirst') : tst('empty')}</Callout>;
        return (
          <>
            {(r.withheld.citationPending > 0 || r.withheld.evidenceIncomplete > 0) && (
              <div className="rounded-md border border-[var(--border)] px-3 py-2 text-xs">
                {r.withheld.citationPending > 0 && <div>{tst('withheldPending', { n: r.withheld.citationPending })}</div>}
                {r.withheld.evidenceIncomplete > 0 && <div>{tst('withheldIncomplete', { n: r.withheld.evidenceIncomplete })}</div>}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-card)]">
              <table className="w-max min-w-full text-sm">
                <thead><tr className="text-[var(--text-dim)]">
                  <th scope="col" className="sticky left-0 z-10 min-w-[160px] bg-[var(--bg-card)] px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium sm:min-w-[240px]">{t('header')}</th>
                  {g.cols.map((c) => <th key={c.key} scope="col" className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-medium"><span className="num block text-[var(--text)]">{c.periodEnd}</span><span className="block text-[11px]">{dur(c.duration)}</span></th>)}
                </tr></thead>
                <tbody>
                  {g.rows.map((row) => {
                    const firstEntry = g.cols.map((c) => row.cells[c.key]).find((e) => e && e.cell.kind === 'derived');
                    return (
                      <tr key={row.id} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]" data-testid={row.alt === 0 ? `metric-row-${row.metric}` : `metric-row-${row.metric}-${row.alt}`}>
                        <th scope="row" className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-[var(--bg-card)] px-3 py-1.5 text-left font-normal">
                          {firstEntry ? (
                            <button type="button" className="text-left focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--accent)]"
                              onClick={() => open(firstEntry, g.cols.find((c) => row.cells[c.key] === firstEntry)!, r)}>
                              {name(row.metric)}<span className="num block text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{rowSub(row)}</span>
                            </button>
                          ) : (<>{name(row.metric)}<span className="num block text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{rowSub(row)}</span></>)}
                        </th>
                        {g.cols.map((c) => {
                          const e = row.cells[c.key];
                          if (!e) return <td key={c.key} className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right text-[var(--text-muted)]" title={t('notProducedTitle')}>{t('notProduced')}</td>;
                          const text = metricText(e, exp);
                          return (
                            <td key={c.key} className="num whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-1.5 text-right">
                              <button type="button" onClick={() => open(e, c, r)}
                                title={text === null ? (e.cell.kind === 'withheld' && e.cell.reason === 'citation_pending' ? tst('cellPendingTitle') : tst('cellIncompleteTitle')) : undefined}
                                className={`${text === null ? 'text-[var(--text-dim)]' : 'underline decoration-dotted underline-offset-4 hover:text-[var(--accent)]'} focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--accent)]`}>
                                {text ?? (e.cell.kind === 'withheld' && e.cell.reason === 'citation_pending' ? tst('cellPending') : tst('cellIncomplete'))}
                              </button>
                            </td>
                          );
                        })}
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('footnote')}</p>
          </>
        );
      })()}

      <div className="mt-6 flex items-center gap-3">
        <hr className="flex-1 border-[var(--border)]" /><span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">{t('modelDivider')}</span><hr className="flex-1 border-[var(--border)]" />
      </div>
      <section aria-label={t('modelTitle')} data-testid="valuation-section" className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-elevated)] p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('modelTitle')}</h2><Tag>{t('modelChip')}</Tag></div>
        {asOf ? <Callout>{tr('dcfHidden')}</Callout> : <DcfStudio ticker={ticker} onOpenFact={(factId) => drawers.open({ kind: 'historyByFact', factId, scaleExp: exp })} />}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

（`metricNames` 来自 `src/lib/facts/derive.ts`，该模块是纯函数，可在客户端导入；若打包报 Node 依赖，改为在 `metrics-model.ts` 内照抄 `FIXED_METRICS` + `Q_SINGLE_CONCEPTS` 的拼法并加一个与 `metricNames` 相等的单测。）

```ts
// src/components/company/filings-model.ts
// Pure model of the filings view (plan 2026-11-06 Task 13; spec §5.5, §10.3).
import type {FilingSummary,Market} from '@/lib/company/types';

export const LINK_FAILED_ATTEMPTS=5;
const CN_TYPES=new Set(['annual','semiannual','q1','q3','restatement']);
export function typeLabel(f:FilingSummary,market:Market):{key:string}|{text:string}{
 if(market==='US')return {text:f.formType};
 return {key:CN_TYPES.has(f.formType)?f.formType:'other'};
}
export function fiscalLabel(f:FilingSummary):string{return [f.fiscalYear??'',f.fiscalPeriod??''].join(' ').trim()||'—';}
export type CitationBadge={kind:'edgar'|'linked';href:string|null}|{kind:'pending'}|{kind:'failed';attempts:number};
export function citationBadge(f:FilingSummary):CitationBadge{
 if(f.citation==='edgar')return {kind:'edgar',href:f.url};
 if(f.citation==='linked')return {kind:'linked',href:f.documentUrl};
 return f.linkAttempts>=LINK_FAILED_ATTEMPTS?{kind:'failed',attempts:f.linkAttempts}:{kind:'pending'};
}
/** "Original" target: document first, then the filing URL; pending filings have none (spec §5.5). */
export function originalHref(f:FilingSummary):string|null{return f.citation==='pending'?null:f.documentUrl??f.url??null;}
```

```tsx
'use client';
// Filings view (plan 2026-11-06 Task 13; spec §5.5, §10.3; canvas Filings).
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';
import { F3_DRAWER_FLAG, companyApi, companyHref, type CompanyFilingsResponse } from '@/lib/company/client';
import type { Market } from '@/lib/company/types';
import { useCompanyFetch } from './useCompanyFetch';
import { Callout, ErrorCard, LoadingGrid } from './StateCallout';
import { citationBadge, fiscalLabel, originalHref, typeLabel } from './filings-model';
import { F3_SOURCE_DRAWER_AVAILABLE, SourceDrawerAdapter } from './f3-source-drawer';

const USE_F3 = F3_DRAWER_FLAG && F3_SOURCE_DRAWER_AVAILABLE;
const chip = 'inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] no-underline';

export function FilingsView({ ticker, market, asOf }: { ticker: string; market: Market; asOf: string | null }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.filings');
  const tt = useTranslations('company.filings.types');
  const ts = useTranslations('company.states');
  const tab = useTranslations('company.tabs');
  const router = useRouter();
  const [source, setSource] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const { state, retry } = useCompanyFetch<CompanyFilingsResponse>(companyApi('filings', ticker, { asOf }));

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]"><span>{t('order')}</span><span className="sm:ml-auto">{t('unpublishedNote')}</span></div>
      {(state.status === 'loading' || state.status === 'idle') && <LoadingGrid />}
      {state.status === 'error' && <ErrorCard message={ts('routeError', { view: tab('filings'), code: state.code })} onRetry={retry} />}
      {state.status === 'ok' && (
        <section className="rounded-lg border border-[var(--border)] bg-[var(--bg-card)]">
          <div className="px-4 pb-1 pt-3 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('periodic')}</div>
          {state.data.filings.length === 0 ? <div className="px-4 pb-4"><Callout>{asOf ? ts('beforeFirst') : t('empty')}</Callout></div> : (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full min-w-[860px] text-sm">
                <thead className="text-left text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]"><tr>
                  <th className="px-4 py-2">{t('colAvailable')}</th><th>{t('colType')}</th><th>{t('colFiscal')}</th><th>{t('colPeriodEnd')}</th>
                  <th>{t('colSource')}</th><th>{t('colCitation')}</th><th className="text-right">{t('colFacts')}</th><th className="px-4">{t('colActions')}</th>
                </tr></thead>
                <tbody>
                  {state.data.filings.map((f) => {
                    const type = typeLabel(f, market);
                    const badge = citationBadge(f);
                    const original = originalHref(f);
                    return (
                      <tr key={f.filingId} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]" data-testid="filing-row">
                        <td className="num px-4 py-2">{f.availableDate}</td>
                        <td>{'text' in type ? <span className="num">{type.text}</span> : tt(type.key)}</td>
                        <td className="num">{fiscalLabel(f)}</td>
                        <td className="num text-[var(--text-dim)]">{f.periodEnd ?? '—'}</td>
                        <td className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{f.source === 'edgar' ? t('sourceEdgar') : t('sourceTushare')}</td>
                        <td>
                          {(badge.kind === 'edgar' || badge.kind === 'linked') && (badge.href
                            ? <a href={badge.href} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className={`${chip} border-[var(--border-active)] text-[var(--accent)]`}>{badge.kind === 'edgar' ? t('citeEdgar') : t('citeLinked')}</a>
                            : <span className={`${chip} border-[var(--border)]`}>{badge.kind}</span>)}
                          {badge.kind === 'pending' && <span className={`${chip} border-[var(--border)] text-[var(--text-dim)]`}>{t('citePending')}</span>}
                          {badge.kind === 'failed' && <span className={`${chip} border-[var(--warn)] text-[var(--warn)]`}>{t('citeFailed', { n: badge.attempts })}</span>}
                        </td>
                        <td className="num text-right">{f.factCount}</td>
                        <td className="px-4">
                          <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => router.push(companyHref(ticker, { view: 'statements', asOf, extra: { highlight: f.filingId } }) as never)}>{t('highlight')}</Button>
                            {original && (USE_F3
                              ? <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setSource(f.filingId)}>{t('original')}</Button>
                              : <a href={original} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 text-xs">{t('original')}</a>)}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="px-4 pb-1 pt-4 text-xs font-medium text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('transcripts')}</div>
          <div className="px-4 pb-4 text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('transcriptsPending')}</div>
        </section>
      )}
      {source && <SourceDrawerAdapter filingId={source} onClose={() => setSource(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
// src/components/company/overview-model.ts
// Pure model of the overview view (plan 2026-11-06 Task 13; spec §5.8, §4.1 payload schemas, §0 #64).
// Payload values may arrive replaced by {kind:'withheld'} (evidence gate) and are passed through as such.
import type {Market} from '@/lib/company/types';
import type {PublicEvent} from '@/lib/company/client';

export type QuickItem={key:string;group:'facts'|'derived'};
export function quickItems(market:Market):QuickItem[]{
 return [{key:market==='CN'?'revenue_operating':'revenue',group:'facts'},{key:'net_income_parent',group:'facts'},{key:'operating_cash_flow',group:'facts'},{key:'gross_margin',group:'derived'},{key:'revenue_yoy',group:'derived'}];
}
export type ValueRef={factId:string;value:string;unit?:string;filingId?:string;availableDate?:string}|{kind:'withheld';reason:'evidence_incomplete'|'citation_pending';factId:string};
export interface EventView{
 eventId:string;occurredOn:string;chip:'kindFiling'|'kindPeriod'|'kindRevised';updated:boolean;
 link:{view:'filings'|'statements';asOf:string|null};
 filing?:{form:string;fiscal:string;factCount:number};
 period?:{periodStart:string;periodEnd:string;duration:string;headline:{concept:string;ref:ValueRef}|null};
 revised?:{concept:string;periodEnd:string;duration:string;unit:string;from:ValueRef;to:ValueRef;relChange:string|ValueRef|null};
}
const rec=(v:unknown)=>(typeof v==='object'&&v!==null?v as Record<string,unknown>:{});
const s=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'?v:'';
/** A gated headline entry carries the withheld marker under `.value` (Task 6 gateEventPayload); surface the marker itself. */
const withheldOrEntry=(x:unknown):ValueRef=>{const v=(x as {value?:unknown}|null)?.value;return (v&&typeof v==='object'&&(v as {kind?:unknown}).kind==='withheld'?v:x) as ValueRef;};
export function eventView(e:PublicEvent,market:Market):EventView{
 const p=e.payload;const base={eventId:e.eventId,occurredOn:e.occurredOn,updated:!!e.payloadChangedAt};
 if(e.kind==='filing_published')return {...base,chip:'kindFiling',link:{view:'filings',asOf:null},
  filing:{form:s(p.formType),fiscal:[p.fiscalYear??'',p.fiscalPeriod??''].join(' ').trim()||'—',factCount:typeof p.factCount==='number'?p.factCount:0}};
 if(e.kind==='period_first_seen'){
  const h=rec(p.headline);
  const order=[market==='CN'?'revenue_operating':'revenue',market==='CN'?'revenue':'revenue_operating','net_income_parent','operating_cash_flow'];
  const c=order.find(k=>k in h);
  return {...base,chip:'kindPeriod',link:{view:'statements',asOf:e.occurredOn},
   period:{periodStart:s(p.periodStart),periodEnd:s(p.periodEnd),duration:s(p.duration),headline:c?{concept:c,ref:withheldOrEntry(h[c])}:null}};
 }
 return {...base,chip:'kindRevised',link:{view:'statements',asOf:e.occurredOn},
  revised:{concept:s(p.concept),periodEnd:s(p.periodEnd),duration:s(p.duration),unit:s(p.unit),from:withheldOrEntry(p.from),to:withheldOrEntry(p.to),relChange:(p.relChange as string|ValueRef|undefined)??null}};
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/OverviewView.tsx
'use client';
// Overview view (plan 2026-11-06 Task 13; spec §5.8, §5.10, decision J; canvas Overview).
// No K-line, no quote card, no PE/PB/ROE/dividend yield/market cap.
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Card, Tag } from '@/components/ui';
import { companyApi, companyHref, isWithheld, type OverviewResponse } from '@/lib/company/client';
import type { Cell, Market } from '@/lib/company/types';
import { useCompanyFetch } from './useCompanyFetch';
import { useDrawers } from './DrawerHost';
import { Callout, ErrorCard, LoadingGrid, TruncatedCard } from './StateCallout';
import { SCALE_EXP, defaultScale, formatPercent, formatScaled, formatValue, signed, unitKindOfUnit } from './format';
import { eventView, quickItems, type ValueRef } from './overview-model';
import { periodKeyParts } from './statements-model';

export function SignalsCard() {
  const t = useTranslations('company.overview');
  return <Card className="flex flex-col gap-1.5"><h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('signalsTitle')}</h2><span className="text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('signalsNone')}</span></Card>;
}

export function OverviewView({ ticker, market, asOf }: { ticker: string; market: Market; asOf: string | null }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.overview');
  const tl = useTranslations('company.overview.labels');
  const tc = useTranslations('company.concepts');
  const tt = useTranslations('company.filings.types');
  const tst = useTranslations('company.statements');
  const ts = useTranslations('company.states');
  const td = useTranslations('company.durations');
  const tab = useTranslations('company.tabs');
  const drawers = useDrawers();
  const { state, retry } = useCompanyFetch<OverviewResponse>(companyApi('overview', ticker, { asOf }));
  const locale = useLocale() === 'en' ? 'en' : 'zh';
  const exp = SCALE_EXP[defaultScale(market === 'CN' ? 'CNY' : 'USD', locale)];
  const dur = (d: string) => (td.has(d) ? td(d) : d);

  const currency = market === 'CN' ? 'CNY' : 'USD';
  function ValueButton({ refv, concept, unit: unitHint }: { refv: ValueRef; concept: string; unit?: string }) {
    if (isWithheld(refv)) {
      return <button type="button" className="text-[var(--text-dim)]" onClick={() => drawers.open({ kind: 'withheld', reason: refv.reason, title: concept })}>{refv.reason === 'citation_pending' ? tst('cellPending') : tst('cellIncomplete')}</button>;
    }
    const unit = refv.unit ?? unitHint ?? currency;
    return (
      <button type="button" onClick={() => drawers.open({ kind: 'historyByFact', factId: refv.factId, scaleExp: unitKindOfUnit(unit) === 'money' ? exp : 0 })}
        className="num underline decoration-dotted underline-offset-4 hover:text-[var(--accent)] focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--accent)]">
        {formatValue(refv.value, unitKindOfUnit(unit), exp)}
      </button>
    );
  }

  function QuickValue({ cell, k, periodKey, stateRev }: { cell: Cell | undefined; k: string; periodKey: string; stateRev: number }) {
    if (!cell) return <span className="num text-[var(--text-muted)]" title={tst('cellMissingTitle')}>—</span>;
    if (cell.kind === 'withheld') return <ValueButton refv={cell} concept={tl(k)} />;
    const parts = periodKeyParts(periodKey);
    const cls = 'num text-xl underline decoration-dotted underline-offset-4 hover:text-[var(--accent)] focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[var(--accent)]';
    if (cell.kind === 'derived') {
      const text = cell.unit === 'pure' ? (k === 'revenue_yoy' ? signed(formatPercent(cell.value)) : formatPercent(cell.value)) : formatScaled(cell.value, exp);
      return <button type="button" className={cls} onClick={() => drawers.open({ kind: 'formula', metric: cell.metric, cell, periodLabel: `${parts.periodEnd} ${dur(parts.duration)}`, computedAt: null, computedAtKind: 'live', basedOnRev: stateRev, scaleExp: exp })}>{text}</button>;
    }
    return (
      <button type="button" className={cls}
        onClick={() => drawers.open({ kind: 'history', key: { concept: k, periodStart: parts.periodStart, periodEnd: parts.periodEnd, unit: cell.unit }, duration: parts.duration, otherUnits: cell.otherUnits, scaleExp: exp })}>
        {formatScaled(cell.value, exp)}
      </button>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-5 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,7fr)_minmax(0,5fr)]">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-5">
        {(state.status === 'loading' || state.status === 'idle') && <LoadingGrid />}
        {state.status === 'error' && <ErrorCard message={ts('routeError', { view: tab('overview'), code: state.code })} onRetry={retry} />}
        {state.status === 'ok' && (() => {
          const o = state.data;
          const latest = o.latest;
          return (
            <>
              <Card aria-label={t('latestTitle')} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('latestTitle')}</h2>
                  {latest && !latest.truncated && latest.periodKey && (() => { const p = periodKeyParts(latest.periodKey); return <Tag><span className="num">{p.periodStart} → {p.periodEnd} · {dur(p.duration)}</span></Tag>; })()}
                </div>
                {latest?.truncated && <TruncatedCard onRetry={retry} />}
                {!latest && <Callout>{asOf ? ts('beforeFirst') : t('noLatest')}</Callout>}
                {latest && !latest.truncated && latest.periodKey && (
                  <>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-5">
                      {quickItems(market).map((it) => (
                        <div key={it.key} className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                          <span className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{tl(it.key)}</span>
                          <span className="num text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)]">{it.key}{it.group === 'derived' ? ` · ${t('derived')}` : ''}</span>
                          <QuickValue cell={(it.group === 'facts' ? latest.facts : latest.derived)[it.key]} k={it.key} periodKey={latest.periodKey ?? ''} stateRev={latest.stateRev} />
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('envelope', { rev: String(latest.stateRev) })}</p>
                  </>
                )}
              </Card>

              <Card aria-label={t('eventsTitle')} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <div className="flex items-center"><h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('eventsTitle')}</h2>
                  <Link href={companyHref(ticker, { view: 'tracking', asOf }) as never} className="ml-auto text-sm">{t('eventsAll')}</Link></div>
                {o.recentEvents.length === 0 ? <Callout>{t('noEvents')}</Callout> : (
                  <div className="overflow-x-auto"><table className="w-full text-sm"><tbody>
                    {o.recentEvents.slice(0, 3).map((e) => {
                      const v = eventView(e, market);
                      return (
                        <tr key={v.eventId} className="border-t border-[var(--border)]">
                          <td className="num w-[110px] py-2 text-[var(--text-dim)]">{v.occurredOn}</td>
                          <td className="pr-2"><Tag>{t(v.chip)}</Tag>{v.updated && <span className="ml-1 text-[10px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('updated')}</span>}</td>
                          <td>
                            {v.filing && t('filingLine', { form: market === 'CN' && tt.has(v.filing.form) ? tt(v.filing.form) : v.filing.form, fiscal: v.filing.fiscal, n: String(v.filing.factCount) })}
                            {v.period && (<>{t('periodLine', { period: v.period.periodEnd, duration: dur(v.period.duration) })}{v.period.headline && <> · {tc.has(v.period.headline.concept) ? tc(v.period.headline.concept) : v.period.headline.concept} <ValueButton refv={v.period.headline.ref} concept={v.period.headline.concept} /></>}</>)}
                            {v.revised && (<>
                              {v.revised.periodEnd} {tc.has(v.revised.concept) ? tc(v.revised.concept) : v.revised.concept}{' '}
                              <ValueButton refv={v.revised.from} concept={v.revised.concept} unit={v.revised.unit} /> → <ValueButton refv={v.revised.to} concept={v.revised.concept} unit={v.revised.unit} />
                              {typeof v.revised.relChange === 'string' && <span className="num ml-1 text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{signed(formatPercent(v.revised.relChange))}</span>}
                            </>)}
                          </td>
                          <td className="text-right">
                            <Link href={companyHref(ticker, { view: v.link.view, asOf: v.link.asOf ?? asOf }) as never} className="text-xs">{v.link.view === 'filings' ? t('toFilings') : t('toStatements')}</Link>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody></table></div>
                )}
              </Card>
            </>
          );
        })()}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-5"><SignalsCard /></div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

（`fact_revised` 的 `from/to` 不带单位，用事件 payload 的 `unit`；headline 自带 `unit`。`ValueButton`、`QuickValue` 定义在组件内部以共用 `drawers`/翻译；若 lint 的 react 规则禁止组件内定义组件，把二者提到文件顶层并显式传入 `drawers`、`exp`、翻译函数。）

```ts
// src/lib/company/judgments-contract.test.ts
// Contract of the company page against F4 (spec §10.4, §12.1): request shape, view/asOf echo, no
// post-cutoff settlement or calibration in replay, client-side percent defence.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {resolve} from 'node:path';
import {describe,it,expect} from 'vitest';
import {judgmentsUrl,checkJudgmentsResponse,displayPercent} from './judgments';

const fx=(name:string)=>JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(),'src/lib/company/fixtures/judgments',`${name}.json`),'utf8'));
const ISSUER='11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';

describe('judgments request',()=>{
 it('asks for latest without asOf and for as_known with asOf in replay',()=>{
  expect(judgmentsUrl(ISSUER,null)).toBe(`/api/judgments?subject_type=issuer&subject_key=${ISSUER}&view=latest`);
  expect(judgmentsUrl(ISSUER,'2024-06-30')).toBe(`/api/judgments?subject_type=issuer&subject_key=${ISSUER}&view=as_known&asOf=2024-06-30`);
 });
});
describe('response contract',()=>{
 it('accepts the as_known fixture in replay: no settlement and no percent appear',()=>{
  const r=checkJudgmentsResponse(fx('as-known-2024-06-30'),'2024-06-30');
  expect(r.ok).toBe(true);
  if(!r.ok)return;
  expect(r.cards.every(c=>c.settlement===null)).toBe(true);
  expect(r.cards.map(displayPercent)).toEqual([null]);
 });
 it('rejects a latest response to a replay request (would leak the 2025 settlement and 62%)',()=>{
  expect(checkJudgmentsResponse(fx('latest'),'2024-06-30')).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'view_mismatch'});
 });
 it('rejects an as_known response whose asOf differs from the request',()=>{
  expect(checkJudgmentsResponse(fx('as-known-2024-06-30'),'2024-07-01')).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'asof_mismatch'});
 });
 it('fails closed when an as_known response still carries a post-cutoff settlement',()=>{
  expect(checkJudgmentsResponse(fx('leaky-as-known'),'2024-06-30')).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'post_cutoff'});
 });
 it('rejects an as_known response to a latest request and malformed bodies',()=>{
  expect(checkJudgmentsResponse(fx('as-known-2024-06-30'),null)).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'view_mismatch'});
  expect(checkJudgmentsResponse({view:'latest'},null)).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'malformed'});
  expect(checkJudgmentsResponse(null,null)).toEqual({ok:false,reason:'malformed'});
 });
 it('latest view shows the calibrated percent of an open/settled card',()=>{
  const r=checkJudgmentsResponse(fx('latest'),null);
  expect(r.ok&&r.cards.map(displayPercent)).toEqual([62]);
 });
});
describe('client-side percent defence',()=>{
 it('shows a percent only for calibrated, open/settled cards with a finite number',()=>{
  const r=checkJudgmentsResponse(fx('defective'),null);
  expect(r.ok&&r.cards.map(displayPercent)).toEqual([null,null,null,62]);
 });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 10: 实现 `src/lib/company/judgments.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/company/judgments.ts
// Company-page consumer of F4 judgment cards (plan 2026-11-06 Task 13; spec §10.4; F4 spec §9.2, §10).
// The page never computes a percentage: it renders display.percent only behind a client-side
// fail-closed check, and in replay accepts only an as_known response echoing the requested asOf
// with nothing registered or settled after the cutoff (asOf end of day).
export interface JudgmentCardDto{
 judgment_id:string;kind:string;lifecycle:string;calibration:string;retrospective?:boolean;
 as_of:string;registered_at:string;
 methodology:{id:string;version:string;title:{zh:string;en:string};href?:string};
 display:{headline:{zh:string;en:string};percent:unknown;value?:unknown;band?:'low'|'mid'|'high'};
 condition:{text:{zh:string;en:string}}|null;
 settlement:{outcome:string|null;settled_at:string;realized?:unknown}|null;
 calibration_summary:{n_independent?:number;n_total?:number;brier?:number|null;href?:string}|null;
}
export type JudgmentsCheck={ok:true;cards:JudgmentCardDto[]}|{ok:false;reason:'view_mismatch'|'asof_mismatch'|'post_cutoff'|'malformed'};

export function judgmentsUrl(issuerId:string,asOf:string|null):string{
 const q=new URLSearchParams({subject_type:'issuer',subject_key:issuerId,view:asOf?'as_known':'latest'});
 if(asOf)q.set('asOf',asOf);
 return `/api/judgments?${q.toString()}`;
}
const isCard=(c:unknown):c is JudgmentCardDto=>{
 const x=c as JudgmentCardDto|null;
 return typeof x==='object'&&x!==null&&typeof x.judgment_id==='string'&&typeof x.lifecycle==='string'&&typeof x.calibration==='string'&&typeof x.registered_at==='string'&&typeof x.display==='object'&&x.display!==null;
};
export function checkJudgmentsResponse(body:unknown,asOf:string|null):JudgmentsCheck{
 const b=body as {view?:unknown;asOf?:unknown;cards?:unknown}|null;
 if(typeof b!=='object'||b===null||!Array.isArray(b.cards)||!b.cards.every(isCard))return {ok:false,reason:'malformed'};
 if(b.view!==(asOf?'as_known':'latest'))return {ok:false,reason:'view_mismatch'};
 const cards=b.cards as JudgmentCardDto[];
 if(asOf){
  if(b.asOf!==asOf)return {ok:false,reason:'asof_mismatch'};
  const cutoff=`${asOf}T23:59:59.999Z`;
  const late=(t:string|undefined|null)=>typeof t==='string'&&new Date(t).toISOString()>cutoff;
  if(cards.some(c=>late(c.registered_at)||late(c.settlement?.settled_at)))return {ok:false,reason:'post_cutoff'};
 }
 return {ok:true,cards};
}
/** spec §10.4 defence: calibrated ∧ lifecycle ∈ {open, settled} ∧ finite number; otherwise no percentage. */
export function displayPercent(c:JudgmentCardDto):number|null{
 const p=c.display.percent;
 return c.calibration==='calibrated'&&(c.lifecycle==='open'||c.lifecycle==='settled')&&typeof p==='number'&&Number.isFinite(p)?p:null;
}
```

```tsx
export function JudgmentCardAdapter({ card, percent }: { card: JudgmentCardDto; percent: number | null }) {

      </div>

        ? <div className="num text-2xl font-medium">{percent}%</div>
        : <div className="text-sm text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('noPercent', { calibration: card.calibration })}{band ? ` · ${t('band', { band: t(band === 'low' ? 'bandLow' : band === 'mid' ? 'bandMid' : 'bandHigh') })}` : ''}</div>}
      {card.condition && <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('condition', { text: card.condition.text[locale] })}</p>}
      {card.settlement && <p className="text-xs">{t('settled', { outcome: card.settlement.outcome ?? '—', date: card.settlement.settled_at.slice(0, 10) })}</p>}
      {card.calibration_summary?.n_independent != null && <p className="num text-xs text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('historyN', { n: String(card.calibration_summary.n_independent) })}</p>}
      <p className="text-[11px] text-[var(--text-dim)]">{t('method', { id: card.methodology.id, version: card.methodology.version, asOf: card.as_of })}</p>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/JudgmentsView.tsx
'use client';
// Judgments view (plan 2026-11-06 Task 13; spec §5.10, §10.4; canvas States): flag off → empty state;
// on → F4 read with view/asOf contract, fail closed on any mismatch.
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { JUDGMENTS_FLAG } from '@/lib/company/client';
import { checkJudgmentsResponse, displayPercent, judgmentsUrl } from '@/lib/company/judgments';
import { useCompanyFetch } from './useCompanyFetch';
import { Callout, ErrorCard, LoadingGrid } from './StateCallout';
import { JudgmentCardAdapter } from './judgment-card-adapter';

export function JudgmentsView({ issuerId, asOf }: { issuerId: string | null; asOf: string | null }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.judgments');
  const enabled = JUDGMENTS_FLAG && issuerId !== null;
  const { state, retry } = useCompanyFetch<unknown>(enabled ? judgmentsUrl(issuerId!, asOf) : null);
  if (!enabled) return <Callout><strong className="text-[var(--text)]">{t('emptyTitle')}</strong> {t('empty')}</Callout>;
  if (state.status === 'loading' || state.status === 'idle') return <LoadingGrid />;
  if (state.status === 'error') return <ErrorCard message={t('loadFailed', { code: state.code })} onRetry={retry} />;
  const checked = checkJudgmentsResponse(state.data, asOf);
  if (!checked.ok) return <ErrorCard message={asOf ? t('replayFailed') : t('loadFailed', { code: checked.reason })} onRetry={retry} />;
  if (checked.cards.length === 0) return <Callout>{t('none')}</Callout>;
  return <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">{checked.cards.map((c) => <JudgmentCardAdapter key={c.judgment_id} card={c} percent={displayPercent(c)} />)}</div>;
}
```

### Task 16: 跟踪 API（watches / read / import / inbox）+ `inbox.ts`

规格：§6.2、§7.3、§4.3、§11、§12.1 `inbox.test.ts`、§0 #64。

**指挥决定（本任务）：**
- 收件箱分页：路由每次向 `eventsOfIssuers` 只要"还缺的行数"，所以取回的每一行要么返回、要么（`unreadOnly`）因已读被跳过，库的 `nextCursor` 恰好落在最后一个被消费的行之后——不必自己从行构造库游标，并列 `first_seen_at` 也不漏不重。对外游标是 `{v, f(过滤指纹), c(库游标)}` 的 base64url，过滤条件变了还拿旧游标 → 400 `invalid_parameter:cursor`。理由：库游标格式归 Task 3 所有，Part E 不能假设其内部结构。
- 未读计数：没有计数函数（迁移已在 Task 2 锁定），按收件箱顺序分页扫描未静音 watch 的事件（每页 200、最多 25 页），每个发行人数到 100 即停（显示 `99+`）；25 页仍未扫完时未饱和发行人的数是下界，显示 `n+`，响应带 `unreadComplete:false`。理由：不改已锁迁移，且给出诚实的下界而不是猜测。
- 跟踪是发行人级（§4.3），所以 `POST /watches {ticker}` 用 `resolveIssuer`（港股发行人也能跟踪，画板有"腾讯控股 港股：待文档管道"），而不是只服务 US/CN 的 `resolvePublicIssuer`。理由：§0 #69 约束的是事实流与市场推断，跟踪不读事实流。
- 收件箱增加可选参数 `issuerId`：必须是当前用户已跟踪的发行人（否则 404 `watch_not_found`），此时**包含已静音**的发行人（公司页跟踪视图用；"静音不进收件箱但公司页可见"，§7.3）。理由：公司页需要已读状态，又不能让会话客户端读 `issuer_events`。
- `POST /read` 先确认 watch 存在（404 `watch_not_found`），再交给触发器校验 id 归属（`invalid_read` → 400 `invalid_parameter:eventIds`）。规格 §11 未列 `watch_not_found`，按 404 处理。
- CSRF 失败码：`Content-Type` 非 JSON → 415 `unsupported_media_type`；跨站 `Origin` → 403 `forbidden_origin`（与 `/api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]` 一致）。`DELETE` 同样要求 `Content-Type: application/json`（客户端发空 JSON 体 `{}`）。
- 新建 watch 返回 201，已存在返回 200 原行（规格只要求"已存在 → 200"）。

```ts
const hex=(n:number)=>n.toString(16).padStart(64,'0');
const ev=(n:number,issuer:string,firstSeen:string,kind:EventKind='filing_published',occurredOn='2025-10-31'):EventRow=>({
 event_id:hex(n),issuer_id:issuer,market:'US',kind,natural_key:`k${n}`,occurred_on:occurredOn,period_end:null,concept:null,filing_id:null,
 payload:{},meta:{},payload_hash:'h',based_on_rev:1,first_seen_at:firstSeen,payload_changed_at:null,retired_at:null,
 rebuilt_at:firstSeen,rebuild_id:'r',rebuild_batch_id:'b',
});
/** Reference keyset source over (first_seen_at desc, event_id desc); its cursor is opaque to the code under test. */
function fakeSource(events:EventRow[],receipts:Set<string>=new Set()):InboxSources&{calls:{issuers:string[];limit:number}[];receipts:Set<string>}{
 const order=(x:EventRow,y:EventRow)=>x.first_seen_at===y.first_seen_at?(x.event_id<y.event_id?1:-1):(x.first_seen_at<y.first_seen_at?1:-1);
 const calls:{issuers:string[];limit:number}[]=[];
 return {calls,receipts,
  async eventsOfIssuers(issuers,{kinds,cursor,limit}){
   calls.push({issuers,limit});
   let rows=events.filter(e=>e.retired_at===null&&issuers.includes(e.issuer_id)&&(!kinds||kinds.includes(e.kind))).sort(order);
   if(cursor){const [fs,id]=JSON.parse(cursor) as [string,string];rows=rows.filter(e=>e.first_seen_at<fs||(e.first_seen_at===fs&&e.event_id<id));}
   const page=rows.slice(0,limit);
   const last=page[page.length-1];
   return {rows:page,nextCursor:rows.length>limit&&last?JSON.stringify([last.first_seen_at,last.event_id]):null};
  },
  async readEventIds(ids){if(ids.length>100)throw new Error('chunk too large');return new Set(ids.filter(id=>receipts.has(id)));},
 };
}
const T1='2026-11-02T03:20:00.000Z',T0='2026-11-01T03:20:00.000Z';
async function drain(src:InboxSources,q:Omit<Parameters<typeof assembleInbox>[1],'cursor'>){
 const out:string[]=[];let cursor:string|null=null;let guard=0;
 do{const p=await assembleInbox(src,{...q,cursor});out.push(...p.rows.map(r=>r.event_id));cursor=p.nextCursor;}while(cursor!==null&&++guard<50);
 return out;
}

describe('assembleInbox keyset paging',()=>{
 it('pages over tied first_seen_at without gaps or repeats, newest first',async()=>{
  const events=[ev(1,A,T0),ev(2,A,T1),ev(3,B,T1),ev(4,A,T1),ev(5,B,T1),ev(6,C,T1),ev(7,A,T0)];
  const src=fakeSource(events);
  const ids=await drain(src,{issuerIds:[A,B],unreadOnly:false,limit:2});
  expect(ids).toEqual([hex(5),hex(4),hex(3),hex(2),hex(7),hex(1)]);   // C is not watched; ties ordered by event_id desc
  expect(src.calls.every(c=>c.limit<=2)).toBe(true);
 });
 it('attaches read by receipt id, and unreadOnly skips read rows without losing later unread ones',async()=>{
  const events=[1,2,3,4,5,6].map(n=>ev(n,A,T1));
  const src=fakeSource(events,new Set([hex(6),hex(5),hex(3)]));
  const first=await assembleInbox(src,{issuerIds:[A],unreadOnly:false,limit:3,cursor:null});
  expect(first.rows.map(r=>[r.event_id,r.read])).toEqual([[hex(6),true],[hex(5),true],[hex(4),false]]);
  expect(await drain(src,{issuerIds:[A],unreadOnly:true,limit:2})).toEqual([hex(4),hex(2),hex(1)]);
 });
 it('maxScans bounds an unreadOnly page: it may be short but keeps a cursor',async()=>{
  const events=[1,2,3,4,5].map(n=>ev(n,A,T1));
  const src=fakeSource(events,new Set([hex(5),hex(4),hex(3)]));
  const p=await assembleInbox(src,{issuerIds:[A],unreadOnly:true,limit:1,cursor:null,maxScans:2});
  expect(p.rows).toEqual([]);
  expect(p.nextCursor).not.toBeNull();
  const rest=await drain(src,{issuerIds:[A],unreadOnly:true,limit:1});
  expect(rest).toEqual([hex(2),hex(1)]);
 });
 it('no watched issuers → empty page, the source is never called',async()=>{
  const src=fakeSource([ev(1,A,T1)]);
  expect(await assembleInbox(src,{issuerIds:[],unreadOnly:false,limit:50,cursor:null})).toEqual({rows:[],nextCursor:null});
  expect(src.calls).toEqual([]);
 });
});

describe('marking read only touches the ids the client was shown',()=>{
 it('rows outside the page and outside the kind filter stay unread',async()=>{
  const events=[ev(1,A,T1,'fact_revised'),ev(2,A,T1),ev(3,A,T1,'fact_revised'),ev(4,A,T1),ev(5,A,T1)];
  const src=fakeSource(events);
  const page=await assembleInbox(src,{issuerIds:[A],kinds:['filing_published'],unreadOnly:false,limit:2,cursor:null});
  const batches=readBatches(page.rows.map(r=>({eventId:r.event_id,issuerId:r.issuer_id,read:r.read})));
  expect(batches).toEqual([{issuerId:A,eventIds:[hex(5),hex(4)]}]);
  for(const b of batches)for(const id of b.eventIds)src.receipts.add(id);
  const all=await assembleInbox(src,{issuerIds:[A],unreadOnly:false,limit:10,cursor:null});
  expect(all.rows.filter(r=>!r.read).map(r=>r.event_id)).toEqual([hex(3),hex(2),hex(1)]);   // out-of-page (2) and filtered-out (1, 3) untouched
 });
 it('a late-committed older event is not covered by an earlier mark (receipts are ids, not a timestamp)',async()=>{
  const events=[ev(2,A,T1)];
  const src=fakeSource(events);
  const page=await assembleInbox(src,{issuerIds:[A],unreadOnly:false,limit:10,cursor:null});
  for(const b of readBatches(page.rows.map(r=>({eventId:r.event_id,issuerId:r.issuer_id,read:r.read}))))for(const id of b.eventIds)src.receipts.add(id);
  events.push(ev(1,A,T0));   // committed after the mark, first_seen_at older than the marked row
  const after=await assembleInbox(src,{issuerIds:[A],unreadOnly:true,limit:10,cursor:null});
  expect(after.rows.map(r=>r.event_id)).toEqual([hex(1)]);
 });
 it('readBatches: unread only, grouped per issuer in display order, at most READ_BATCH_MAX ids per batch',()=>{
  const rows=[...Array.from({length:READ_BATCH_MAX+3},(_,i)=>({eventId:hex(1000+i),issuerId:A,read:false})),{eventId:hex(1),issuerId:B,read:false},{eventId:hex(2),issuerId:B,read:true}];
  const b=readBatches(rows);
  expect(b.map(x=>[x.issuerId,x.eventIds.length])).toEqual([[A,READ_BATCH_MAX],[A,3],[B,1]]);
 });
});

describe('fold, sections, badges',()=>{
 const pe=(id:string,issuerId:string,occurredOn:string,firstSeenAt:string)=>({eventId:id,issuerId,occurredOn,firstSeenAt});
 it('folds same issuer + same occurred_on + same first-seen day, keeping first-appearance order',()=>{
  const g=foldSameIssuerDay([pe('1',A,'2025-11-06',T1),pe('2',B,'2025-10-31',T1),pe('3',A,'2025-11-06',T1),pe('4',A,'2025-11-06',T0),pe('5',A,'2025-11-05',T1)]);

 it('formatUnread: 99+ at the cap, n+ when the scan was incomplete, null when muted',()=>{
  expect(formatUnread(UNREAD_CAP,true)).toBe('99+');
  expect(formatUnread(99,true)).toBe('99');

describe('muted issuers and cursors',()=>{
 const w=(issuer_id:string,muted:boolean)=>({user_id:'u',issuer_id,note:null,muted,created_at:T0,updated_at:T0});
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/inbox.ts
// Tracking inbox helpers (spec §6.2, §7.3, §4.3, §0 #64; plan Task 16). Pure: callers inject the two reads —
// eventsOfIssuers on the SERVICE-ROLE CompanyDb (issuer_events is service_role only, restricted by the caller
// to the user's watched issuer ids) and readEventIds on the SESSION CompanyDb (RLS) — so keyset paging, the
// receipt join and unread counting are unit-testable. Nothing here writes receipts. Browser-safe (no Buffer):
// the fold/section/batch helpers are also used by the tracking UI.
import type {EventKind,EventRow,WatchRow} from './types';
import {EVENT_KINDS} from './types';

// MAX_COMPANY_WATCHES (decision F) is defined once in db.ts (Task 3, server-only); this browser-safe module does not re-export it.
export const INBOX_DEFAULT_LIMIT=50;
export const INBOX_MAX_LIMIT=200;
/** POST /api/tracking/watches/[issuerId]/read accepts at most this many ids. */
export const READ_BATCH_MAX=500;
/** Unread counting stops at this many per issuer; shown as 99+. */
export const UNREAD_CAP=100;
const ID_CHUNK=100;
const MAX_CURSOR_LEN=1024;

export interface InboxSources{
 eventsOfIssuers(issuers:string[],opts:{kinds?:EventKind[];cursor?:string|null;limit:number}):Promise<{rows:EventRow[];nextCursor:string|null}>;
 readEventIds(eventIds:string[]):Promise<Set<string>>;
}
/** Receipt lookup in chunks of 100 ids (keeps PostgREST `in` filters short). */
export async function readSet(src:Pick<InboxSources,'readEventIds'>,ids:string[]):Promise<Set<string>>{
 const out=new Set<string>();
 for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i+=ID_CHUNK)for(const id of await src.readEventIds(ids.slice(i,i+ID_CHUNK)))out.add(id);
 return out;
}

export interface InboxQuery{issuerIds:string[];kinds?:EventKind[];unreadOnly:boolean;limit:number;cursor:string|null;maxScans?:number}
export interface InboxPage{rows:(EventRow&{read:boolean})[];nextCursor:string|null}
/**
 * One inbox page, keyset (first_seen_at desc, event_id desc). Each source call asks for exactly the rows still
 * missing, so every fetched row is either returned or (unreadOnly) skipped as read; the source's nextCursor is
 * then exactly "after the last consumed row": nothing is skipped or repeated across pages, ties included.
 * maxScans bounds an unreadOnly page over many read rows: it may come back short with a non-null cursor.
 */
export async function assembleInbox(src:InboxSources,q:InboxQuery):Promise<InboxPage>{
 const rows:InboxPage['rows']=[];
 if(q.issuerIds.length===0)return {rows,nextCursor:null};
 const maxScans=q.maxScans??10;
 let cursor=q.cursor,scans=0;
 while(rows.length<q.limit&&scans<maxScans){
  const need=q.limit-rows.length;
  const page=await src.eventsOfIssuers(q.issuerIds,{kinds:q.kinds,cursor,limit:need});
  scans++;
  if(page.rows.length>need)throw new Error('inbox_source_overflow');
  if(page.rows.length===0){cursor=null;break;}
  const read=await readSet(src,page.rows.map(r=>r.event_id));
  for(const r of page.rows){const isRead=read.has(r.event_id);if(q.unreadOnly&&isRead)continue;rows.push({...r,read:isRead});}
  cursor=page.nextCursor;
  if(cursor===null)break;
 }
 return {rows,nextCursor:cursor};
}

export interface UnreadCounts{counts:Map<string,number>;complete:boolean}
/**
 * Unread (no receipt, retired_at is null) per issuer, scanning in inbox order. An issuer stops counting at
 * UNREAD_CAP. complete=false: the scan budget ran out first, so unsaturated counts are lower bounds.
 */
export async function unreadCounts(src:InboxSources,issuerIds:string[],opts:{pageSize?:number;maxScans?:number}={}):Promise<UnreadCounts>{
 const counts=new Map<string,number>(issuerIds.map(id=>[id,0]));
 if(issuerIds.length===0)return {counts,complete:true};
 const pageSize=opts.pageSize??200,maxScans=opts.maxScans??25;
 let cursor:string|null=null;
 for(let scan=0;scan<maxScans;scan++){
  const page=await src.eventsOfIssuers(issuerIds,{cursor,limit:pageSize});
  const open=page.rows.filter(r=>(counts.get(r.issuer_id)??UNREAD_CAP)<UNREAD_CAP);
  const read=await readSet(src,open.map(r=>r.event_id));
  for(const r of open)if(!read.has(r.event_id))counts.set(r.issuer_id,Math.min(UNREAD_CAP,(counts.get(r.issuer_id)??0)+1));
  cursor=page.nextCursor;
  if(cursor===null||page.rows.length===0||[...counts.values()].every(n=>n>=UNREAD_CAP))return {counts,complete:true};
 }
 return {counts,complete:false};
}
export function formatUnread(n:number|null,complete:boolean):string|null{
 if(n===null)return null;
 if(n>=UNREAD_CAP)return '99+';
 return complete?String(n):`${n}+`;
}

/** Issuers whose events the inbox reads: non-muted watches; an explicit watched issuer even when muted; not watched → null. */
export function inboxIssuerIds(watches:Pick<WatchRow,'issuer_id'|'muted'>[],issuerId:string|null):string[]|null{
 if(issuerId!==null)return watches.some(w=>w.issuer_id===issuerId)?[issuerId]:null;
 return watches.filter(w=>!w.muted).map(w=>w.issuer_id);
}

export function inboxFingerprint(q:{kinds?:EventKind[];unreadOnly:boolean;issuerId:string|null}):string{
 return `${[...(q.kinds??EVENT_KINDS)].sort().join(',')}|${q.unreadOnly?1:0}|${q.issuerId??''}`;
}
const b64u=(s:string)=>{let bin='';for(const b of new TextEncoder().encode(s))bin+=String.fromCharCode(b);return btoa(bin).replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=+$/,'');};
const unb64u=(s:string)=>new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:true}).decode(Uint8Array.from(atob(s.replace(/-/g,'+').replace(/_/g,'/')),c=>c.charCodeAt(0)));
/** Public cursor = the CompanyDb cursor bound to the filter it was issued for. */
export function encodeInboxCursor(dbCursor:string,fingerprint:string):string{return b64u(JSON.stringify({v:1,f:fingerprint,c:dbCursor}));}
/** Throws Error('invalid_cursor') for anything not issued by encodeInboxCursor under the same fingerprint. */
export function decodeInboxCursor(raw:string,fingerprint:string):string{
 if(raw.length===0||raw.length>MAX_CURSOR_LEN||!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(raw))throw new Error('invalid_cursor');
 let o:unknown;
 try{o=JSON.parse(unb64u(raw));}catch{throw new Error('invalid_cursor');}
 const c=o as {v?:unknown;f?:unknown;c?:unknown}|null;
 if(!c||c.v!==1||c.f!==fingerprint||typeof c.c!=='string'||c.c==='')throw new Error('invalid_cursor');
 return c.c;
}

export interface FoldableEvent{eventId:string;issuerId:string;occurredOn:string;firstSeenAt:string|null}
export interface FoldGroup<T extends FoldableEvent>{key:string;head:T;rest:T[]}
/** §7.3 same issuer, same day: groups rows with equal (issuer, occurred_on, first-seen UTC day); group sits at its first row. */
export function foldSameIssuerDay<T extends FoldableEvent>(rows:T[]):FoldGroup<T>[]{
 const groups:FoldGroup<T>[]=[];const byKey=new Map<string,FoldGroup<T>>();
 for(const r of rows){
  const key=`${r.issuerId}|${r.occurredOn}|${r.firstSeenAt?new Date(r.firstSeenAt).toISOString().slice(0,10):''}`;
  const g=byKey.get(key);
  if(g)g.rest.push(r);else{const n={key,head:r,rest:[]};byKey.set(key,n);groups.push(n);}
 }
 return groups;
}
export function firstSeenSection(firstSeenAt:string|null,today:string):'today'|'earlier'{
 return firstSeenAt!==null&&new Date(firstSeenAt).toISOString().slice(0,10)===today?'today':'earlier';
}
/** "Mark this page read": the UNREAD ids the client actually shows, per issuer, ≤ READ_BATCH_MAX per request. */
export function readBatches(rows:{eventId:string;issuerId:string;read:boolean}[]):{issuerId:string;eventIds:string[]}[]{
 const per=new Map<string,string[]>();
 for(const r of rows){if(r.read)continue;const l=per.get(r.issuerId);if(l)l.push(r.eventId);else per.set(r.issuerId,[r.eventId]);}
 const out:{issuerId:string;eventIds:string[]}[]=[];
 for(const [issuerId,ids] of per)for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i+=READ_BATCH_MAX)out.push({issuerId,eventIds:ids.slice(i,i+READ_BATCH_MAX)});
 return out;
}
/** "已更新" badge: payload changed strictly after first sight (§7.2: no re-count as unread). */
export function isUpdated(e:{firstSeenAt:string|null;payloadChangedAt:string|null}):boolean{
 if(e.firstSeenAt===null||e.payloadChangedAt===null)return false;
 return Date.parse(e.payloadChangedAt)>Date.parse(e.firstSeenAt);
}
```

```ts
import {describe,expect,it,vi} from 'vitest';
import {CompanyDbError} from './types';
import {importWatchlist} from './tracking-import';

const A='aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa',B='bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb',C='cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc',D='dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd';
const IDS:Record<string,string>={AAPL:A,'600519.SH':B,'600519':B,MSFT:C,NVDA:D};

describe('importWatchlist',()=>{
 it('classifies added / existing / unresolved, dedupes tickers and issuers',async()=>{
  const upsert=vi.fn(async(id:string)=>({created:id!==C}));
  const r=await importWatchlist(['aapl','AAPL','600519.SH','600519','NVTS','MSFT'],{
   resolve:async t=>IDS[t]??null,existing:new Set([A]),upsert,
  });
  expect(r).toEqual({
   added:[{ticker:'600519',issuerId:B}],
   existing:[{ticker:'600519.SH',issuerId:B},{ticker:'AAPL',issuerId:A},{ticker:'MSFT',issuerId:C}],
   unresolved:[{ticker:'NVTS'}],skippedByLimit:[],
  });
  expect(upsert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);   // B once (second ticker of the same issuer is existing), C once (server says it already existed)
 });
 it('a resolver error counts as unresolved, not as a failure',async()=>{
  const r=await importWatchlist(['BAD'],{resolve:async()=>{throw new Error('ambiguous_owner');},existing:new Set(),upsert:vi.fn()});
  expect(r.unresolved).toEqual([{ticker:'BAD'}]);
 });
 it('after watch_limit every further new issuer is skippedByLimit without another insert',async()=>{
  const upsert=vi.fn(async(id:string)=>{if(id===C)throw new CompanyDbError('watch_limit');return {created:true};});
  const r=await importWatchlist(['NVDA','MSFT','AAPL'],{resolve:async t=>IDS[t]??null,existing:new Set(),upsert});   // processed sorted: AAPL, MSFT, NVDA
  expect(r.added).toEqual([{ticker:'AAPL',issuerId:A}]);
  expect(r.skippedByLimit).toEqual([{ticker:'MSFT',issuerId:C},{ticker:'NVDA',issuerId:D}]);
  expect(upsert).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);   // AAPL, MSFT; NVDA is not attempted after the limit
 });
 it('other insert errors propagate',async()=>{
  await expect(importWatchlist(['AAPL'],{resolve:async()=>A,existing:new Set(),upsert:async()=>{throw new Error('boom');}})).rejects.toThrow('boom');
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/tracking-issuers.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {streamOfTicker,toWatchCards} from './tracking-issuers';
import type {CoverageRow,WatchRow} from './types';

const A='aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa',H='eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee',M='ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff';
```
