```ts
// src/lib/company/tracking-import.ts
// POST /api/tracking/watches/import-watchlist core (spec §6.2): server watchlist tickers → issuers → watches.
// Pure over injected resolve/upsert. Tickers are upper-cased, de-duplicated and processed in sorted order;
// an issuer reached by a second ticker is 'existing'. The DB trigger is the limit authority: the first
// watch_limit stops further inserts and every later new issuer is reported as skippedByLimit.
import {CompanyDbError} from './types';

export interface ImportItem{ticker:string;issuerId?:string}
export interface ImportResult{added:ImportItem[];existing:ImportItem[];unresolved:ImportItem[];skippedByLimit:ImportItem[]}
export interface ImportDeps{resolve(ticker:string):Promise<string|null>;existing:Set<string>;upsert(issuerId:string):Promise<{created:boolean}>}

export async function importWatchlist(rawTickers:string[],deps:ImportDeps):Promise<ImportResult>{
 const out:ImportResult={added:[],existing:[],unresolved:[],skippedByLimit:[]};
 const tickers=[...new Set(rawTickers.map(t=>t.trim().toUpperCase()).filter(t=>t!==''))].sort();
 const seen=new Set(deps.existing);let limitHit=false;
 for(const ticker of tickers){
  let issuerId:string|null=null;
  try{issuerId=await deps.resolve(ticker);}catch{issuerId=null;}
  if(!issuerId){out.unresolved.push({ticker});continue;}
  if(seen.has(issuerId)){out.existing.push({ticker,issuerId});continue;}
  if(limitHit){out.skippedByLimit.push({ticker,issuerId});continue;}
  try{
   const r=await deps.upsert(issuerId);
   seen.add(issuerId);
   (r.created?out.added:out.existing).push({ticker,issuerId});
  }catch(e){
   if(e instanceof CompanyDbError&&e.code==='watch_limit'){limitHit=true;out.skippedByLimit.push({ticker,issuerId});continue;}
   throw e;
  }
 }
 return out;
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/tracking-issuers.ts
// Issuer cards for GET /api/tracking/watches (spec §6.2): names and CURRENT tickers from issuers /
// issuer_securities (anon-readable reference data, read with the session client), stream dates from
// issuer_coverage (public), unread counts from inbox.unreadCounts. toWatchCards is pure.
import {isCurrentSecurity} from '../entities/resolve';
import {publicMarketOf} from '../facts/public-route';
import {formatUnread,UNREAD_CAP,type UnreadCounts} from './inbox';
import type {CoverageRow,WatchRow} from './types';

export interface IssuerLite{issuer_id:string;canonical_name_zh:string|null;canonical_name_en:string|null}
export interface SecurityLite{issuer_id:string;ticker:string;is_primary:boolean;valid_from:string;valid_to:string|null}
export type TickerStream='US'|'CN'|'HK';
export interface WatchCard{
 issuerId:string;names:{zh:string|null;en:string|null};
 tickers:{ticker:string;stream:TickerStream|null;isPrimary:boolean}[];
 primaryTicker:Partial<Record<TickerStream,string>>;
 streams:{market:'US'|'CN';latestPeriodEnd:string|null;latestAvailableDate:string|null}[];
 hkOnly:boolean;note:string|null;muted:boolean;createdAt:string;updatedAt:string;
 unread:number|null;unreadLabel:string|null;
}

export const streamOfTicker=(ticker:string):TickerStream|null=>/\.HK$/i.test(ticker)?'HK':publicMarketOf(ticker.toUpperCase());

/** Minimal structural view of the session Supabase client used here (cast at the call site). */
export interface SelectInClient{from(table:string):{select(cols:string):{in(col:string,vals:string[]):PromiseLike<{data:unknown[]|null;error:{message:string}|null}>}}}
const CHUNK=100;
async function selectIn<T>(sb:SelectInClient,table:string,cols:string,col:string,ids:string[]):Promise<T[]>{
 const out:T[]=[];
 for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i+=CHUNK){
  const {data,error}=await sb.from(table).select(cols).in(col,ids.slice(i,i+CHUNK));
  if(error)throw new Error(`${table}_read_failed`);
  out.push(...((data??[]) as T[]));
 }
 return out;
}
export async function loadIssuerLites(sb:SelectInClient,ids:string[]):Promise<{issuers:IssuerLite[];securities:SecurityLite[]}>{
 if(ids.length===0)return {issuers:[],securities:[]};
 const [issuers,securities]=await Promise.all([
  selectIn<IssuerLite>(sb,'issuers','issuer_id,canonical_name_zh,canonical_name_en','issuer_id',ids),
  selectIn<SecurityLite>(sb,'issuer_securities','issuer_id,ticker,is_primary,valid_from,valid_to','issuer_id',ids),
 ]);
 return {issuers,securities};
}

export function toWatchCards(input:{watches:WatchRow[];issuers:IssuerLite[];securities:SecurityLite[];coverage:CoverageRow[];unread:UnreadCounts;today:string}):WatchCard[]{
 const issuer=new Map(input.issuers.map(i=>[i.issuer_id,i]));
 const cards=input.watches.map((w):WatchCard=>{
  const secs=input.securities.filter(s=>s.issuer_id===w.issuer_id&&isCurrentSecurity(s as unknown as Record<string,unknown>,input.today))
   .sort((x,y)=>Number(y.is_primary)-Number(x.is_primary)||x.valid_from.localeCompare(y.valid_from)||x.ticker.localeCompare(y.ticker));
  const tickers=secs.map(s=>({ticker:s.ticker,stream:streamOfTicker(s.ticker),isPrimary:s.is_primary}));
  const primaryTicker:WatchCard['primaryTicker']={};
  for(const t of tickers)if(t.stream&&!primaryTicker[t.stream])primaryTicker[t.stream]=t.ticker;
  const streams=input.coverage.filter(c=>c.issuer_id===w.issuer_id).sort((x,y)=>x.market.localeCompare(y.market))
   .map(c=>({market:c.market,latestPeriodEnd:c.latest_period_end,latestAvailableDate:c.latest_available_date}));
  const n=w.muted?null:Math.min(UNREAD_CAP,input.unread.counts.get(w.issuer_id)??0);
  const i=issuer.get(w.issuer_id);
  return {
   issuerId:w.issuer_id,names:{zh:i?.canonical_name_zh??null,en:i?.canonical_name_en??null},tickers,primaryTicker,streams,
   hkOnly:tickers.length>0&&tickers.every(t=>t.stream==='HK')&&streams.length===0,
   note:w.note,muted:w.muted,createdAt:w.created_at,updatedAt:w.updated_at,
   unread:n,unreadLabel:formatUnread(n,input.unread.complete),
  };
 });
 return cards.sort((x,y)=>y.updatedAt.localeCompare(x.updatedAt)||x.issuerId.localeCompare(y.issuerId));
}
```

注意：`isCurrentSecurity` 的参数类型是 `Row`（`Record<string,unknown>`）；若类型检查对 `as unknown as Record<string,unknown>` 报错以外的问题，保持此强转，不要改 `src/lib/entities/*`。

```ts
// src/lib/company/tracking-route.ts
// Conventions of the per-user tracking routes (spec §6.2, §11, §0 #64): session client + RLS for watches and
// receipts; a SERVICE-ROLE CompanyDb only for issuer_events reads restricted to the user's watched issuers;
// every response (success and error) `Cache-Control: private, no-store`; 401 not_authenticated; mutations
// require Content-Type application/json and a same-origin Origin (as /api/admin/dq/quarantine/[id]).
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';
import {getServerSupabase,serverIsSupabaseConfigured} from '../supabase/server';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../supabase/admin';
import {supabaseTableClient,type TableClient} from '../db/table-client';
import {resolveIssuer} from '../entities/resolve';
import {TICKER_RE,UUID_RE,utcDate} from '../facts/public-route';
import {MAX_COMPANY_WATCHES,supabaseCompanyDb} from './db';
import {CompanyDbError,type CompanyDb,type WatchRow} from './types';

export const PRIVATE_NO_STORE={'Cache-Control':'private, no-store'} as const;
export const EVENT_ID_RE=/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
export const trackingJson=(body:unknown,status=200)=>NextResponse.json(body,{status,headers:PRIVATE_NO_STORE});
export const trackingError=(code:string,message:string,status:number)=>trackingJson({error:{code,message}},status);
export const unauthenticated=()=>trackingError('not_authenticated','sign in required',401);

/** CSRF defence for POST/PATCH/DELETE; null = allowed. */
export function mutationGuard(request:Request):NextResponse|null{
 if(!(request.headers.get('content-type')??'').toLowerCase().startsWith('application/json'))return trackingError('unsupported_media_type','Content-Type must be application/json',415);
 const origin=request.headers.get('origin');
 if(origin!==null&&origin!==new URL(request.url).origin)return trackingError('forbidden_origin','cross-site request',403);
 return null;
}
/** JSON object body or null (malformed / not an object). */
export async function jsonObject(request:Request):Promise<Record<string,unknown>|null>{
 const b:unknown=await request.json().catch(()=>null);
 return b!==null&&typeof b==='object'&&!Array.isArray(b)?b as Record<string,unknown>:null;
}

import type {SupabaseClient} from '@supabase/supabase-js';
type ServerSb=Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getServerSupabase>>;
export interface TrackingSession{userId:string;sb:ServerSb;db:CompanyDb;tables:TableClient}
/** The signed-in user's session-scoped clients, or null (→ 401). */
export async function trackingSession():Promise<TrackingSession|null>{
 if(!serverIsSupabaseConfigured())return null;
 const sb=await getServerSupabase();
 const {data:{user}}=await sb.auth.getUser();
 if(!user)return null;
 const client=sb as unknown as SupabaseClient;   // generated Database generic ≠ adapters' SupabaseClient (same boundary cast as Task 9)
 return {userId:user.id,sb,db:supabaseCompanyDb(client),tables:supabaseTableClient(client)};
}
/** issuer_events is service_role only (§0 #64): callers pass ONLY the user's watched issuer ids. */
export const serviceCompanyDb=():CompanyDb=>supabaseCompanyDb(getAdminSupabase());

export function trackingFailure(e:unknown,tag:string):NextResponse{
 if(e instanceof CompanyDbError&&e.code==='watch_limit')return trackingError('watch_limit',`at most ${MAX_COMPANY_WATCHES} tracked companies`,409);
 if(e instanceof CompanyDbError&&e.code==='invalid_read')return trackingError('invalid_parameter:eventIds','event ids do not belong to this issuer',400);
 if(e instanceof Error&&e.message==='ambiguous_owner')return trackingError('ambiguous_ticker','ticker maps to several issuers',409);
 console.error(`[${tag}]`,e instanceof Error?e.message:e);
 return trackingError('internal','tracking unavailable',500);
}

export const isIssuerId=(v:unknown):v is string=>typeof v==='string'&&UUID_RE.test(v);
export const findWatch=(watches:WatchRow[],issuerId:string)=>watches.find(w=>w.issuer_id===issuerId)??null;
export const watchDto=(r:WatchRow)=>({issuerId:r.issuer_id,note:r.note,muted:r.muted,createdAt:r.created_at,updatedAt:r.updated_at});

/**
 * Watch target from {issuerId} or {ticker} (exactly one). Tracking is issuer-level (§4.3): tickers go through
 * resolveIssuer (HK issuers included), an issuer id must exist; a merged issuer is redirected one hop.
 */
export async function resolveWatchTarget(tables:TableClient,body:Record<string,unknown>):Promise<{issuerId:string}|{error:NextResponse}>{
 const keys=Object.keys(body);
 const hasId='issuerId' in body,hasTicker='ticker' in body;
 if(keys.length!==1||hasId===hasTicker)return {error:trackingError('invalid_parameter:body','give exactly one of issuerId, ticker',400)};
 if(hasId){
  if(!isIssuerId(body.issuerId))return {error:trackingError('invalid_parameter:issuerId','invalid issuerId',400)};
  const [row]=await tables.select('issuers',{issuer_id:body.issuerId},{limit:1});
  if(!row)return {error:trackingError('unknown_issuer','issuer not found',404)};
  if(row.status==='merged'){
   const target=typeof row.merged_into==='string'?row.merged_into:null;
   if(!target)return {error:trackingError('unknown_issuer','issuer not found',404)};
   return {issuerId:target};
  }
  return {issuerId:String(row.issuer_id)};
 }
 const ticker=body.ticker;
 if(typeof ticker!=='string'||!TICKER_RE.test(ticker))return {error:trackingError('invalid_parameter:ticker','invalid ticker',400)};
 const r=await resolveIssuer(tables,{ticker},{today:utcDate(new Date())});
 if(!r)return {error:trackingError('unknown_ticker','ticker not found',404)};
 return {issuerId:r.issuer_id};
}
```

若 `supabaseCompanyDb` 的形参类型与 `getServerSupabase()` 的返回类型（`SupabaseClient<Database>` 的 SSR 变体）不兼容，在调用处写 `supabaseCompanyDb(sb as unknown as Parameters<typeof supabaseCompanyDb>[0])`，不要改 `db.ts` 的签名。`supabaseTableClient(sb)` 同理。

```ts
// src/app/api/tracking/watches/route.ts
// GET: the user's watches with names, current tickers, coverage streams and unread counts (spec §6.2).
// POST: {issuerId} | {ticker} → insert … on conflict do nothing; trigger limit → 409 watch_limit.
import {getAnonSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/anon';
import {supabaseCompanyDb} from '@/lib/company/db';
import {MAX_COMPANY_WATCHES} from '@/lib/company/db';
import {unreadCounts} from '@/lib/company/inbox';
import {loadIssuerLites,toWatchCards,type SelectInClient} from '@/lib/company/tracking-issuers';
import {jsonObject,mutationGuard,resolveWatchTarget,serviceCompanyDb,trackingError,trackingFailure,trackingJson,trackingSession,unauthenticated,watchDto} from '@/lib/company/tracking-route';
import {utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';

export async function GET(){
 const s=await trackingSession();
 if(!s)return unauthenticated();
 try{
  const watches=await s.db.watchesOf(s.userId);
  const ids=watches.map(w=>w.issuer_id);
  const service=serviceCompanyDb();
  const [lites,coverage,unread]=await Promise.all([
   loadIssuerLites(s.sb as unknown as SelectInClient,ids),
   ids.length?supabaseCompanyDb(getAnonSupabase()).coverageOf(ids):Promise.resolve([]),
   unreadCounts({eventsOfIssuers:(i,o)=>service.eventsOfIssuers(i,o),readEventIds:(e)=>s.db.readEventIds(s.userId,e)},watches.filter(w=>!w.muted).map(w=>w.issuer_id)),
  ]);
  const cards=toWatchCards({watches,issuers:lites.issuers,securities:lites.securities,coverage,unread,today:utcDate(new Date())});
  return trackingJson({count:cards.length,limit:MAX_COMPANY_WATCHES,unreadComplete:unread.complete,watches:cards});
 }catch(e){return trackingFailure(e,'tracking/watches');}
}

export async function POST(request:Request){
 const s=await trackingSession();
 if(!s)return unauthenticated();
 const guard=mutationGuard(request);if(guard)return guard;
 const body=await jsonObject(request);
 if(!body)return trackingError('invalid_parameter:body','JSON object required',400);
 try{
  const t=await resolveWatchTarget(s.tables,body);
  if('error' in t)return t.error;
  const {row,created}=await s.db.upsertWatch(s.userId,t.issuerId);
  return trackingJson({watch:{...watchDto(row),created}},created?201:200);
 }catch(e){return trackingFailure(e,'tracking/watches');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/tracking/watches/[issuerId]/route.ts
// PATCH {note?, muted?} and DELETE (receipts cascade through the (user_id, issuer_id) foreign key). spec §6.2.
import {isIssuerId,jsonObject,mutationGuard,trackingError,trackingFailure,trackingJson,trackingSession,unauthenticated,watchDto} from '@/lib/company/tracking-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
interface Ctx{params:Promise<{issuerId:string}>}
const NOTE_MAX=2000;

export async function PATCH(request:Request,{params}:Ctx){
 const s=await trackingSession();
 if(!s)return unauthenticated();
 const guard=mutationGuard(request);if(guard)return guard;
 const {issuerId}=await params;
 if(!isIssuerId(issuerId))return trackingError('invalid_parameter:issuerId','invalid issuerId',400);
 const body=await jsonObject(request);
 if(!body)return trackingError('invalid_parameter:body','JSON object required',400);
 const keys=Object.keys(body);
 if(keys.length===0||keys.some(k=>k!=='note'&&k!=='muted'))return trackingError('invalid_parameter:body','only note and muted may be patched',400);
 const patch:{note?:string|null;muted?:boolean}={};
 if('note' in body){
  const n=body.note;
  if(n!==null&&(typeof n!=='string'||n.length>NOTE_MAX))return trackingError('invalid_parameter:note',`note must be null or ≤ ${NOTE_MAX} characters`,400);
  patch.note=n===null||n.trim()===''?null:n;
 }
 if('muted' in body){
  if(typeof body.muted!=='boolean')return trackingError('invalid_parameter:muted','muted must be boolean',400);
  patch.muted=body.muted;
 }
 try{
  const row=await s.db.patchWatch(s.userId,issuerId,patch);
  if(!row)return trackingError('watch_not_found','not tracking this company',404);
  return trackingJson({watch:watchDto(row)});
 }catch(e){return trackingFailure(e,'tracking/watch');}
}

export async function DELETE(request:Request,{params}:Ctx){
 const s=await trackingSession();
 if(!s)return unauthenticated();
 const guard=mutationGuard(request);if(guard)return guard;
 const {issuerId}=await params;
 if(!isIssuerId(issuerId))return trackingError('invalid_parameter:issuerId','invalid issuerId',400);
 try{
  if(!await s.db.deleteWatch(s.userId,issuerId))return trackingError('watch_not_found','not tracking this company',404);
  return trackingJson({deleted:true});
 }catch(e){return trackingFailure(e,'tracking/watch');}
}
```

注意：`note` 的长度按 JS 字符串长度（UTF-16 码元）检查，数据库约束是 `char_length ≤ 2000`（码点）；JS 侧更严或相等，不会放过数据库会拒的值。

```ts
// src/app/api/tracking/watches/[issuerId]/read/route.ts
// POST {eventIds ≤ 500}: receipts for exactly these ids (spec §6.2). The user must hold the watch; the
// company_event_reads trigger rejects ids of another issuer (→ 400 invalid_parameter:eventIds). No timestamp
// semantics: "mark this page read" posts the ids the client was shown.
import {READ_BATCH_MAX} from '@/lib/company/inbox';
import {EVENT_ID_RE,findWatch,isIssuerId,jsonObject,mutationGuard,trackingError,trackingFailure,trackingJson,trackingSession,unauthenticated} from '@/lib/company/tracking-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
interface Ctx{params:Promise<{issuerId:string}>}
const badIds=()=>trackingError('invalid_parameter:eventIds',`eventIds: 1..${READ_BATCH_MAX} event ids`,400);

export async function POST(request:Request,{params}:Ctx){
 const s=await trackingSession();
 if(!s)return unauthenticated();
 const guard=mutationGuard(request);if(guard)return guard;
 const {issuerId}=await params;
 if(!isIssuerId(issuerId))return trackingError('invalid_parameter:issuerId','invalid issuerId',400);
 const body=await jsonObject(request);
 const ids=body?.eventIds;
 if(!Array.isArray(ids)||ids.length===0||ids.length>READ_BATCH_MAX||ids.some(v=>typeof v!=='string'||!EVENT_ID_RE.test(v)))return badIds();
 const unique=[...new Set(ids as string[])];
 try{
  if(!findWatch(await s.db.watchesOf(s.userId),issuerId))return trackingError('watch_not_found','not tracking this company',404);
  return trackingJson(await s.db.markRead(s.userId,issuerId,unique));
 }catch(e){return trackingFailure(e,'tracking/read');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/tracking/watches/import-watchlist/route.ts
// POST: server-side watchlist_items tickers (RLS) → resolveIssuer → watches (spec §6.2). Guest/localStorage
// watchlists are invisible to the server: no rows → 409 no_server_watchlist.
import {resolveIssuer} from '@/lib/entities/resolve';
import {utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {importWatchlist} from '@/lib/company/tracking-import';
import {mutationGuard,trackingError,trackingFailure,trackingJson,trackingSession,unauthenticated} from '@/lib/company/tracking-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const MAX_TICKERS=1000;

export async function POST(request:Request){
 const s=await trackingSession();
 if(!s)return unauthenticated();
 const guard=mutationGuard(request);if(guard)return guard;
 try{
  const {data,error}=await s.sb.from('watchlist_items').select('ticker').limit(MAX_TICKERS);
  if(error)throw new Error('watchlist_read_failed');
  const tickers=((data??[]) as {ticker:unknown}[]).map(r=>r.ticker).filter((t):t is string=>typeof t==='string');
  if(tickers.length===0)return trackingError('no_server_watchlist','no server-side watchlist to import',409);
  const today=utcDate(new Date());
  const existing=new Set((await s.db.watchesOf(s.userId)).map(w=>w.issuer_id));
  const result=await importWatchlist(tickers,{
   resolve:async t=>(await resolveIssuer(s.tables,{ticker:t},{today}))?.issuer_id??null,
   existing,
   upsert:async id=>({created:(await s.db.upsertWatch(s.userId,id)).created}),
  });
  return trackingJson(result);
 }catch(e){return trackingFailure(e,'tracking/import');}
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/tracking/inbox/route.ts
// GET ?cursor&limit≤200&kinds&unreadOnly=1&issuerId (spec §6.2, §7.3, §0 #64). Watches and receipts via the
// session client (RLS); issuer_events via the service-role CompanyDb restricted to the user's watched issuer
// ids (non-muted, or the one explicit watched issuerId, muted or not). Keyset (first_seen_at desc, event_id
// desc). Payload values pass the shared evidence gate (same function as /api/companies/[ticker]/events).
import {gateEventRows} from '@/lib/company/event-dto';
import {productionEventGateDeps} from '@/lib/company/deps';
import {assembleInbox,decodeInboxCursor,encodeInboxCursor,inboxFingerprint,inboxIssuerIds,INBOX_DEFAULT_LIMIT,INBOX_MAX_LIMIT} from '@/lib/company/inbox';
import {serviceCompanyDb,trackingError,trackingFailure,trackingJson,trackingSession,unauthenticated} from '@/lib/company/tracking-route';
import {EVENT_KINDS,type EventKind} from '@/lib/company/types';
import {QueryError,UUID_RE,flagParam,intParam,listParam,readParams} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['cursor','limit','kinds','unreadOnly','issuerId'] as const;

export async function GET(request:Request){
 const s=await trackingSession();
 if(!s)return unauthenticated();
 let limit:number,kinds:EventKind[]|undefined,unreadOnly:boolean,issuerId:string|null,cursorRaw:string|undefined;
 try{
  const p=readParams(new URL(request.url),PARAMS);
  limit=intParam(p,'limit',INBOX_DEFAULT_LIMIT,INBOX_MAX_LIMIT);
  kinds=listParam(p,'kinds',new Set(EVENT_KINDS),EVENT_KINDS.length) as EventKind[]|undefined;
  unreadOnly=flagParam(p,'unreadOnly');
  issuerId=p.get('issuerId')??null;
  if(issuerId!==null&&!UUID_RE.test(issuerId))throw new QueryError('issuerId');
  cursorRaw=p.get('cursor');
 }catch(e){
  if(e instanceof QueryError)return trackingError(e.message,`invalid ${e.param}`,400);
  return trackingFailure(e,'tracking/inbox');
 }
 const fingerprint=inboxFingerprint({kinds,unreadOnly,issuerId});
 let dbCursor:string|null=null;
 if(cursorRaw!==undefined){
  try{dbCursor=decodeInboxCursor(cursorRaw,fingerprint);}catch{return trackingError('invalid_parameter:cursor','invalid cursor',400);}
 }
 try{
  const issuerIds=inboxIssuerIds(await s.db.watchesOf(s.userId),issuerId);
  if(issuerIds===null)return trackingError('watch_not_found','not tracking this company',404);
  if(issuerIds.length===0)return trackingJson({rows:[],nextCursor:null,evidence:{}});
  const service=serviceCompanyDb();
  const page=await assembleInbox(
   {eventsOfIssuers:(i,o)=>service.eventsOfIssuers(i,o),readEventIds:(e)=>s.db.readEventIds(s.userId,e)},
   {issuerIds,kinds,unreadOnly,limit,cursor:dbCursor},
  );
  const {events,evidence}=await gateEventRows(page.rows,productionEventGateDeps(),{admin:false});
  const read=new Map(page.rows.map(r=>[r.event_id,r.read]));
  return trackingJson({
   rows:events.map(e=>({...e,read:read.get(e.eventId)===true})),
   nextCursor:page.nextCursor===null?null:encodeInboxCursor(page.nextCursor,fingerprint),
   evidence,
  });
 }catch(e){return trackingFailure(e,'tracking/inbox');}
}
```

### Task 17: `/watchlist/tracking` 收件箱页 + 公司页跟踪视图

规格：§6.2、§7.3、§5.10（tracking 行）、§5.9、决策 G（不显示"预计披露日"）；画板 `Tracking.dc.html`、`M-Tracking.dc.html`（先读这两个画板源文件；数值为示意）。

**指挥决定（本任务）：**
- "标记本页已读"提交**当前已加载并显示**的全部未读行（含折叠组内的行），按发行人分组、每批 ≤ 500（`readBatches`）。理由：用户看到的就是"本页"；分页外、过滤外、迟提交的行不会被提交。
- 收件箱里的数值不做抽屉按钮，整行链接到公司页（`view=statements&asOf=<occurred_on>` 或 `view=filings`），抽屉在公司页打开。理由：事件 payload 只有 `factId/value`，抽屉序列需要公司页的同快照读（§0 #68）。
- 收件箱数值按披露单位原样分组显示（`383,285,000,000 USD`），不做"亿/bn"缩放。理由：缩放规则属于报表网格（Task 7），事件行不复制它。
- 概念名用 `company.concepts.<conceptId>`（`t.has` 判断，缺失时显示概念 id 的等宽文本）。理由：概念标签归 Task 11/12 的 `company` 域。
- 移动端（< 640px）按 M-Tracking：发行人芯片横滑 + "管理"展开 watch 面板。
- 公司页跟踪视图：已跟踪 → `GET /api/tracking/inbox?issuerId=`（含静音、带已读）；未跟踪 → 公共 `GET /api/companies/[ticker]/events`（无已读，提示"跟踪后可记录已读"）；有 `asOf` → 公共 events 路由带 `asOf`（现算），已读操作禁用并显示"回放模式不记录已读"。`TrackButton` 用 `inbox?issuerId=&limit=1` 的 200/404 判定是否已跟踪（不调用要扫描未读数的 `GET /watches`）。

```ts
// src/lib/company/event-text.ts
// Display model of one tracking event (spec §7.1–7.3; plan Task 17). Pure and browser-safe. Values are the
// disclosed value_text strings: grouped, never parsed to floats; relChange (exact decimal ratio) becomes a
// percent through BigInt. A gated value ({kind:'withheld',reason}) is shown as its reason only.
import type {PublicEvent} from './event-dto';

export type WithheldView={kind:'withheld';reason:'evidence_incomplete'|'citation_pending'};
export type ValueView={kind:'value';text:string}|WithheldView|{kind:'missing'};
export type EventSummary=
 |{kind:'filing_published';formType:string;fiscalYear:number|null;fiscalPeriod:string|null;factCount:number|null}
 |{kind:'period_first_seen';periodEnd:string;duration:string;conceptCount:number|null;headline:{concept:string;value:ValueView}[];ambiguousUnits:string[]}
 |{kind:'fact_revised';concept:string;periodEnd:string;duration:string;from:ValueView;to:ValueView;relChange:ValueView|null};

const obj=(v:unknown):Record<string,unknown>|null=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)?v as Record<string,unknown>:null;
const str=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='string'?v:null;
const num=(v:unknown)=>typeof v==='number'&&Number.isFinite(v)?v:null;
const HEADLINE_ORDER=['revenue','revenue_operating','net_income_parent','operating_cash_flow'];

export function groupDigits(v:string):string{
 const m=/^(-?)(\d+)(\.\d+)?$/.exec(v);
 if(!m)return v;
 return m[1]+m[2].replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g,',')+(m[3]??'');
}
/** Exact decimal ratio → signed percent with `dp` decimals, half away from zero. */
export function ratioToPercent(r:string,dp=4):string|null{
 const m=/^(-?)(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?$/.exec(r);
 if(!m)return null;
 const neg=m[1]==='-',frac=(m[3]??'').padEnd(dp+3,'0');
 let n=BigInt(m[2]+frac.slice(0,dp+2));
 if(Number(frac[dp+2])>=5)n+=1n;
 if(n===0n)return `0.${'0'.repeat(dp)}%`;
 const s=n.toString().padStart(dp+1,'0');
 return `${neg?'-':'+'}${s.slice(0,s.length-dp)}.${s.slice(s.length-dp)}%`;
}
function withheldOf(v:unknown):WithheldView|null{
 const o=obj(v);
 return o&&o.kind==='withheld'&&(o.reason==='evidence_incomplete'||o.reason==='citation_pending')?{kind:'withheld',reason:o.reason}:null;
}
export function valueView(v:unknown,unit:string|null):ValueView{
 const w=withheldOf(v);if(w)return w;
 const s=str(v);if(s===null)return {kind:'missing'};
 return {kind:'value',text:unit?`${groupDigits(s)} ${unit}`:groupDigits(s)};
}
export function eventSummary(e:Pick<PublicEvent,'kind'|'payload'>):EventSummary{
 const p=e.payload;
 switch(e.kind){
  case 'filing_published':
   return {kind:'filing_published',formType:str(p.formType)??'',fiscalYear:num(p.fiscalYear),fiscalPeriod:str(p.fiscalPeriod),factCount:num(p.factCount)};
  case 'period_first_seen':{
   const h=obj(p.headline)??{};
   return {kind:'period_first_seen',periodEnd:str(p.periodEnd)??'',duration:str(p.duration)??'',conceptCount:num(p.conceptCount),
    headline:HEADLINE_ORDER.filter(c=>obj(h[c])!==null).map(c=>{const x=obj(h[c])!;return {concept:c,value:valueView(x.value,str(x.unit))};}),
    ambiguousUnits:Array.isArray(p.ambiguousUnits)?p.ambiguousUnits.filter((x):x is string=>typeof x==='string'):[]};
  }
  case 'fact_revised':{
   const unit=str(p.unit),rel=p.relChange;
   let relChange:ValueView|null=null;
   if(rel!==undefined){const w=withheldOf(rel);const pct=typeof rel==='string'?ratioToPercent(rel):null;relChange=w??(pct!==null?{kind:'value',text:pct}:{kind:'missing'});}
   return {kind:'fact_revised',concept:str(p.concept)??'',periodEnd:str(p.periodEnd)??'',duration:str(p.duration)??'',
    from:valueView(obj(p.from)?.value,unit),to:valueView(obj(p.to)?.value,unit),relChange};
  }
 }
}
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/tracking-client.ts
// Browser helpers for the tracking API (spec §6.2). Mutations send Content-Type application/json (the routes'
// CSRF guard); every call is cache: 'no-store'; a non-2xx answer throws TrackingApiError(code, status).
import {readBatches} from './inbox';
import type {EventKind,EvidenceDto,WithheldCounts} from './types';
import type {PublicEvent} from './event-dto';
import type {WatchCard} from './tracking-issuers';
import type {ImportResult} from './tracking-import';
export type {WatchCard,ImportResult};

export interface InboxRowDto extends PublicEvent{read:boolean}
export interface InboxResponse{rows:InboxRowDto[];nextCursor:string|null;evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>}
export interface WatchesResponse{count:number;limit:number;unreadComplete:boolean;watches:WatchCard[]}
export interface WatchDto{issuerId:string;note:string|null;muted:boolean;createdAt:string;updatedAt:string}
/** Task 10 EventsDto (handlers/events.ts), the fields this client reads; replay truncation is a 400 replay_truncated, not a flag. */
export interface EventsResponse{rows:PublicEvent[];nextCursor:string|null;evidence:Record<string,EvidenceDto>;computed:'materialized'|'live';withheld:WithheldCounts}

export class TrackingApiError extends Error{
 constructor(public readonly code:string,public readonly status:number){super(code);this.name='TrackingApiError';}
}
async function call<T>(url:string,init?:RequestInit):Promise<T>{
 const res=await fetch(url,{...init,cache:'no-store'});
 const body=await res.json().catch(()=>null) as {error?:{code?:string}}|null;
 if(!res.ok)throw new TrackingApiError(body?.error?.code??'internal',res.status);
 return body as T;
}
const send=<T>(method:'POST'|'PATCH'|'DELETE',url:string,body:unknown)=>call<T>(url,{method,body:JSON.stringify(body??{}),headers:{'content-type':'application/json'}});

export const fetchWatches=()=>call<WatchesResponse>('/api/tracking/watches');
export function fetchInbox(q:{cursor?:string|null;limit?:number;kinds?:EventKind[];unreadOnly?:boolean;issuerId?:string|null}):Promise<InboxResponse>{
 const p=new URLSearchParams();
 if(q.limit!==undefined)p.set('limit',String(q.limit));
 if(q.kinds&&q.kinds.length)p.set('kinds',q.kinds.join(','));
 if(q.unreadOnly)p.set('unreadOnly','1');
 if(q.issuerId)p.set('issuerId',q.issuerId);
 if(q.cursor)p.set('cursor',q.cursor);
 const qs=p.toString();
 return call<InboxResponse>(`/api/tracking/inbox${qs?`?${qs}`:''}`);
}
export function fetchCompanyEvents(ticker:string,q:{asOf?:string|null;cursor?:string|null;limit?:number}):Promise<EventsResponse>{
 const p=new URLSearchParams();
 p.set('limit',String(q.limit??50));
 if(q.asOf)p.set('asOf',q.asOf);
 if(q.cursor)p.set('cursor',q.cursor);
 return call<EventsResponse>(`/api/companies/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}/events?${p.toString()}`);
}
export const addWatch=(target:{issuerId:string}|{ticker:string})=>send<{watch:WatchDto&{created:boolean}}>('POST','/api/tracking/watches',target);
export const patchWatch=(issuerId:string,patch:{note?:string|null;muted?:boolean})=>send<{watch:WatchDto}>('PATCH',`/api/tracking/watches/${issuerId}`,patch);
export const removeWatch=(issuerId:string)=>send<{deleted:true}>('DELETE',`/api/tracking/watches/${issuerId}`,{});
export const markRead=(issuerId:string,eventIds:string[])=>send<{inserted:number}>('POST',`/api/tracking/watches/${issuerId}/read`,{eventIds});
export const importFromWatchlist=()=>send<ImportResult>('POST','/api/tracking/watches/import-watchlist',{});
/** "Mark this page read": the unread ids shown, per issuer, ≤ 500 per request; returns receipts inserted. */
export async function markRowsRead(rows:{eventId:string;issuerId:string;read:boolean}[]):Promise<number>{
 let inserted=0;
 for(const b of readBatches(rows))inserted+=(await markRead(b.issuerId,b.eventIds)).inserted;
 return inserted;
}
/** true / false from the inbox's 200 / 404 watch_not_found for one issuer (cheap: limit=1). */
export async function isWatching(issuerId:string):Promise<boolean>{
 try{await fetchInbox({issuerId,limit:1});return true;}
 catch(e){if(e instanceof TrackingApiError&&e.code==='watch_not_found')return false;throw e;}
}
```

注意：`tracking-client.test.ts` 第二个用例断言 `headers:{'content-type':'application/json'}` 与 `body:'{}'`，`send` 的写法必须保持如上（`cache` 由 `call` 追加）。

```tsx
// src/components/company/tracking/EventSummaryText.tsx
// One-line text of a tracking event (spec §7.3; artboards Tracking / M-Tracking). Values come from
// eventSummary (exact decimal text); withheld values show their reason only.
'use client';

import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { eventSummary, type ValueView } from '@/lib/company/event-text';
import type { PublicEvent } from '@/lib/company/event-dto';

export function useConceptLabel() {
  const tc = useTranslations('company');
  return (concept: string) => (tc.has(`concepts.${concept}`) ? tc(`concepts.${concept}`) : concept);
}

function Value({ v }: { v: ValueView }) {
  const t = useTranslations('tracking');
  if (v.kind === 'value') return <span className="font-mono tabular-nums">{v.text}</span>;
  if (v.kind === 'withheld') return <span className="text-text-dim">— {t(`withheld.${v.reason}`)}</span>;
  return <span className="text-text-dim">—</span>;
}

export function EventSummaryText({ event }: { event: Pick<PublicEvent, 'kind' | 'payload'> }) {
  const t = useTranslations('tracking');
  const label = useConceptLabel();
  const s = eventSummary(event);
  if (s.kind === 'filing_published') {
    return (
      <span>
        {s.formType} {s.fiscalYear ?? ''} {s.fiscalPeriod ?? ''}
        {s.factCount !== null && <> · {t('summary.facts', { count: s.factCount })}</>}
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (s.kind === 'period_first_seen') {
    return (
      <span>
        <span className="font-mono">{s.periodEnd}</span> {s.duration}
        {s.headline.length === 0 && <> · {t('summary.noHeadline')}</>}
        {s.headline.map((h) => (
          <span key={h.concept}> · {label(h.concept)} <Value v={h.value} /></span>
        ))}
        {s.ambiguousUnits.length > 0 && (
          <span className="text-text-dim"> · {t('summary.ambiguous', { concepts: s.ambiguousUnits.map(label).join('、') })}</span>
        )}
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span>
      <span className="font-mono">{s.periodEnd}</span> {s.duration} {label(s.concept)} <Value v={s.from} /> → <Value v={s.to} />
      {s.relChange && <> （<Value v={s.relChange} />）</>}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/tracking/InboxEventRow.tsx
// One folded inbox group (spec §7.3): issuer, kind tag, "updated" when payload_changed_at > first_seen_at,
// same-day fold count, available date, summary, deep link to the company page. Unread = brass dot.
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Tag } from '@/components/ui';
import { isUpdated } from '@/lib/company/inbox';
import type { PublicEvent } from '@/lib/company/event-dto';
import type { WatchCard } from '@/lib/company/tracking-client';
import { EventSummaryText } from './EventSummaryText';

export type DisplayEvent = PublicEvent & { read: boolean };

export function companyHref(event: Pick<PublicEvent, 'kind' | 'occurredOn' | 'market'>, ticker: string | null) {
  if (!ticker) return null;
  const base = `/stock/${encodeURIComponent(ticker)}`;
  return event.kind === 'filing_published' ? `${base}?view=filings` : `${base}?view=statements&asOf=${event.occurredOn}`;
}

export function InboxEventRow({
  head, rest, card, showIssuer = true,
}: { head: DisplayEvent; rest: DisplayEvent[]; card?: WatchCard; showIssuer?: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations('tracking');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const all = [head, ...rest];
  const unread = all.some((e) => !e.read);
  const ticker = card?.primaryTicker[head.market] ?? null;
  const href = companyHref(head, ticker);
  const name = card ? (card.names.zh ?? card.names.en ?? ticker ?? head.issuerId) : (ticker ?? '');
  const kinds = [...new Set(all.map((e) => e.kind))];
  return (
    <li className="border-b border-border px-3 py-2.5 last:border-b-0" data-testid="inbox-row" data-event-id={head.eventId}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-sm">
        <span
          aria-label={unread ? t('inbox.unread') : undefined}
          className={`inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${unread ? 'bg-accent' : 'bg-transparent'}`}
        />
        {showIssuer && <span className="font-semibold">{name}</span>}
        {kinds.map((k) => <Tag key={k} tone="neutral">{t(`filters.${k}`)}</Tag>)}
        {all.some((e) => isUpdated(e)) && <Tag tone="accent">{t('inbox.updated')}</Tag>}
        {rest.length > 0 && <Tag tone="neutral">{t('inbox.folded', { count: rest.length })}</Tag>}
        <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-[11px] text-text-dim">{t('inbox.available', { date: head.occurredOn })}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 text-[13px] text-text-muted">
        <EventSummaryText event={head} />
        {href && (
          <Link href={href as never} className="shrink-0 text-xs text-accent">
            {head.kind === 'filing_published' ? t('inbox.toFilings') : t('inbox.toStatements')}
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>
      {rest.length > 0 && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} className="mt-1 text-xs text-text-dim hover:text-text">
          {open ? t('inbox.collapse') : t('inbox.expand', { count: rest.length })}
        </button>
      )}
      {open && (
        <ul className="mt-1 space-y-1 border-l border-border pl-3 text-[13px] text-text-muted">
          {rest.map((e) => (
            <li key={e.eventId} data-testid="inbox-folded-row">
              <Tag tone="neutral">{t(`filters.${e.kind}`)}</Tag> <EventSummaryText event={e} />
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/tracking/WatchPanel.tsx
// Left column of the inbox (artboard Tracking): count n/200, add by ticker, import from watchlist, issuer
// filter list with unread labels (99+), mute / note / remove per watch. Muted issuers show no count.
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Button, Card, Tag } from '@/components/ui';
import { useToast } from '@/components/Toast';
import {
  addWatch, importFromWatchlist, patchWatch, removeWatch, TrackingApiError,
  type ImportResult, type WatchCard, type WatchesResponse,
} from '@/lib/company/tracking-client';

export function useTrackingError() {
  const t = useTranslations('tracking');
  return (e: unknown, limit: number) => {
    const code = e instanceof TrackingApiError ? e.code : 'internal';
    if (code === 'watch_limit') return t('errors.watch_limit', { limit });
    if (code === 'unknown_ticker') return t('errors.unknown_ticker');
    if (code === 'no_server_watchlist') return t('import.noServerWatchlist');
    return t('errors.generic', { code });
  };
}

export function streamLabel(card: WatchCard, t: ReturnType<typeof useTranslations>) {
  if (card.hkOnly) return t('stream.hkPending');
  if (card.streams.length === 0) return t('stream.none');
  return card.streams.map((s) => t(`stream.${s.market}`)).join(' · ');
}

function WatchItem({ card, selected, onSelect, onChanged, limit }: {
  card: WatchCard; selected: boolean; onSelect: () => void; onChanged: () => void; limit: number;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('tracking');
  const { show } = useToast();
  const errorText = useTrackingError();
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [note, setNote] = useState(card.note ?? '');
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const name = card.names.zh ?? card.names.en ?? card.tickers[0]?.ticker ?? card.issuerId;
  const run = async (fn: () => Promise<unknown>) => {
    try { await fn(); onChanged(); } catch (e) { show(errorText(e, limit)); }
  };
  return (
    <li className={`rounded-md px-2 py-2 ${selected ? 'bg-bg-elevated' : ''}`} data-testid="watch-item" data-issuer-id={card.issuerId}>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={onSelect} className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left">
          <div className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">{name}</div>
          <div className="truncate text-[11px] text-text-dim">
            {card.muted ? `${t('watches.muted')} · ${t('watches.mutedHint')}` : streamLabel(card, t)}
          </div>
        </button>
        {card.unreadLabel !== null && (
          <Tag tone={card.unread ? 'accent' : 'neutral'} data-testid="unread-count">{card.unreadLabel}</Tag>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => run(() => patchWatch(card.issuerId, { muted: !card.muted }))}>
          {card.muted ? t('watches.unmute') : t('watches.mute')}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setEditing(!editing)}>{t('watches.note')}</Button>
        {confirming ? (
          <Button variant="danger" size="sm" onClick={() => run(() => removeWatch(card.issuerId))}>{t('watches.confirmRemove')}</Button>
        ) : (
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setConfirming(true)}>{t('watches.remove')}</Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {card.note && !editing && <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap text-[12px] text-text-muted">{card.note}</p>}
      {editing && (
        <div className="mt-1 space-y-1">
          <textarea
            value={note}
            maxLength={2000}
            onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
            placeholder={t('watches.notePlaceholder')}
            className="w-full rounded-md bg-bg-card px-2 py-1 text-[13px]"
            rows={3}
          />
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => run(async () => { await patchWatch(card.issuerId, { note: note.trim() === '' ? null : note }); setEditing(false); })}>
              {t('watches.save')}
            </Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => { setNote(card.note ?? ''); setEditing(false); }}>{t('watches.cancel')}</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

export function WatchPanel({ data, selected, onSelect, onChanged, onImported }: {
  data: WatchesResponse; selected: string | null; onSelect: (issuerId: string | null) => void;
  onChanged: () => void; onImported: (r: ImportResult) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('tracking');
  const { show } = useToast();
  const errorText = useTrackingError();
  const [ticker, setTicker] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const add = async () => {
    if (!ticker.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try { await addWatch({ ticker: ticker.trim() }); setTicker(''); onChanged(); }
    catch (e) { show(errorText(e, data.limit)); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const doImport = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try { onImported(await importFromWatchlist()); onChanged(); }
    catch (e) { show(errorText(e, data.limit)); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return (
    <Card>
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{t('watches.title')}</span>
        <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-text-dim" data-testid="watch-count">{t('page.count', { count: data.count, limit: data.limit })}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="mb-2 flex gap-1">
        <input
          value={ticker}
          onChange={(e) => setTicker(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') void add(); }}
          placeholder={t('watches.addPlaceholder')}
          className="min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-md bg-bg-card px-2 py-1 text-[13px]"
        />
        <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={add}>{t('watches.add')}</Button>
      </div>
      <Button size="sm" variant="secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={doImport} className="mb-2 w-full">{t('watches.import')}</Button>
      {data.count === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-[13px] text-text-dim">{t('watches.empty')}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="space-y-0.5">
          <li>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => onSelect(null)} className={`w-full rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-sm ${selected === null ? 'bg-bg-elevated font-semibold' : 'text-text-dim'}`}>
              {t('watches.all')}
            </button>
          </li>
          {data.watches.map((c) => (
            <WatchItem key={c.issuerId} card={c} limit={data.limit} selected={selected === c.issuerId} onSelect={() => onSelect(c.issuerId)} onChanged={onChanged} />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/tracking/TrackingInbox.tsx
// /watchlist/tracking body (spec §6.2, §7.3; artboards Tracking, M-Tracking): watch panel, kind filter,
// unread-only, "mark this page read" (the unread ids shown, per issuer, ≤500 per request), first-seen
// sections (today / earlier), same-issuer same-day fold, keyset "load more". No email/push; no expected
// disclosure dates (decision G).
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Button, Card } from '@/components/ui';
import { useToast } from '@/components/Toast';
import { EVENT_KINDS, type EventKind } from '@/lib/company/types';
import { firstSeenSection, foldSameIssuerDay, INBOX_DEFAULT_LIMIT } from '@/lib/company/inbox';
import {
  fetchInbox, fetchWatches, markRowsRead, TrackingApiError,
  type ImportResult, type InboxRowDto, type WatchesResponse,
} from '@/lib/company/tracking-client';
import { ImportResultPanel } from './ImportResultPanel';
import { InboxEventRow } from './InboxEventRow';
import { WatchPanel, useTrackingError } from './WatchPanel';

type KindFilter = 'all' | EventKind;
const codeOf = (e: unknown) => (e instanceof TrackingApiError ? e.code : 'internal');

export function TrackingInbox() {
  const t = useTranslations('tracking');
  const { show } = useToast();
  const errorText = useTrackingError();
  const [watches, setWatches] = useState<WatchesResponse | null>(null);
  const [issuer, setIssuer] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<KindFilter>('all');
  const [unreadOnly, setUnreadOnly] = useState(false);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<InboxRowDto[]>([]);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [importResult, setImportResult] = useState<ImportResult | null>(null);
  const [manageOpen, setManageOpen] = useState(false);
  const seq = useRef(0);
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  const loadWatches = useCallback(async () => {
    try { setWatches(await fetchWatches()); } catch (e) { setError(codeOf(e)); }
  }, []);
  const loadInbox = useCallback(async (from: string | null) => {
    const my = ++seq.current;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const r = await fetchInbox({ cursor: from, limit: INBOX_DEFAULT_LIMIT, kinds: kind === 'all' ? undefined : [kind], unreadOnly, issuerId: issuer });
      if (my !== seq.current) return;
      setRows((prev) => (from ? [...prev, ...r.rows] : r.rows));
      setCursor(r.nextCursor);
      setError(null);
    } catch (e) {
      if (my === seq.current) setError(codeOf(e));
    } finally {
      if (my === seq.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [kind, unreadOnly, issuer]);

  useEffect(() => { void loadWatches(); }, [loadWatches]);
  useEffect(() => { void loadInbox(null); }, [loadInbox]);

  const refreshAll = useCallback(() => { void loadWatches(); void loadInbox(null); }, [loadWatches, loadInbox]);
  const cards = useMemo(() => new Map((watches?.watches ?? []).map((c) => [c.issuerId, c])), [watches]);
  const groups = useMemo(() => foldSameIssuerDay(rows), [rows]);
  const hasUnread = rows.some((r) => !r.read);

  const markPage = async () => {
    try {
      const n = await markRowsRead(rows);
      setRows((prev) => (unreadOnly ? [] : prev.map((r) => ({ ...r, read: true }))));
      show(t('inbox.markedRead', { count: n }));
      void loadWatches();
      if (unreadOnly) void loadInbox(null);
    } catch (e) { show(errorText(e, watches?.limit ?? 200)); }
  };

  let lastSection: string | null = null;
  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">{t('page.title')}</h1>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-text-dim">{t('page.subtitle')}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-md border border-border p-1 text-sm">
          <Link href="/watchlist" className="rounded px-3 py-1 text-text-dim">{t('page.kanban')}</Link>
          <span className="rounded bg-accent-dim/20 px-3 py-1 font-semibold text-accent">{t('page.tracking')}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {importResult && <ImportResultPanel result={importResult} onDismiss={() => setImportResult(null)} />}

      {/* mobile: issuer chips + manage toggle (M-Tracking) */}
      {watches && (
        <div className="mb-2 sm:hidden">
          <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pb-1" data-testid="issuer-chips">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setIssuer(null)} className={`shrink-0 rounded border px-2 py-1 text-xs ${issuer === null ? 'border-accent text-accent' : 'border-border text-text-dim'}`}>
              {t('watches.all')}
            </button>
            {watches.watches.map((c) => (
              <button key={c.issuerId} type="button" onClick={() => setIssuer(c.issuerId)} className={`shrink-0 rounded border px-2 py-1 text-xs ${issuer === c.issuerId ? 'border-accent text-accent' : 'border-border text-text-dim'}`}>
                {c.names.zh ?? c.names.en ?? c.tickers[0]?.ticker} {c.unreadLabel ?? ''}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setManageOpen(!manageOpen)}>{t('watches.manage')}</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[280px_1fr]">
        <div className={manageOpen ? '' : 'hidden sm:block'}>
          {watches && (
            <WatchPanel data={watches} selected={issuer} onSelect={setIssuer} onChanged={refreshAll} onImported={setImportResult} />
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-md border border-border p-1 text-xs" role="tablist">
              {(['all', ...EVENT_KINDS] as KindFilter[]).map((k) => (
                <button key={k} type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={kind === k} onClick={() => setKind(k)}
                  className={`rounded px-2 py-1 ${kind === k ? 'bg-accent-dim/20 font-semibold text-accent' : 'text-text-dim'}`}>
                  {t(`filters.${k}`)}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <label className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-text-dim">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={unreadOnly} onChange={(e) => setUnreadOnly(e.target.checked)} />
              {t('filters.unreadOnly')}
            </label>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" className="ml-auto" disabled={!hasUnread} onClick={markPage}>
              {t('filters.markPageRead')}
            </Button>
          </div>

          {error && (
            <Card className="mb-2 text-[13px]">
              {t('inbox.error', { code: error })}{' '}
              <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={refreshAll}>{t('inbox.retry')}</Button>
            </Card>
          )}

          {watches?.count === 0 ? (
            <Card className="text-[13px] text-text-dim">{t('watches.empty')}</Card>
          ) : rows.length === 0 && !loading ? (
            <Card className="text-[13px] text-text-dim">
              {unreadOnly ? (
                <>{t('inbox.noUnread')} <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setUnreadOnly(false)}>{t('inbox.showAll')}</Button></>
              ) : t('inbox.empty')}
            </Card>
          ) : (
            <Card className="p-0">
              <ul data-testid="inbox-list">
                {groups.map((g) => {
                  const section = firstSeenSection(g.head.firstSeenAt, today);
                  const header = section !== lastSection
                    ? <li key={`s-${g.key}`} className="bg-bg-elevated px-3 py-1 text-[11px] text-text-dim">{section === 'today' ? t('inbox.today') : t('inbox.earlier')}</li>
                    : null;
                  lastSection = section;
                  return [header, <InboxEventRow key={g.key} head={g.head} rest={g.rest} card={cards.get(g.head.issuerId)} />];
                })}
              </ul>
            </Card>
          )}

          <div className="mt-2 text-center">
            {loading && <span className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('inbox.loading')}</span>}
            {!loading && cursor && <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => loadInbox(cursor)}>{t('inbox.loadMore')}</Button>}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

```ts
// src/components/company/tracking/guarded-load.test.ts
// 计划第 3 轮审计 R7: a late response of a superseded scope never writes rows, errors or the loading flag.
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {LoadGenerations,guardedLoad,type LoadSink,type PageResult} from './guarded-load';

function deferred<T>(){let resolve!:(v:T)=>void,reject!:(e:unknown)=>void;const promise=new Promise<T>((res,rej)=>{resolve=res;reject=rej;});return {promise,resolve,reject};}
function recorder(){
 const log:{rows:string[];cursor:string|null;error:string|null;loading:boolean}={rows:[],cursor:null,error:null,loading:false};
 const sink:LoadSink<string>={setLoading:(v)=>{log.loading=v;},page:(from,r)=>{log.rows=from?[...log.rows,...r.rows]:r.rows;log.cursor=r.nextCursor;log.error=null;},fail:(c)=>{log.error=c;}};
 return {log,sink};
}
const codeOf=(e:unknown)=>e instanceof Error?e.message:'internal';

describe('guardedLoad (company tracking view)',()=>{
 it('current-mode response resolving after the replay response never replaces replay rows',async()=>{
  const gens=new LoadGenerations();const {log,sink}=recorder();
  const inbox=deferred<PageResult<string>>(),replay=deferred<PageResult<string>>();
  const a=guardedLoad(gens,null,()=>inbox.promise,sink,codeOf);      // watched, current mode
  gens.invalidate();log.rows=[];log.cursor=null;                       // scope change: asOf set (component clears rows/cursor)
  const b=guardedLoad(gens,null,()=>replay.promise,sink,codeOf);     // replay request
  replay.resolve({rows:['historical-2024-06-30'],nextCursor:null});await b;
  expect(log).toEqual({rows:['historical-2024-06-30'],cursor:null,error:null,loading:false});
  inbox.resolve({rows:['current-event'],nextCursor:'c1'});await a;
  expect(log.rows).toEqual(['historical-2024-06-30']);
  expect(log.rows).not.toContain('current-event');
  expect(log.cursor).toBeNull();expect(log.loading).toBe(false);
 });
 it('a stale failure writes no error and does not clear the loading flag of the live request',async()=>{
  const gens=new LoadGenerations();const {log,sink}=recorder();
  const old=deferred<PageResult<string>>(),live=deferred<PageResult<string>>();
  const a=guardedLoad(gens,null,()=>old.promise,sink,codeOf);
  const b=guardedLoad(gens,null,()=>live.promise,sink,codeOf);
  old.reject(new Error('not_authenticated'));await a;
  expect(log.error).toBeNull();expect(log.loading).toBe(true);
  live.resolve({rows:['x'],nextCursor:null});await b;
  expect(log).toMatchObject({rows:['x'],error:null,loading:false});
 });
 it('invalidate (unmount / scope change) drops every in-flight result',async()=>{
  const gens=new LoadGenerations();const {log,sink}=recorder();
  const d=deferred<PageResult<string>>();
  const a=guardedLoad(gens,null,()=>d.promise,sink,codeOf);
  gens.invalidate();d.resolve({rows:['late'],nextCursor:'c'});await a;
  expect(log.rows).toEqual([]);expect(log.cursor).toBeNull();
  const g=gens.peek();expect(gens.isCurrent(g)).toBe(true);gens.invalidate();expect(gens.isCurrent(g)).toBe(false);
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/components/company/tracking/guarded-load.ts
// Request-generation guard for the company tracking view (计划第 3 轮审计 R7). Every load supersedes the
// earlier ones; a scope change (issuerId/ticker/market/asOf/watching) or unmount invalidates all of them.
// Only the current generation may write rows, cursor, error or the loading flag.
export class LoadGenerations{
 private gen=0;
 /** Scope change or unmount: every in-flight load becomes stale. */
 invalidate():number{return ++this.gen;}
 /** A new load: supersedes every earlier one. */
 begin():number{return ++this.gen;}
 /** Capture without superseding (e.g. mark-read writes). */
 peek():number{return this.gen;}
 isCurrent(g:number):boolean{return g===this.gen;}
}
export interface PageResult<T>{rows:T[];nextCursor:string|null}
export interface LoadSink<T>{setLoading(v:boolean):void;page(from:string|null,r:PageResult<T>):void;fail(code:string):void}
export async function guardedLoad<T>(gens:LoadGenerations,from:string|null,fetchPage:(from:string|null)=>Promise<PageResult<T>>,sink:LoadSink<T>,codeOf:(e:unknown)=>string):Promise<void>{
 const g=gens.begin();
 sink.setLoading(true);
 try{const r=await fetchPage(from);if(gens.isCurrent(g))sink.page(from,r);}
 catch(e){if(gens.isCurrent(g))sink.fail(codeOf(e));}
 finally{if(gens.isCurrent(g))sink.setLoading(false);}
}
```

```tsx
// src/components/company/tracking/CompanyTrackingView.tsx
// Company page "跟踪" view (spec §5.10 tracking row, §7.3): watched → inbox?issuerId= (muted included, with
// read state and "mark read"); not watched → public events (no read state); asOf → public events computed
// for the replay date, read actions disabled ("回放模式不记录已读").
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Button, Card } from '@/components/ui';
import { useToast } from '@/components/Toast';
import { foldSameIssuerDay } from '@/lib/company/inbox';
import type { Market } from '@/lib/company/types';
import { fetchCompanyEvents, fetchInbox, isWatching, markRowsRead, TrackingApiError } from '@/lib/company/tracking-client';
import { LoadGenerations, guardedLoad } from './guarded-load';
import { InboxEventRow, type DisplayEvent } from './InboxEventRow';
import { TrackButton } from './TrackButton';

export function CompanyTrackingView({ issuerId, ticker, market, asOf }: { issuerId: string; ticker: string; market: Market; asOf: string | null }) {
  const t = useTranslations('tracking');
  const { show } = useToast();
  const replay = asOf !== null;
  const [watching, setWatching] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<DisplayEvent[]>([]);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [gens] = useState(() => new LoadGenerations());   // 计划第 3 轮审计 R7: request generations

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    setWatching(null);   // a new issuer must not reuse the previous issuer's watch state
    isWatching(issuerId).then((w) => { if (live) setWatching(w); }).catch(() => { if (live) setWatching(false); });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [issuerId]);

  // 计划第 3 轮审计 R7: a scope change invalidates every in-flight load and clears the previous scope's rows;
  // declared before the load effect so it runs first. Cleanup (unmount / next scope) invalidates as well.
  useEffect(() => {
    gens.invalidate();
    setRows([]); setCursor(null); setError(null); setLoading(false);
    return () => { gens.invalidate(); };
  }, [gens, issuerId, ticker, market, asOf, watching]);

  const load = useCallback((from: string | null): Promise<void> => {
    if (watching === null) return Promise.resolve();
    return guardedLoad<DisplayEvent>(gens, from, async (c) => {
      if (!replay && watching) {
        const r = await fetchInbox({ issuerId, cursor: c, limit: 50 });
        return { rows: r.rows, nextCursor: r.nextCursor };
      }
      const r = await fetchCompanyEvents(ticker, { asOf, cursor: c, limit: 50 });
      return { rows: r.rows.filter((e) => e.market === market).map((e) => ({ ...e, read: true })), nextCursor: r.nextCursor };   // no read state outside the inbox
    }, {
      setLoading,
      page: (f, r) => { setRows((prev) => (f ? [...prev, ...r.rows] : r.rows)); setCursor(r.nextCursor); setError(null); },
      fail: setError,
    }, (e) => (e instanceof TrackingApiError ? e.code : 'internal'));
  }, [gens, watching, replay, issuerId, ticker, asOf, market]);
  useEffect(() => { void load(null); }, [load]);

  const groups = useMemo(() => foldSameIssuerDay(rows), [rows]);
  const card = useMemo(() => ({
    issuerId, names: { zh: null, en: null }, tickers: [], primaryTicker: { [market]: ticker }, streams: [], hkOnly: false,
    note: null, muted: false, createdAt: '', updatedAt: '', unread: null, unreadLabel: null,
  }), [issuerId, market, ticker]);
  const canMark = !replay && watching === true && rows.some((r) => !r.read);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2" data-testid="company-tracking">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[13px] text-text-dim">
        {replay ? <span data-testid="replay-no-read">{t('company.replayNoRead')} · {t('company.live')}</span>
          : watching === false ? <><span>{t('company.notWatching')}</span><TrackButton issuerId={issuerId} /></> : null}
        <Button
          variant="secondary" size="sm" className="ml-auto" disabled={!canMark}
          title={replay ? t('company.replayNoRead') : undefined}
          onClick={async () => {
            const g = gens.peek();   // 计划第 3 轮审计 R7: no write into a scope that changed meanwhile
            try { await markRowsRead(rows); if (gens.isCurrent(g)) setRows((p) => p.map((r) => ({ ...r, read: true }))); }
            catch (e) { show(t('errors.generic', { code: e instanceof TrackingApiError ? e.code : 'internal' })); }
          }}
        >
          {t('company.markRead')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {error && <Card className="text-[13px]">{t('inbox.error', { code: error })} <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => load(null)}>{t('inbox.retry')}</Button></Card>}
      {!error && rows.length === 0 && !loading && <Card className="text-[13px] text-text-dim">{t('inbox.empty')}</Card>}
      {rows.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="p-0">
          <ul>{groups.map((g) => <InboxEventRow key={g.key} head={g.head} rest={g.rest} card={card} showIssuer={false} />)}</ul>
        </Card>
      )}
      <div className="text-center">
        {loading && <span className="text-xs text-text-dim">{t('inbox.loading')}</span>}
        {!loading && cursor && <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => load(cursor)}>{t('inbox.loadMore')}</Button>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Task 18: 覆盖目录 `GET /api/companies` + `/intel/companies` + `/intel` 入口卡

规格：§8、§6.1（`GET /api/companies` 行）、§11、决策 H（需登录，默认）；画板 `Directory.dc.html`。

**指挥决定（本任务）：**
- `q` 只允许字母、数字、空格、`.`、`-`（`/^[\p{L}\p{N} .\-]{1,24}$/u`）：PostgREST `or=(…ilike…)` 过滤串里的逗号、括号、引号、`*`、`%`、`_` 都会改变语义，白名单比转义更可靠。名称前缀匹配 `canonical_name_zh/en`（不区分大小写），代码前缀匹配**当前有效**证券的 `ticker`。计划第 3 轮审计 R8：两条前缀查询不再 `.limit(1000)`，而是稳定排序（`issuer_id`；证券另加 `ticker, valid_from`）后 `.range(offset, offset+999)` 翻页直到空页，全部读完再按当前有效过滤、再与覆盖表求交；任一页出错或候选超过 100 000 行 → `directory_search_failed`（失败关闭，不返回看似完整的部分结果）。
- 目录页需登录：`/intel/companies` 在 `(app)` 受保护组内，中间件已重定向未登录用户（决策 H 默认）；`GET /api/companies` 本身是公共只读（不读会话、无按用户字段，规格 §6.1），以便共享缓存。
- 概念覆盖分母用响应字段 `conceptsTotal = FACT_CONCEPTS.length`（客户端不 import 事实层模块）。
- TabBar：把高亮判定抽成 `isTabActive(href, pathname)`，`/intel/companies`、`/watchlist/tracking` 分别高亮"情报""股票池"；同时收紧为路径段前缀（`/intel` 不再匹配 `/intelligence`）。
- 管理员判定在服务端页面里用 `requireAdminUser()`（失败即非 admin），只决定是否显示 `/admin/dq` 链接。

```ts
// src/lib/company/directory.test.ts
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {DIRECTORY_Q_RE,issuerIdsByPrefix,toDirectoryRows,type PrefixClient,type PrefixPage} from './directory';
import type {CoverageRow} from './types';

/** Fake anon client: order() is recorded, range(a,b) slices like PostgREST (server max-rows 1000). 计划第 3 轮审计 R8 */
function fakePrefix(names:Record<string,unknown>[],tickers:Record<string,unknown>[],fail=false){
 const log:Record<string,string[]>={issuers:[],issuer_securities:[]};
 const pageOf=(rows:Record<string,unknown>[],l:string[]):PrefixPage=>{
  const p:PrefixPage={order:(col)=>{l.push(`order:${col}`);return p;},range:async(a,b)=>{l.push(`range:${a}-${b}`);return fail?{data:null,error:{message:'boom'}}:{data:rows.slice(a,Math.min(b+1,a+1000)),error:null};}};
  return p;
 };
 const sb:PrefixClient={from:(table)=>({select:(cols)=>({
  or:(f)=>{log[table].push(`select:${cols}`,`or:${f}`);return pageOf(names,log[table]);},
  ilike:(col,pat)=>{log[table].push(`select:${cols}`,`ilike:${col}:${pat}`);return pageOf(tickers,log[table]);},
 })})};
 return {sb,log};
}
const uid=(n:number)=>`00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12,'0')}`;

const A='aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa',B='bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb',C='cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc';
const cov=(issuer_id:string,market:'US'|'CN',p:Partial<CoverageRow>={}):CoverageRow=>({issuer_id,market,filings_count:10,facts_count:500,concepts_covered:30,earliest_period_end:'2015-09-26',latest_period_end:'2025-09-27',latest_available_date:'2025-10-31',citation_summary:{linked:0,pending:0,edgar:10},scope_last_success_at:'2026-11-02T03:00:00Z',scope_last_status:'success',based_on_rev:3,rebuilt_at:'x',rebuild_id:'r',rebuild_batch_id:'b',...p});

describe('directory helpers',()=>{
 it('q whitelist',()=>{
  for(const ok of ['AAP','贵州','600519','BRK.A','Kweichow Moutai','A-B'])expect(DIRECTORY_Q_RE.test(ok),ok).toBe(true);
  for(const bad of ['','a,b','a(b','a*','a%','a_b','"x"','x'.repeat(25)])expect(DIRECTORY_Q_RE.test(bad),bad).toBe(false);
 });
 it('rows: names, the stream’s current tickers (primary first), coverage fields; never a per-user field',()=>{
  const rows=toDirectoryRows([cov(A,'US'),cov(B,'CN',{citation_summary:{linked:9,pending:1,edgar:0}})],{
   issuers:[{issuer_id:A,canonical_name_zh:null,canonical_name_en:'Apple Inc.'},{issuer_id:B,canonical_name_zh:'贵州茅台',canonical_name_en:'Kweichow Moutai'}],
   securities:[
    {issuer_id:A,ticker:'AAPL',is_primary:true,valid_from:'2000-01-01',valid_to:null},
    {issuer_id:B,ticker:'600519.SH',is_primary:true,valid_from:'2001-08-27',valid_to:null},
    {issuer_id:B,ticker:'OLD.SH',is_primary:false,valid_from:'1990-01-01',valid_to:'2000-01-01'},
   ]},'2026-11-06');
  expect(rows[1]).toEqual({issuerId:B,market:'CN',names:{zh:'贵州茅台',en:'Kweichow Moutai'},primaryTicker:'600519.SH',tickers:['600519.SH'],
   latestPeriodEnd:'2025-09-27',latestAvailableDate:'2025-10-31',conceptsCovered:30,citationSummary:{linked:9,pending:1,edgar:0},
   scopeLastSuccessAt:'2026-11-02T03:00:00Z',scopeLastStatus:'success'});
  expect(rows[0]).toMatchObject({issuerId:A,market:'US',primaryTicker:'AAPL',tickers:['AAPL']});
 });
 it('issuerIdsByPrefix: names (zh/en, case-insensitive prefix) ∪ current tickers, de-duplicated; stable order + range pages',async()=>{
  const {sb,log}=fakePrefix([{issuer_id:A}],[{issuer_id:A,valid_from:'2000-01-01',valid_to:null},{issuer_id:C,valid_from:'1990-01-01',valid_to:'2000-01-01'},{issuer_id:B,valid_from:'2001-01-01',valid_to:null}]);
  expect((await issuerIdsByPrefix(sb,'aap','2026-11-06')).sort()).toEqual([A,B]);
  expect(log.issuers.slice(0,4)).toEqual(['select:issuer_id','or:canonical_name_zh.ilike."aap*",canonical_name_en.ilike."aap*"','order:issuer_id','range:0-999']);
  expect(log.issuer_securities.slice(0,6)).toEqual(['select:issuer_id,valid_from,valid_to','ilike:ticker:AAP%','order:issuer_id','order:ticker','order:valid_from','range:0-999']);
  expect(log.issuer_securities.filter(x=>x.startsWith('range:'))).toEqual(['range:0-999','range:3-1002']);   // read until an empty page
 });
 it('pages through every candidate: a current match after 1,500 expired securities and name matches beyond row 1,000 are found (计划第 3 轮审计 R8)',async()=>{
  const expired=Array.from({length:1500},(_,i)=>({issuer_id:uid(i),valid_from:'1990-01-01',valid_to:'2000-01-01'}));
  const names=Array.from({length:1200},(_,i)=>({issuer_id:uid(10000+i)}));
  const {sb,log}=fakePrefix(names,[...expired,{issuer_id:B,valid_from:'2001-01-01',valid_to:null}]);
  const ids=new Set(await issuerIdsByPrefix(sb,'aap','2026-11-06'));
  expect(ids.has(B)).toBe(true);
  expect(ids.has(uid(11199))).toBe(true);
  expect(expired.some(e=>ids.has(e.issuer_id))).toBe(false);
  expect(ids.size).toBe(1201);
  expect(log.issuer_securities.filter(x=>x.startsWith('range:'))).toEqual(['range:0-999','range:1000-1999','range:1501-2500']);
  expect(log.issuers.filter(x=>x.startsWith('range:'))).toEqual(['range:0-999','range:1000-1999','range:1200-2199']);
 });
 it('a failed page fails the whole search (never a silently partial match set)',async()=>{
  const {sb}=fakePrefix([{issuer_id:A}],[],true);
  await expect(issuerIdsByPrefix(sb,'aap','2026-11-06')).rejects.toThrow('directory_search_failed');
 });
});
```

```ts
// src/lib/company/directory.ts
// Coverage directory (spec §8, §6.1 GET /api/companies). Public reference reads only (anon): issuer ids by
// name / ticker prefix, and rows assembled from issuer_coverage + issuers + current issuer_securities. No
// ratings, no judgment counts, no per-user field.
import {isCurrentSecurity} from '../entities/resolve';
import {publicMarketOf} from '../facts/public-route';
import type {IssuerLite,SecurityLite} from './tracking-issuers';
import type {CitationSummary,CoverageRow,Market} from './types';

/** Letters, digits, space, '.', '-' only: PostgREST or/ilike syntax characters never reach the filter. */
export const DIRECTORY_Q_RE=/^[\p{L}\p{N} .\-]{1,24}$/u;
export const DIRECTORY_SORTS=['latest_available_date','latest_period_end','name'] as const;
export type DirectorySort=typeof DIRECTORY_SORTS[number];
export const DIRECTORY_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE=100;
export const DIRECTORY_MAX_PAGE_SIZE=200;

export interface DirectoryRow{
 issuerId:string;market:Market;names:{zh:string|null;en:string|null};primaryTicker:string|null;tickers:string[];
 latestPeriodEnd:string|null;latestAvailableDate:string|null;conceptsCovered:number;citationSummary:CitationSummary;
 scopeLastSuccessAt:string|null;scopeLastStatus:'success'|'failed'|null;
}

type Result={data:unknown[]|null;error:{message:string}|null};
/** One ordered, ranged PostgREST query (计划第 3 轮审计 R8: .order(...).range(a,b) replaces .limit(CAP)). */
export interface PrefixPage{order(col:string):PrefixPage;range(from:number,to:number):PromiseLike<Result>}
/** Minimal structural view of the anon Supabase client (cast at the call site). */
export interface PrefixClient{from(table:string):{select(cols:string):{
 or(filter:string):PrefixPage;
 ilike(col:string,pattern:string):PrefixPage;
}}}
const PAGE=1000;
const MAX_CANDIDATES=100_000;   // fail closed beyond this, never a silently partial match set

/** Every row of one stably ordered query: range pages until an empty page (robust to a server max-rows below PAGE). */
async function exhaust<T>(page:(from:number,to:number)=>PromiseLike<Result>):Promise<T[]>{
 const out:T[]=[];
 for(let offset=0;;){
  const r=await page(offset,offset+PAGE-1);
  if(r.error)throw new Error('directory_search_failed');
  const data=(r.data??[]) as T[];
  if(data.length===0)return out;
  out.push(...data);offset+=data.length;
  if(out.length>MAX_CANDIDATES)throw new Error('directory_search_failed');
 }
}

/** Issuer ids whose zh/en name or a CURRENT ticker starts with q (case-insensitive). q must match DIRECTORY_Q_RE.
 * 计划第 3 轮审计 R8: both prefix queries are paged to exhaustion BEFORE the current-security filter and the
 * coverage intersection, so expired securities or early name matches cannot crowd out a valid later match. */
export async function issuerIdsByPrefix(sb:PrefixClient,q:string,today:string):Promise<string[]>{
 if(!DIRECTORY_Q_RE.test(q))throw new Error('invalid_q');
 const pat=`"${q}*"`;
 const [names,tickers]=await Promise.all([
  exhaust<{issuer_id:string}>((a,b)=>sb.from('issuers').select('issuer_id').or(`canonical_name_zh.ilike.${pat},canonical_name_en.ilike.${pat}`).order('issuer_id').range(a,b)),
  exhaust<{issuer_id:string;valid_from:string;valid_to:string|null}>((a,b)=>sb.from('issuer_securities').select('issuer_id,valid_from,valid_to').ilike('ticker',`${q.toUpperCase()}%`).order('issuer_id').order('ticker').order('valid_from').range(a,b)),
 ]);
 const ids=new Set<string>();
 for(const r of names)ids.add(r.issuer_id);
 for(const r of tickers)if(isCurrentSecurity(r as unknown as Record<string,unknown>,today))ids.add(r.issuer_id);
 return [...ids];
}

export function toDirectoryRows(coverage:CoverageRow[],lites:{issuers:IssuerLite[];securities:SecurityLite[]},today:string):DirectoryRow[]{
 const issuer=new Map(lites.issuers.map(i=>[i.issuer_id,i]));
 return coverage.map(c=>{
  const secs=lites.securities.filter(s=>s.issuer_id===c.issuer_id&&isCurrentSecurity(s as unknown as Record<string,unknown>,today)&&publicMarketOf(s.ticker.toUpperCase())===c.market)
   .sort((x,y)=>Number(y.is_primary)-Number(x.is_primary)||x.valid_from.localeCompare(y.valid_from)||x.ticker.localeCompare(y.ticker));
  const i=issuer.get(c.issuer_id);
  return {
   issuerId:c.issuer_id,market:c.market,names:{zh:i?.canonical_name_zh??null,en:i?.canonical_name_en??null},
   primaryTicker:secs[0]?.ticker??null,tickers:secs.map(s=>s.ticker),
   latestPeriodEnd:c.latest_period_end,latestAvailableDate:c.latest_available_date,conceptsCovered:c.concepts_covered,
   citationSummary:c.citation_summary,scopeLastSuccessAt:c.scope_last_success_at,scopeLastStatus:c.scope_last_status,
  };
 });
}
```

```ts
// src/app/api/companies/route.ts
// GET /api/companies — coverage directory (spec §8, §6.1). Public, anon, no session, no per-user fields.
// ?market=US|CN &q=<name|ticker prefix ≤24> &sort=latest_available_date|latest_period_end|name &page &pageSize≤200
import {getAnonSupabase} from '@/lib/supabase/anon';
import {supabaseCompanyDb} from '@/lib/company/db';
import {DIRECTORY_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,DIRECTORY_MAX_PAGE_SIZE,DIRECTORY_Q_RE,DIRECTORY_SORTS,issuerIdsByPrefix,toDirectoryRows,type DirectorySort,type PrefixClient} from '@/lib/company/directory';
import {loadIssuerLites,type SelectInClient} from '@/lib/company/tracking-issuers';
import type {Market} from '@/lib/company/types';
import {FACT_CONCEPTS} from '@/lib/facts/concepts';
import {QueryError,failureResponse,intParam,paramErrorResponse,readParams,successHeaders,utcDate} from '@/lib/facts/public-route';
import {NextResponse} from 'next/server';

export const dynamic='force-dynamic';
const PARAMS=['market','q','sort','page','pageSize'] as const;

export async function GET(request:Request){
 const now=new Date(),today=utcDate(now);
 let market:Market|undefined,q:string|undefined,sort:DirectorySort,page:number,pageSize:number;
 try{
  const p=readParams(new URL(request.url),PARAMS);
  const m=p.get('market');
  if(m!==undefined&&m!=='US'&&m!=='CN')throw new QueryError('market');
  market=m as Market|undefined;
  q=p.get('q')?.trim();
  if(q!==undefined&&!DIRECTORY_Q_RE.test(q))throw new QueryError('q');
  const s=p.get('sort')??'latest_available_date';
  if(!(DIRECTORY_SORTS as readonly string[]).includes(s))throw new QueryError('sort');
  sort=s as DirectorySort;
  page=intParam(p,'page',1,10000);
  pageSize=intParam(p,'pageSize',DIRECTORY_DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,DIRECTORY_MAX_PAGE_SIZE);
 }catch(e){
  return paramErrorResponse(e)??failureResponse(e,'companies','directory unavailable');
 }
 const empty={total:0,page,pageSize,conceptsTotal:FACT_CONCEPTS.length,rows:[]};
 try{
  const sb=getAnonSupabase();
  let issuerIds:string[]|undefined;
  if(q!==undefined){
   issuerIds=await issuerIdsByPrefix(sb as unknown as PrefixClient,q,today);
   if(issuerIds.length===0)return NextResponse.json(empty,{headers:successHeaders(now,undefined,true)});
  }
  const {rows,total}=await supabaseCompanyDb(sb).listCoverage({market,issuerIds},sort,{offset:(page-1)*pageSize,limit:pageSize});
  const lites=await loadIssuerLites(sb as unknown as SelectInClient,[...new Set(rows.map(r=>r.issuer_id))]);
  const body={total,page,pageSize,conceptsTotal:FACT_CONCEPTS.length,rows:toDirectoryRows(rows,lites,today)};
  return NextResponse.json(body,{headers:successHeaders(now,undefined,rows.length===0)});
 }catch(e){
  return failureResponse(e,'companies','directory unavailable');
 }
}
```

注意：`q` 先 `trim()` 再校验，`?q=` 的空串经 trim 后不匹配 `{1,24}` → 400，符合"参数非法 → 400"。`issuerIds` 最多约 2000 个（两路各 1000）：整合核对——Task 3 的 `listCoverage` 在三个实现里都调用 Task 2 的 `company_list_coverage(p_market, p_issuer_ids uuid[], p_sort, p_offset, p_limit)`（rpc 走 POST 体，不受 URL 长度限制；`sort='name'` 在 SQL 内联 `issuers` 排序后分页，`total` 为过滤后总数），本路由不截断。
