```tsx
// src/components/company/directory/CompanyDirectory.tsx
// Coverage directory view (spec §8; artboard Directory): freshness strip (GET /api/companies/freshness),
// prefix search, market filter, three sorts, 100 per page, table with a frozen first column on mobile.
// Facts only: no ratings, no judgment counts, no per-user fields; last sync is stated, not colour-coded.
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { Button, Card, Tag } from '@/components/ui';
import type { DirectoryRow, DirectorySort } from '@/lib/company/directory';

interface DirectoryResponse { total: number; page: number; pageSize: number; conceptsTotal: number; rows: DirectoryRow[] }
interface Freshness { dataset: string; status: string; lastOkAt: string | null; lastAttemptAt: string | null }
type MarketFilter = 'all' | 'CN' | 'US';
const SORTS: DirectorySort[] = ['latest_available_date', 'latest_period_end', 'name'];
const PAGE_SIZE = 100;
const fmtAt = (s: string | null) => (s ? s.replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 16) : null);

export function CompanyDirectory({ isAdmin }: { isAdmin: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations('company.directory');
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [debouncedQ, setDebouncedQ] = useState('');
  const [market, setMarket] = useState<MarketFilter>('all');
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<DirectorySort>('latest_available_date');
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [data, setData] = useState<DirectoryResponse | null>(null);
  const [fresh, setFresh] = useState<Freshness[]>([]);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reload, setReload] = useState(0);
  const seq = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => { const h = setTimeout(() => { setDebouncedQ(q.trim()); setPage(1); }, 250); return () => clearTimeout(h); }, [q]);
  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/companies/freshness').then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : null)).then((b) => setFresh(b?.datasets ?? [])).catch(() => setFresh([]));
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    const my = ++seq.current;
    const p = new URLSearchParams({ sort, page: String(page), pageSize: String(PAGE_SIZE) });
    if (market !== 'all') p.set('market', market);
    if (debouncedQ) p.set('q', debouncedQ);
    fetch(`/api/companies?${p.toString()}`)
      .then(async (r) => { const b = await r.json(); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(b?.error?.code ?? 'internal'); return b as DirectoryResponse; })
      .then((b) => { if (my === seq.current) { setData(b); setError(null); } })
      .catch((e: Error) => { if (my === seq.current) setError(e.message); });
  }, [debouncedQ, market, sort, page, reload]);

  const pages = data ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(data.total / PAGE_SIZE)) : 1;
  const filtered = debouncedQ !== '' || market !== 'all';
  return (
    <>
      <div className="mb-1 text-[11px] text-text-dim">{t('breadcrumb')}</div>
      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1" data-testid="freshness-strip">
          {fresh.map((f) => (
            <Tag key={f.dataset} tone="neutral">{t('freshness', { dataset: f.dataset, status: f.status, at: fmtAt(f.lastOkAt) ?? t('never') })}</Tag>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card className="mb-3">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">
          <label className="flex min-w-[200px] flex-1 flex-col gap-1 text-[11px] text-text-dim">
            {t('searchLabel')}
            <input value={q} maxLength={24} onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)} placeholder={t('searchPlaceholder')}
              className="rounded-md bg-bg-card px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-text" data-testid="directory-search" />
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-[11px] text-text-dim">
            {t('market')}
            <div className="flex gap-1 rounded-md border border-border p-1 text-xs">
              {(['all', 'CN', 'US'] as MarketFilter[]).map((m) => (
                <button key={m} type="button" onClick={() => { setMarket(m); setPage(1); }}
                  className={`rounded px-2 py-0.5 ${market === m ? 'bg-accent-dim/20 font-semibold text-accent' : 'text-text-dim'}`}>
                  {m === 'all' ? t('marketAll') : m === 'CN' ? t('marketCN') : t('marketUS')}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-[11px] text-text-dim">
            {t('sort')}
            <select value={sort} onChange={(e) => { setSort(e.target.value as DirectorySort); setPage(1); }} className="rounded-md bg-bg-card px-2 py-1.5 text-sm text-text">
              {SORTS.map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{t(`sort_${s}`)}</option>)}
            </select>
          </label>
        </div>
        <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-dim">{t('industryHint')}</p>
      </Card>

      {error && <Card className="mb-3 text-[13px]">{t('error', { code: error })} <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setReload((n) => n + 1)}>{t('retry')}</Button></Card>}

      {data && data.rows.length === 0 && (
        <Card className="text-[13px] text-text-dim" data-testid="directory-empty">
          {filtered ? t('noMatch') : t('empty')}
          {!filtered && isAdmin && <> <Link href="/admin/dq" className="text-accent">{t('adminDq')}</Link></>}
        </Card>
      )}

      {data && data.rows.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="overflow-x-auto p-0">
          <table className="w-full min-w-[860px] text-[13px]" data-testid="directory-table">
            <thead className="text-left text-[11px] text-text-dim">
              <tr className="border-b border-border">
                <th className="sticky left-0 bg-bg-card px-3 py-2">{t('col.name')}</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2">{t('col.ticker')}</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2">{t('col.stream')}</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2">{t('col.latestPeriod')}</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2">{t('col.latestFiling')}</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2">{t('col.concepts')}</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2">{t('col.citations')}</th>
                <th className="px-3 py-2">{t('col.lastSync')}</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {data.rows.map((r) => {
                const name = r.names.zh ?? r.names.en ?? r.primaryTicker ?? r.issuerId;
                return (
                  <tr key={`${r.issuerId}:${r.market}`} className="border-b border-border last:border-b-0" data-testid="directory-row">
                    <td className="sticky left-0 bg-bg-card px-3 py-2 font-semibold">
                      {r.primaryTicker ? <Link href={`/stock/${encodeURIComponent(r.primaryTicker)}` as never} className="hover:text-accent">{name}</Link> : name}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-mono">
                      {r.primaryTicker ?? '—'}
                      {r.tickers.length > 1 && <span className="ml-1 text-text-dim">+{r.tickers.length - 1}</span>}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2">{r.market}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-mono">{r.latestPeriodEnd ?? '—'}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-mono">{r.latestAvailableDate ?? '—'}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-mono">{t('conceptsOf', { covered: r.conceptsCovered, total: data.conceptsTotal })}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 text-text-muted">{t('citations', { linked: r.citationSummary.linked, pending: r.citationSummary.pending, edgar: r.citationSummary.edgar })}</td>
                    <td className="px-3 py-2 font-mono text-text-muted">
                      {r.scopeLastSuccessAt || r.scopeLastStatus
                        ? t('lastSync', { at: fmtAt(r.scopeLastSuccessAt) ?? t('never'), status: r.scopeLastStatus ? t(`status_${r.scopeLastStatus}`) : t('never') })
                        : t('never')}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </Card>
      )}

      {data && data.total > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-text-dim">
          <span>{t('footer', { total: data.total, pageSize: PAGE_SIZE })}</span>
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={page <= 1} onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)}>{t('prev')}</Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" disabled={page >= pages} onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)}>{t('next')}</Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-text-dim">{t('syncNote')}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Task 19: e2e、夹具清单补全、runbook、规格 §17、全量门禁

规格：§12.0、§12.3（1–11）、§12.4、§13 C6、§14、§15（决策 I 默认：本机 Playwright 报告附 PR + 复审者复跑）、§16、§17、§3（回归对照，信息性）、§0 #72。

**指挥决定（本任务）：**
- e2e 的数据库是**本机 Supabase 栈**（`supabase start`：PostgREST + GoTrue + Storage），不是 `test:db` 的裸 PostgreSQL（后者没有 PostgREST/GoTrue，Next 应用连不上）。夹具由 `scripts/company/e2e-seed.ts` 回放：发行人登记 → 美股夹具经 `runFactsSync`（`fetchUs` 换成录制文件，快照写入本机 Storage，证据索引才能核对）→ `scripts/facts/materialize.ts` → `scripts/company/digest.ts --full --apply` → 创建/复用夹具账号并清空其 watch。种子脚本只接受 `127.0.0.1`/`localhost` 的 URL。理由：决策 I 默认（CI 不可行），且回放必须走与生产相同的读路径。
- e2e 的环境变量只在 shell 里 `export`，**工作树里不放任何 `.env*` 文件**（`startLocalDatabase()` 见到 `.env*` 会拒绝运行 `test:db`）；跑 e2e 的 shell 与跑 `test:db` 的 shell 分开（后者拒绝继承 `SUPABASE_*`/`NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_*`）。
- e2e 默认跳过：需要 `E2E_COMPANY=1` 且有 `E2E_EMAIL`/`E2E_PASSWORD`。理由：普通 `npx playwright test` 没有回放库。
- §12.3 第 6 条按决策 J 默认：断言概览**没有** K 线（`data-testid="kline-chart"`，现有组件的 testid）与行情行（`data-testid="quote-row"`）。
- §12.3 第 11 条：直接写 `NEXT_LOCALE=en` cookie（设置页切换写的就是这个 cookie），不驱动设置页 UI。理由：设置页不在本模块范围，其 DOM 变化不应让公司页 e2e 失败。记入 §17。
- 第 3 条的数值断言（revenue `value`）只在夹具清单该条 `status:'ready'` 时执行；`availableDate=2023-11-03`、`disclosureSeq=1/2`、`isRevision=false` 是规格 §1.1 原文，直接断言。
- 第 2 条带上 §14 的无障碍要求：单元格键盘 Enter 打开抽屉，Esc 关闭，焦点回到单元格。

```ts
// src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest.test.ts
// spec §12.0 + §0 #72: the manifest lists the recorded fixtures (sha256 checked against the bytes) and the
// acceptance expectations transcribed by a human. Entries not yet transcribed stay `pending`: they are
// SKIPPED here (and in e2e) and listed by id, never filled from implementation output.
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {describe,expect,it} from 'vitest';
import {containsPending,EXPECTATION_KINDS,isReady,loadManifest} from './manifest';

const manifest=loadManifest();
const pending=manifest.expectations.filter(e=>!isReady(e));

describe('company fixture manifest',()=>{
 it('has unique ids and known kinds',()=>{
  const ids=[...manifest.fixtures.map(f=>f.id),...manifest.expectations.map(e=>e.id)];
  expect(new Set(ids).size).toBe(ids.length);
  for(const e of manifest.expectations)expect(EXPECTATION_KINDS).toContain(e.kind);
 });
 it('every fixture file matches its recorded sha256',()=>{
  expect(manifest.fixtures.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3);
  for(const f of manifest.fixtures){
   const sha=createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(f.path)).digest('hex');
   expect(sha,f.path).toBe(f.sha256);
  }
 });
 it('a ready entry carries no pending marker (status and content agree)',()=>{
  for(const e of manifest.expectations)if(e.status==='ready'){
   expect(containsPending(e.expected),e.id).toBe(false);
   expect(containsPending(e.source),e.id).toBe(false);
  }
 });
 it('lists pending entries (owner items, spec §0 #72)',()=>{
  if(pending.length)console.info(`[manifest] pending (skipped until transcribed): ${pending.map(e=>e.id).join(', ')}`);
  expect(pending.length+manifest.expectations.filter(isReady).length).toBe(manifest.expectations.length);
 });
 for(const e of manifest.expectations){
  if(!isReady(e)){it.skip(`pending (human transcription): ${e.id}`,()=>{});continue;}
  it(`${e.id}: provenance recorded by a human`,()=>{
   expect(e.source.document.trim()).not.toBe('');
   expect(e.source.page_or_row.trim()).not.toBe('');
   expect(e.source.url).toMatch(/^https:\/\//);
   expect(e.source.transcribed_by.trim()).not.toBe('');
   expect(e.source.transcribed_at).toMatch(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/);
  });
 }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 实现读取器 `manifest.ts`**

```ts
// src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest.ts
// Reader of src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest.json (spec §12.0, §0 #72). Node-only (fs): unit tests, e2e and
// scripts use it, app code never does. An expectation is usable only once a human has transcribed it:
// status 'ready' and no 'pending' string anywhere in expected/source.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';

export const MANIFEST_PATH='src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest.json';
export const PENDING='pending';
export const EXPECTATION_KINDS=['statement_cell','filing_published_list','statement_matrix'] as const;
export type ExpectationKind=typeof EXPECTATION_KINDS[number];
export interface ManifestFixture{id:string;path:string;sha256:string;recorded_at:string|null;source:string}
export interface ManifestSource{document:string;page_or_row:string;url:string;transcribed_by:string;transcribed_at:string|null}
export interface ManifestExpectation{id:string;kind:ExpectationKind;status:'pending'|'ready';query:Record<string,unknown>;expected:Record<string,unknown>;source:ManifestSource;notes?:string}
export interface Manifest{version:number;note:string;fixtures:ManifestFixture[];expectations:ManifestExpectation[]}

export function containsPending(v:unknown):boolean{
 if(v===PENDING)return true;
 if(Array.isArray(v))return v.some(containsPending);
 if(v!==null&&typeof v==='object')return Object.values(v).some(containsPending);
 return false;
}
export const isReady=(e:ManifestExpectation)=>e.status==='ready'&&!containsPending(e.expected)&&!containsPending(e.source)&&e.source.transcribed_at!==null;
export function loadManifest(root=process.cwd()):Manifest{
 return JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root,MANIFEST_PATH),'utf8')) as Manifest;
}
export function readyExpectation(id:string,root?:string):ManifestExpectation|null{
 const e=loadManifest(root).expectations.find(x=>x.id===id);
 return e&&isReady(e)?e:null;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 哈希脚本并写入 sha256**

```ts
// scripts/company/manifest-hash.ts
/**
 * Checks (default) or writes (--write) the sha256 of every fixture listed in src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest.json.
 *   node --import tsx scripts/company/manifest-hash.ts [--write]
 * Exit 0 = all match (or written), 1 = mismatch in check mode, 2 = bad arguments. Touches fixtures[].sha256 only.
 */
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync,writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {MANIFEST_PATH,type Manifest} from '../../src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest';

const args=process.argv.slice(2);
if(args.some(a=>a!=='--write')){console.error('usage: manifest-hash.ts [--write]');process.exit(2);}
const write=args.includes('--write');
const m=JSON.parse(readFileSync(MANIFEST_PATH,'utf8')) as Manifest;
let mismatch=0;
for(const f of m.fixtures){
 const sha=createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(f.path)).digest('hex');
 if(sha!==f.sha256){mismatch++;console.log(`${write?'set':'MISMATCH'} ${f.id} ${f.path} ${sha}`);f.sha256=sha;}
}
if(write){writeFileSync(MANIFEST_PATH,`${JSON.stringify(m,null,2)}\n`);console.log(`written (${mismatch} updated)`);}
else if(mismatch>0)process.exit(1);
else console.log('all fixture hashes match');
```

Run: `node --import tsx scripts/company/manifest-hash.ts --write && node --import tsx scripts/company/manifest-hash.ts`
Expected: 第一条打印 3 行 `set …` 和 `written (3 updated)`；第二条打印 `all fixture hashes match`。

Run: `npm test -- src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest.test.ts`
Expected: PASS，3 个 skipped（`pending (human transcription): …`），控制台列出三个 pending id。

- [ ] **Step 5: e2e 种子脚本**

```ts
// scripts/company/e2e-seed.ts
/**
 * Prepares a LOCAL Supabase stack for e2e/company.spec.ts (spec §12.3, decision I default: local Playwright
 * report attached to the PR, re-run by the reviewer). Refuses any non-local Supabase URL.
 *
 *   node --import tsx scripts/company/e2e-seed.ts --apply
 *
 * Environment (exported in the shell; never a .env* file in this worktree): NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
 * (http://127.0.0.1:54321), SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, E2E_EMAIL, E2E_PASSWORD, VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA.
 * Steps: issuers AAPL / MSFT (US, by CIK) and an HK-only Tencent issuer → US facts replayed from the recorded
 * companyfacts fixtures (runFactsSync with fetchUs replaced; snapshots go to the local Storage bucket so the
 * evidence index can verify them) → scripts/facts/materialize.ts → scripts/company/digest.ts --full --apply →
 * the e2e user (created if missing, password set to E2E_PASSWORD) with its company watches cleared.
 * Re-runnable: a second run publishes duplicates only and rebuilds the digest idempotently.
 */
import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
import {randomUUID} from 'node:crypto';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {getAdminSupabase} from '../../src/lib/supabase/admin';
import {productionSyncDeps} from '../../src/lib/facts/deps';
import {runFactsSync} from '../../src/lib/facts/sync';
import type {SyncDeps} from '../../src/lib/facts/sync';
import {ProviderError,snapshotOf} from '../../src/lib/facts/providers/shared';
import {companyFactsUrl} from '../../src/lib/facts/providers/edgar-companyfacts';

const US=[
 {ticker:'AAPL',cik:'320193',name:'Apple Inc.',file:'CIK0000320193.trimmed.json'},
 {ticker:'MSFT',cik:'789019',name:'Microsoft Corp.',file:'CIK0000789019.trimmed.json'},
];
const HK={ticker:'00700.HK',zh:'腾讯控股',en:'Tencent Holdings Ltd.'};

function fail(msg:string):never{console.error(`e2e-seed: ${msg}`);process.exit(1);}
function env(name:string):string{const v=process.env[name];if(!v)fail(`${name} is required`);return v;}

// Untyped table access for seeding only (the generated Database types do not cover every column used here).
// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
type AnyClient={from:(t:string)=>any};
async function ensureIssuer(sb:AnyClient,row:{cik?:string;zh?:string;en:string;country:string}):Promise<string>{
 const sel=row.cik?sb.from('issuers').select('issuer_id').eq('cik',row.cik):sb.from('issuers').select('issuer_id').eq('canonical_name_en',row.en);
 const {data,error}=await sel.limit(1);
 if(error)fail(`issuers read: ${error.message}`);
 if(data?.[0])return String(data[0].issuer_id);
 const id=randomUUID();
 const ins=await sb.from('issuers').insert({issuer_id:id,canonical_name_en:row.en,canonical_name_zh:row.zh??null,country_code:row.country,cik:row.cik??null});
 if(ins.error)fail(`issuers insert: ${ins.error.message}`);
 return id;
}
async function ensureSecurity(sb:AnyClient,issuerId:string,ticker:string,name:string,market:'US'|'HK'){
 const u=await sb.from('stocks_universe').upsert({ticker,name,market},{onConflict:'ticker',ignoreDuplicates:true});
 if(u.error)fail(`stocks_universe: ${u.error.message}`);
 const {data,error}=await sb.from('issuer_securities').select('issuer_id').eq('ticker',ticker).limit(1);
 if(error)fail(`issuer_securities read: ${error.message}`);
 if(data?.[0])return;
 const ins=await sb.from('issuer_securities').insert({issuer_id:issuerId,ticker,share_class:'common',is_primary:true,valid_from:'2000-01-01',source:'e2e-seed'});
 if(ins.error)fail(`issuer_securities insert: ${ins.error.message}`);
}
function runScript(args:string[]){
 const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--import','tsx',...args],{stdio:'inherit',env:process.env});
 if(r.status!==0)fail(`${args.join(' ')} exited ${r.status}`);
}

async function main(){
 if(process.argv.slice(2).join(' ')!=='--apply')fail('usage: e2e-seed.ts --apply');
 const host=new URL(env('NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL')).hostname;
 if(!['127.0.0.1','localhost','[::1]','::1'].includes(host))fail(`refusing non-local Supabase host ${host}`);
 env('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');
 const email=env('E2E_EMAIL'),password=env('E2E_PASSWORD'),codeVersion=env('VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA');
 const admin=getAdminSupabase();
 const sb=admin as unknown as AnyClient;

 const ids:Record<string,string>={};
 for(const u of US){ids[u.ticker]=await ensureIssuer(sb,{cik:u.cik,en:u.name,country:'US'});await ensureSecurity(sb,ids[u.ticker],u.ticker,u.name,'US');}
 const hk=await ensureIssuer(sb,{zh:HK.zh,en:HK.en,country:'HK'});
 await ensureSecurity(sb,hk,HK.ticker,HK.zh,'HK');

 const files=new Map(US.map(u=>[u.cik.padStart(10,'0'),u.file]));
 const base=productionSyncDeps({deadline:null,codeVersion,admin});
 const deps:SyncDeps={...base,linkCn:undefined,fetchUs:async(cik10)=>{
  const f=files.get(cik10);
  if(!f)throw new ProviderError('no_companyfacts',cik10);
  return snapshotOf(new Uint8Array(readFileSync(`src/lib/facts/fixtures/edgar/${f}`)),{source:'edgar',url:companyFactsUrl(cik10)});
 }};
 const r=await runFactsSync(deps,{market:'US',limit:10,issuerIds:Object.values(ids),dryRun:false,triggeredBy:'script'});
 console.log(JSON.stringify({facts:{status:r.status,detail:r.detail,counts:r.counts}}));
 if(r.detail.failed>0)fail('facts replay failed');

 runScript(['scripts/facts/materialize.ts','--market','US','--issuer','AAPL','--issuer','MSFT']);
 runScript(['scripts/company/digest.ts','--full','--market','US','--apply']);

 const created=await admin.auth.admin.createUser({email,password,email_confirm:true});
 let userId=created.data.user?.id;
 if(!userId){
  const list=await admin.auth.admin.listUsers({page:1,perPage:1000});
  const u=list.data.users.find(x=>x.email===email);
  if(!u)fail(`could not create or find ${email}: ${created.error?.message??'unknown'}`);
  userId=u.id;
  const upd=await admin.auth.admin.updateUserById(userId,{password});
  if(upd.error)fail(`password reset: ${upd.error.message}`);
 }
 const del=await sb.from('company_watches').delete().eq('user_id',userId);
 if(del.error)fail(`clearing watches: ${del.error.message}`);
 console.log(JSON.stringify({seeded:true,issuers:{...ids,'00700.HK':hk}}));
}

main().catch(e=>fail(e instanceof Error?e.stack??e.message:String(e)));
```

脚本与日志都不打印 `E2E_PASSWORD`。若 lint 对 `eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` 报"未使用的禁用注释"（规则未启用），删除该注释行。

```ts
// e2e/company.spec.ts
// spec §12.3 items 1–11 (+ the AAPL filing gold list once transcribed). Prerequisite: a LOCAL Supabase stack
// prepared by scripts/company/e2e-seed.ts and a Next dev server pointed at it (docs/runbooks/company-research.md
// §6). Opt-in: E2E_COMPANY=1 with E2E_EMAIL / E2E_PASSWORD. Decision I default: the HTML report (screenshots +
// traces) is attached to the PR and the reviewer re-runs it once. Item 6 follows decision J's default: no K-line
// and no quote row on the company page.
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { readyExpectation } from '../src/lib/company/fixtures/manifest';

test.skip(
  process.env.E2E_COMPANY !== '1' || !process.env.E2E_EMAIL || !process.env.E2E_PASSWORD,
  'company e2e needs E2E_COMPANY=1, E2E_EMAIL, E2E_PASSWORD and the seeded local database',
);
test.describe.configure({ mode: 'serial' });
test.use({ screenshot: 'on', trace: 'on' });

const PERIOD = '2022-09-25:2023-09-30:12M';

async function login(page: Page) {
  await page.goto('/login');
  await page.locator('input[type="email"]').fill(process.env.E2E_EMAIL!);
  await page.locator('input[type="password"]').fill(process.env.E2E_PASSWORD!);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /登录/ }).click();
  await page.waitForURL('**/today');
}
type GridCell = { kind: string; value?: string; availableDate?: string; disclosureSeq?: number; isRevision?: boolean } | null;
type Grid = { rows: { concept: string; cells: Record<string, GridCell> }[] };
const cellOf = (g: Grid, concept: string, key: string) => g.rows.find((r) => r.concept === concept)?.cells[key] ?? null;

test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => { await login(page); });

test('1 header: English name, security chip, CIK, data status', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/stock/AAPL');
  const header = page.getByTestId('company-header');
  await expect(header).toContainText('Apple Inc.');
  await expect(header.getByTestId('security-chip').filter({ hasText: 'AAPL' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(header).toContainText('320193');
  await expect(header.getByTestId('data-status')).toBeVisible();
});

test('2 statements: revenue row; a cell opens the disclosure drawer by keyboard', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/stock/AAPL?view=statements');
  const row = page.getByTestId('grid-row-revenue');
  await expect(row).toBeVisible();
  const cell = row.locator('button[data-testid^="cell-revenue-"]').first();
  await cell.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  const drawer = page.getByRole('dialog');
  await expect(drawer).toBeVisible();
  await expect(drawer.getByTestId('drawer-available-date').first()).toHaveText(/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/);
  await expect(drawer.locator('a[href*="sec.gov"]').first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(drawer.getByTestId('drawer-transform-chain')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(drawer.getByTestId('drawer-code-version').first()).not.toBeEmpty();
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(drawer).toBeHidden();
  await expect(cell).toBeFocused();
});

test('3 replay asOf=2024-06-30: replay bar, disclosureSeq 1, valuation hidden; latest is seq 2', async ({ page }) => {
  const resp = page.waitForResponse((r) => r.url().includes('/api/companies/AAPL/statements') && r.url().includes('statement=IS') && r.url().includes('asOf=2024-06-30'));
  await page.goto('/stock/AAPL?view=statements&asOf=2024-06-30');
  await expect(page.getByTestId('replay-bar')).toContainText('2024-06-30');

  const gold = readyExpectation('aapl-revenue-fy2023-replay');

  else test.info().annotations.push({ type: 'pending', description: 'aapl-revenue-fy2023-replay: value not transcribed yet (spec §0 #72)' });
  await expect(page.getByTestId('valuation-section')).toHaveCount(0);
  const latest = await page.request.get('/api/companies/AAPL/statements?statement=IS&basis=annual');
  expect(latest.ok()).toBe(true);
  expect(cellOf(await latest.json() as Grid, 'revenue', PERIOD)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'fact', disclosureSeq: 2, isRevision: false });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 8: runbook `docs/runbooks/company-research.md`（全文）**

````markdown
# 公司研究与跟踪运行手册

适用迁移：`supabase/migrations/20261112090000_company_research.sql`（表、索引、触发器、RLS、授权）、`supabase/migrations/20261112091000_company_research_functions.sql`（全部函数与授权）。前提：规格二的 `20261106090000_financial_facts.sql` 已在库中。规格：`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-04-company-research-design.md`（§0 优先）。代码：`src/lib/company/*`、`/api/companies/*`、`/api/admin/companies/*`、`/api/tracking/*`、`/api/cron/company-digest`、`scripts/company/*`。

## 1. 表与权限

| 表 | 读 | 写 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issuer_events` | 仅 service_role（§0 #64） | 只经 `replace_company_digest` | 事实事件；`retired_at` 为墓碑，不删行；`first_seen_at` 跨重建保留 |
| `issuer_coverage` | anon / authenticated / service_role | 只经 `replace_company_digest` | 每 (发行人, 市场) 一行，计数与日期，无财务数值 |
| `company_digest_state` | 仅 service_role | 只经三个 digest 函数 | 物化游标、尝试身份、退避 |
| `company_fact_evidence` | 仅 service_role；公共读经 `company_fact_evidence(uuid[])` | 只经 `replace_company_fact_evidence` | 证据索引（快照 → 事实的全键匹配） |
| `company_watches` | 本人（RLS） | 本人（RLS）；触发器 `company_watches_limit` ≤ 200 | 跟踪；删除级联清回执 |
| `company_event_reads` | 本人（RLS） | 本人（RLS）；触发器拒绝跨发行人 `event_id` | 已读回执按事件 id |

## 2. 迁移应用顺序

1. 确认规格二迁移已在目标库：`select to_regclass('public.financial_facts') is not null;` 为 `true`。
2. 按文件名顺序应用：先 `20261112090000_company_research.sql`，再 `20261112091000_company_research_functions.sql`（与此前迁移相同的应用方式；生产走 Supabase Management API，令牌在钥匙串，不打印）。两份文件可重放；已锁定在 `supabase/migrations.lock.json`，任何修改都要新迁移。
3. 核对：`select proname from pg_proc where proname like 'company_%' or proname in ('begin_company_digest_attempt','replace_company_digest','mark_company_digest_failed','replace_company_fact_evidence');` 列出全部函数；`select has_table_privilege('anon','public.issuer_events','select');` 为 `false`。

## 3. 首轮物化（owner，合并后）

在主检出（有 `.env.local`）运行，先 dry-run 再 apply：

```bash
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/company/digest.ts --full
node --env-file=.env.local --import tsx scripts/company/digest.ts --full --apply
```

- `--apply` 需要代码版本（`VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA` 或 git 检出）；取不到 → `code_version_missing`，不写库。
- 可用 `--market US|CN`、`--issuer <ticker>` 分批。
- 结果看 `ingest_batches`（`producer='company-digest'`）与 `/admin/dq` 的 `company.events` 新鲜度。

### 3.1 cron 与脚本绝不同时运行

`/api/cron/company-digest` 每小时第 20 分运行（`vercel.json`），`recordAttempt('company.events')` 假设单一生产者。运行脚本前：

1. `select count(*) from public.ingest_batches where producer='company-digest' and status='running';` 必须为 0（有则等它结束；超过 10 分钟仍 running，按数据底座手册"悬空 running 批次"处理）。
2. 在两次 cron 之间开始（如每小时 :25）；预计超过 50 分钟的全量用 `--market`/`--issuer` 分批，每批在下一个 :20 之前结束。
3. 数据库层面 `replace_company_digest` 对 `fact_sync_scope` 行 `for update`，并发写不会损坏数据；本规则保护的是新鲜度记录与批次计数。

## 4. 证据索引重建

证据索引在 digest 每个流开始时重建（快照 → 已落地解析器重解析 → 全键匹配；任何不确定 → 不写行，该事实 `evidence_incomplete`）。以下情况全量重跑 `digest.ts --full --apply`：规格二解析器或映射代（`MAPPING_GEN`）变化、`EVIDENCE_INDEX_VERSION` / `EVENTS_VERSION` / `FORMULA_VERSION` 变化、快照桶迁移。若 Task 8 提供了只重建证据的参数，用它；否则用 `--full`。检查：公共 `statements` 响应的 `withheld.evidenceIncomplete` 计数在重建后下降或不变。

## 6. 本机 e2e（决策 I：报告附 PR + 复审者复跑）

前提：Supabase CLI、Docker、`npm ci` 完成的工作树（**不放任何 `.env*` 文件**，否则 `test:db` 拒绝运行）。e2e 的 shell 与 `test:db` 的 shell 分开。

```bash
supabase start && supabase db reset
eval "$(supabase status -o env | sed -E -n 's/^(API_URL|ANON_KEY|SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)=/export SB_\1=/p')"
export NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="$SB_API_URL" NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="$SB_ANON_KEY" SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY="$SB_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"
export VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" CRON_SECRET="local-e2e-cron"
export E2E_EMAIL="e2e-company@example.test" E2E_PASSWORD="$(openssl rand -hex 16)" E2E_COMPANY=1
node --import tsx scripts/company/e2e-seed.ts --apply
npx playwright test e2e/company.spec.ts --reporter=list,html
```

- 种子脚本只接受本机 Supabase URL；夹具账号是本机测试值，不进仓库。
- 种子：AAPL、MSFT（美股夹具回放）、腾讯（仅 HK 证券，用于 F3 空状态）；物化与 digest 全量；清空夹具账号的 watch。可重复运行。
- 若 `supabase db reset` 因 `config.toml` 的 `major_version` 失败：本机临时改为 17，不提交。
- 报告：`playwright-report/`（含截图与 trace）打包附 PR；复审者用同一段命令复跑。

## 7. 跟踪运维

- 上限 200（决策 F）由触发器强制；改上限需要新迁移，并同步 `src/lib/company/db.ts::MAX_COMPANY_WATCHES`（唯一定义）。
- 未读计数是扫描式（每页 200、最多 25 页，每个发行人数到 100 即 `99+`）；扫描未完时显示 `n+`，响应带 `unreadComplete:false`。若用户普遍出现 `n+`，在规格 §16 登记并考虑新增计数函数（新迁移）。
- 收件箱只读未静音的 watch；公司页跟踪视图含静音发行人。回放模式不读物化表、不记已读。
- 取消跟踪即级联删除回执；重新跟踪后旧事件重新计为未读（预期行为）。

| CN 值全部"引用待挂接" | 预期：PDF 逐值定位（规格三）未落地 | 无需处理；admin 用 `/api/admin/companies/…` 查看 |
````

`.claude/scratch/db-one.ts` 内容：

```ts
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { startLocalDatabase, stopLocalDatabase } from '../../scripts/s4/local-db';
async function main(){
  const files=process.argv.slice(2);
  const db=await startLocalDatabase();
  let err:unknown;
  try{
    await new Promise<void>((res,rej)=>{
      const c=spawn(process.execPath,['node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs','run',...files],{stdio:'inherit',env:{...process.env,S4_TEST_STATE:db.stateFile}});
      c.once('exit',code=>code===0?res():rej(new Error('vitest exit '+code)));
    });
  }catch(e){err=e;}finally{stopLocalDatabase(db,err);}
  if(err)process.exitCode=1;
}
main();
```
